bcos 'ga' zhig mdzad/ slob dpon 'di gnyi ga mthar ril bu'i dngos grub grub nas rig 'dzin gyi gnas su gshegs so//'di skabs tsam nas theg chen dbu ma pa rnams kyang tshan gnyis su gyes pa yin te/ slob dpon 'di gnyis kyis dgongs gzhi zhig gis thogs med sems tsam pa kho na yin zhing dbu ma pa gtan ma yin par bsgrubs pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang thogs med zhabs kyi rjes 'brangs phyogs glang sogs kyis rnam rig smra ba'i grub mtha' ji bzhin du bkral ba yin zhing / 'phags pa nyid kyis rnam rig smra ba rnams drang ba'i phyir de dang phyogs mthun tsam zhig bstan pa las/ don du dbu ma nyid zhal gyis bzhes par des mdzad pa'i bstan bcos rnams su gsal lo / /de lta ma yin na klu sgrub dang thogs med gnyi ga 'phags pa'i sa la gnas par ni rtsod pa med la/ 'phags pa nang 'gal can yang srid par thal ba'i phyir ro/ /klu sgrub kyi gzhung lugs la'ang sangs rgyas bskyangs 'das nas de'i bstan bcos la legs ldan gyis dgag pa brjod nas snga ma'i rjes 'brangs la thal 'gyur ba dang / phyi ma'i rjes 'brangs la rang rgyud pa zhes tshan gnyis su gyes so/ /slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis shes phyin gyi gzhung bshad cing / dge 'dun sung gis man ngag phog pa'i slob ma rnam grol sdes kyang byams pas lung bstan pa ltar/ dge bsnyen zhi ba'i go chas nyi khri le brgyad ma'i dpe po ṭa la nas spyan drangs pa dang / wā rā ṇa sīr 'dzom pas der the tshom thams cad chod nas nyi khri rgyan dang sbyar ba'i 'grel pa brtsams so/ /dbyig gnyen dang phyogs glang sogs mkhas pa mang po'i slob ma smra ba'i dbang phyug chen po dkon mchog gsum gyi dbangs kyis brgyad stong don bsdus sogs bstan bcos mang po mdzad/ dra 185—150

ba li'i yul du chos gzhi chen po lnga bcu btsugs nas bstan pa yun ring du gsal bar mdzad do//yon tan 'od kyi sku tshe'i mjug tsam du/ rgyal po shrī tar+ṣa'i bu ngang tshul zhes pa grong khyer lā tar lo brgyar rgyal srid byed cing phyogs bzhi'i dge 'dun zhal zas bzang pos mchod pa zhig byung ste/ 'di dus sgrol ma grub pa'i slob dpon nyi ma sbas pa byung / des slob dpon klu sgrub dang thogs med gnyis kyi bzhed pa gcig tu bsgrubs/ ma ga d+mar chos gzhi bcu gnyis btsugs pa sogs bstan pa la phan par mdzad/ dge 'dun 'bangs kyi slob ma/ gsang bas byin dang /chos 'bangs kyi slob ma rat+na ma ti gnyis kyis ston pa'i tshems mche ba la mchod pa byed cing 'khor mang po la chos bstan/khyad par lho phyogs sa man+tar 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa slob dpon chen po zla ba grags pa byon te/ sangs rgyas bskyangs kyi slob ma ka ma la burnyi la klu sgrub kyi gzhung lugs man ngag mtha' dag gsan/ snga phyir sde snod thams cad la sbyangs pas mkhas pa chen por gyur te na lan+da'i mkhan po mdzad de rtsa 'jug gzhi gsum dang / rigs pa drug cu pa'i 'grel pa sogs bstan bcos mang po brtsams/ mu stegs kyi rgol ba mang po tshar gcad/ lho phyogs kosku na'i yul gyi bram ze dang / khyim bdag phal cher bstan pa la bkod nas chos gzhi mang du btab pa sogs ngo mtshar gyi mdzad pa mang pos bstan pa ches gsal bar mdzad nas sngags lam la brten nas sgyu ma'i sku bsgrubs te gshegs par grags so / /slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mi'ang tshe rabs su spyan ras gzigs kyis byin gyis 105—151

brlabs shing chung ngu nas sgra dang rtog ge sogs thun mong gi rig gnas rnams ma bslabs par shes pa zhig slob dpon blo gros brtan pa las mdo sde dang mngon pa'i sde snod phal cher lan cig nyan pa tsam gyis shes/ sngags kyang grub nas sa steng gi mkhas pa zla med par gyur te rten go mi'i dge bsnyen du bzhugs/ gling phran rnams su byon nas bzo dang sman dpyad sogs rig gnas dpag tu med pa spel bas lhag par phan btags/ de dag tu theg pa chen po'ang ci rigs par dar bar mdzad/ na lan+dar byon te zla grags dang chos kyi bgro gleng gi brgal brtag lo bdun du mdzad pas/ de blta ba'i phyir skye bo mang po rtag tu 'dus te/grong pa'i khye'u dang bu mo tshun chad kyis kyang phyogs tsam rig nas/ kye ma 'phags pa klu sgrub gzhung / /la la'i sman la la la'i dug /mi pham 'phags pa thogs med gzhung / /skye bo kun la bdud rtsi nyid/ /zhes glur len pa byung ngo / /slob dpon 'dis bstod pa brgya dang brgyad/ nang rig pa'i bstan bcos brgya dang brgyad/ phyi rol thun mong gi rig gnas kyi bstan bcos brgya dang brgyad/bzo gnas brgya dang brgyad/ phra mo thor bu ba bzhi brgya dang sum cu rtsa gnyis brtsams pa sogs rgyal ba'i bstan pa mchog tu gsal bar mdzad nas po ṭa lar gshegs te da lta'ang bzhugs so//gzhan yang 'di skabs snga phyi ci rigs par rnam grol sde'i slob ma mchog sde dang / yon tan 'od kyi slob ma 'phags pa zla ba'i nor bu dang / dge 'dun 'bangs kyi slob ma 'phags pa sa ga lha sogs mang pos bstan pa rgyas par mdzad cing / nub phyogs ma la ba'i rgyal po g.yo bas kyang bstan pa la lhag par mchod do / /de dang dus mnyam las cung zad 'phyi ba tsam na/ shar phyogs su rgyal po 105—152

seng ge lnga pa dang / lho phyogs kyi rgyal po me tog dang / ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po gsal ba sogs kyis bstan pa la gus pas mchod pa'i tshe mchog sde'i slob ma dul ba'i lha dang ma ga ṅgār btsun pa grol sde dang / yon tan 'od kyi slob ma mngon pa ba yon tan blo gros dang / slob dpon chos skyong dang / dbang phyug sde sogs kyis 'gro don mdzad pa yin zhing / de las khyad par yon tan blo gros kyis dbu ma rtsa ba'i 'grel pa sogs brtsams/ legs ldan gyi slob ma saṃ pra dra ta dang brtsad pas rgyal bar grags/ slob dpon chos skyong ni lho phyogs kyi snyan ngag mkhan chen po zhig ste/ chos 'bangs las rab tu byung zhing 'dul ba nyan/phyogs glang las sde snod gsum ga mnyan te zla med pa'i mkhas pa chen por gyur/rdo rje gdan du lo sum cu lhag cig tu chos bstan/ zla grags kyi rjes su na lan+da'i mkhan po mdzad/ dbu ma bzhi brgya pa rnam rig tu bkral ba'i 'grel pa sogs bstan bcos mang po mdzad cing mthar lha gnas su gshegs/ 'di'i rjes su rgyal ba'i lhas na lan+da'i mkhan po mdzad de/ de'i slob ma zhi ba lha dang dpal ldan chos skyong rnams yin no//de la zhi ba lha ni sau raṣ+ṭa'i rgyal po'i sras/ tshe rabs su 'jam dpal gyis rjes su bzung ba zhig ste/ na lan+dar rgyal ba'i lha las rab tu byung zhing mkhan po dang / gtso bor 'jam dpal nyid las chos gsan pas mkhas pa chen por gyur kyang gzhan snang du bhu su ku'i spyod pas gnas/ bslab btus/ mdo btus/spyod 'jug sogs brtsams/ uts+tsha ma'i spyod pas yul tha dad du gshegs nas/ngo mtshar gyi mdzad pa mang po bstan pa sogs kyis ston pa'i bstan pa gsal bar mdzad do/ /dpal ldan chos skyong gis kyang na lan+dar bstan pa'i bya ba mdzad 105—153

cing sngags grub nas spyod pa la gshegs so/ /'di skabs nyi ma sbas pa'i slob ma thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen gyis kyang bstan pa la sman par mdzad do//de'i phyi nas slob dpon chos kyi grags pa sogs kyis bstan pa bskyangs te/de'ang rgyal po gsal ba'i bu rab gsal sogs rgyal srid byed pa'i tshe/ mu stegs byed chen po saṅga ra ā tsar+ya dang / bhaṣ+ṭa ā tsar+ya dang / ku mā ra lī la sogs kyis nang pa'i bstan pa mang po nyams par byas pa'i skabs shig na/ tri ma la ya'i yul du dpal ldan chos kyi grags pa byung ste/ chung ngu nas thun mong gi rig gnas rnams dang / rig byed yan lag dang bcas pa dang / mu stegs pa'i grub mtha' la shin tu mkhas pa zhig slob dpon chos skyong las rab tu byung / sde snod gsum la mkhas par sbyangs/ phyogs glang gi slob bu dbang phyug sde las tshad ma nyan pas phyogs glang dang mnyam par gyur/ dpal he ru yis phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi dngos grub stsal/ sngar bshad pa'i mu stegs byed rtsod pa'i khyu mchog tu grags pa de dag dang / gzhan yang mu stegs byed dang / bram ze bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams rtsod pas pham par byas te thams cad bstan pa 'di la bcug /yul thams cad du chos gzhi dang / dge 'dun gyi sdes khyab par mdzad/ tshad ma sde bdun sogs kyi bstan bcos kyang mang du brtsams te/ mdor na chos kyi grags pa nyid kyis/ gal te chos kyi grags pa yi/ /smra ba'i nyi ma nub pa na/ /chos rnams gnyid log yang na shi/ /chos ma yin rnams da gdod lang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dus de tsam na bstan pa'i rtsa lag gcig pu pa yin no/ /de ltar slob dpon klu sgrub/ thogs med/ phyogs glang gsum ni gzhung byed pa po dang / ār+ya de wa/ dbyig gnyen/ chos kyi grags pa gsum ni 'grel pa byed 105—154

pa po ste/ 'dzam gling mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan drug tu grags pa'o//gzhan yang 'di skabs saṃ pra dru ta'i slob ma dbu ma pa dpal sbas dang /spyan ras gzigs kyis rjes su bzung ba ka ma la go mi dang / mngon pa ba dbyig bshes dang / paṇ+ḍi ta a ma ra sidha sogs kyis kyang bstan pa gsal bar mdzad do / /de 'og tsan+da'i rigs kyi rgyal po rdzogs mtshams shig tu na lan+dar slob dpon dul ba'i lha byung ste/ des sde bdun la 'grel pa byas/ slob dpon shu bha mi tra dang / tshul khrims bskyangs dang / shārnyi sau ma sogs kyis rnam rig gi grub mtha' bzung nas/ mdo sde dang / 'dul ba dar bar byas/ dpal sbas kyi slob ma slob dpon ye shes snying po dang / slob dpon tsaspa la pa sogs kyis klu sgrub kyi lugs bskyangs/ bhaṅga la'i bye brag ha tsi pu ra zhes par btsun pa ngo bo nyid med pa byon te/ thogs med lugs kyi dbu ma rgya cher bshad/ tho gar gyi yul du bye smra'i slob dpon 'dul ba 'dzin pa chos kyi bshes gnyen byon/ma ru'i yul du 'dul 'dzin bsod nams grags dang / tsi ta ba ra'i yul du 'dul 'dzin zhi ba 'od dang / kha cher 'dul 'dzin ma khol pa rnams kyis bstan pa spel lo/ /'di phyin cad du rgyan drug lta bu'i bstan pa'i gsal byed chen po mang du ma byon cing / 'ga' zhig byon du zin kyang dus dbang gis bstan pa snga ma rnams kyis ltar gsal bar ma nus shing / sngar theg chen gyi dge slong las nyan thos kye dge slong lhag par mang ba 'di tsam nas rgyal po sogs dbang che ba rnams kyis theg chen kho na mchod pa shas che bas/ nyan thos pa rnams je nyung du song ba'i rgyus theg chen pa mang bar byung ngo //de nas pā la'i ming can gyi rgyal po rnams kyi thog ma bhaṅga la'i yul du tsun+da'i 105—155

rig sngags grub cing klu mo gdug pa can btul nas/ rgyal por gyur pa go sā la zhes bya bas/ o tan+ta pu ri dang nye bar nā len+d+ra zhes bya ba'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs / bhaṅga la dang ma ga dhā gnyis su dbang bsgyur nas de dag tu dge 'dun gyi sde mang du btsugs/ bstan pa la mchod pa rgya chen po byas so/ /'di skabs zhi ba 'od dang / bsod nams grags kyi slob ma shākya 'od dang / dā na shī la dang / bshes gnyen dang / shes rab go cha dang / 'dul 'dzin dpa' bo rnams kyis 'gro don mdzad/ shar phyogs su slob dpon ye shes snying po'ang bzhugs / shākya blo gros dang / ngang tshul bzang po dang / rgyal po'i sras grags pa'i bshes gnyen dang / paṇ+ḍi ta sa'i rtsa lag rnams kyang 'di dus byung ngo / /rgyal po 'di dang / de wa pā la'i mtshams su mu stegs kyi sngags pa nā ra da zhes bya bas ro langs kyi dngos grub bsgrubs pa'i tshe nang pa'i dge bsnyen urgya u pā si ka zhes pa zhig gis de'i sgrub g.yog byas pas/ ro'i lus gser du gyur pa thob pa'i gser la brten te/ ma ga ṅgā'i phyogs gcig tu o tan+ta bu ri'i gtsug lag khang ri rab gling bzhi'i tshul du bzhengs/ dge slong lnga brgya dang dge bsnyen lnga brgya'i 'tsho ba sbyar/ rgyal po de wa pā la rgyal po snga ma las dbang che bar gyur te/ shar phyogs wa ren+d+ra'i yul du so ma pu ri'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs / rnal 'byor pa shi ro ma ṇis bskul cing nag po chen pos lung bstan nas / mtha' skor nas rol mo byas pa tsam gyis mu stegs kyi gnas gzhi chen po bzhi bcu tsam bshig /o ḍi bi shar bye ma'i phung po bsal ba'i 'og nas rdo'i lha khang ngo mtshar can zhig kyang byung ba tsha ba gsum gyi lha khang du grags/ 'di skabs slob dpon shākya 'od kyi slob ma shākya bshes gnyen byung / gzhan yang 105—156

'dul 'dzin dge legs bshes gnyen/ blo bzang ngang tshul/ rdas se na/ ye shes zla ba sogs kyis bstan pa gsal bar mdzad/ lho phyogs kyi rgyud du btsun pa spyan ras gzigs brtul zhugs dang / kha che'i yul du dha na mi tra'ang byung /khyad par du bod yul 'dir bka' drin che ba'i ā tsar+ya bo dhi sa twas 'gro don bskyangs pa'i dus so//de nas rgyal po dharma pā la zhes pa snga ma rnams las kyang shin tu mnga' thang che ba de byung ste/ des slob dpon seng ge bzang po dang / sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs gnyis bla mar brten nas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i bstan pas phyogs thams cad khyab par byas/ shes phyin 'chad pa'i chos gzhi sum cu rtsa lngas gtsos pa'i spyir chos gzhi lnga bcu tsam btsugs/ khyad par du ma ga ṅgā'i byang ngos gaṅgā'i 'gram du ri de'u zhig gi rtse la dbus su byang chub chen po dang mnyam pa'i ston pa'i sku brnyan bzhugs pa'i lha khang / mtha' skor du gsang sngags nang gi lnga khang chung ngu lnga bcu nga gsum/ lha khang gzhan lnga bcu nga bzhi/ thams cad kyi phyi nas lcags ris bskor ba bzhengs te bi kra ma la shī la'i gtsug lag khang du grags/ der gnyug mar gnas pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta brgya dang brgyad/ gtor ma / sbyin sreg rab gnas te sngags kyi slob dpon gsum/ byi pa dang / phug ron srung ba gnyis/ lha 'bangs kyi gnyer byed pa gcig ste/ de rnams la yo byad zla med pas mchod cing / chos nyan pa rnams la'ang dus ston dang /rtag ras 'khor gyi ston mo dang / yon sogs kyis mnyes par byed/ paṇ+ḍi ta re res chos sna re re rgyun tu gsungs pas/ chos gzhi brgya rtsa brgyad dang mnyam par gyur/ 'di'i mkhan pos na lan+t+ra'ang mnyam du bskyangs bar grags/ 'di 185—157

skabs rnam snang mdzad bzang po la shes phyin gsan cing / 'phags pa byams pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i slob dpon seng ge bzang pos tri ka ṭu ku'i lha khang du skye bo stong phrag mang po la shes phyin gyi chos bstan/ brgyad stong 'grel chen sogs bstan bcos mang po mdzad de/ theg chen gyi bstan pa lhag par bskyangs shing nyid kyi slob ma'i mchog sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis kyang bstan pa'i bya ba rgya chen po mdzad do//gzhan yang 'di dus rtog ge ba chen po dge srung dang / mdzes bkod dang /rgya mtsho'i sprin dang / 'od zer 'byung gnas dang / gang la spel dang / ka ma la shī la dang / kha che ba pad+ma 'byung gnas dbyangs sogs kyis kyang bstan bcos rtsom pa dang 'chad nyan sogs kyi sgo nas bstan pa spel bar mdzad do//sangs rgyas ye shes kyi slob ma rab zhi bshes gnyen gyis na lan+da'i lho phyogs su bdud rtsi 'byung gnas zhes bya ba'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs so/ /de nas rgyal po ma su rak+ṣi ta sogs kyi ring la slob dpon rtog ge ba chos mchog dang / dharma mi tra dang / bi ma la mi tra/ dharmā ka ra rnams byung / de nas rgyal po ma hi pā la'i tshe rta dbyangs phyi ma zhig dang / slob dpon gzhan la phan pa dang / zla ba pad+ma dang / ye shes byin dang / ye shes grags pa dang / kha cher 'dul ba 'dzin pa dzi na mi tra dang / sarba dzñā de wa dang / dā na shī la sogs kyis mdo'i bstan pa'i srog 'dzin par mdzad do//de'i 'og tu rgyal po ma hā pā las o tan+ta pu rir nyan thos kyi dge 'dun gtso bor mchod cing / dge slong lnga brgya dang chos ston pa lnga bcu la 'tsho ba sbyor/u ru bā sa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs te/ der yang nyan thos sernya pa lnga brgya la 185—158

'tsho ba sbyar/ bi kra ma lar yang sngar bzhin mchod/ na lan+dar yang chos gzhi 'ga' re btsugs/ na lan+d+ra dang / tri ka ṭu ka dang / sau ma pu ri sogs su'ang chos gzhi mang po btsugs/ 'di skabs rtog ge pa shes 'byung sbas pa dang / dze tā ri chen po sogs kyis bstan bcos rtsom pa sogs bstan pa la bya ba lhag par mdzad/ khyad par phyi ma ni 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis rjes su bzung bas smra ba'i dbang phyug chen por gyur te/ mdo sngags kyi bstan bcos brgya rtsa brgyad mdzad par grags so//de'i 'og tu rgyal po dhe ya pā la lo chung bas de'i zhang po tsa na ka rgyal srid byed pa'i tshe bstan pa'i gsal byed ches mang po dang khyad par bi kra ma la shī la'i mkhas pa sgo drug tu grags pa'ang byung ste/ shar sgo srung ba rtsod dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa rat+na ka ra shārnyi pa/ lho sgo srung ba shes rab 'byung gnas/ nub sgo srung ba ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa/ byang sgo sung pa na ro ba/ dbus kyi ka chen dang po bram ze rin chen rdo rje dang / gnyis pa dzñā na shrī mi tra rnams so/ /de drug po so sor zla med pa'i mkhas pa chen por gyur te/ mu stegs kyi rgol ba mtha' dag bzlog pa dang / mdo sngags kyi bstan bcos mang po brtsams pa dang ske/ ches ngo mtshar ba'i mdzad pa mang pos de skabs kyi skye bo dag chos la btsud de bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa spyi dang khyad par theg pa chen po'i bstan pa nyi ma ltar gsal bar mdzad pa yin no/ /'di skabs rdo rje gdan gyi garnyo la la me'i gnod pa'ang byung mod kyi lha khang dang sku gzugs ma zhig cing shing tshig pa dang ri mo zub pa sogs skyon phran bu rnams slar gsos te/ ma ga dhā la sogs pa'i yul mang por gtsug lag khang dang chos gzhi rnying gso gsar bzhengs 185—159

du ma'ang byung ngo //de 'og rgyal po bhe ya bā la'i tshe jo bo rje dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā nas bi kra ma la dang /o tan+ta bu rir gtso bor bstan pa bskyangs te 'di ni gtso bor gser gling pa brten nas byang chub kyi sems lhag par bsgoms pa zhig yin la mkhas grub kyi yon tan dang bstan pa spel ba'i mdzad pa ni slob dpon snga ma rnams las mi dman par grags so//de dag gi phyi zhig na a gra pā las rgyal srid byed pa'i tshe rat+na ka ra gup+tas rdo rje gdan du bstan pa skyong bar mdzad do/ /gzhan yang 'di skabs rgyal rabs 'ga' zhig gi tshe dī paṃ ka ra'i slob ma pi ṭo ba chen po sogs thugs sras lnga dang /dzñā na shrī mi tra sogs paṇ+ḍi ta sum cu rtsa bdun gyis 'gro don mdzad do/ /khyad par paṇ+ḍi ta sbri ra bā la mtshan gzhan 'bum phrag gsum par grags pa des/ bi kra ma lar shes phyin bshad pas bstan pa la mchog tu phan par mdzad/ de'i 'og tu rā ma pā la ste dga' ba skyong rgyal por gyur pa'i tshe o ḍi bi shar sku 'khrungs pa'i slob dpon chen po a bha ya ka ra gup+ta spyan drangs te rdo rje gdan gyi mkhan po mdzad / phyi nas bi kra ma la shī la dang / na lan+dar yang mkhan po mdzad de/dus de tsam na 'gran du med pa'i bstan pa'i bdag po chen por gyur/ 'di skabs sngon dang mi 'dra bar bi kra ma la shī lar yang chos smra ba'i paṇ+ḍi ta kho na brgya drug cu tsam dang / gnyug mar gnas pa'i dge slong stong de yod pa byung / rdo rje gdan du theg chen pa bzhi bcu re dang / nyan thos kyi dge slong nyis brgya re rtag tu bzhugs/ dus dus su nyan thos pa'i dge slong khri phrag re 'du ba byung /o tan+ta pu rir yang dge slong stong phrag re gnyug mar gnas/ dus dus su theg 105—160

pa che chung gi dge slong stong phrag bcu gnyis re 'dus pa'ang byung / mdor na theg pa che chung gi bstan pa thams cad dang / khyad par shes phyin gyi chos tshul shin tu rgyas par mdzad de rgyan drug gi dus yol nas mkhas pa sgo drug gi ya gyal rin 'byung zhi ba dang / slob dpon 'di gnyis las bstan 'gro'i don rgya che ba ma byung bar grags so/ /'dis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos rnams ni phyi rabs pa dag la srog chad ka ma'i bdud rtsi lta bur gyur pa yin te 'di las phyis 'di dang mnyam pa'i bstan pa'i gsal byed mkhas pa chen po'ang ma byung bar grags pa dang / de ltar mi 'byung bar yang mkhyen nas mi gsal ba rnams gsal bar 'grel zhing / 'thor ba rnams bsdu ba dang / 'khrugs pa go rims su bsdebs pa sogs kyis legs par bshad pa'i bstan bcos rnams phyi rabs pa dag la ngag lon lta bur bzhag pa yin pa'i phyir ro//gzhan yang rgyal po rā ma pā la de nyid dang / yak+ṣa pā la/ la wa se na sogs kyi skabs a bha ya'i slob ma rtsa mi sangs rgyas grags dang / shu bhā ka ra gup+ta / wā gī shwa ra gup+ta/ ra bi shrī dzñā na/ bi khyu ta de ba/ bha sa ka ra gup+ta/niṣ+ka laṅka / nā ya ka pā da/ dharmā ka/ ra gup+ta sogs kyis bstan pa gsal bar mdzad do//de 'og rgyal po rā thi ka se na'i dus su kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shākya shrī bha dra bstan pa'i bdag po chen por gyur/ gzhan yang bal po bud+dha shrī dang / slob dpon chen po rat+na rak+ṣi ta/ mkhas pa chen po dzñā nā ka ra gup+ta/ mkhas pa chen po bud+dha shrī mi tra/ mkhas pa chen po saṃ ga ma dzñā/ ra bi shrī bha dra/ tsan+d+ra ka ra gup+ta sogs sdom brtson gsung rab rgya mtsho'i pha rol du son pa mang po bstan 105—161

'gro'i dpal du byon to/ /de las shākya shrī bha dra ni/ bi kra ma la shī la dang /na lan+da'i mkhan po mdzad nas phyogs bzhi'i mu stegs kyi rgol ba mang po rtsod pas pham par mdzad nas bstan pa la bcug /dge 'dun stong phrag mang po la chos gsungs / o tan+ta pu ri'i dge 'dun khri nyis stong gis kyang bla mar bkur/bstan bcos mang du brtsams pa sogs bstan pa la phyag rjes shin tu che/ bal po bud+dha shrīs kyang bal yul du phar phyin sogs rgyas par byas/ rat+na rak+ṣi tas bi kra ma la shī lar sngags kyi slob dpon mdzad pa sogs thams cad kyis bstan pa la mchog tu phan par mdzad cing ma hān+ta nyi shu rtsa bzhir grags pa'ang 'di skabs so//dus 'di tsam na ma ga bar yang rdo rje gdan du theg chen gyi chos gzhi ni med cing /dbyar gnas la nyan thos sen+dha pa khri tsam 'du/ chos gzhi gzhan rnams kyang med pa ltar song / na lan+da dang bi kra ma la shī lar a bha ya'i dus dang mtshungs kyang /spyir mu stegs je 'phel la song zhing / mu sumān ste kā klo'i grub mtha' 'dzin pa'ang mang du byung / bi kra ma la shī la dang o tan+ta pu rir yang rgyal pos rdzong brtsigs te dmag mi 'ga' zhig bzhag nas bsrung dgos pa yod do//de 'og rgyal po la laṅga se na'i dus an+tar bri di'i yul du tu ruṣ+ka'i rgyal po zla ba zhes pa byung ste/ dge slong gi pho nya'i 'grul gyis rkyen byas nas rgyal po de dang gar log gi rgyal phran gzhan mang po 'gril nas ma ga ṅgā'i yul thams cad bcom/o tan+ta bu ri dang bi kra ma la gnyis car bshig /khyad par o tan+ta pu ri'i rab byung mang po bsad cing bi ha ri'i shul du ta zig gi rdzong bcas/ paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrī shar phyogs o ḍi sha'i yul dza gan+da lar byon/ der lo gsum bzhugs nas bod du byon/ rat+na rak+ṣi tas bal yul du byon/ dzñā nā ka ra gup+ta sogs paṇa chen 185—162

'ga' zhig dang / paṇa chung brgya tsam lho nub phyogs su byon/ bud+dha shrī mi tra dang / badz+ra shrī sogs lho phyogs thag ring por byon/ saṅga ma shrī dzñā na dang /ra bi shrī bha dra dang / tsan+d+ra ka ra gup+ta sogs ma hān+ta bcu drug tsam dang / paṇa chung nyis brgya tsam ra shang dang / mu nyang / rka bo jo sogs shar phyogs thag ring po rnams su bros nas dbus 'gyur 'chang du bstan pa'i dngos gzhi nub bo/ /'on kyang go rak+ṣa'i rjes 'brang na ḍi shwa ra'i sde nyung ngu zhig nang pa nyid du lus pa dang / nang pa'i lha rten sogs lus pa rnams la la waṃ ga se na'i rgyud du tu ru skal lung len dgos pa'i rgyal phran 'ga' zhig byung bas kyang rang stobs la dpag pas mchod cing khyad par rgyal po bud+dha se na'i dus/ ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta rā hu la shrī bha dra na lan+dar bzhugs shing chos nyan pa'ang bdun cu tsam yod par grags/gzhan yang de'i rjes su ci rigs par bhū mi shrī bha dra dang / ka ru ḍā shrī bha dra sogs kyis kyang brtson pa chen pos bstan pa bskyangs par grags so/ /de'i rjes phyi mo zhig tu r+ghaṃ ga la'i rgyal po tsa ga la rā dza zhes pa stobs chen pos tu ruṣ+ka rnams la dbang bsgyur ba des rdo rje gdan du chos gzhi btsugs nas der paṇ+ḍi ta shā ri pu tras chos bshad do/ /yang de rjes phyi mo zhig na rgyal po mu kun+da de bzhes pas ma ga dhar chos gzhi btsugs/ o ḍi bi shar yang lha khang dang chos gzhi 'ga' re byas pa'i gtam snang zhing / 'di skabs rdo rje gdan gyi mkhan po sgra can 'dzin dpal bzang po dang / paṇ+ḍi ta dpal ldan yid kyi shing rta gnyis kyang byung bar snang ngo / /deng sang ni rdo rje gdan du sa t+yā shī zhes pa dat+ta n+t+ra'i slob ma dag gis bzung nas yul dbus su nang pa ni 'ga' yang med do/ /rgya gar gyi shar dang / byang shar ra khaṃ dang / mu haṃ/ tsag dang / rka bo dza 105—163

sogs ko ko'i yul du grags pa'i mtha' 'di dag tu sngon rgyal po mya ngan med kyi dus tsam nas bzung ste bstan pa dar ba dbyig gnyen ma byon pa phan chad nyan thos pa kho na yin la/ de nas dbyig gnyen gyi slob ma 'ga' zhig gis theg chen dar bar byas te/ se na bzhi'i dus su lhag par dar zhing yul de'i rgyal po sho bha dza ta dang / sidha dza ṭi sogs kyis lha khang dang chos gzhi mang po btab nas bstan pa shin tu dar ba deng sang du'ang ma nub par yod pa thos so/ /rgya gar lho phyogs kyi rgyud thag ring por ma ga dhā tu ruṣ+kas bcom phyin chad nas/ bibyā nā ga ra/ koṅku na/ ma bya ra/ ka liṅga rnams su chos gzhi chung ngu mang po rgyas/lho nub phyogs su/ ma ru/ me wa ra/ tsikā wa ra/ pi hu pa/ a bhu/ sau raṣ+ṭa / gu dzi ra tha sogs su chos gzhi mang po dar/ khyad par kha gen+d+ra la sogs pa'i yul du grub chen zhi ba sbas pa sogs kyis bstan pa bskyangs nas/ deng sang du'ang nang ba'i sde 'ga' zhig dar bar yod par thos so gzhan yang sit+ta la'i gling dang / nas gling dang / zangs gling dang / dha na shrī'i gling dang / pa yi gu zhes pa'i gling ste/ gling phran de dag tu sngon nas bstan pa cher dar ba da lta'ang ma nub par yod pa yul de dag tu phyin pa'i mi'i gtam las mngon sum du thos so/ /khyad par sid+dha la'i gling du ni theg chen pa nyung shas tsam dang / nyan thos pa shin tu mang zhing dha na shrī dang / pa yi gu gnyis na'ang theg chen pa cung zad dang gzhan rnams nyan thos pa kho na'o//li yul ni dpal dus kyi 'khor lo nas gsungs pa'i yul drug gi nang tshan bod rgya'i mtshams su yod pa ste/ der chos rgyal mya ngan med kyi btsun mo la sras byung ba sa nur grags/ des yul de bzung nas yun ring lon pa rgyal po bi dza ya 105—164

sam+bha wa'i ring la/ dge slong bai ro tsa na sogs kyis bstan pa spel te/ gtsug lag khang dang / mchod rten bzhengs pa'ang mang du byung / de'i rjes rgyal po bi dza ya bīrnyu'i tshe 'phags yul nas dgra bcom pa bzhi phebs/ sangs rgyas 'od srung gi mchod rten la dgra bcom rnams kyis ngo sprad/ lhe'u do shan gyi gtsug lag khang brtsigs/ de bzhin du nyan thos dgra bcom pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' mang po gshegs te theg pa che chung gnyi ga'i bstan pa spel bar mdzad de/ gtsug lag khang dang dge 'dun gyi sdes khyab par gyur mod/ da lta ni gzugs brnyan tsam las bstan pa rnal ma yod par mi gsha'o//rgya yul du ni ston pa mya ngan las 'das nas lo brgya dang bcu lon pa na/han gyi rgyud las/ ha na min ti zhes bya ba'i rgyal po'i tshe sngon ci'u'i rgyud las/ci'u ji'u wang zhes pa'i rgyal po'i rmi lam gyi ltas rdo rings la bris pa dang mthun par / 'phags yul nas paṇ+ḍi ta grol ba dang 'bar ba zer ba bden pa mthong ba gnyis shig gis theg pa chung ngu'i sde snod chos kyi rnam grangs lnga bcu rtsa gnyis dang ske/ u da ya nas bzhengs pa'i thub pa'i bris sku rta dkar po zhig la bkal nas 'ongs pas bstan pa'i gzhi bting / sa'i ba'i gsi zhes pa'i gtsug lag khang thog mar bzhengs/ paṇ+ḍi ta gnyis kyis kyang dgra bcom thob/ zin shing rnams btul/ dad pas rab tu byung ba mang po byung ste/ dge 'dun gyi sde shin tu 'phel bar gyur/ yang phyi zhig na paṇ+ḍita ku mā ra spyan drangs nas des kyang bstan pa spel/thang gi rgyud pa'i rings la thang dzang dzang zhes pa slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyi slob mar gyur nas theg pa che chung gi chos dpag tu med pa bsgyur/ 'di'i gong 105—165

du chos bsgyur nus pa'i rgya'i lo tsā ba nyis brgya tsam byung zhes grags shing / de dag gis kyang chos mang du bsgyur ba yod pas bstan pa shin tu dar zhing dgra bcom pa'ang mang du byon/de nas me nyag dang hor gyi rgyal po byung gi bar du rgya nag gi rgyal po rabs mang po'i tshe dang / ri nas kyang da lta'i bar bstan pa gnas bzhin la/ me nyag gi rgyal po tha'i hus chos rje dus gsum ma phyin pa spyan drangs kyang ma byon par gtsang po ba btang ba la chos nyan pa dang / hor yul du hor gyi rgyal po jing gi slan gyi tshe zhang tshal pa'i slob ma gtsang pa dung khur bas hor yul du byon pas gnam mchod la dad pa bskyed pa tsam mdzad/ rjes nas me nyag kyang hor gyis dbang du bsdus/ phyi zhig na rgyal po go dan gyis sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta spyan drangs/de'i rjes su chos rje rin po che 'phags pa'ang spyan drangs nas/ go bo la la dbang bskur ba sogs kyis bstan pa gsal bar mdzad/ mo gor gan gyis kurma pa shī spyan drangs pa sogs bod yul gyi bstan pa'ang ci rigs par mchod pa byung /rgya nag phyi ma la min gyi rgyud tha'i dzu rgyal pos bi rū pa dang / gnas brtan bcu drug spyan drangs pa dang / tā min g.yung los chos rje de bzhin gshegs pa spyan drangs pa sogs bstan pa la gus pas mchod pa'i rgyal po kho na byung zhing / da lta tshin gyi brgyud pa 'dir yang shun ci rgyal pos ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho spyan drangs pa sogs nas da lta'i bar bstan pa la gus pas mchod bzhin pa'o/ /'on kyang rgya yul du chos rgyal 'phags pas se chen rgyal por dgyes pa rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pas tā min rgyal por thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dbang bskur zhing khrid btab pa sogs skal 105wa 166

ldan re gnyis kyis gsang sngags spyod pa srid mod/ bod lta bur thun mong du gsang sngags kyi bstan pa dar ba ni ma byung snang zhing / de mthun rgya yul gyi gsung rab rnams su'ang bya rgyud kyi gzungs phran 'ga' zhig las sngags rgyud dngos gzhi mi bzhugs so/ /mdo phyogs las kyang deng sang na theg chen kho na spyod che bar snang zhing / de las kyang 'khor lo tha ma'i mdo rnams gtso bor dar ba zhig snang ngo // //gnyis pa de dag tu gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa ji ltar bskyangs pa'i tshul ni/ rgyud sde chen po bzhi las bya ba dang / spyod pa'i rgyud ni/bcom ldan 'das kyis dzam+bu'i gling 'di nyid du mi rnams la bstan pa dang /gzhan du lha dang gnod sbyin sogs la bstan pa dag las ci rigs par dus de nyid nas bzung ste 'phags pa'i yul la sogs par skal ba can rnams kyis gsang zhing spyad pas sngags kyi dngos grub chen po 'grub par gyur pa mang du byung zhing lhag par theg chen dar ba nas brtsams te rgyas par gyur to/ /de tsam na rnal 'byor dang / rnal 'byor bla med gnyis ni gdul bya mchog gi skal ba can dag la thod rgal du snang ba tsam las rgyun chags par gnas pa zhig ni med par mngon pas/ phyis slob dpon chen po bram ze mda' bsnun zhabs sogs kyi dus nas rgyas shing rgyun chags su gnas pa yin no/ /de'ang bcom ldan 'das nyid bzhugs pa'i dus mnyan yod nas nub tu dpag tshad lnga brgya rgal ba na/ nub phyogs au rtsen gyi yul du rgyal po in+d+ra bhā ti zhes bya ba yod pa des bcom ldan 'das kyi mtshan thos pas dad de phyag 'tshal zhing yid kyis gsol ba btab pas 105—167

bcom ldan 'das byon te/ gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod pa'i dkyil 'khor du sprul te/ rgyal po 'khor bcas la dbang bskur zhing / 'dod yon mi spong bar lam du byed pa'i thabs khyad par can ston pa'i rgyud bstan nas rjes su gdams par mdzad do/ /rgyal pos kyang don de thams cad khong du chud nas spros bcas kyi spyod pa rgya chen po brtsams pas 'khor bcas kyis rig pa 'dzin pa'i gnas brnyes te yul de lan cig stongs so zhes grags shing / de ma thag lho phyogs kyi mtsho zhig yod pa 'phel te klu mang po dang bcas pas yul de gang bar gyur to/ /klu de rnams la lag na rdo rjes rgyud kyi glegs bam gtad cing klu rnams kyis kyang mir bsgyur nas mtsho de'i 'gram du grong khyer byas te 'khod cing / lam nyams su blangs pas phal cher kyis grub par gyur to/ /grub pa ma thob pa rnams kyang mir gyur nas de skyong ba'i rgyal po rnams kyang chos dang ldan pa sha stag tu gyur pa dang / yul de la au byen mkha' 'gro'i gling zhes gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i 'byung khungs chen por 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel gyi sgo mchog tu 'grigs par gyur to / /yang sham+bha la na gsang ba'i bdag po zla ba bzang pos spyir rgyud thams cad nye bar bsdus shing / khyad par dus kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel chen stong phrag drug cu pa mdzad/ grong bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa drug gi skye bo skal ldan rnams la dbang bskur zhing rgyud bshad/ ka lā pa'i grong gi lho phyogs ma la ya'i skyed mos tshal du dus kyi 'khor lo'i sku gsung thugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po bzhengs/ sras lha dbang seng ge'i khri la chos ston par dbang bskur / byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje snying pos dgyes pa rdo rje 'grel pa mdzad de rgyal ba'i sras po rnams la bstan/ lha dbang gis lo brgyar rtsa rgyud bstan 185—168

nas gzi brjid can dbang bskur ba sogs rim bzhin chos rgyal bdun dang /de nas 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa'i sku grags pas rigs bzhi rdo rje'i rigs gcig tu byas te drang srong nyi ma'i shing rta la sogs pa tshangs pa'i drang srong bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi sogs sham+bha la'i skye bo thams cad la dkyil 'khor gcig tu dbang bskur zhing rgyud bstan pas 'di phyin rigs ldan du grags/ nyi ma'i shing rtas zhus pa'i ngor rtsa rgyud las bsdus rgyud btus/ de rjes rigs ldan pad+ma dkar pos bsdus rgyud kyi rgyas 'grel dri med 'od dang / don dam bsnyen pa sogs mdzad de rim bzhin rigs ldan rnams byon zin pa dang 'byon par 'gyur ba ste/ma 'ongs pa na kla klos 'dzam gling chung ngu 'di phal cher dbang sgyur ba'i tshe rigs ldan drag po 'khor los sprul pa'i dmag gis btul te las sa dum bu bcu gnyis su gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa 'jog par 'gyur ba'ang lung las nges pa yin no//ston pa mya ngan las 'das nas lo sum brgya tsam 'das pa sham+bha lar chos rgyal zla bas byin longs skur gshegs ka tsam gyi dus su lā ḍa'i yul du bram ze chen po sgra gcan 'dzin byung / slob dpon rnam par mi rtog pa dang / o ḍi bi sha'i rgyal po bi su kulpa zhes bya ba au byin du byon nas klu las gyur pa'i rnal 'byor mas gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang bskur te grub pa thob pa de sogs bla ma mang po dang /khyad par gsang ba'i bdag po sogs lhag pa'i lha rnams las dngos su rgyud mang po gsan nas mchog gi dngos grub brnyes te spyod pa skyong ba'i tshe sa ra har grags/au byen nas sangs rgyas thod pa sogs rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i glegs bam mang po'ang spyan 'dren par mdzad do/ /de'i tshe shar phyogs bhaṅga lar rgyal po ha ri tsan+d+ra zhes 105—169

pa tsan+d+ra'i rigs kyi thog ma de byung nas/ sngags kyi lam la brten te sngags kyi mthus mngon par bsgrubs pa'i longs spyod chen po la rol bzhin 'khor stong dang bcas te rig pa 'dzin pa'i gnas thob bo//bram ze chen pos kyang klu sgrub la dbang bskur ba dang / rgyud bshad pa dang /man ngag sbyin pa la sogs pa gsang sngags kyi bstan pa gtad pa dang / klu sgrub nyid kyis lhag pa'i lha sogs las gsan te gsang sngags kyi bstan pa yongs su gsal bar mdzad do/ /slob dpon 'di gnyis kyis snga mas sangs rgyas thod pa'i dka' 'grel sogs dang / phyi mas gsang 'dus kyi sgrub thabs gnyis sogs sngags kyi bstan bcos kyang mang du mdzad par snang ngo / /dang po theg chen dar tsam nas 'di'i bar du bya spyod kyi sngags grub pa shas che ba'i sngags kyi rig pa 'dzin pa stong phrag brgya byung bar grags te/ gshin rje gshed kyi sngags sogs bla med la brten pa'ang mang du yod do//klu sgrub kyi grogs po bram ze mchog sred kyis kyang sngags grub ste/ nag po chen po mngag gzhug par gyur nas grub chen brgyad po re res kyang skye bo stong phrag re re'i don mdzad cing / grub pa thob pa stong phrag brgyad byung ngo //de nas slob dpon 'phags pa lhas kyang / spyod bsdus sgron ma sogs sngags kyi bstan bcos mang du mdzad cing rgyud bshad pas skal ldan mang po smin par mdzad do//slob dpon klu'i byang chub kyis dpal gyi rir phug zab mo zhig tu lo bcu gnyis bsgoms pas phyag rgya chen po'i mchog grub cing tshe'ang nyi zla dang mnyam par gyur pa la klu sgrub kyis sngags kyi bstan pa thams cad gtad pa ltar mdzad 105—170

nas 'gro don bskyangs pa dang / grub thob shriṅga pa dang / sha ba ri pa sogs kyang byung zhing 'gro don mdzad do/ /des na mda' bsnun zhabs nas bzung 'di dag gi bar du nye bar gdams pa'i gsang sngags ni/ gtso bor gsang ba 'dus pa / 'khor lo sdom pa/ gdan bzhi/ sangs rgyas thod pa sogs yin par mngon no//skabs 'dir/ rgya nag tu 'khrungs pa'i gshin rje gshed dang / rta mgrin gyi grub thob slob dpon rta mchog tu grags pa'ang byon te/ des au rtsen nas 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud sgyu 'phrul dra ba khri drug stong pa sogs spyan drangs/grub pa'i dbang phyug lū yi pa'ang 'di skabs byung ste/ de ni bram ze chen pos 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur rgyud gtad pas 'khor lo sdom pa gtso bor gyur pa'i ma rgyud kyi bstan pa'i bdag po lta bur gyur/ o ḍi bi sha'i yul du rgyal po bi ma la tsan+d+ra 'khor bcas btul nas bde mchog gi dbang bskur gdams ngag phog pas lo bcu gnyis su rtogs pa bskyangs te/ grub pa thob pa rgyal po dā ri ka pa/ blon po ḍo gi pa/ smad 'tshong ma su kha dhā rī sogs yin zhing / gzhan yang yul der bud med stong phrag bcu bzhi la sogs pa skye bo'i tshogs thams cad grol lo zhes grags so/ /slob dpon 'di dag gis mdzad pa'i sngags kyi bstan bcos dang rdo rje'i glu la sogs pa'ang yod do/ /slob dpon thogs med sogs rgyan drug gzhan dag kyang sngags kyi dngos grub chen po brnyes pa sha stag yin mod kyi yongs grags su rkang tshugs pa'i sngags kyi bstan pa 'di lta bu zhig gsal bar byas so zhes pa'i gtam deng sang ni mi snang ngo //slob dpon zla ba grags pas ma nu r+ghaṃ ga'i rir sngags kyi dngos grub brnyes 185—171

pas zag med kyi skur gyur/ 'dus pa'i rgyan gyi 'grel pa sogs brtsams te pha rgyud kyi bstan pa spel bar mdzad/de 'og na lan+da'i mkhan po rgyal ba'i lha'i slob ma bi rū pa byung ste slob dpon klu'i byang chub la gshin rje gshed kyi dbang dang gdams ngag zhus te bsgoms pas grub/ bdag med lha mo brtswa lnga'i dkyil 'khor dngos su byon nas dbang bskur bas rim gyis sa drug pa brnyes/ bā rā ṇa sī'i mu stegs kyi rgyal po sogs mu stegs byed mang po rdzu 'phrul gyis btul/ au rtsen nas gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud spyan drangs/ de'i sgrub thabs sogs brtsams te 'gro don dang bstan pa la bya ba bla lhag tu mdzad nas spyod pa la gshegs/khyad par dus 'di tsam gyi snga phyi ci rigs par grub pa'i slob dpon chen po mang du byon pa las/ slob dpon sa ro ru ha ste mtsho skyes ni ku ku ra dza ra yang grags shing khyi'i rnam pa can gyi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma mang po dang lhan cig tshogs kyi 'khor lo sogs dam tshig gi spyod pa mdzad pa zla gsang thig le'i rgyud la brten nas grub pa thob pa des au can nas dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgyud spyan drangs/sgrub thabs sogs bstan bcos kyang mdzad/ nang rgyud sde lnga dang / rnal 'byor rgyud rgya cher bshad cing sngags kyi bstan pa rgyas par mdzad/slob dpon la li ta badz+ra ni rdo rje ro langs mas zhal mngon sum du bstan nas gshin rje gshed kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur/ man ngag bsgoms pas drod thob/ rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa mdzad/ au can gyi yul du sngar mtsho yod pa de bskams nas de'i shul du dharma gañdza ste sngags kyi rgyud thams cad bzhugs pa'i pho brang la rig pa 'dzin pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma du ma 185—172

gnas pa'i grong khyer gyis bskor ba yod pa der byon te/ sku gsung thugs kyi gshin rje gshed nag po'i rgyud/ sdom pa gsum pa/ rtog bdun sogs mang po thugs la bzung nas byon/ 'phags pa'i yul sogs su de dag gsal bar mdzad / mngon spyod kyi phrin las kyis bstan la sdang ba'i mu stegs dang ta zig sogs mang po tshar bcad nas bstan pa bskyangs so//de'i slob ma lī la badz+ra gyis kyang bstan pa de'i rgyun bskyangs shing / bi rū ba'i slob ma ko mkhan las grub pa brnyes pa ḍo bhi pas kyang shar phyogs kyi rgyal po sde na ra btul/ yul khams de'i mi phyugs thams cad grol nas mkha' spyod grub/au rtsen nas ku ru kul+le'i rtog pa dang / ā ra khri'i rgyud gnyis spyan drangs/mngon shes kyi rgyud don gzigs pa'i phyir ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang bka' bgros nas/ dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgyud kyi snying po blangs te bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs dang / lhan cig skyes grub sogs bstan bcos kyang mang du mdzad/ḍo bhi he ru gas au can gyi yul du chang 'tshong ma bi na sa btul nas/ des la ba pa la dbang bskur cing rgyud mtha' dag gtad/ lo bcu gnyis mnal 'od gsal du log pas mchog grub/ au can nas dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgyud spyan drangs/swa saṃ be da pra kṛ ta zhes bya ba rdzogs rim gtso bor ston ba sogs bstan bcos mang du brtsams/ au can gyi rgyal po in+d+ra bu dhi pa ra pa dad par byas te mchog gi grub pa la bkod do//slob dpon la pa pa dang / la li ta badz+ra gnyis kyis in+d+ra bu dhi bar pa de thun mong gi grub pa tsam zhig thob pa'i skabs su der byon nas rdzu 'phrul bstan pas rgyal po'i nga rgyal bcag /slob dpon gnyis rang lam gar rdzu 'phrul 'gran 105—173

pas la li tas la ba pa la phyag byas pa'i gtam rgyud kyang yod do//shes phyin tshul brgya lnga bcu pa'i 'grel pa las 'byung ba'i za hor gyi yul du sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor la sogs pa'i rgyud sde bcwa brgyad byon pa yul de'i rgyal po in+d+ra bu dhi la slob dpon ku ku rā dzas bgrol te bshad cing rgyal po 'khor bcas kyis rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor ltar byas nas bsgoms pas thams cad kyis mchog grub pa dang / de'i sras shākya pra bu dhi 'khor bcas kyis kyang de bzhin du bsgoms pas grub pa dang / de'i sras mo go ma de bī 'khor bcas kyang grub pa thob pa sogs kyi yo gi'i lo rgyus 'di ni/ bod 'ga' zhig gis bcom ldan 'das bzhugs dus kyi in+d+ra bhū ti de'i dus su 'chad pa dang / 'ga' zhig gis rab gsal zla ba dang sbyar ba dang / 'ga' zhig gis in+d+ra bu dhi bar pa 'di dang sbyar ba sogs snang yang / spyir au can gyi yul du rgyal po in+d+ra bu dhi'i mtshan can mang po zhig byon par bshad pa mthong yang gong gi ku ku rā dza de au rtsen du byon pa de'i dus kyi gtam yin par snang ngo / /lhan cig skyes grub cig shos kyi gzhung rtsom mkhan gyi in+d+ra bu dhi de ni in+d+ra bu dhi bar pa'i rjes su byung bas dbang po'i blo chung bar grags pa ste phyis rab tu byung nas grub pa brnyes pa'i tshe la ba par yang grags so/ /de'ang lhan cig skyes grub kyi 'grel pa las/ sngon tshe au khyan du lag na rdo rje'i sprul pa drang srong 'gro ba dbugs 'byin gyis rgyal po'i bu mo rol pa mo 'khor bu mo lnga brgya dang bcas pa rjes su bzung / rol pa mos au can gyi rgyal po dpa' bo rdo rje rjes su bzung / des mdun na 'don dam tshig rdo rje/des zhing pa pad+ma'i rdo rje/ des chang 'tshong ma lhan cig skyes pa'i rdo rje/ des tha ga pa dga' ba'i rdo rje/ des bram ze mo rdo rje/ des 'breg mkhan grub pa'i 185—174

rdo rje/ des dpal kun 'gro'i mgon po/ des thugs kyi rdo rje/ des lcam laspyi / des rgyal po in+d+ra bu dhi grol bar mdzad de/ des dur khrod du bsgoms pa'i tshe/ btsun mo sngags 'chang ma rnams kyis bgam pa'i tshe la bar snang bas mtshan de ltar grags so zhes 'byung ngo //grub chen dā ri ka pas 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur cing rgyud bstan pa'i grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po rdo rje dril bu pas au ḍi bi sha'i rgyal po rdzu 'phrul gyis btul/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i phyi dkyil dang / lus dkyil rim pa lnga pa sogs mdzad/ des rus sbal zhabs/ des dza lan+dha rī pa/ des nag po pa sogs rim bzhin grub pa'i gnas su bkod cing thams cad kyis rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa spyi dang bye brag tu bde mchog skor gyi sgrub pa'i rgyun mchog tu gsal bar mdzad do/ /khyad par nag po zhabs kyis yi dam gyis lung bstan pa ltar nag po gzhung drug tu grags pa 'di brtsams te sku drin mchog tu che'o//de'i 'og tu rgya gar shar phyogs kyi yul r+ghaṃ ga lar tsan+d+ra'i rigs kyi rgyal phran pra kā sha tsan+d+rar grags pa de lag na rdo rjes dngos su byin gyis brlabs pas grub pa thob par gyur te rnal 'byor rgyud rgya cher bshad do/ /'di ni yo ga pa rnams kyis sdom pa'i rgyud phyi ma zhes bya ba las rgyal po tsa zhes bya ba zhig 'byung bar lung bstan to zhes zer ba de yin pa snyam yang lung 'dren gyi tshigs bcad de las 'byung ba'i dus dang ni mi 'byor bar snang ngo //de'i 'og tu bi rū pa chung ba byon te/ nub phyogs kuts+tsha'i yul gyi rgyal po bi dha rat+na zhes pa'i lha khang rab gnas la spyan drangs pa'i tshe sngags spyod ngo mtshar bas phyi rol par mos pa'i blon po sogs dad par byas/ bsam mi khyab mdzad 105—175

mkhan gyi tog tse ba che ba'ang 'di dus byung bar snang ngo / /gzhan yang 'di skabs su grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon zhing / re res 'gro ba smin grol du bkod pa'i grangs kyang gzhal bar mi nus pa yin na/thams cad kyi 'phrin las la ni su zhig gis gzhal bar nus/ de nas rgyal po de wa pā la'i ring la nag po spyod pa chung ba byon te/ de ni nag po pas byin gyis brlabs pa bde mchog la brten nas dngos grub brnyes shing sdom pa bshad pa la sogs pa'i bstan bcos mdzad/gzhan yang shākya bshes gnyen dang / rdo rje mtshon cha dang / 'jam dpal grags pa dang / badz+ra de wa sogs byon te/ sngags lam gsal bar mdzad cing / khyad par shākya bshes gnyen gyis yo ga de nyid bsdus pa'i 'grel pa ko sa la'i rgyan sogs mdzad pas rnal 'byor rgyud la phyag rjes che/ 'jam dpal grags pa'ang mtshan brjod rnal 'byor rgyud du bkral ba'i 'grel chen mdzad pa po ste / chos dbyings gsung dbang gi dkyil 'khor mngon sum du gzigs nas dngos grub brnyes pa zhig go//de nas au ḍi ya na'i slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rje byon te/ na lan+dar gsang sngags kyi bstan pa rgya cher spel/ mtshan brjod 'grel pa sogs bstan bcos mang po brtsams/ au rtsen du'ang 'gro don dpag med mdzad nas mthar 'ja' lus su gshegs so//'di skabs gdol ba'i bu zhig gis dag snang du ār+ya de wa mjal te byin gyis brlabs pas chos gtol shes su byung / bsgoms pas grub pa thob/ klu sgrub yab sras kyi sngags gzhung mtha' dag skal ba lta bur rnyed nas ci rigs par 185—176

bshad pas bstan pa spel lo//yang koṅka na'i slob dpon srung ba'i zhabs kyis zla grags dang mjal nas sgron gsal gyi glegs bam yang rnyed do/ /yang paṇ+ḍi ta sgra can 'dzin gyis klu'i byang chub dang mjal te klu sgrub yab sras kyi sngags kyi man ngag thams cad nos par yang grags te/ mdor na 'di dus tsam nas 'dus pa 'phags skor thog mar dar ba yin no//de 'og rgyal po dharma pā la'i tshe shar phyogs bhaṅga la'i yul du grub chen ku ku rī pa byung ste/ 'dis au byen nas ma hā mā lnga'i rgyud spyan drangs nas ku ku rī pa'i chos bdun du grags pa las drug mdzad/ seng ge bzang po'i slob ma sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis au rtsen du byon nas/ lasmri chen mo mnyes par byas/ gzhan yang srung ba'i zhabs dang 'jam dpal bshes gnyen sogs las gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang rgyud man ngag dang bcas pa nos nas bsgoms pas kyang grub ste/ bi kra ma la shī lar sngags kyi rdo rje slob dpon chen po mdzad de kri yog sde gsum dang /nang rgyud sde lnga ste/ 'dus pa/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/zla gsang thig le/ 'jam dpal khros pa rnams dang / khyad par gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud gtso bor bshad pas rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa rgya cher rgyas par mdzad / sgrub thabs kun bzang la sogs pa'i gzhung bcu bzhi dang / gzhan yang gzhung mang po brtsams so/ /slob ma shin tu mang yang gtso bo mchog bco brgyad byung zhing de las kyang mar me mdzad bzang po/ rab zhi bshes gnyen/sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po/ rdo rje bde ba chen po ste bzhis rig pa 'dzin pa'i gnas grub par grags so//185—177

de las rab zhi bshes gnyen gyis gnod sbyin bkol nas na lan+da'i lho phyogs su bdud rtsi 'byung ba'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ rgyal rigs sgra gcan 'dzin bzang pos 'gro lding gi yul du gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde mang po dar bar mdzad/der klu las nor blangs te gsang ba 'dus pa'i lha khang chen po bzhengs/ klu rnams 'dul ba'i phyir klu'i gnas su gshegs te da lta'ang bzhugs par grags/yang ye shes zhabs kyi slob ma sangs rgyas gsang ba dang / sangs rgyas zhi ba gnyis ni rdo rje 'dzin pa gzhan dag las kyang gsang sngags mang du gsan pas/sngags spyi dang / khyad par bya spyod rnal 'byor gsum la mkhas shing / grub pa thob pa yin/ khyad par sangs rgyas gsang bas/ kri yog sde gsum gyi bstan pa rgyas par mdzad cing / rnam snang mngon byang gi bsdus 'grel/ bsam gtan phyi ma'i rgyas 'grel/ rdo rje dbyings kyi sgrub thabs sogs brtsams/de'i 'og tu ma ga d+ma'i slob dpon kun dga' snying po byung ste/ r+ghaṃ ga la na rab gsal zla ba'i slob ma rab 'byor bskyangs sogs mang po la gtugs nas/rnal 'byor rgyud mtha' dag la mkhas par mdzad/ bsgoms pas rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor gzigs shing bstan bcos rtsom par lung bstan thob/ dpal mchog dang po dang / de nyid bsdus pa sogs yo ga'i rgyud mang po la 'grel pa brtsams shing bshad/ gzhan yang gsang ba 'dus pa sogs rgyud mang po'i 'grel pa mdzad de sngags spyi dang khyad par yo ga'i srol shin tu rgya chen por byas so / /slob dpon ye shes byin dang ye shes grags pa sogs kyis kyang bstan pa la bya ba mdzad do//'di tsam na sit+ta lar laṅka rgyal ba bzang po'ang byon te/ 'dis lho phyogs 105—178

koṅka nar dpal reg pa med pa'i mchod rten yod pa'i sar/ sngags kyi theg pa mang du bshad/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud 'grel sogs bstan bcos mang po brtsams / bi kra ma lar sngags kyi slob dpon chen po mdzad do//khyad par 'di skabs shar phyogs dza go'i yul du rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po tai l+li pa byon te/ des tsarla pa sogs bka' babs bzhi'i bla ma bsten/sngags rgyud spyi dang khyad par bla med kyi skor yod do cog gi dbang rgyud man ngag thams cad yongs su rdzogs nas bhaṅga lar lo bcu gnyis su til brdung ba'i spyod pa spyad bas mchog gi dngos grub mngon du mdzad/ gtso bor lhag pa'i lha shrī he ru ka nyid las dngos su rdo rje theg pa mtha' dag gsan cing gzhan la bstan pas r+ghaṃ ga la'i rgyal khams kho na lan gsum du stongs par grags/ mdor na snying po'i nges gsang gi bstan pa nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad do//gzhan yang sngon tshe kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta zab pa'i rdo rje zhes bya bas dur khrod bsil tshal ru sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyi rgyud la brten nas rdo rje nyi ma sgrub pa'i tshe rdo rje bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor gzigs nas lung bstan pa bzhin au rgyan dhu ma sbyi rar byon te/ der mkha' 'gro ma zhig gis bdud rtsi bzhi'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur/ rgyud bshad/ glegs bam gtad/ he ru ka bsgoms pas mchog gi dngos grub thob/ phyis ma la bar skal ldan ni sprang po brgyad la dbang bskur bas grub pa chen po re re thob pa byung / yang phyi zhig na slob dpon bdud rtsi gsang ba rjes su bzung nas dbang bskur/ rgyud bshad/ man ngag byin nas lha yul du 'gro don la gshegs/ bdud rtsi gsang bas kyang mchog grub ste/slob dpon kun snying sogs byon ba'i dus tsam la slob dpon bha go rjes su bzung /105—179

des ro langs dang gter gyi bum pa bsgrubs te 'gro don mdzad/ khyad par ṅgā ka dang nye bar rigs lnga'i lha khang chen po dang / lho phyogs kuṇ+ḍa ṭar rdo rje bdud rtsi'i lha khang chen po bzhengs nas paṇ+ḍi ta dri med bzang po sogs la rgyud bshad pas 'phags yul sogs su legs par dar ba yin no//rgyal po dharma pā la'i ring la bram ze'i slob dpon dpal 'dzin byung zhing /des ye shes zhabs kyi slob rgyud 'ga' re bsten nas gsang 'dus dang / gshin rje gshed kyi skor thams cad thugs su chud/ bsgoms pas grub pa brnyes/ lho phyogs kyi rgyud be dar+bha sogs su nus pa bstan pas sangs rgyas pa dar bar mdzad/rgyal po ma tī pā la'i tshe bi kra ma'i sngags kyi slob dpon yang mdzad do/ /de nas bha wa bha ṭa byon te de'ang rgyud sde lnga bcu tsam mkhyen pa'i mkhas pa chen por grags / de nas skal ldan grags pa byon te rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son/gzhan yang rim pas lī la badz+ra dang / mi thub zla ba dang / ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi ta rnams kyang bde mchog dang / gshin rje gshed sogs kyi sgo nas grub pa brnyes pa'i sngags kyi slob dpon chen po yin te thams cad kyis bi kra ma lar yang bstan pa bskyangs so//rgyal po ma tī pā la'i sku tshe'i smad tsam la shar phyogs o'i sar tsi lu pa'am pi ṭo ā tsārla che ba byon te/ mkhas pa chen por gyur pa des na lan+da dang bi kra ma la shī la dang / rin chen ri bo'i gtsug lag khang du sde snod dang rgyud kyi glegs bam mtha' dag gzigs pa'i tshe/ sngags kyi sbas don mthar thug 'byed pa la byang chub sems 'grel dgos pas/ de sham+bha la na sprul pa'i rgyal pos ston pa yod ces 'dug pa gzigs pa dang / lhag lhas kyang bskul nas sham+bha lar byon par 185—180

dgongs te byon pa'i lam khar rigs ldan gyis sprul pa'i dge slong gi tshul du byon nas byin gyis brlabs shing / dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang rgyud 'grel man ngag dang bcas gnang ba mtha' dag thugs la'ang zin nas thugs tshim ste slar log /wa ren+d+rar piṇ+ḍi ba chung ba rjes su bzung nas dbang rgyud sogs mtha' dag gnang /'dis dmag gi gnod pa byung ba'i tshe rgyud 'grel rnams sbas pa las phyis rtsa rgyud rtsa 'grel ma tshang ba yin no//khyad par wa ren+d+rar dus zhabs pa chen por grags pa byon te/ des tse lu pa chung ba la thug /des kyang thugs ma tshim par shaṃ bha lar byon pa'i lam gar rigs ldan rnam 'phrul zhig dang mjal te/ des dbang bskur/ man ngag bstan / bsgoms pas grub ste shaṃ bha la nyid du brtol/ rigs ldan nyid las dbang rgyud 'grel man ngag dang bcas pa dngos su thob/ tshur byon nas 'phags yul du sems 'grel skor ches dar bar mdzad do//'di skabs slob dpon ka ma la rak+ṣi tas bi kra ma la'i sngags kyi slob dpon mdzad de/ gsang ba 'dus pa dang gshin rje gshed la mkhas/ mngon spyod kyi las shin tu mang ba zhig mdzad pas mkha' spyod du 'byon rgyu ba la cung zad bsgribs par grags so//gzhan yang slob dpon pad+ma lcags kyus kyang yo ga'i bstan pa gsal bar mdzad / khyad par slob dpon dze tā ri byon te/ rang nyid kyi yab bram ze snying po'i zhabs las bde dgyes gsang gsum sogs gsan/ 'jam dpal dbyangs grub pas rig pa'i gnas thams cad la zla med pa'i mkhas pa chen por gyur/bi kra mar chos bshad cing mdo sngags kyi bstan bcos brgya rtsa brgyad mdzad par 185—181

grags/sangs rgyas ye shes kyi rgyud 'dzin nag po dam tshig rdo rjes kyang sngags grub nas bstan pa'i bya ba mdzad/ 'di skabs kyi snga phyi ci rigs par grub chen tha ga na dang bram ze ye shes zhabs kyang byung / rgyal po tsa na po'i ring la bi kra ma la shī la'i byang sgo srung ba'i paṇ+ḍi ta na ro pa ni phyi nang gi mkhas pa sus kyang rtsod par mi nus pas rtsod med de/ des dka' thub chen pos grub chen til+li pa mnyes par bgyis / gzhan yang dus 'khor zhabs sogs bla ma mang po bsten nas rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i dbang phyug tu gyur te grub pa brnyes/ dbang mdor bstan dang dgyes rdor gyi 'grel pa sogs sngags kyi bstan bcos mang po brtsams/ rdo rje theg pa nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad nas spyod pa la gshegs so//shar sgo srung ba rat+na ka ra shārnyi yang na ro pa las dbang rgyud man ngag shin tu mang po yang yang du nos/ bsgoms pas grub pa brnyes/ sngags gzhung mang po'ang mdzad de bstan pa'i sgron mer gyur to//nub sgo srung ba ngag dbang grags pas kyang 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud la bstan nas dngos grub brnyes/ bi kra ma la shī lar tshogs bdag las nor blangs te/gsang 'dus/ bde mchog dgyes rdor/ gdan bzhi rnams la mchod pa'i chos bzhi re re btsugs/ phyis bal por phebs te shān+ta bu rir bde mchog gi lha khang bzhengs / der rab gnas kyi mjug tu 'khor lo sdom pa lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor du sprul pa de ma bsdus par da lta'ang bzhugs par grags so//dbus kyi bram ze rin chen rdo rje'ang 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgo nas grub pa brnyes te bi kra ma lar gsang sngags kyang bshad/ khyad par kha cher byon te gsang ba 105—182

'dus pa 'chad pa'i grwa btsugs so/ /phyis au byon du byon pa'i tshe/ kha che'i yul gyi mu stegs byed mkhas pa zhig khong rang gi lhas bskul nas au byen du phyin/de dang rtsod pas slob dpon rgyal nas mu stegs de nang pa'i chos sgor zhugs/sngags nos pas grub pa thob/ mtshan gu h+ya pra dzñār grags te bod du byon pa'i ā tsār+ya dmar po zhes pa de'o/ /rin chen rdo rje'i sras ma hā dza na/ de'i sras sadz+dza na'o / /dbus kyi ka chen cig shos dzñā na shrī mi tra'ang sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa chen po ste / mtha' gnyis sel ba sogs sngags kyi bstan bcos mang po mdzad do//de tsam na r+ghaṃ ga lar jo bo rje a ti sha'ang byon te/ des ni na ro pa/ ḍo bhi ba / shārnyi pa/ ba ling ā tsār+ya sogs bla ma mang po bsten/ gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde mtha' dag la mkhas par gyur/ mthong lam gyi rtogs pa brnyes/ slob ma rdo rje 'dzin pa'ang mang du byung / mi tī pa ni na ro pa'i slob ma yin la phyis dpal gyi rir gshegs te sha ba ri pa dang mjal/ dbang bskur/ byin gyis brlabs / bde dgyes gsang gsum/ mtshan brjod/ rtog med sogs gsan/khyad par grub snying a ma na si'i skor yongs su rdzogs par gsan nas bsgoms pas grub pa brnyes/ bi kra ma la sogs su gsang sngags kyi bstan pa'ang skyong bar mdzad do/ /gzhan yang de'i 'og tu na ro pa la sogs pa'i bla ma bsten nas sngags kyi dngos grub brnyes par gyur pa rdo rje gdan pa chen po/ a mo gha badz+ra/de ba ā ka ra tsan+d+ra/ pradzñā rak+ṣi ta sogs kyis phrin las bskyangs shing / khyad par pradzñā rak+ṣi tas ni lo bcu gnyis su na ro pa bsten/ bla med kyi rgyud mang du gsan / khyad par ma rgyud dang yang dgos 'khor lo bde mchog la mkhas par 185—183

gyur / 'grel pa lugs bzhi dang / man ngag mtha' yas pa thugs su chud/bde mchog rigs kyi dbang bskur rang yang bdun cu tsam mnga' bar grags/lo lngar bsgrubs pas dngos grub chen po brnyes te sdom pa'i chos gtso bor bshad pas 'gro don dpag med mdzad do//dpal mchog ḍo bhi pa ni ba lang rdzi'u zhig na ro pas skal ldan du mkhyen nas/chang thod phor gang gnang ba tsam gyis byin rlabs zhugs te cig car du chos thams cad khong du chud nas dngos grub thob ste 'dis jo bo a ti sha'ang byin gyis brlabs so/ /ka so ri pa dang / ri ri pa dang / ni ri pa rnams kyang na ro pas rjes su bzung zhing sdom pa yab yum la brten nas grub pa thob pa ste/ 'di dag gis kyang snying po'i bstan pa la bya ba cher mdzad do//slob dpon dpe med 'tsho zhes sbyor drug lugs gcig gi khungs 'ded sa de'ang 'di skabs byon/ khyad par na ro pa'i lcam ni gum ni sngar ming pos sngags lam du smin par byas zin pa zhig /phyis badz+ra dha ras dngos su rjes su bzung nas mchog gi grub pa brnyes pa'o/ /des na slob dpon chen po bi rū pa dang / na ro pa dang / lcam ni gu ma ste/ 'di dag las byung ba'i chos drug lugs gnyis po la sogs pa rnams ni/ bla med kyi rgyud sde thams cad kyi zab mo'i nyams len gtso che ba rnams mdor bsdus pa yin gyi phyogs gcig tu chad pa'i rgyud sde re re'i nyams len gyi srol rkang tshugs pa zhig ni ma yin no//'di skabs rtog ge pa ya mā ri'ang byung ste nor rgyun ma'i sngags grub po/gzhan yang man ka shrī/ kha che ba byang chub bzang po/ sgra can 'dzin bshes gnyen / rgya gar dā re ka pa/ bal po tham steng pa sku mched/ rgya gar phyag na 105—184

sogs kyis kyang sngags kyi bstan pa gsal bar mdzad do/ /de 'og a bha yā ka ra gup+ta rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i dbang phyug tu gyur te/ rdo rje rnal 'byor mas byin gyis brlabs / saṃ pu ṭa'i 'grel ba man snye dang / dkyil chog rdo rje phreng ba sogs gsang sngags kyi bstan bcos kyang zab cing rgya che ba du ma mdzad/ dgung lo brgya nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar du bstan pa bskyangs te bar dor mchog gi dngos grub brnyes so/ /'di skabs na lan+da pa'am/ dus 'khor zhabs chung ba byung ste/des dus zhabs pa che ba la brten nas dbang rgyud 'grel yongs su rdzogs par gsan / na lan+da'i gtsug lag khang gi sgo khang du rnam bcu dbang ldan gyi yi ge dang / de'i gsham du dus 'khor ma shes na gsang sngags thams cad shes par mi 'gyur ba'i sgrub byed bkod pas a bha ya/ rtsa mi/ a bhi yuk+ta/ kha che zla mgon / dā na shrī sogs paṇ+ḍi ta lnga brgya tsam gyis gzigs pas thugs ma rangs te rtsod pa na dus 'khor zhabs rgyal/ paṇ+ḍi ta thams cad kyis gus pas btud de chos nyan pa'i slob mar gyur to/ /a bha ya'i slob ma shu bhā ka ra gup+ta dang /shiska laṅka de ba sogs rdo rje 'dzin pa mang du byon te/ slob dpon de'i man ngag dang bshad srol shin tu rgyas par gyur to//de las khyad par du grub pa brnyes pa rat+na rak+ṣi tas bi kra ma la shī lar sngags kyi slob dpon chen po mdzad/ sdom 'byung gi 'grel pa sogs brtsams nas snying po'i bstan pa'i bdag por gyur to/ /bi khyu ta de wa chos 'byung zhi bas kyang a bha ya brten nas grub pa brnyes/ rdo rje gdan gyi mkhan po mdzad/ de rjes ma hān+ta nyi shu rtsa bzhir grags pa sogs byin rlabs dang nus pa phul byung mnga' bas bstan pa skyong bar mdzad pa yang dag cig byung ba thams cad sngags kyi rdo rje 105—185

'dzin pa chen po sha dag yin no/ /phyi mo zhig na paṇa chen pa na rat+na'ang rgya gar shar phyogs su byon te grub thob chen po sha ba ri dbang phyug gis rjes su bzung bas gsang sngags kyi grub pa'i dbang phyug rdo rje'i slob dpon chen por gyur pa zhig ste/ bod yul 'dir yang gsang sngags kyi tshul la shin tu bka' drin che'o//de 'og 'phags yul lho phyogs su/ kha gen+d+rar rdo rje slob dpon zhi ba sbas pa'ang byon te/ des yul phyogs kyi rgyud de dag dang ko ku'i yul sogs su gsang sngags kyi bstan pa shin tu gsal bar mdzad do/ /de bzhin du phyis rgya gar lho phyogs dang / shar phyogs ko ki'i yul sogs su gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa shin tu dar bar yod pa las/ deng sang gi gnas skabs su ji ltar gyur pa'i khungs gsal ka ni ma thos so/khyad par 'gro lding gi yul du thog mar slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis sngags kyi bstan pa ches dar bar mdzad de/ mar me mdzad bzang pos kyang byon pas 'phags yul du phyis mi bzhugs pa'i rgyud mang po'ang der bzhugs par grags shing da lta'ang sngags kyi bstan pa dar bzhin pa yin no// //gnyis pa bod yul du bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa ji ltar byon pa'i tshul la mdo sngags gnyis las/ dang po la'ang 'dul ba/ mngon pa/ mdo sde'i bstan pa ji ltar phebs shing bskyangs pa'i tshul gsum mo/ /de la dang po bstan pa'i gzhi ma 'dul ba ji ltar dar ba'i tshul ni/ sngon bod kyi yul 'dir chos kyi rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis za hor gyi mkhan po bo dhi sa ta'am shān+ta rak+ṣi ta ba la yul du bzhugs pa gsan nas rba gsal snang pho nyar btang ste spyan drangs/185—186

gus pa chen pos nye bar bsnyen/ 'phags yul nas yod smra'i dge slong bcu gnyis kyang spyan drangs/ skabs shig bod kyi mi la rab byung btub bam mi btub sad pa'i phyir/ zhang blon dad pa can rba khri gzigs rab tu byung bar rgyal pos gsol bas/ bo dhi sa twas mkhan po mdzad de/ rab tu phyung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs / mtshan dpal dbyangs/ btsan pos bsngags pas rba rat+nar yang grags / bsgoms pas mngon shes lnga'ang grub par gyur to/ /de nas rim bzhin rba gsal snang dang / pa gor be+e ro tsa na/ ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs / rma rin chen mchog /'khon klu'i dbang po srung ba/ las sum rgyal ba byang chub rnams rab tu byung zhing / ming ye shes dbang po sogs su spos/bsnyen par rdzogs/ de bdun la sad mi bdun du grags/ de nas rgyal pos kyang bod la rab byung btub par dgongs nas/ zhang blon dra ma dang /'bangs blo gsal ba sum brgya tsam rab tu byung / skye bo thams cad kyis rje'i bka' nyan cing / rje 'bangs thams cad kyis rab tu byung ba dbu'i mchod gnas su phyung nas/ phyag mchod bkur sti bya ba'i chos kyi bka' khrims chen mo bcas / bka' gtsigs kyi rdo rings btsugs/ ska cog sogs kyis 'dul ba lung sde bzhi bsgyur te/ mdor na mkhan slob de dag gis/ gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i 'dul ba'i bshad pa dang / lag len mtha' dag thog mar gsal bar mdzad de/ bstan pa'i gzhi bting bar grags so/ /shān+ta rak+ṣi ta nas rim bzhin rba rat+na/ sangs rgyas ye shes/ ska ba 'od mchog grags/de'i mkhan bu smar g.yo gtsang gsum ste/ 'di gsum gyis glang dar mas bstan pa bsgrubs pa'i tshe/ 'dul ba drel khal gcig bkal nas/ gar log dang 105—187

hor yul du phyin kyang bstan pa spel ma btub ste khams su byon/ rma lung rdo rje'i brag ra an chung gnam rdzong ngam/ dan tig shel gyi yang dgon du bsgom zhing bzhugs pa'i tshe/ dmu gzugs la 'bar gyis bltar phyin pas dad de/ rab tu dbyung bar zhus pa la/ smar gyis mkhan po dang g.yos slob dpon byas te rab tu byung / mir shākya dge ba rab gsal du btags/ bsnyen rdzogs zhus pas dge slong lnga ma tshang ba dang / 'dan du lha lung dpal rdor bzhugs pa btsal kyang kho bos rgyal po sdig can bsad pas kha skong mi 'ong gi 'on kyang gzhan btsal nas btang ngo zhes rgya'i hwa shang ke wang dang / gyi phan gnyis mngag ste lnga'i tshogs kyis bsnyen par rdzogs/ mkhan slob rnams las 'dul ba lo bco lngar nyan/ bla chen shākya dge ba rab gsal gyis bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo lnga lon pa dang / dbus gtsang mi bcus khams su 'ongs pa la stan thog gcig tu tshigs gsum rim nod kyis tshig rdzogs su bsnyen par rdzogs te/ 'di lta bu'i tshig rdzogs mdzad pa dang / bstan pa'i yan lag lo bcu ma tshang ba sogs ni bla chen 'di byang sems mos spyod par grags shing / de skabs smar g.yo gtsang gsum gyis gang zag khyad par can yin pa dang / bstan pa'i 'phel 'grib mtshams su thug pa'i dgos gal che ba la ni de ltar rung ngo zhes gnang ba byin pas skyon med do zhes bla ma kha cig gsungs la/ 'ga' zhig ni 'dul ba'i lag len rtsing ger spyad pas nongs so zhes zer ro/ /dbus gtsang mi bcus yar byon te bstan pa'i me ro bslang bar mdzad pa yin no/ /smad 'dul 'di'i bshad rgyun ni/ 'phags yul gyi slob dpon dā na shī la dang / dzi na mi tra gnyis la cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis gsan/ de nas rim bzhin smar g.yo 185—188

gtsang gsum/ bla chen/ grum ye shes rgyal mtshan/ klu mes tshul khrims dbang phyug /gzus rdo rje rgyal mtshan te/ 'di nas stod 'dul gyi bshad rgyun dang gcig tu 'dres so//stod 'dul du grags pa ni glang dar mas bstan pa bsnubs pa'i rjes bod sil bur 'thor yang / stod mnga' ris su chos rgyal gyi gdung las chab srid zhwa tsam zhig chags pa'i skabs bstan pa phyi dar gyi mgo rtsom pa'i dus su/ lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis 'phags yul nas paṇ+ḍi ta dharma pā la spyan drangs nas pā la gsum sogs mang po rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs su bcug /de las pradzñā pā la'i mkhan bu zhang zhung rgyal ba'i shes rab/ des paṇ+ḍi ta mang po la gtugs shing —/ khyad par bal po'i 'dul 'dzin pre ta ka las 'dul ba'i lag len thams cad la mkhas par spyangs/ kha che dzñā na shī las so thar mdo'i 'grel pa 'dul ba bsdus pa dang / kha che shrī su bhā ti shān+ta las sum brgya pa rtsa 'grel/sa man+ta shrī dzñā na las k+ṣa ri ka lnga bcu pa dang lo dri ba gnyis sogs legs par mnyan nas 'gyur bcos dang bsgyur cing bshad pa sogs kyis legs par gtan la phab/ zhang zhung ba'i slob ma lo tsā ba dpal 'byor gyis bal bo dza ya ka ra las dge slong gi kā ri ka dang / kha che par hi ta dang ma hā dza na las dge tshul gyi bslab pa'i gzhi mdo rnams gsan cing de dag las rim par brgyud de dar ba yin no/ /'di'i bshad rgyun ni/ dzi na dā na gnyis las shākya se na/ dharma pā la / klubs lo tsā dang / skyogs 'dul 'dzin gnyis/ de gnyis la gzus kyis thug ste/ de nas stod smad kyi bshad rgyun gcig 'dres de nyid gzus kyi bu bzhir grags pa/ 'dzim pa shes rab 'od dang sne so grags pa rgyal mtshan te 105—189

gtsang gi bu gnyis/ sngo chung tshul khrims bla ma dang glan tshul byang ste dbus kyi bu gnyis rnams las rgya cher 'phel pa yin no/ /bshad rgyun 'di las phyis mtsho sna pa chen po byon te mnal lam du yon tan 'od las mdo rtsa gsan/ mgon po trak+ṣad kyis bskul nas 'dul ba'i rnam bshad nyi ma'i 'od zer sogs brtsams te 'dul ba'i bstan pa gzhi bzhengs su btang ba yin no/ /de bzhin du gzhan yang bya 'dul ba 'dzin pa sogs 'dul ba'i bstan 'dzin mang du byung ngo //khyad par kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī khro phu lo tsā bas bod du spyan drangs/ dbus su phebs pa'i tshe chu shul prog ma dgon du mi bcu gcig gis bsnyen rdzogs nyin gcig la bsgrubs pa'i nang nas kher gad byang chub dpal dang gtsang pa rdo rje dpal gnyis kyi rgyun las deng sang gi bar du sa dge dkar gsum sogs thams cad la sdom rgyun 'dis khyab pa yin no/ /paṇa chen 'dis snar klas mo cher dbyar gnas mdzad skabs/ sa ga'i lhas mdzad pa'i 'dul ba me tog phreng rgyud gsungs pa/ seng ge zil gnon dang shang pa jo stan gnyis kyis gsan nas so sos ṭīka byas/ snga ma la tshad ma'i skyes bus gsan/ de la bu ston gyis gsan te ṭīka chen yang brtsams mod kyi ha cang dar che ba ma byung zhing / 'dul ba'i bstan bcos kyi nang nas gtso bor mdo rtsa 'grel bcas nyid bstan pa snga dar nas brtsams te da lta'i bar shin tu dar ro/ /'di dag tu sprul pa'i lo tsā ba mang pos 'dul ba'i bstan bcos mang du bsgyur ba deng sang bstan 'gyur gyi khrod du bsta ka bcwa brgyad tsam bzhugs pa 'di dag go// //gnyis pa theg pa che chung gi mngon pa'i sde snod ji ltar dar ba'i tshul ni/105—190

————— wa —sngon bstan pa snga dar gyi tshe paṇ+ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / lo tsā ba ska ba dpal brtsegs sogs kyis gdags pa'i bstan bcos las/ 'jig rten gdags pa/rgyu gdags pa/ las gdags pa gsum dang / thogs med kyis mdzad pa'i theg chen gyi mngon pa kun las btus dang / dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i nyan thos par grags pa'i mngon pa mdzod kyi gzhung / de'i rang 'grel dang 'grel pa rgyal sras ma sogs bsgyur nas bshad/ de dag gi slob ma sna nam zla ba'i rdo rje dang / lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje/ dbas ye shes rgyal ba gsum las/ phyi mas khams su byon nas grum rgyal ba'i ye shes la bshad pa sogs nas mngon pa'i 'chad nyan gangs ri'i rgyun 'dir da lta'i bar shin tu dar bar byung ngo / /'gos lo sogs kyis brgyud pa 'di nas dar ba ni mngon pa gong ma kho na yin la/mdzod kyi bshad srol la brgyud pa bstar chags 'dred rgyu med par smras kyang /bshad srol 'di las kun btus gtso cher dar ba ni byung srid mod kyi/ mdzod 'grel pa dang bcas pa'ang 'di las nges par 'byung dgos te/ kun mkhyen bu byigs mkhas pa thams cad kyis brgyud khungs 'di nyid gtso bor smos pa'i phyir yang na ro pa'i slob ma paṇ+ḍi ta smṛ ti dzñā na bod du byon nas khams kyi 'dan klong thang du mngon pa mdzod kyi bshad pa mdzad pa'i tshe mkhas btsun mang du 'dus pas mngon pa 'og ma'i bstan pa gzhi bzhengs su btang ste/ de'i slob ma g.yas chen po shes rab grags sogs kyis dbus gtsang khams gsum du spel bas mdzod kyi bshad pa gtso bor dar ba ni 'di las byung ba yin no//yang paṇa chen shākya shrīs sa skya paṇa chen la mdzod kyi bshad pa gnang zhing /105—191

sa paṇa gyis mnal lam du dbyig gnyen las zla gcig bar du gsan pa'i thugs nyams byung bas brgyud pa 'di las byung ba'i bshad srol yang khyad par du 'phags pa zhig go/ /bod yul 'dir mkhas pa dang mi mkhas pa sna tshogs zhig gis mngon pa gong 'og gi 'grel pa brtsams pa shin tu mang zhing / snga phyir lo tsā ba rnams kyis bsgyur ba'i bstan bcos mngon pa gong ma la pusti gnyis tsam zhig dang 'og ma la pusti dgu yod do// //gsum pa mdo sde'i bstan pa ji ltar phebs pa'i tshul la gsum las/ 'khor lo dang por gtogs pa 'dul ba dang mngon pa 'og ma'i phyogs ni bshad zin la/mdo sde'i phyogs las sngon 'phags yul du bka' bsdu dang po'i tshe bsdus pa rnams rim gyis nyams pas/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyi skabs na nyan thos pa rnams la grags pa'ang phal che ba zhig nub zin par gsal te rnam bshad rigs pa las/ bla ma kun dga' 'od sel dang / /sdug bsngal phung ston sa ston dang / /'char ka stong nyid chu las skyes/ /gang po sa 'tshe chu shing dang / /mya ngan 'das dang yul 'khor skyong / /'gro ba'i mdo dang de bzhin gzhan/ /yang dag bsdus pa'i gzhi nyams phyir/ /mtha' dag min par rtogs pa yin/ /zhes bshad pa'i phyir dang / de skabs yod pa rnams las kyang phyis je nyung du song zhing / de las lhag par bod du snga phyi ci rigs par 'gyur ba ni nyung shas tsam du mngon te mdo sde las brgya pa sogs so/ /'on kyang 'di dag la bklag lung gi rgyun tsam ma gtogs bshad srol chen po byung ba'i lo rgyus ni ma mthong ngo //'khor lo bar pa shes phyin skor ni 'phags yul na bzhugs pa'i mdo thams 105—192

cad bod du byon pa yin te/ bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su rlangs khams pa go chas 'phags yul du byon te shes phyin 'bum pa thugs la bzung nas bod du legs par bsgyur/ rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis theg chen gyi chos la gus pa chen pos nyid kyi mtshal khrag dang ra dkar mo'i 'o ma sbyar nas bris pas dum pa bzhi byung ba reg zig dmar po grags te/ lha sa gong gi so phag mchod rten gyi nang du bzhugs yod par bshad do/ /yang dbas mañdzu shrī/ nyang in+da wa ro gnyis kyis rgya gar nas dpe blangs te bsgyur ba/ btsan po'i dbu skra'i gzhob rams dang ra dkar mo'i 'o ma la sbyar nas bris pa reg zig sngon por grags pa pod bzhi ma zhig kyang byung bar grags/ de ltar reg zig sngo dmar gnyis po ni 'gres rkang thams cad mi rgyas pas/ pa gor bai ro tsa nas slar yang zhu chen mdzad de 'gres rkang chad pa sogs bsabs/ tshig sna bsrings te brjod bde bar bsgyur/ 'di dus lo tsā chen po nyid kyis phyag bris mdzad de bzhugs snod las 'bum sha sgro can du grags pa da lta'ang mchims phu na bzhugs/ gzhan yang 'gyur mi 'dra ba 'ga' zhig byung bar grags shing nyi khri dang brgyad stong pa sogs kyang bsgyur/'grel pa'i skor yang rda ṣ+ṭa se na'i 'bum ṭīka dang / yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi gzhung 'grel yum gsum gnod 'joms su grags pa dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa sogs bsgyur/ bshad pa dang nyams len gnyi ga'i rgyun yang rgya cher byung mod kyi bar skabs su dbus gtsang du nyams par gyur/ bstan pa phyi dar la lo chen rin chen bzang pos 'phags yul du byon te paṇ+ḍi ta gu ṇa mi tra las mngon rtogs rgyan 'grel pa dang bcas pa gsan/ des shar phyogs pa zla ba bzang po/ des slob dpon brtan skyong / des rngog lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab 105—193

la brgyud de/ shes phyin gyi mdo'i sbas don mngon rtogs kyi rim pa gsal bar byed pa'i gzhung 'grel rnams kyi 'chad nyan ches dar bar gyur to//yang jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti shas 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas la par phyin gyi bshad pa legs par stsal/ a ti sha dang lo chen rin bzang gnyis kyis 'grel bshad rtogs dka'i snang ba bsgyur/ brgyad stong pa dang / nyi snang dang /brgyad stong 'grel chen sogs sngar bsgyur ba mang po la zhu dag mdzad/ 'brom ston gyis 'brom stong btsan nam mgo bla ma la bshad pa sogs kyis bshad srol che ba zhig byung ba yin no/ /yang jo bo rje nas khu chen po lha ldings pa sogs brgyud pa'i bshad srol cig kyang byung ngo / /yang jo bos phywa dar ston la bshad pas phar phyin khams lugs su grags pa'ang dar/ de dag las blo ldan shes rab kyis bal yul pham thing gi gtsug lag khang na bzhugs pa'i 'bum las ting nge 'dzin gyi ming chad pa bsabs pa sogs 'gyur bcos kyang mdzad/ mngon rtogs rgyan rtsa 'grel 'ga' zhig kyang 'gyur bcos dang gsar 'gyur ci rigs par mdzad de de dag gi bshad pa'ang dpyis phyin par gtan la phab/ de nas dge bshes 'bro shes rab 'bar gyis bstan pa snga dar gyi bshad rgyun khams su 'phos pa las byung ba'i rgyun dang / jo bo dang rin bzang gi bshad rgyun rnams gcig dril gyi bshad srol chen po btod pa ar byang chub ye shes kyis bzung ste bstan pa 'di la bya ba che thang du mdzad/ de nas bzung ste da lta'i bar 'chad nyan ma nub par yod pa 'di lags shing / bod yul du sher phyogs kyi bstan bcos rtsom mkhan yang shin tu mang bar byung ngo / /yang rngog lo'i slob ma gro lung pa blo gros 'byung gnas kyi bshad srol la brten nas phyis dge bshes phywa pas kyang spel lo/ /phar 105—194

phyin gyi dngos bstan stong nyid kyi rim pa bshad pa dang / nyams su len pa dag la dbu ma par grags pas de ni dang por paṇ+ḍi ta dzñā na gar+bha dang / cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis dbu ma rtsa ba'i shes rab dang / de'i 'grel pa shes rab sgron ma sogs kyi gzhung bsgyur bshad mdzad pa sogs nas dar yang / phyi dar la lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab kyis shes rab sgron ma gtso bor gyur pa'i gzhung la 'chad nyan mdzad nas ches dar ba yin zhing / khyad par pa tshab lo tsās kha cher byon nas/sadz+dza na'i sras gnyis sogs la bsten te lo nyi shu rtsa gsum du sbyangs pa mdzad nas/bod du rtsa 'jug gzhi gsum sogs kyi 'grel pa zla bas mdzad pa'i rigs rnams bsgyur / 'chad nyan gyi sgo nas legs par gtan la phab/ de'i slob ma gtsang pa sar sbos dang / rma bya byang brtson sogs mang pos dbus gtsang du spel bas dbu ma'i bshad rgyun rgya cher dar ba deng sang yang yod do/ /de'i nyams len gyi rgyun yang jo bo rje nas 'brom rgyud gtso bor bka' gdams rin po che la dar zhing / de lta'i bshad sgrub kyi rgyun gnyi ga'ang rang stong smra ba'i lugs dang /de las kyang thal 'gyur ba'i phyogs te 'di la bod kyi slob dpon ṭī ka byed pa'ang mang zhig byung ngo / /de'i gseb tu rang rgyud kyi grub mtha' smra ba'ang thar thor byung med kyi de dag gi bshad srol gyi rgyun chen po tshugs pa zhig ni ma byung bar mngon no//'khor lo tha ma'i mdo sde rnams ni shin tu rgya che na'ang / phyi nas 'phags yul du'ang cher mi bzhugs pa gong du smos zin pa ltar la/ de las bod du byon pa ni/ phal po che dang / dkon brtsegs dang / lang gshegs sogs phyis rgya gar du gang bzhugs las kyang phal che ba zhig yin gyi yongs su rdzogs par bsgyur 105—195

ba ni ma yin te/ rgya gzhung rnams su lung khungs smos pa rnams las mang po 'dir mi bzhugs pa'i phyir ro/ /de'ang bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po ston pa'i mdo phal che ba zhig bstan pa snga dar gyi skabs su bsgyur ba yin zhing / phyi 'gyur yang ci rigs par yod la/ de dag gi dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos kyang snga dar phyi dar gnyi ga la ci rigs par bsgyur ba yin zhing / de dag gi bshad srol yang mang du yod pa las/ gtso bor ni phyis lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab kyis slob dpon sadz+dza na las mdo sde rgyan dang rgyud bla ma/ chos nyid rnam 'byed/ dbus mtha' rnam 'byed rnams kyi gzhung 'grel bshad pa dang bcas pa gsan nas slob ma rnams la bstan pa dang rgya cher 'phel te/ phyis gtsang nag pa dang / kun mkhyen rang byung zhabs dang / jo mo nang pa sogs kyis rtsal du bton nas bshad pas 'khor lo mtha' ma'i snying po'i don ches cher gsal bar gyur pa yin no / /des na 'di dag ni dbu ma gzhan stong gi srol legs par 'dzin pa po yin zhing / srol 'di las ṭīka chen mdzad po'ang mang du byon te/ kha cig lugs 'di la sems tsam par 'chad pa ni shin tu nor ro/ /yang grwa pa mngon shes kyi mkhan bu btsan kha bo ches sadz+dza na las rgyud bla sogs zhus/ lcang ra ba sogs slob ma rnams la bshad nas/ phyi mo bar du bshad srol byung ba ni sems tsam gyi grub mtha' smra ba'i lugs su nges te/ lugs de'i yig cha rnams su gnyis stong gi shes pa rang rig rang gsal bden grub pa de sangs rgyas kyi rgyu grungs por khas blangs pa'i phyir ro// //gnyis pa gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa ji ltar byon pa'i tshul ni/ bstan pa snga 185—196

dar gyi dus su chos rgyal tho tho ri snyan shal gyi dus su dpang skong phyag brgya pa/mdo za ma tog /tsin+ta ma ṇi'i gzungs kyi bkol phor sogs yum bu bla mkhar gyi rtser babs pa der gnyen po gsang ba zhes pa'i mtshan gsol nas mchod pa byed pa tsam byung bas dam pa chos kyi dbu brnyes/ de nas srong btsan sgam po'i dus rgya gar gyi slob dpon ku sa ra dang / bram ze shaṅka ra/ bal po shī la mañdzu sogs byon te lo tsā ba thon mi saṃ bho ṭa sogs kyis byas nas spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo rgyud nyi shu rtsa gcig sogs bsgyur/ slob ma skal ldan rnams la rgyal po nyid kyis de dang 'tsham pa'i yi dam lha'i dkyil 'khor sprul nas dbang bskur man ngag phog pas grub pa thob pa'ang mang du byung bar grags/ de nas btsad po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba spyan 'dren du dbas mañdzu shrī sogs btang yang ma byon par kri yog sde gsum bshad pa nyan/ nyid kyi 'grel pa rnams gnang ba khyer te slar 'ongs nas btsan po la'ang phul/ slob ma rnams la'ang bshad pas dar bar gyur/khyad par slob dpon chen po pad ma 'byung gnas spyan drangs te/ des bod kyi lha srin gdug pa can rnams btul/ zan yang lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa la rab tu gnas pa mdzad/ chos gter dang nor gter dpag tu med pa sbas/ sngags kyi rgyud sde bzhi dang khyad par bla med kyi rgyud rnams bshad pa dang / dbang bskur man ngag sbyin pa sogs gsang sngags kyi bstan pa nyin mo lta bur mdzad/ gzhan yang slob dpon shān+ti gar+bha dang sngags 'chang dharma krirti sogs kyis kyang sngags rgyud bsgyur zhing bdud 'dul sngags pa gling du dbang bskur ba dang rgyud bshad pa sogs mdzad/ btsan pos yer pa dang / chu bo 105wa 197

ri sogs la bsgom grwa chen po btsugs/ dbyig rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ gnubs nam mkha'i snying po/ btsun pa dpal dbyangs/ ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs / myang ting 'dzin bzang po sogs skyes bu dam pa brgya rtsa brgyad kyis grub pa thob par grags/ rje 'bangs nyer lnga'ang de dag gi gtso bor gyur pa rnams so/ /bon po dang brtsad pas bon po pham ste dran pa nam mkha' sogs chos la bcug /phyis bsgoms pas grub pa thob pa'ang mang zhig byung / de dag gi dus su gtso bor dar ba'i rgyud sde rnams ni gsang ba 'dus pa la sogs pa tan+t+ra chen po sde bco brgyad du grags pa dag go/ /de las sgrub pa bka' brgyad du grags pa rnams ni rta mgrin dang phur pa'i skor pad+ma saṃ bha bas dar bar mdzad/de bzhin du shān+ti gar+bhas 'jam dpal sku dang / hūm̐ kā ras yang dag thugs/dri med bshes gnyen gyis bdud rtsi yon tan gyi dbang / rgyud nyams len dang bcas pa dar bar mdzad/ ma mo sogs 'jig rten pa'i sde gsum yang / slob dpon pad+mas bod yul sogs kyi lha 'dre gdug pa can rnams dam la btags/srog snying phul/ dkyil 'khor du bcug nas dbang bskur te/ so so'i sde tshan du bsdus nas rig sngags bsgrub pa'i cho ga mdzad pa yin no//khyad par rdzogs chen la sems klong man ngag sde gsum las/ dang po bai ro tsa na rak+ṣi tas/ gnyis pa'ang de nyid kyis/ gsum pa bi ma la mi tras spel bar byas pa yin/ der ma gtogs pa'i 'dus pa mdo ni mdo dgongs 'dus su grags pa ste/ bru sha'i slob dpon che btsan skyes dang / gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes gnyis kyis bsgyur bshad mdzad de dar/ sgyu 'phrul rgyud kyi skor ni/gsang ba snying po sogs rtsa 'grel dang bcas pa rnams te/ thog mar bi ma la 105—198

dngamarinachenamachog gisabasgyur(tādzā r+shardo sdo —— ——— —— sdo rjernos (shā bzhirno shā wawa nyan bsgom bsgrub kyi rgyun dar ba yin no/ /de dag gi skabs su slob dpon gyis gter du sbas pa rnams phyi nas chos de dang de'i gdul byar gyur pa dag byung ba'i tshe sprul pa'i gter ston rnams kyis phyung ste 'gro don mdzad pa yin no/ /de ltar bstan pa snga dar gyi tshe byung ba'i gsang sngags rnams la ni gsang sngags snga 'gyur du grags te da lta'i bar du srol de'i bka' gter gnyi ga'i dbang rgyud man ngag sogs ci rigs par snang ngo //bstan pa phyi dar gyi tshe bya ba'i rgyud dang spyod pa'i rgyud gnyis la brten pa'i dbang bka' dang / rjes gnang dang / rig gtang tsam dang lung sbyin pa sogs las 'chad nyan gyi srol ni ma byung bar mngon la/ bla ma kha cig gis dpung bzang sogs la bshad pa byas par grags pa'ang rtsal bshad byas pa nyid du zad kyi bshad rgyun 'ded rgyu yod pa ma mthong ngo / /rnal 'byor rgyud ni lo chen rin chen bzang po kha cher byon te bla ma mang po bsten/ rgyud dang gdams ngag mang po nyan nas/ gsang sngags spyi dang khyad par yo ga la shin tu mkhas/bod du rnal 'byor gyi rgyud rnams phal cher sngar nas yod mod kyi 'grel pa dang bstun nas gsar du bsgyur/ 'grel pa'ang de nyid bsdus pa'i 'grel pa de nyid snang ba sogs bsgyur nas 'chad nyan gyis legs par gtan la phab/ phyag len nges tig mdzad de/ rngog legs shes sogs thugs sras bzhi gtso bor gyur pa'i slob ma mang po la gnang ste/ 'chad nyan gyis brgyud pa zin pa shin tu mang bar byung / de las pho brang zhi ba 'od kyis paṇ+ḍi ta man+t+ra ka lā sha sogs spyan drangs te/'gyur mang du mdzad cing khyad par dpal mchog gi hor kong bsabs/ bshad 185—199
