rgyud rdo rje rtse mo sogs slob ma mang po la bshad/ zangs dkar lo tsās kyang yo ga'i skor la gsan pa rgya chen po mdzad nas/ smad 'grel dum bu gsum yang rdzogs par bsgyur/ zangs dkar gyi bu bzhir grags pa sogs la bshad pas ches dar bar gyur pa yin no/ /de dag las brgyud de phyis bu ston rin po che la dbang dang rgyud 'grel gyi bshad pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byung ba des rnal 'byor rgyud kyi bstan pa rmang nas gso ba lta bur mdzad pa yin zhing / deng sang ni rgyud rnams kyi bklag lung tsam dang / dbang bka' 'ga' zhig las rgyud 'grel gyi bshad pa sogs phal cher mi bzhugs so/ /rnal 'byor bla med rgyud las pha rgyud kyi gtso bo gsang ba 'dus pa ni/ 'phags lugs dang ye shes zhabs lugs gnyis las snga ma ni dang por lo chen rin chen bzang pos 'dus pa'i rgyud nyid dang / de'i 'grel pa sgron gsal sogs gzhung che phra mang po bsgyur / de dag gi dbang dang bshad pa sogs kyang dbyis phyin par gsan/gzhan yang phyi nas lo tsā ba mang pos 'phags yul nas mnyan te bsgyur bshad ci rigs par mdzad mod kyi gtso bor mar 'gos kyi lugs gnyis su grags che/de'ang 'gos lugs ni lo tsā ba chen po 'gos khug pa lha btsas kyis slob dpon chen po dī paṃ ka ra dang / de wā ka ra tsan+d+ra dang / bir+ya bha dra sogs paṇ+ḍi ta bdun cu/ mkha' 'gro ma gnyis rnams las gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang rgyud 'grel man ngag dang bcas pa gsan/ bod du sngar bsgyur ba'i rgyud 'grel phran dang bcas pa rnams la 'gyur bcos dang zhus dag sogs shin tu legs par mdzad / slob ma rnams la rgya cher bstan pa las mang ra ba seng ge rgyal mtshan sogs slob ma'i mchog drug byung / de dag las nye bar brgyud de 'dus pa'i 105—200

skor shin tu dar bar byung ba yin te 'gos lugs su grags so//mar pa lo tsā chos kyi blo gros kyis slob dpon na ro pa dang ye shes snying po la sogs pa bsten nas gsang ba 'dus pa'i skor rnams zhus/ bod du slob ma rnams la bstan pa las slob ma'i mchog tu gyur pa ka chen bzhi las khyad par du mtshur ston dbang de la 'dus pa'i skor yongs su rdzogs par gnang / des khams pa ro mnyam rdo rje la gnang ste/ ro mnyam rdo rjes rgya gar du 'dus pa nyan pa la byon pa'i tshe lam du rgya gar ba gnyis mar pa la 'dus pa nyan du 'ongs pa dang 'phrad nas tshur byon/ mar pa gshegs zin pas mtshur ston la 'dus pa gsan pa sogs nas nye bar brgyud de mar lugs su grags so/ /'on kyang jo bo rje a ti shas nag tsho la gsungs/ des rong pa phyag sor ba la bshad pa sogs nas jo bo lugs su grags pa byung ngo / /yang chag chos rje dpal gyis paṇ+ḍi ta ra len+d+ra pa sogs bsten nas 'dus pa gsan pa/ 'u yug kung ra ba bla ma dpal sogs la bshad pa nas nye bar brgyud de chag lugs su grags pa byung ngo / /yang kha che paṇa chen gyis sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta dang / dpyal chos kyi bzang po sogs la gnang ba nas paṇa chen lugs su grags pa'ang byung ngo / /gzhan yang bshad srol cung zad 'dra min yod pa'i rgyun sna tshogs zhig byung 'dug kyang bris pas mi lang ngo //phyi ma ye shes zhabs lugs ni dang por lo chen rin bzang las rkyang po chos blo sogs la dar zhing smṛ ti dzñā nas kyang khams su bshad pa khams lugs su grags pa byung / paṇ+ḍi ta su na ya shrī dang gnyan lo nas brgyud pa sa skya pa rnams la grags che bas sa lugs su grags pa dang / paṇ+ḍi ta purgya shrī sogs las rwa lo tsā bas gsan nas dar ba rwa lugs dang / yang gnyos 'byung pos ba ling ā tsār+ya 105—201

bsten te 'dus pa nyan pa nas gnyos lugs su grags pa sogs byung ngo / /de ltar lugs snga phyi gnyi ga'i phyogs la bod yul 'dir ṭī ka dang / sgrub thabs dkyil chog dang man ngag gi yi ge sogs rtsom mkhan ni shin tu mang ba zhig byung snang ngo // yang pha rgyud las gshed skor ni/ phyi dar la dang por cog gru lo tsā ba shes rab bla mas/ gshin rje gshed nag gi rgyud dang / 'jigs byed rtog bdun gnyis dang / 'jigs byed zhe dgu ma'i sgrub thabs sogs bsgyur/ dgra gdong 'jigs gsum gyi dbang dang bshad pa'ang dar bar mdzad/ nag tsho lo tsās kyang jo bo dang dam tshig rdo rje sogs las gsan te rgyud 'grel bsgyur/ dbang bskur ba dang rgyud bshad pa sogs las kyang mang du mched/ rong zom chos bzang gis u pā ya shrī mi tra la bsten te nag 'jigs kyi rgyud sogs bsgyur te bshad pa'ang mdzad do/ /gzhan yang gnyos dang rwa lo dang shud ke lo tsā sogs mang pos dmar nag 'jigs gsum sogs kyi rgyud gzhung man ngag mang du gsar du bsgyur ba dang / 'gyur bcos mdzad pa sogs shin tu mang zhing khyad par srol cher btod pa po ni dpyal lo sogs bzhi dang / ra skyo zhang gsum dang /gnyos te brgyad yin pa las/ snga ma ni gshed dmar gyi skor te dpyal lo chos dpal bzang pos niṣ+ka laṅka la zhus nas bod du dar ba dang / dā na shī las sa skya paṇa chen la gnang ba dang / chag los kyang bi rū pa'i gzhung sogs bsgyur cing bstan pa dang / glo bo lo tsās darba na ā tsār+ya sogs las gsan cing spel ba rnams te/ de dag gi rgyun las/ gshed dmar gyi skor rnams kyi dbang khrid man ngag dang bcas pa byung ba yin no//185—202

rwa lugs ni/ rwa lo rdo rje grags kyi bal po 'ba' ro phyag rdum dang / me tsa ling pa gnyis bsten nas/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dbang rgyud man ngag dang bcas pa gsan/ khyad par bal po thugs rje chen po la dgra gdong 'jigs gsum sogs kyi skor rdzogs par gsan/ bod du chos 'khor chen po mdzad cing /gshed skor gnang ba'i slob ma kho na'ang nyis stong lhag byung bar grags/ gtso bor rwa chos rab sogs te/ de dag las mched pa'i tshul ni smos kyis mi lang ngo ske//skyo lugs su grags pa ni/ bla ma skyos a mo gha badz+ra sogs las/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi skor rnams gsan nas dar bar mdzad pa yin zhing /zhang lugs ni/ gong gi cog gru lo tsā ba des de wā ka ra tsan+d+ra la nag 'jigs gnyis gsan pa nas nye bar brgyud pa rnams kyi srol yin no//gnyos lugs ni/ gnyos lo stos ba ling ā tsār+ya sogs las/ nag po skor gsum gsan pa nas mched pa dag go//ma rgyud kyi phyogs las/ rdo rje gdan bzhi pa'i dbang khrid bshad pa man ngag dang bcas pa rnams/ lo chen rin bzang dus su'ang cung zad byung zhing /ga ya dha ra dang / 'brog mi dpon slob sogs kyis bsgyur bshad mdzad pa dang /mar 'gos gnyis kyis bshad sgrub kyi srol cher btod pa yin no/ /sgyu 'phrul chen mo'ang de dang mtshungs shing / sangs rgyas thod pa la gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer sogs kyis rgyud 'grel bsgyur bshad mdzad pa dang / mar 'gos sogs las kyang dar ro//bde mchog gi skor ni/ phyi dar gyi thog mar jo bo rjes lo chen rin bzang 105—203

dang / rong pa mgar dge sogs la gnang zhing / paṇ+ḍi ta mang po la bsten nas lo chen dang / 'gos sogs kyis rgyud dang / sgrub thabs/ 'grel ba sogs bde mchog skor gyi gzhung mang du bsgyur/ phyis jo bos nag tsho lo tsā sogs la'ang gnang ba nas dar ba dang / glog skya shes rab brtsegs kyis/bal bor pham thing ba sku mched la bde mchog gi skor rnams gsan nas/ ma la lo sogs la gnang ba dang / mal lo nyid kyis pham thing sku mched sogs mang po bsten nas zhus pas/ bde mchog skor la mkhas par gyur pa de la sa chen gyis gsan pa sogs nas/ sa skya pa yab sras brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams la ches dar ba yin no//mar pa lo tsās na ro pa la bde mchog gi skor rnams kyi nges gsang bla na med pa gsan nas/ phyis bod du slob ma rnams la gdams pa las/ dbang dang khrid kyi srol khyad par ba mang po mar mi'i bka' rgyud rnams la dar bar snang zhing / khyad par mar pa do pas/ na ro pa'i slob ma ma na ka shrī sogs bla ma mang po bsten nas/ na ro'i lugs kyi bde mchog gi dbang / rgyud bshad pa man ngag dang bcas pa gsan te/ bde mchog gi chos skor las 'gyur yang mang po mdzad/ bod du slob ma'ang mang du tshang zhing / khyad par gtsang gi mkhas pa rgya nam do'i gzi ba blo ldan sogs kyis chos rgyud legs par gzung ste/ 'di las gyes pa'i bshad srol dang / sgrub rgyun shin tu 'phel ba yin no//yang pham thing ba sku mched gsum sogs las pu rong lo chung dang gnyos lo sogs kyis gsan nas/ rgyun byung ba'ang ci rigs par yod cing / de las khyad par pu rong lo chung nas brgyud pa rnams kyi bshad srol bzang la yun ring 185—204

b.rabyungabayinado ———wa — ————— ——————————————————————————der ma zad sum+bha lo tsā dharma yon tan gyis paṇ+ḍi ta dza ya se na bsten te/bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mcho1re rgyud 'grel yan lag dang bcas pa gsan nas 'gyur yang mdzad de/ bod yul du de dag gi dbang bka' dang / bshad bka' sogs ches dar bar gyur pa yin no//de'i yum bka' rdo rje phag mo'i skor yang / lha so bdun mar grags pa'i dbang bskur dang / bsnyen bsgrub kyi rgyun tsam zhig dar bar snang zhing / khyad par phag mo gzhung drug tu grags pa ni bal po ba ren+d+ra ru tsi la gzhung drug byin brlabs dang bcas pa zhus/ de bzhin du rngog lo chen po dang / sgrubs ston dang / khu ne tso sogs kyis kyang gsan nas/ de dag so so las brgyud de ches dar zhing / rwa los paṇ+ḍi ta a bhi yuk+ta la gsan nas kyang mched pa yin no/ /yang mar los na ro pa sogs las gsan te mched pa'i lugs kyang yod do//dpal dgyes pa rdo rje yab yum gyi skor la/ 'brog mi lo tsā sogs kyis rgyud 'grel phran dang bcas pa rnams bsgyur bshad mdzad de dar ba yin zhing / de las khyad par 'brog mis paṇ+ḍi ta ga ya dha ra la sogs pa bsten nas/ dbang rgyud bshad pa man ngag dang bcas pa gsan nas nye bar brgyud de/ rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras sogs la rgya cher mched pa dang / 'gos los bram ze nag po'i zhabs sogs las gsan nas dar ba dang / khyad par mar pa lo tsās na ro pa bsten nas gsan pa/ mes rngog gnyis las bshad sgrub kyi rgyun ches cher dar ba dang / se tsa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis/ pham thing ba las na ro'i lugs gsan nas dar ba sogs so//105wa 205

khyad par rgyud sde thams cad kyi yang rtse dpal dus kyi 'khor lo ni/ thog mar paṇ+ḍi ta shrī bha dra bo dhi dang / gyi jo lo tsās rgyud 'grel bsgyur nas/ dbang bshad man ngag gi srol btod pa pro ma lo tsā sogs las brgyud pa gyi jo lugs dang / 'byo lo tsās kha che zla ba mgon po bsten nas/ mchog mi 'gyur gyi le'u ma gtogs rgyud 'grel rdzogs par bsgyur/ dbang bshad man ngag dang bcas pa mnos/ phyis paṇ+ḍi tas mchog mi 'gyur la rang 'gyur mdzad/ paṇa chen la 'phan yul grab sgom gyis thug ste/ dus 'khor la mkhas grub gnyis ldan du gyur/des sgre ston la bshad pa sogs nas dar ba 'byo 'gyur gyi steng nas bshad pa byed pa'i srol yod pas/ 'bro lugs dang / rtsa mi sangs rgyas grags kyis dus zhabs pa las gsan te 'grel chen bsgyur nas/ rga lo sogs slob ma rnams la bshad pa rtsa mi'i lugs dang / rwa chos rab kyis phal po'i paṇ+ḍi ta sa man+ta shrī las rgyud 'grel gsan nas bsgyur ba las/ rwa ye shes seng ge sogs la mched pa rwa lugs dang / gzhan yang paṇa chen lugs dang / chag lugs dang / sha ba ri pa'i man ngag lugs sogs mang du byung ste/ de dag gi gdams ngag gtso bor gyur pa ni/ sbyor ba yan lag drug pa yin zhing / kye rdor la sogs pa ma rgyud gzhan la'ang sbyor ba drug gi sgo nas/ khrid tshul yod pa 'ga' zhig byung mod kyi 'di dngos ma yin no/ /de ltar dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i skor rnams gangs ri'i khrod du ches cher gsal bar gyur pa la/ phyis bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa dang / rang byung zhabs dang / jo mo nang pa sogs mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa mang pos kyang lhag par gsal bar mdzad pa yin no/ /de ltar bshad pa ni rgyud gtso che ba'i byung tshul mgo smos rags pa tsam yin zhing / des mtshon nas 185—206

shes par bya ba las/ zhib par na bod du 'gyur ro cog gi rgyud rnams phal cher la / sngon dus dbang rjes gnang bshad pa man ngag sogs ma byung ba med pas smos kyis mi lang ngo //mtha' gcig tu ma nges pa'i bla med kyi rgyud sde spyi'i man ngag gi gnad gsang thams cad/ gang zag skal ba can gcig grol ba'i cha rkyen du tshang la/ ma nor bar bsdus pa'i khrid kyi srol ni bod yul 'dir mang du gyur snang ba las/jo bo bka' gdams pa rnams la spyir grags pa'i lam rim ni/ sngags kyi thun mong ma yin par mi 'gyur bas der mi gtogs la/ gzhan ni 'brog mi lo tsās ga ya dha ra las gsan te/ des rgyud kyi bshad pa gtso che ba 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po la gnang / gdams ngag lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i skor rnams se ston kun rig la gnang / se ston gyis dkon mchog rgyal po la bshad skor rnams kyang gsan/ des gdams ngag rnams rdzogs par zhang ston chos 'bar dang / phal cher zha ma lcam sring sogs la gnang / sa chen gyis se ston mjal te / gzhung bshad gsan yang gdams ngag ma gsan pas/ phyis zhang dgon pa ba las gsan te/ thugs nyams su bzhes pas grub pa'i dbang phyug chen por gyur / des rje btsun bsod nams rtse mo la gnang ste/ zag med bde ba chen po'i sku brnyes nas mkha' spyod chen por byon/ des grags pa rgyal mtshan la gnang bas/ grub pa chen po'i ngang tshul 'dzin par mdzad/ des sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la gnang ste/ 'di ni rig pa'i gnas lnga la thogs pa med pa'i mkhyen rab kyi pad+mo bye bar gyur pas/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang mi gnyis par khums shing / bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa 185—207

snang bar byed pa'i nyi ma gcig pu par gyur/ de nas thugs rje'i bdag nyid bla ma 'phags pa sogs las nye bar brgyud de/ gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir dpal ldan sa skya pa zhes/ bstan pa'i rtsa lag mchog tu gyur pa 'di byung ba yin zhing /de las kyang tshogs bshad kyi srol 'dzin ngor rdzong gong dkar ba rnams dang /slob bshad thun mong min pa'i srol 'dzin kha'u brag rdzong pa sogs rgya cher rgyas par gyur pa yin no//yang mar pa lo tsās na ro pa sogs bsten te/ rgyud kyi dbang bshad man ngag sna tshogs dang / khyad par zab lam na ro'i chos drug tu grags pa gsan/slob ma ka chen bzhi gtso bor gyur pa la gnang zhing / gzhan rnams las bshad rgyud dang / khyad par grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po mi la ras pa las sgrub rgyud kyi bstan pa rgya cher rgyas pa byung / de'ang mi la'i slob ma dgas po lha rje/ de'i slob ma khams pa mi gsum las/ grub thob dbu se nas kurma kai tshang gi lugs dang / phag mo gru pa las 'bri 'brug stag lung 'ba' rom bka' rgyud khro phu bka' rgyud sogs byung ba yin no/ /gzhan yang mi la'i slob ma ras chung ba nas ras chung snyan rgyud du grags pa dang / ngan rdzong ras pa nas ngan rdzong snyan rgyud du grags pa sogs mang du mched pa rnams ni smos kyis mi lang ngo /yang na ro pa'i lcam ni gu mas khyung po rnal 'byor rjes su bzung ste/ de las gdams ngag ni gu chos drug sogs/ shang pa'i chos skor du grags pa rnams byung zhing / srol de 'dzin pa la shang pa bka' rgyud du grags so//yang grub chen dam pa sangs rgyas su grags pa des/ bod yul du lan mang por byon nas/ chos bstan pa'i gtso bo ni/ dam chos sdug bsngal zhi byed kyi 185—208

—wa wawa wawa gewa wa ———————wa ———— — — — — — — — —— ——— — — — skor rnams te/ de la'ang brgyud pa snga phyi bar gsum sogs kyis rgya cher 'phel ba dang / gcod yul du grags pa ma gcig lab sgron nas brgyud pa 'di dag ni ༷do snga/rdzos kyi phyogs gnyis kur gtogs pa las mtha' gcig tu chad par gzung ma nurdo k+ṣiṃ/ /bu'i bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' srol chen po bod kyi yul du 'dren zhing skyong bar mdzad pa'i lo paṇa gyi tshogs ci tsam zhig byon pa yin ce na/bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su rgya gar gyi slob dpon ku sa ra/ bram ze shaṅka ra/kha che ta nu/ bram ze ā nan+da/ bal po shī la mañdzu/ bud+dha gu h+ya/ bud+dha shān+ta/shān+ta rak+ṣi ta/ pad+ma saṃ bha wa/ yo ga'i slob dpon dharma krirti/ bi ma la mi tra/shīn+ti gar+bha/ bi shud+dha sidha/ ka ma la shī la/ kulpa mi tra/ dzi na mi tra/ su ren+d+ra bo dhi/ shī len+d+ra bo dhi/ dā na shī la/ bo dhi mi tra/ mu ni warma/ sarba dzñā de wa/di n+ya pra bha sogs dang / rgya'i slob dpon hwa shang ma hā de ba tshe/ hwa shang ma ko se / hwa shang ma hā ya na sogs so//bstan pa phyi dar gyi dus su rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta shrī ka ra warma/ dharma pā la/pradzñā pā la/ budha pā la/ kha che shān+ta bha dra/ shān+ta ka ra warma/ pad+ma gup+ta/musti mi tra/ bud+dha shān+ta shrī/ su bhā ṣi ta/ pradzñā warma/ dī paṃ kā ra shrī dzñā na/de'i dpon po dā na shrī/ smṛ ti dzñā na gīrti/ paṇ+ḍi ta phra la ring ba/ su na ya shrī/kha che dzñā na shrī/ tsan+d+ra rā hu la/ dhī ra pā la/ a tu l+ya da sha /su ma ti krirti/a ma ra tsan+d+ra/ thig le bum pa/ gzhon nu bum pa/ ka na ka warma/ dam pa rgya gar/ dza ya ā nan+da/ ga ya dha ra/ kha che zla ba mgon po/ stong nyid ting 'dzin rdo rje/ ye shes rdo rje/ shes rab gsang ba/ ma hā dza na/ man+t+ra ka lak+ṣa/105wa 209

kurma badz+ra/ ya mā ri/ dpa' bo rdo rje/ rā hu la gup+ta badz+ra/ bai ro tsa na badz+ra/bal bo a su/ rat+na kā ra shārnyi/ mañdzu gho ṣa/ srur+ya krirti/ ga ga na dha ra/nor sbas/ sa mat+na shrī/ niṣ+ka laṅka de ba/ dza gad mi tra ā nan+da/ bud+dha shrī dzñā na / shākya shrī bha dra/ bi bhu ti tsan+d+ra/ su ga ta shrī/ dza ya dat+ta/ dā na shī la/sat+ta shrī/ su ma ti sā ga ra/ kā la tsan+d+ra/ dzi na gup+ta/ ma hā bo dhi/ paṇ+ḍi ta dza bha ma shrī/ tre+e lokya ā nan+da/ longs spyod rdo rje/ rat+na shrī/ bal po ma hā pa na / bal po badz+ra krirti/ bal po kā ya shrī/ bal po grags pa dpal/ ku mā ra thams cad mkhyen pa'i dpal/ sādhu krirti/ maṅga la shrī/ bārban ā tsar+ya/ dza ya de wa/ lasmri ka ra/ rat+na shrī/ ā nan+da shrī/ rā hu la shrī/ zangs gling pa/krirti paṇ+ḍi ta/ shā ri pu tra/ paṇ+ḍi ta shrī ba na rat+na/ bud+dha gup+ta sogs so//de bzhin du lo tsā ba yang bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su thon mi saṃ bho ṭa/ dharma koṣ+ṭha / lha lung rdo rje dpal/ bran ka mū la ko ṣa/ kha che ā nan+da/ khri bzher saṃ shi ta/ sbrang rgya ra legs gzigs/ seng ma gong lha lung gzigs/ rba ye shes dbang po/ ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/ dbas mañdzu shrī/ pa gor bai ro tsa na/ rba mang rje gsal snang / sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms/ gnyags dzñā na ku mā ra/ ce dzñā na sidhi/ mchims shākya bra bha/ brang ti dza ya rak+ṣi ta/shud pu dpal gyi seng ge /rtsangs de ben+d+ra rak+ṣi ta/ bran ka musti ka /kho na nā gen+da rak+ṣi ta/ rma rin chen mchog /rtsangs sa pa'i bu rin chen legs grub/dharma ā lo ka /dran pa nam mkha'/ sgro rin chen sde/ rma rnam par mi rtog pa/rma shākya 'od/ ce khyi 'brug /rlangs khams pa go cha/ gnyags de wa ko ṣa/zhang rgyal nyen nya bzang / 'gos chos 'grub/ stong ā tsar+ya/ dharma tā shī la/185—210

cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan/ ska ba dpal brtsegs srung ba/ zhang ye shes sde/rat+na rak+ṣi ta/ dza ya rak+ṣi ta/ mañdzu shrī barma/ rasne n+d+ra shī la/ bzang skyong /lha'i zla ba/ dpal gyi lhun po/ dpal 'byor/ ye shes snying po/ rgyal ba shes rab/ shākya bshes gnyen/ dge ba dpal/ legs pa'i sde/ gnubs nam mkha'i snying po/ yi ge pa dgon gling rma/ gzhon nu srung ba/ nam mkha' skyong rnams so//phyi dar la lha bla ma ye shes 'od/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/ grags 'byor shes rab/ mgar chos bzang / dge tshul khyung grags/ bal po pad+ma ru co/ pa tshab tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ se tsa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/rong pa chos bzang / 'bro seng dkar shākya 'od/ khyung po chos brtson/ rgya brtson 'grus seng ge/ nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal ba/ rngog legs pa'i shes rab/'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ khyung po rnal 'byor/ yol lcags rdo rje dbang phyug /rma dge ba'i blo gros/ gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer/ lha zhi ba 'od/khu dngos grub/ chos kyi shes rab/ mar thung ngad pa shes rab/ ga rod tshul khrims 'byung gnas/ 'brog mi shākya blo gros/ 'brog mi shākya ye shes/ stag lo gzhin brtson/ mar pa chos kyi blo gros/ 'gos khug pa lhas btsas/zangs dkar 'phags pa shes rab/ gnyan dar ma grags/ rwa rdo rje grags/kher gad 'khor lo grags/ la chings yon tan 'bar/ spong zho gsal ba grags / she'u badz+ra de wa/ rab zhi bshes gnyen/ mar pa do pa chos kyi dbang phyug /pu hrang lo chung legs pa'i shes rab/ gzu dga' ba rdo rje/ chos kyi yon tan/ chos kyi rin chen/ glog skya shes rab brtsegs/ ba ri rin chen 185—211

grags / pa tshab nyi ma grags/ lha btsan po mu ni rā dza/ ding ri chos grags/rgyus smon lam grags/ mang 'or byang chub shes rab/ mal gyo blo gros grags/gyi ljang dbu dkar/ 'byo shes rab grags/ ba reg thos pa dga'/ rma chos 'bar / mtshur dbyig gi rgyal mtshan/ rtsa mi sangs rgyas grags/ sga lo gzhon nu dpal/ kre bo shes rab dpal/ mtshur ston dbang gi rdo rje/ rwa chos rab/dpyal kun dga' rdo rje/ dpyal kun dga' grags/ zhang shes rab bla ma/bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ chos kyi snying po/ kum chos kyi ye shes/ phyug mtshams dbang phyug rgya mtsho/ tshul khrims yon tan/ khor gad yon tan dpal/bsod nams bzang po/ sum̐ bha dpal mchog dang po'i rdo rje/ nyi ma rdo rje/ khu dge bsnyen ne tso/ glog skya gzhon nu 'bar/ lha ye shes rgyal mtshan/ byang chub 'byung gnas/ glan chos kyi blo gros/ cog gru ting 'dzin bzang po/shes rab ye shes/ rig pa gzhon nu/ gzhon tshul/ khu mdo sde 'bar/ steng lo tshul khrims 'byung gnas/ shes rab brtson 'grus/ g.yung drung 'od/bsod nams rgyal ba/ cog gru shes rab bla ma/ cog gru mya ngan med/ bsod nams mos pa/ tshul khrims brtsegs/ rngog bud+dha pā li ta/ rgyal lo tsā ba/sbal rdo rje rgyal po/ lha rin po che/ lha chos kyi rin chen/ kyu ra tshul khrims 'od zer/ dge slong bya'i gdong can/ ra byid lo tsā/ phur bu 'od/ shes rab legs/ nag tsho dharma grags/ mar pa blo gros bzang po se lo tsā/rong gling lo tsā/ sho rim lo tsā/ zla ba grags pa/ gnyal mi ye shes chos/chos kyi zla ba/ shes rab skyabs/ nag tsho shes rab rgyal mtshan/ 'a zha rgya gar brtsegs / gnyan bsod nams/ ba ri chos grags/ yong po lo tsā/ gzhon 705—212

————wa wa——wa — ————wa ————— —— ——————— — — — nu shes rab/ mgar shes 'byung / 'jam dpal gzhon nu/ shes rab 'od zer / ce dga' ba dpal/ ye shes 'byung gnas/ shākya brtson 'grus/ lo rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ zha ma dge bsnyen seng rgyal/ ce bkra shis/ chag dgra bcom / dpyal chos bzang / dkar lo tsā ba/ zhang dge ba/ sanubs byams pa'i dpal/ chag chos rje dpal/ dpyal shes rab 'od/ zhang grub pa dpal / sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ glo bo shes rab rin chen/ lho brag pa 'u ru dar ma seng ge/ mi mnyam bzang po/ au rgyan pa rin chen dpal/shong rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ shong blo gros brtan pa/ khams pa blo gros rgyal po/'dan ma tshul seng / ra ba gzhon brtson/ shud ke grags pa rgyal mtshan/thar lo nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ dpang blo gros brtan pa/ sgra tshad pa rin rgyal/dbus pa blo gsal/ stag lung pa shākya bzang po/ legs pa'i blo gros/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/ thugs sras lo tsā ba rin chen rnam rgyal/ jo nang lo tsā ba blo gros dpal/ sa bzang pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ 'bri khung lo tsā ba/kun spangs grags pa rgyal mtshan/ yar lo grags pa rgyal mtshan/ lo chen byang chub rtse mo/ bo dong grags pa rgyal mtshan/ snar thang pa saṅgha shrī/ lo chen skyabs mchog dpal bzang / chos 'khor sgang pa shes rab rin chen/ 'gos lo tsā ba gzhon nu dpal/ khrims khang pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/ chag lo rin rdon cho~X rgyal/ zha lu lo chen chos skyong bzang po/ jo nang lo tsā ba tā ra nā tha gdi dir// smras/ /pa/ gi tam rigs las 'khrungs pa'i nyin byed che/ thub mchog thub pa'i tshogs kyis phyag byas gang / /legs gsungs 'od zer bye bas 705—213

zhing kun du/ /rgyas par 'gengs pa'i phrin las 'di rmad byung / /'on kyang skal chung rnams kyi blo gros kyi/ /bu ga phra mo'i snod dang ma 'tsham pas ma rtogs log par rtog pa'i mun pa des/ /phyogs re tsam la bslad par byas pa yod / /des na 'phags yul mkhas pa'i rna ba la/ /nye bar babs shing mgrin pa'i rgyan gyur pa/ /lung bstan brnyes pa'i smra mkhas mchog rnams kyis/ /yang yang byi dor byas 'di 'khrul med yin/ /gang la bder gshegs rnams kyis gshegs gyur cing / /grub pa rnams kyis snying por bcang ba'i lam/ /de la sems yod skye bos smos ci dgos/ /bems dngos rnams kyang 'dud pa lhur len snyam / /tshad med yon tan gter gyur bstan pa 'di/ /gangs can skye dgu'i bsod nams do ra ru/ /mngon par drangs pa'i shing rta cher gyur pa/ /lo paṇa nor bu'i phreng ba dngar rnams kyi/ /bka' drin tshad med yid la rnam bkod na/ /dad pa'i spu long ches cher g.yo bzhin du/ /zhing gi rdul snyed lus kyis byang chub bar / /de dag spyi bor mchod la su mi spro/ /snyigs ma'i gzeb nang las kyi zhags pa yis/ /dam por bcings pa'i dman pa bdag 'dra rnams/ /dam pa'i mdzad bzang 'di lta'i rjes zhugs te/ /rgyal bstan ma lus 'dzin pa'i mthu thob shog /bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' gangs can gyi brdas drangs pa'i phyi mo'i tshogs ji snyed pa par du bsgrubs pa'i tshul las nye bar brtsams pa'i gtam bzang po blo ldan mos pa'i kun+da yongs su kha bye ba'i zla 'od gzhon nu'i 'khri shing las bstan pa de dzam+bu'i gling du ji ltar bskyangs pa'i tshul rags pa tsam zhig bshad pa'i yal 'dab ste gnyis pa'o// //105—214

pa/////yi ge brgyad pa rjes bsngags kyi sdeb sbyor las mi mnyam pa 'i bṛt+ta'i bye brag kha sgo phan pa zhes bya ba'i prasta ras bcings —4 1——wa /sdegos lo — —)༄ ————ri 155—— ——snro—————nge so 〉 rjotswarnya༄rdo sbyosmyo /tshelo dzñosgyu sna/sna'e /rgormi me 0rnye'i ma sgros stang r+sha༄7/ /dzā hā sto te ṣā sa 'i rlu ra t+na ra dz+dza ཿ su sno ya nā༄ta riX ci pā tshong ༄༅/ /skye /sa skye dir legadī byas ༈/ //na che/ rdul mang sdusags ༵ chos/ /na na sno snyo r+yā skor+sharā rwa tre ljonas go rardzoshārwadzā 2—— phro/4000rwar+sha༄954 khri /lhaXsdormi ༷sti kurwa'e semama'i skum sgyu ma/ sau rdostab sdokasdi ñtsha dh+ri rdzis bzhin rdo/ ma/gyu/ pa sbyi /sna lhu/ po stang tā/ // /mi bdag phal cher 'dod pa yis/ /chang gis rab dregs glang po bzhin/ /rang nyid bza' ba'i 'dam bu yang / /nyes pa med par 'joms pa yod/ /'di ni bskal par bsod nams la/ /goms pas thog mar gzhan bsrungs shing / /de yis rang nyid bde ba'i rgyu/ /'bad pa med par grub pa mthong /'gro ba'i bde ba legs spyad las/ /de yang thub mchog gsung las skyes/ /de yang yi ge la brten phyir/ /mi bdag blo gros de rjes song / /snying stobs dri med ston zla bzhin/ /gsal bas brtson 'grus che rtsom pa/ /chu gter lta bur 'phel gyur pas/ /dpag bsam sar pa 'di byung ngo / /de ltar bsil ldan gyi ljongs 'dir dam pa'i chos kyi dbu brnyes pa nas bzung ste da lta'i bar du bdag cag gi ston pa mnyam med yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya'i dbang po'i gsung rab 'khrul pa med pa ci tsam zhig snang bar gyur pa de dag las deng sang phyi mo ji tsam snyed pa dag mi'i dbang po bstan pa

tshe rings yab sras kyi bdag rkyen las par du bsgrubs pa'i tshul gleng ba la gnyis te bdag rkyen byed pa po'i lo rgyus 'chad pa dang / rnam dkar gyi bya ba dngos smos pa'o/ /dang po la yul rigs yon tan gsum gyi sgo nas 'chad pa la/dang po ni spyir kai lā sha'i ra bas yongs su bskor ba'i ljongs byang phyogs bod kyi yul 'di nyid/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ kha ba can du mtsho bri nas/ /sā la'i nags ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes lung bstan pa ltar dang por mtsho yod pa rim gyis bri nas nags tshal stug po rgyas par gyur pa'i skabs shig na/ yul gru 'dzin nas thugs rje chen pos byin gyis brlabs pa'i spre'u zhig 'ongs pa de dang brag srin mo 'dus pa las/ bod rnams nye bar mched pa yin zhes kyang zer lha las phul byung gi bstod 'grel las/ khyab 'jug gis ni 'thab dka' zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i rigs brgyud brlag par gyur pa yin te/ 'di ltar khyab 'jug gis 'thab dka' la dris pa/ dpung tshogs bco brgyad khyer ram/'on te nor lha gcig pu khyer zhes dris pa dang / des dpung gi tshogs rnams khyer ro zhes smras pa dang / des zhe 'gras par gyur nas/ khyab 'jug gis skya bseng gi phyogs byas te g.yul ngor chas pa na/ srid sgrub kyis kun du bltas te smras pa/ kho bos ni nye du'i tshogs gsod par mi nus te/ gang gi don du rgyal srid thob par 'dod pa'i nye du'i tshogs de ji ltar gsad par bya zhes smras te srid sgrub 'thab pa las ldog par gyur pa dang / khyab 'jug gis smras pa/ khyed ni blun pa yin te/ gang gis mi ni gsad pa dang / /gang zhig gsod par byed pa dag /de dag gnyi ga mi dmigs te/ /gsad dang gsod pa po yod min/ /rigs dang 'dul ba phun sum tshogs/ /bram ze ba lang glang po dang / /khyi dang 185—216

rme sha can dag dang / /mkhas pa rnams ni mnyam par lta/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa med par lta ba'i tshigs su bcad pa mang po bstan cing / sna tshogs pa'i gzugs bstan pas bslus nas/ srid sgrub kyi kha lo pa rang nyid kyis byas te / g.yul bkye bas 'thab dka'i rigs dpung gi tshogs bco brgyad dang bcas pa brlag par gyur to/ /rū pa ti zhes bya ba'i rgyal po dpung gi tshogs gcig dang bcas pa g.yul 'gyed pa'i tshe bud med kyi cha lugs su byas te bros nas ri kha ba can gyi ri khrod du zhugs te gnas pa'i rigs las deng sang na'ang bod ces bya bar grags pa yin no/ /zhes 'byung ba sogs 'chad tshul sna tshogs zhig snang ba/ gang ltar yang yul 'di'i skye bo dag la 'phags pa thugs rje chen pos byin gyis brlabs kyis skyong bar mdzad pa zhig ni gor ma chag la/ de lta bu'i mi yi skye bo rnams kyis yul ljongs rim pas longs spyod du gyur pa nas bzung / yul dbus dag tu nags tshal yang rim gyis med par gyur te/ grong dang grong tshom dang grong rdal dang rgyal po'i pho brang dang gtsug lag khang la sogs pas kun nas brgyan pa 'di lta bu byung ngo / /de'ang yul spyi'i dge mtshan gyi dbang du byas na chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos/ de ltar 'phags pa'i gang zag rnams 'byung zhing / 'khor ni legs gnas ston pa'i gsung rab dang / /ston pa'i sku gzugs dngos su bzhugs pa dang / /ri bo yon tan can yang de na yod / /tsa ri tsa gong bde mchog rang byung dang / /rdo chu rin po che yang de na yod / /ti se'i gangs la dgra bcom lnga brgya bzhugs/ /bdud rtsi'i chu yang ri bo de na yod/ /gye re'i brag la yig 'bru rang byung dang / /mkha' 'gro'i phyag rgya ri bo de na yod/ /ma pang mtsho la klu rgyal byang sems gnas/ /chu bo yon 105—217

tan can yang de na yod/ /khri bshos rgya mtsho'i klu blon byang chub sems/ /chu bo chen po kun la phan par mdzad/ /gnam mtsho phyug mo'i nang na byang chub sems//thang lha'i brag la dgra bcom lnga brgya yod/ /sbubs mtsho'i gling na klu rgyal byang chub sems/ /kha'u'i gangs la dgra bcom mang po yod/ /ri mtho sa gtsang gangs ri gnyan gyis bskor/ /sgra dag skad snyan saṃ skṛ ta dang mtshungs/ /mi skad chos la bsgyur du btub pa'i sgra/ /yangs shing mtha' legs yon tan kun ldan pa/ /de ltar kha ba can gyi yul dbus su/ /zhes sogs kyis bsngags pa mdzad pa ltar dang / gam 'brog rgyang 'brog rtswa yi dge/ /khang sa zhing sa sa yi dge / /'thung chu yur chu chu yi dge/ /khang rdo 'thag rdo rdo yi dge/ /khang shing bud shing shing gi dge/ /zhes sogs bshad pa ltar dge bcu tshang zhing khyad par du mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i slob dpon chen po dang / sprul pa'i chos kyi rgyal po la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' sa chen po la gnas pa rnams dang /bde bar gshegs pa'i sprul pa'i sku du ma bgrang bar mi spyod pa dag gis byin gyis brlabs shing yongs su skyong bar mdzad cing snyigs ma'i dus su ston pa nyid kyis lung du bstan pa ltar rgyal ba'i bstan pa ches cher gsal bar gyur pa'i gnas phun sum tshogs pa ste/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa ltar na/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud las/ bod yul du ni lhan skyes te/ /zhi zhing gsal ba'i gzugs can ma/ /chu srin rgyal mtshan lag na thogs/ /brag gi khyim la brten te gnas//rang byung gi ni skye gnas can/ /zhes yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i ya gyal du gsungs shing / bod nyid kyi nang gses su'ang rdo rje'i gnas chen po rnams ci rigs par tshang ba yin te grub pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po rnams kyis nang gi 105—218

rten 'brel khyad par ba rnams bsgrigs pa'i yul gyi gnad gsang thams cad ma tshang ba med par yod pa'i phyir ro/ /de lta bu'i yon tan dang ldan pa'i bsil ldan gyi ljongs sam/ lha mo dri ma med pa'i 'od lung bstan pa'i mdo las gdong dmar can gyi yul du gsungs pa 'di nyid la bod dang bod chen po zhes gnyis su grags pa las/ bod chen po'i ljongs 'di ni bod spyi'i 'dra dpe stod du mnga' ris skor gsum rdzing lta bu dang / bar du dbus gtsang ru bzhi yur ba lta bu dang / smad du mdo khams sgang drug zhing lta bu'i tshul du bshad pa'i phyi ma yin zhing / de las mdo khams smad du gtogs pa'i sa'i cha gling gi yul zhes bya ba 'di ni sgang drug las zal mo sgang du grags pa ste/ chu bo chen po bzhi las 'bri dang shar zla'i chu klung chen po gnyis kyi bar du chud pa/ bde gshegs phag mo grub dang / ka thog pa dam pa'i mtshan can dang / grub chen gsal stong sho sgom dang / grub pa'i dbang phyug kurma pak+ṣi dang / rgyal ba'i sras po spom brag pa la sogs pa grub pa brnyes pa'i rdo rje slob dpon mang po bsam bzhin du srid pa nye bar bzung zhing / de dag la sogs pa mkhas shing grub pa'i rgyal ba'i sras po mang pos zhabs kyis bcags shing byin gyis brlabs pas skye dgu rnams rang bzhin gyis dge ba can du gnas pa'i yul/ slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa la sogs pa'i spyan sngar dam mnos pa'i 'byung po chen po dkar phyogs la dga' ba rnams kyis yongs su srung zhing bde bar gshegs/ pa'i bstan pa gtso bor sgrub pa nyams len gyi sgo nas ches shin tu gsal ba'i phyogs/ bsngags pa du mas bsngags par 'os pa 'di nyid do/ /de las kyang legs byas rgya chen po 'di mngon par 'du byed pa'i yul dngos ni g.yas ri g.yu 'brug 'gying ba lta bu g.yon ri seng ge 105—219

gnam du 'phyo ba lta bu/ rgyab ri shel gyi mchod rten lta bu/ mdun ri glang po che 'dud pa lta bu/ gser ldan gyi rgyun dbang gi phyogs nas dal bu'i 'bab pa sogs sa'i dpyad legs rgu ma tshang ba med pa'i dbus su dpal ldan lhun grub steng gi chos grwa chen po/ dge 'dun gyi sde rnams kyang / rje btsun sa skya pa chen po yab sras nas nye bar brgyud de/ rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos nges gsang gi gnad thams cad legs par phye ba'i rgyun dri ma med pa 'dzin par mdzad cing / klog pa thos bsam gyi 'khor lo dang /bya ba nan tan gyi 'khor lo rnam pa gnyis kyis dus 'da' ba rgyud sde mang po'i bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor zab mo dang / dkyil 'khor gyi las rab 'byams dang / smin grol gyi bka' zab mo sogs ma nub cing ches gsal ba sogs rnam grangs du mas bsngags par 'os pa 'di nyid du/ rgyal khab kyi pho brang chen po/bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gzugs lugs ma dang / ri mor bris pa sogs dang /sde snod gsum gyi pusta ka du ma sogs rin thang dang bral ba'i rin po che'i tshogs du mas gyur bur bkang bas gtsug lag khang chen por gyur pa/ 'phags yul gyi rat+na kū ḍa bi ha ra ji lta ba bzhin du grags pa mngon par gsal ba 'di'o// //gnyis pa de lta bu'i yul du byung ba'i mi'i dbang po 'di'i rigs rgyud kyi khyad par ni/ mi dbang 'di nyid kyi drung yig pa 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i blo gros kyis yig tshang khungs ma las btus pa'i gtam gyi sbyor ba byas pa ltar 'god na/de'ang bod chen po'i ljongs 'dir spyir sbra 'bru sdong sga ste rus chen bzhi dang /sgo lha sde dkar po'i rigs te mi rigs lnga byung bar grags pa las phyi ma/ de las 185—220

kyang bye brag tu yangu chen rgyal mo tsho bco brgyad du grags pa 'gar ke 'gol gsum/gsung gser 'brom gsum/ ci 'bu gzhag gsum/ shel stag phyang gsum/gce sing ram gsum/ phyug po bu gsum rnams las 'gar gyi rigs 'gar chen ye shes bzang po dang / 'gar dam par grags pa sku mched gnyis byung ste/de las phyi ma ni/ drung yig pas bkod pa'i yi ge de nyid dang bstun na spo bo phu lung dgon pa sogs dang sbyar bas lo rgyus ma dag pa ma gtogs 'gar dam pa chos sdings pa yin par mngon te/ de ni sid+dha la'i slob dpon ār+ya de ba'i rnam 'phrul du grags/ yab mes rnams rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnal 'byor pa yin pas sku chung ngu'i dus nas 'jigs byed la thugs dam mdzad/ 'bri khung du byon nas 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po brten te grub pa'i dbang phyug chen por gyur/ tsa rir byon te gsang sngags kyi spyod pa bskyangs/ dwags po 'gar phug tu bzhugs pa'i tshe bod kyi lha 'dre thams cad 'dus nas sku lus zangs thal du 'gro ba'i mtshon cha mang po brgyab kyang nyam nga med pas thams cad kyis skyabs su song ste srog snying phul/ phrin las mang po mdzad nas phyis spo bor phebs/ der chos ye mi dar ba la rdzu 'phrul dang thabs mkhas kyis skye bo dad par byas nas phu lung dgon pa rin chen gling gi gzhi bting nas zhi bar gshegs/ de nas nyid kyi dbon po u rgyan la sogs pa khams nas 'ongs te de'i 'phro bskyangs/ de las dpon rgyud rim par byung ba phu lung sde pa thog ka bar grags te dus phyis kyi bar du yod do/ /'gar chen ye shes bzang pos slang mdo drug gi sa'i cha bdag gir mdzad de/ de'i sras gnyis kyi bsod nams rin chen gyis 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa'i zhabs pad brten nas gsol dpon gyi las ka bzung / gong ma se 105—221

chen gan gyis dam ga dang 'ja' sa sogs byin te chen po'i go sar dbang bskur/de nas sku tshe'i smad la sa dmar yang dgon du tshogs pa stong phrag tsam bskyangs/de'i dpon po rngu rgu ru la sras dgu byung ba'i nang nas stong dpon zla ba bzang po zhes pa la gong ma mchod yon gyis sa dmar stong dpon gyi las ka gnang bas mngon par mtho ba byung / de'i sras gnyis las rngu rgyal ba bzang po'i sras pad+ma bstan srung / de'i sras dkar chen byang chub 'bum/ de'i sras rngu chos rdor ba ni gsang chen rnying ma'i grub thob chen por gyur/ de'i mched ya dge 'dun rgyal mtshan gyi sras mgon po gzungs sogs las brgyud de deng sang gi bar du sa dmar phyogs 'dir rgyun ma chad par yod do/ /dkar chen byang chub 'bum gyi sras / bde chen bsod nams bzang po zhes pa yum 'das pa'i dgongs rdzogs bsgrub par/ ka thog rdo rje gdan du byon nas phyir ma log pas/ mched gzhan gyis slar 'gugs par btang rtsis la/ kurma pa chos grags rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas dang / rngu chos rdor ba dpon slob zung gis kho bos kyang 'ong ba mi yong mod/'on kyang grub thob chen po zhig gis byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas sa bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi dbyibs su byas pa zhig tu rim gyis dbang bsgyur nas/ brgyud pa je bzang du 'gro'o zhes lung bstan mdzad/ phyis de ji lta ba bzhin thog tu khel ba byung ste/ bsod nams bzang po de nyid rim gyis lcags ra na gling chen po bdag drung gi spyan sngar 'byor/ sde dge zhes pa'i mtshan yang 'di skabs tsam nas byung bar grags/ de la sras bzhi byung ba'i gnyis pa bo thar du grags pa des grub pa'i dbang phyug thang stong rgyal po spyan drangs te gus pas mchod/ grub chen gyis dngul mda'i srib ri'i gsham du klu gnas pa'i mtsho chung ngu zhig yod pa 105—222

rdzu 'phrul gyis bsubs nas/ der gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcas pa bzhengs te/ chos sde chen po dpal lhun grub steng du grags pa 'di'i bstan pa'i rmang thog mar tshugs/ gtsug lag gnyi ga'i rten 'brel gyi sgo lhun grub tu 'grig par gyur/ de'i sras gnyis las bla ma dpal ldan seng shes sngar gyi gtsug lag khang yod pa'i nyin ri'i phyogs su 'dus sde btsugs pa la deng sang nyin dgon du grags/ cig shos rgyal mtshan 'bum la sras bzhi byung ba'i a snga zer ba la sras bdun tsam byung ba'i jo gdan nam mkha' lhun bzang gis/ rdo rje 'jigs byed la thugs dam nan tan du mdzad pas/ nye 'khor ba rnams kyis rdo rje 'jigs byed du mthong ba dang / bzlas pa dung phyur grub pa'i tshe ljags thog tu lcags kyi ril bu rang rdol du byung ba sogs grub pa'i mtshan ma brnyes/ de'i mched ya rgyal 'phel la sras gsum byung ba'i sde dge kun dga' rin chen ni lhun grub steng gi bla brang gi lha khang bzhengs pa sogs sku bsod rgyas pa'i mgo tshugs/bsnyen bsgrub gnang ba'i tshe gzims khang thams cad me'i phung por gyur ba thams cad kyis mngon sum du mthong ba byung / de'i gcung dpon nam mkha' dang rdo rje lhun grub gnyis byung ba'i phyi ma las nye bar brgyud de da lta bla ma bkra shis rgya mtsho sogs bzhugs pa 'di'i bar ro/ /snga ma'i sras lhun thub/ de la sras drug byung ba'i dang po ni rig 'dzin rgod ldem can gyi sprul pa'i zlos gar du grags pa grub thob kun dga' rgya mtsho ste/ 'dis gsang sngags gsar rnying spyi dang /khyad par du sngags rnying ma'i chos kyis grub pa'i mtshan ma brnyes/ lkog gyur gyi gnas lugs ston pa dang / snang ba bden med du gzigs pas sra mkhregs kyi rdo ba 'dam ltar rdzi ba dang / 'byung po gdug pa can mang po 'dul ba sogs ngo 185—223

mtshar gyi mdzad pa sna tshogs zhig bstan par grags/ gsum pa bla ma dam chos lhun grub bam/ byams pa phun tshogs ces pa des sngon gyi bsod nams kyi las shugs ches cher bdo bas chab srid skyong ba'i bya ba gtso bor mdzad cing / ris med kyi chos sde mang po'i bdag por gyur/ lnga pa bla ma lha srung thugs dam 'ba' zhig la brtson par mdzad/ drug pa bla ma kurma bsam 'grub kurma kai tshang gi grub mtha' 'dzin pa zhig ste dbon po stod du bzhugs/ sras gnyis pa dang bzhi pa gzhis kur bzhugs pa'i snga ma dpon klu 'phel gyi sras rnams las/ dbon chen kun dga' phun tshogs kyis sa skyong dam pa byams pa phun tshogs sku gshegs nas gdan sa'i khrir phebs te/ lugs gnyis kyi srol bzang po bskyang bar mdzad do//khyad par gter gzhung 'ga' zhig las cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan gyi sprul pa'i zlos gar du bshad pa khri chen sangs rgyas bstan pa ni/ legs byas kyi mthu rgya chen pos 'gran du med pa'i dbang brnyes par gyur te gdan sar bzhugs khrir phebs nas bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa ris su ma chad pa la mchod pa dang bsnyen bkur ba dang / gtsug lag khang dang 'dus pa'i sde mang po'i nyams gso gsar spel sogs dang / rgyal khams la byams pas gzigs pa'i bka' khrims drang pos phan bder mdzad pa sogs lugs gnyis kyi srol bzang pos mnga' ris thams cad dkar por bsgyur bar mdzad/ 'di'i yum mi gcig pa'i gcen po dpon u rgyan bkra shis kyi sras sa skyong bla ma bsod nams phun tshogs kyis de'i rjes su khri bskyangs te/ de ni thugs sgam zhing ngang ring ba/ dkyel che ba sogs ya rabs kyi skyes bu'i yon tan dang ldan pa zhig go/ /de'i mched yar gyur pa dpon dbang chen mgon po'i sras mi'i dbang po bstan pa tshe rings ni da 185—224

lta bzhugs khrir phebs nas srid skyong bzhin pa yin te/ 'di ni rnam dkar gyi bya ba rgya chen po 'di 'grub pa'i bdag rkyen dngos so// //gsum pa bdag rkyen byed pa po de'i yon tan rang nyid kyis ji ltar mthong ba bzhin ngo bstod med par brjod na/ tshe rabs mang por legs byas rgya mtsho mngon par 'du byas pa'i mthus chung ngu nas dge ba'i ngang tshul can/ bla ma dang rgan rabs sogs zhe sar 'os pa rnams la sri zhu che ba/ gsang sngags gsar rnying gi yi dam mang po'i bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len thun grangs su bcad pa'i bzlas brjod dang zhal 'don sogs kyi brtson pa mi bshol ba/ bzhugs khrir ma 'khod gong 'byor pa ha cang mi bdo ba'i skabs su'ang dkon mchog mchod pa dang / sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzhengs pa sogs la snying stobs chen pos ngang gis 'jug pa zhig ste bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong gi sku brnyan so so'i yab yum sras rim gro pa sogs 'khor dang bcas pa ri mor bris pa'i zhal thang grangs mang zhing spus legs pa dang / rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog rin po che las bzhengs pa sogs mtha' yas shing srid skyong gi go sa chen por bzhugs pa na'ang / ji skad du/ lugs kyi bstan bcos shes rab sdong bu las/ dam pa mang po khas 'che mi byed la/ /gal te dka' bas khas ni blangs gyur na/ /rdo la ri mo bres pa lta bur ni/ /shi yang gzhan du byed par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dam bcas pa brtan cing mi 'gyur ba/ shin tu thugs sgam pas sgrin po rnams kyis kyang thugs bsams kyi gting mi sleb pa/ slob dpon klus/dman pas gang tshe nor ni cung zad rnyed/ /'gro ba thams cad brnyas pa'i nga 105—225

rgyal ldan/ /dam pa nor gyi 'byor pa thob gyur kyang / /sā lu smin pa lta bur shin tu 'dud/ /rigs dma' ba yi sems can dag /nor ram rig pa rnyed gyur na/ /'gro ba kun la rtswa snyam sems/ /pags pa sngon po'i wa bzhin no/ /nor ram rig par ldan gyur na/ /dman pa rnams ni dregs par 'gyur/ /go 'phang gnyis po de dag gis/ /mkhas pa shin tu dul bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar 'byor pa'i tshogs shas cher bdo bar gyur kyang thugs kun nas dul bas nam yang dregs pa mi mnga' ba/ 'byor pa rnams kyang 'phral 'phral du dge 'dun gyi 'du sgo dang / dkon mchog gi mchod pa dang / sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzhengs pa sogs chos kyi phyogs su zad du 'jug pa las/ dgra 'dul gnyen skyong la sogs pa rnam smin yid du mi 'ong ba skyed pa'i phyogs la zad du mi 'jug pa dang / ha cang sog 'jog la sred par mi mdzad pa sogs dam pa'i yon tan thams cad kyis phyug pa ste de'ang / gtsang du gdan sa chen po e waṃ chos ldan gyi gling pa spyi khang dang 'di gar zhabs drung dpal mchog pas bzhengs pa'i mchod rten chen mo sogs gsar bzhengs lta bu'i rten dang brten pa'i nyams pa gso ba bgrang gis mi lang ba mdzad pa dang / 'gro ba'i mgon po sa skya ba gong ma rnam lnga'i bka' 'bum skya pod dngos gtsang bcu drug /rin chen gnyis pa las grub pa'i bstan bcos 'gyur ro 'tshal glegs bam nyis brgya dang bdun yod pa shin tu dngos gtsang / rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog mtshal par ma dang / yang rin chen dang po kho na las bzhengs pa'i bka' 'gyur glegs shing glegs thag na bza' tshun chod shin tu spus legs la dngos gtsang ba/tsan+dan dmar po las grub pa'i sangs rgyas stong sku thams cad mkhyed gang tsam pa/185—226

yang tsan+dan dmar po'i phye ma'i lde gu las grub pa'i sangs rgyas stong sku thams cad mtho tshad ma/ tsan+dan dkar dmar las grub pa'i sku gdung cha brgyad bzo bkod phun sum tshogs pa/ tsan 'dam las grub pa'i chos rgyal lo paṇa bzhi bcu rtsa lnga'i sku thams cad brkyang khru gang lhag yod pa/ tsan+dan dkar ba'i lde gu kho na las grub pa'i las 'bras kyi bla rgyud thams cad mkhyed tshad ma/ yang gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i bla ma brgyud pa rnams kyi sku brnyan gser zangs las grub pa thams cad brkyang khru gang dang sor lnga lhag tsam yod pa lnga bcu/khyad par gser zangs las grub pa'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems chos srung nor lha sogs kyi sku lugs ma shin tu dngos gtsang ba sum brgya lhag tsam/lhun grub steng gi 'du khang chung ba gañdzi ra bcas/ lcags ra'i 'du khang rgyal mtshan bcas/ sgom mdzangs chos sde'i 'du khang / dpal sbyangs su kho bo cag gi lha khang 'dus sde dang bcas pa/ bla ma kun chos pa'i sku gdung gañdzi ra bcas sogs gsar bzhengs kho na'ang bgrang gis mi lang zhing da dung yang sgrub bzhin pa dang / lo bstar du zab mo'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pa'i dge sbyong rnams la chos dang mthun pa'i yon phun sum tshogs pa stsal te/ yi dam gyi lha rnams kyi rtsa sngags dang snying po sogs dung phyur phrag mang por lang ba bcad rgya kho nas sog tu 'jug pa sogs mchod sbyin gyi khyad par rgya chen po bsgrubs pa rnams kyang de dang mtshungs pa ste/ skyes rabs dpag bsam 'khri shing las/ mi rnams nor ni dngul chu'i thigs pa khu tshur dag gis bsdoms pa'i rnam par mthong / /dbul dang mgon med rnams la ster zhing nye bar mkho bar gyur pa rab tu rgyas pa'i dpal / /bsod nams dga' tshal gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten bcom ldan 105—227

sku gzugs rab gnas la sogs kyis/ /nor ldan 'di ni grags pas lhan cig mi bzad gnas su gang zhig gang gis rnam par mdzes/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu dang / slob dpon klus/ phan sems che ba sgrin pa'i tshul/ /drang po'i tshul ni mi slu ba/ /bag yod nyam nga med pa ni/ /de ni rgyal po'i tshul du bshad/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar thugs shin tu sgrin pas phan pa'i sems kyis mnga' 'bangs la sogs pa bde bar skyong ba/ drang po'i thugs dang ldan pas g.yo sgyus skye bo sgyu bar mi mdzad pa/ bya ba thams cad la bag yod cing nyam nga ba med pa'i tshul gyis spyod pa ste/ tsa na ku'i rgyal po'i lugs kyi bstan bcos las/ kun dga' ra ba'i phreng brgyud ltar/ /me tog me tog tsam btu yi/ /sol pa mkhan ni ji bzhin du/ /rtsa nas gcad par mi bya'o/ /'o ma bzhos nas 'thung bzhin du/ /ba ni gsad par mi bya'o/ /de bzhin rgyal pos yul 'khor ni/ /dus shes nas ni longs spyod bya/ /ba yi brla ni bcag gyur na/ /bzho bas 'o ma thob mi 'gyur / /de bzhin yul 'khor tshul min pas/ /gnod pa byas na 'phel mi 'gyur / /yul 'khor sbrang rtsi ltar spyad kyi/ /sbrang bu gsad par mi bya'o/ /ba las bdag pos bzho ba ltar/ /rgyal bos sa ni de ltar bskyang / /zhes bshad pa lta bu'i sa legs par skyong ba'i tshul thams cad phun sum tshogs pa/ gzhan yang / sa bdag rtag tu rgyu med par/ /khro gnyer dag ni mi bya zhing / /bran g.yog nor med par ma yin/ /rgyal pos chos ni bsrung bar bya/ /zhes sogs bshad pa ltar chos kho na'i rjes su song bas mnyen gshin des pa'i ngang tshul can/ma btul bar yang phas kyi rgol ba rnams rang gi ngang gis 'dud pa lhur len pa dang / mnga' zhabs kyi 'bangs rnams kyang rma med par skyong bzhin pa nas/185—228

dus phyis gnam skos 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen pos bod yul gyi ljongs 'di nyid bdag gir mnga' bsgyur ba na'ang / mi'i dbang po 'di nyid kyi yon tan gyi khyad par rnams snyan la dengs pas bsngags brjod dang bcas te 'bangs kyi skye bo mi khyim mang po sa ris dang bcas pa gsar du sbyor 'jag gi bka' drin mdzad pa sogs mchog dman thams cad kyi yid dam pa'i ngang tshul gyis phrogs par mdzad pa ste mdor na snyigs ma'i mun klong stug por g.yo ba'i dus 'di lta bur chos kyi rgyal po mya ngan med slar yang 'ongs pa lta bu'i phrin las can zhig go//mi'i dbang phyug 'di'i sras gnyis pa dang gsum pa rab tu byung ba'i brtul zhugs yang dag par len par mdzad la/ dang pos srid 'dzin par mdzad pa ste gsum ga'ang rang bzhin gyis dge ba la 'dun zhing mi 'phrog pa'i brtan pa can/dkyil che zhing gzu bor gnas pa/ gtsug lag lugs gnyis kyi mkhyen pa rnam par rgyas pa sogs/ ma su rak+ṣas byas pa'i lugs kyi bstan bcos las/brtan zhing zab mo'i blo dang ldan/ /mdangs ldan chos dang bstan bcos rig /dul zhing bden par smra ba dang / /rgyal po'i 'khor la phan par sems/ /rigs btsun rgyud ni mnyen pa dang / bla ma la ni gus nyan dang / /skye dgu rjes brtser ldan pa yi/ /rgyud byung de ni rgyal sras yin/ /zhes bshad pa lta bu'i yon tan dang ldan zhing / btsun mo dam pa dag kyang / rgya cher rol pa las/rgyags pa ma mchis mi g.yeng zungs thub tshul 'chang zhing / /nga rgyal ma mchis 'gying dang bral bas bran mo bzhin/ /sgra dri ro la ma chags chang la ma chags te/ /'dod bral brnab sems ma mchis rang gi nor gyis 'tshal/ /bden la gnas shing mi 'phyar g.yeng ba ma lags pa/ /ngo tsha'i gos 'tshal rgod dang khengs pa ma 185wa 229

mchis gnas/ /lta dang bkra shis ma chags rtag tu chos la brtson/ /zhes gsungs pa'i tshul dang mthun pa/ de bzhin du ma su rak+ṣas/ tshig gsal blo ni phun sum tshogs/ /lugs kyi bstan bcos dag la mkhas/ /ngang 'jam dpyod par byed pa ste/ /rgyal po'i blon po de 'dras bya/ /zhes bshad pa lta bu'i blon po dang / tshe yi rig byed goms pa dang / /chos rig yid 'ong snyan smra zhing / /cho ga ngang tshul phun sum tshogs/ /thang la 'bar bzhin gso mkhas shing / /nad kyi mtshan nyid kun la mkhas/ /rgyal po de 'dra'i sman pa bsten/ /zhes pa lta bu'i sman pa dang / sgra rig rtsis kyang shes pa ste/ /yi ge byang zhing lag pa myur / /yid gzhungs tshig ni gsal ba dang / /grags dang sbyin ldan yi ge pa/ /zhes pa lta bu'i drung yig pa dang / rigs dang ngang tshul yon tan ldan/ /bden dang chos la mchog tu gzhol/ /gzugs byad shin tu bzang ba ni/ /rgyal po'i spyan mi yin par bshad/ /ces pa lta bu'i nang blon rnams dang /mtshon la goms shing nus dang ldan/ /bzhon pa dag la bya bzhin goms/ /dpa' zhing brtan pa phun sum tshogs/ /de 'dra dmag dpon yin par shes/ /zhes pa lta bu'i dmag dpon dang / pha mes rgyud byung grims par shes/ /bstan bcos rig cing zhim par 'tshed/ /gtsang sbra che zhing snying nye ba/ /de lta bu yis phyag tshang bya/ /zhes pa lta bu'i phyag tshang pa dang / yid gzhungs tshig gsal shes rab ldan/ /gzhan sems nye bar mtshon nus dang / /brtan zhing ji skad bsgo bzhin smra/ /rgyal po'i pho nya de 'dras bya/ /zhes pa lta bu'i mngag gzhug pa sogs mdor na bstan bcos dang mthun pa'i rgyal po'i yan lag rnams kyang legs par tshang ba yin no// //185—230

rtsa ba'i sa bcad gnyis pa rgyal ba'i gsung rab par du 'khod pa'i rnam dkar gyi bya ba dngos smos pa la/ bzhengs pa'i dus dang / phyi mo ji ltar bsags shing dag par bgyis pa'i tshul dang / bzhengs tshul dngos so/ /dang po ni/ spyir bskal pa chen po bzang po 'di la chags pa'i dus dang / gnas pa'i dus dang / 'jig pa'i dus dang gsum las gnas pa'i bskal pa de la'ang ya thog ring mo dang / ma thog ring mo dang / bar gyi khug pa bco brgyad du grags pa ste bar bskal nyi shu yod pa las/ ya thog ring mo'i gsham gyi dus te/de'ang thub pa'i bstan pa lung gi dus kyi lnga brgya pa phrag gsum las dkyil smad tsam du phyin pa bdag cag gi ston pa rnam 'dren bzhi pa shākya'i dbang po de nyid zhing 'di'i ngo skal gyi sprul pa'i snang brnyan nye bar bstan nas da lta'i bar gyi 'das lo'i tshul la mkhas pa dag gis dpyad pas bzhed pa mi mthun pa mang du byung ba las/ deng sang yongs su grags pa pad dkar zhal lung ba'i lugs kyis ston pa drag po lcags sprel sa ga zla ba'i tshes bdun zla skar rgyal gyi dus su sku bltam pa nas/ bgrang bya nyis stong dang drug brgya brgyad cu rtsa dgu 'das shing /rgyal ba shing rta sa ga zla ba'i bco lnga la mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas/lo de'i chu stod can gyi tshes bzhir lnga sde la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas nyis stong drug brgya lnga bcu rtsa lnga 'das pa/ de bzhin du lcags 'brug nag nya sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lnga'i gung thun la dgongs pa zhi dbyings su mnal ba'i tshul bstan nas nyis stong drug brgya dgu 'das shing / chos rje sa skya pa'i lugs kyis ston pa rnam 'byung sa 'brug la sku bltam zhing / thams cad 'dul sa phag lor gshegs nas 185—231

sum stong brgyad brgya drug cu rtsa gcig 'das pa/ kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī'i lugs kyis me mo sbrul la sku bltam zhing me byi lor gshegs nas nyis stong nyis brgya bdun cu don gcig 'das pa/ jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha'i bzhed pas shing mo glang la sku bltam zhing shing sprel la gshegs pa'i tshul bstan nas sum stong brgyad brgya drug cu rtsa bzhi 'das pa/ stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba gnam skos gong ma chen po g.yung cin gser khrir phebs nas nyag ma bdun thal ba/ mi'i dbang po 'di nyid dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa gnyis su pheb pa/ bde mchog stod 'grel ltar na sau mya zhes pa zhi bar grags shing / shar phyogs tong ku'i rgyal khams su gyi le'ur bod pa sa mo bya'i lo sme phreng dang po 'byung ba sum ldan phur bu klung du zhugs pa'i dus/ de la'ang nyi ma lhor bsgod pa dang byang du bsgrod pa'i dus gnyis yod pa las snga ma/ dbyar dgun ston dpyid bzhi las/ 'dod dgu thams cad phun sum tshogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa ston ku'i dus/dgun dang dpyid dang dbyar dang dbyar thung dang dbyar ring po ste dus lnga las phyi ma/ zla ba bcu gnyis las hor lugs kyi zla ba bdun par grags pa/ tong ku'i rgyal khams pa'i lugs kyis ston ra ba spre'u'i zla ba/ 'phags pa'i yul du shra ba khor grags pa rgyu skar gro bzhin gyis nya ba'i dkar phyogs/ gang ba gnyis pa'i tshes/ res gza' mnga' lha'i grogs po'i 'dzum mdangs rgyu skar gyi lha mo a nu rā d+ma'i bzhin gyi pad+mor 'phos pa/ 'chi med grub pa'i sbyor ba/ dus 'khor ba'i lugs kyi dbyangs o/ gsal byed pho/ 'byung ba chu/ 'dod yon gzugs / dbyangs 'char ba'i lugs kyi dbyangs e/ gsal byed ra/'byung ba rlung / 'dod yo na reg bya sogs 'char ba'i dus phun sum tshogs pa 185wa 232

la / sa skyong chen pos thog ma med pa'i dus nas bsags pa'i legs byas kyi mthu rgya chen po brtas pa las slar yang legs byas kyi lam rgya chen po 'di lta bu bsgrub pa la spro ba chen po zla ba mthong ba'i rgya mtsho bzhin du 'phel bar gyur te/rgya chen po'i gnas 'di lta bu la spyod mi nus so snyam pa'i zhum pa dang / gnas 'di tshogs kyis spyad pa gzhan gyis bsgrub mi nus pas bdag nyid kho na mchog yin gyi gzhan dag ni sbrang bu lta bu'o snyam pa'i khengs pa dang / 'di lta bu spyad par 'os pa yin med kyi 'on kyang rgyu 'di las mdzod dang bang ba rnams ha cang 'bri bar 'gyur ro snyam pa'i ser sna la sogs pa ring du spangs nas/ bdud dang bdud kyi ris dag gis dngos dang brgyud nas bar chad rtsom zhing thabs du mas bshol bar byed kyang snying stobs kyi go cha lhod par mi 'gyur ba'i brtan pa'i blo gros chen pos thog mar mgo rtsom pa'i las kyi grwa 'dzug par mdzad pa yin no/ /rta) :she /) shes 61byenge mthothesno:re15 (pethego:reji)cesatha/ 05 tshog (1 thab 95rnga5 khur sprang zud tha/ zugasprang ཿsazug par dag pa bsags nas zhus dag mdzad pa yin te/ de'ang gtso bor deng sang gangs ri'i khrod 'dir grags che ba tshal pa bka' 'gyur dang / rgyal rtse them spang mar grags pa gnyis kyi rgyun yin pas de'i khungs btsal cing zhus dag gis gtan la phab pa'i tshul ni/ bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su chos kyi rgyal po sad na legs mjing yon gyi sku ring la/ lo tsā ba ban+de dpal brtsegs rak+ṣi ta/ chos kyi snying po/ de len+d+ra/ dpal gyi lhun po sogs kyis 'phang thang ka med kyi gtsug lag khang du bzhugs pa'i gsung rab rnams la/ tsheg bar brgyad brgyad 105—233

la tshig rkang re re/ de bzhi la sh+lau ka /de sum brgya la sogs pa la bam po'i tshad du byas te grangs des gzhal ba'i them byang ma 'khrul bar chos tshan 'di dang 'di la grangs 'di dang 'di'o zhes bkod pa dkar chag 'phang thang mar grags pa ste/ gangs can 'dir rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i thog ma ni 'di yin no zhes yongs su grags la/ de'i rjes su lo tsā ba dpal brtsegs dang / 'khon nā gen+d+ra rak+ṣi ta sogs kyis stong thang ldan dkar gyi pho brang chen po na bzhugs pa'i gsung rab zhus chen mdzad zin pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs nas dkar chag mdzad pa la ldan dkar mar grags pa byung / de'i rjes su btsan po khri lde srong btsan ral pa can gyi sku ring la pho brang 'on cang rdo rgya phubs dgu thog mar sngon rgyal ba'i gsung rab bsgyur ba rnams skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab pa dang gsar du'ang mang po bsgyur te sgra sbyor bam gnyis su/ nyi 'og gi mkhan po ā tsār+ya dzi na mi tra dang / su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / shī len+d+ra bo dhi dang / dā na shī la dang / bo dhi mi tra dang / bod kyi mkhan po rat+na rak+ṣi ta dang / dharma tā shī la dang / lo tsā ba mkhas par chud pa dzñā na se na dang / dza ya rak+ṣi ta dang / mañdzu shrī warma dang / man+dePROB shī la la sogs pas theg pa che chung las byung ba'i rgya gar gyi skad las bod kyi skad du bsgyur cing ming du btags pa rnams dkar chag tu bris te/ nam du yang gzhung lugs de las mi bsgyur zhing kun gyis bslab tu rung bar gyis shig ces bka' stsal nas/ sngon lha sras yab kyi ring la/ ā tsār+ya bo dhi sa twa dang / ye shes dbang po dang / zhang rgyal nyen nya bzang dang / blon khri bzher sang shi dang /lo tsā ba dzñā de wa ko ṣa dang / ce khyi 'brug dang / bram ze ā nan+da la sogs pas 185—234

chos kyi skad bod la ma grags pa las ming du btags pa'i dag cig mchis pa'i nang nas/ kha cig chos kyi gzhung dang / byā ka ra ṇa'i lugs dang mi mthun te/mi bcos su mi rung ba rnams kyang bcos/ skad kyi ming gces so 'tshal gyis kyang bsnan nas/ theg pa che chung gi gzhung las ji ltar 'byung ba dang /gna'i mkhan po chen po nā ga rdzu na dang / ba su ban+dha la sogs pas ji ltar bshad pa dang / byā ka ra ṇa'i sgra'i lugs las ji skad du 'dren pa dang yang bstun te/ mjal dka' ba rnams kyang tshig so sor phral nas gtan tshigs kyis bshad de gzhung du bris/ skad rkyang pa bshad mi 'tshal ba sgra bzhin du bsgyur bar rigs pa rnams kyang sgra btsan par bgyis te ming du btags/ skad kha cig don bzhin du gdags par rigs pa rnams kyang don btsan par bgyis te ming du btags nas btsan po'i spyan sngar brje chen po yon tan dang / ban+de chen po ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa yang 'tshogs te rje blon gdan 'dzom pa la zhus nas dharma bsgyur ba'i thabs dang / rgya gar gyi skad la bod kyi skad du ming gdags pa rnams gtan la phab ste bkas bcad pa/ zhes 'byung zhing / dkar chag chen mo de dag mdzad pa'i skabs su gsang sngags nang gi rgyud sde zab mo rnams gsang nas spyod pa nyid yin pa'i phyir yongs grags su them byang du ma btab po/ /bstan pa phyi dar gyi tshe sngar gyi rnams phal cher yod pa'i steng du sprul pa'i lo tsā ba chen po rnams kyis mdo rgyud mang du bsgyur cing bsnan par mdzad pa yin mod kyi re zhig phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas dkar chag 'debs pa bo ma byung la/ phyis mkhas pa bcom ral pa'i slob ma 'jam dgag pak+ṣis hor yul nas bka' 'gyur bzhengs pa'i mthun rkyen gyi yo byad mang po bskur ba la brten nas 'dul ba lung 105—235

gi ma phyi mchims chen po nam mkha' grags kyis dge ba'i bshes gnyen rgya 'dul ba 'dzin pa zhal bzhugs pa'i dus na/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'dul ba 'dzin pa zhing mo che pa byang chub seng ges gnyer mdzad nas/ lung phran tshegs kyi bam po bcu gnyis ma tshang ba dang / gzhung bla ma'i zhu ba ma rdzogs pa bam po bcu gnyis dang / sdom tshig yig tshar gnyis ma tshang ba rnams bsam yas mchims phu la sogs pa dbus gtsang gi gtsug lag khang rnams nas btsal te/ la stod 'ol rgod kyi gtsug lag khang du gnas brtan dharma seng ges lung sde bzhi tshang bar bzhengs pa snar thang gi gtsug lag khang du gdan drangs te de la dpe phyi mdzad nas bzhengs pa dang / gzhan yang chu mig ring mo'i gtsug lag khang dang /rung klung shod grog gi gtsug lag khang gi 'dul ba lung la sogs pa rnams la gtugs pa yin zhing / mdo mang gi skor rnams kyi ma phyi 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa'i thugs dam rten lha mi'i rgyan mchog tu grags pa dang / gtsang chu mig ring mo'i gtsug lag khang gi mdo mang rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'dar phyar gyis bzhengs pa'i mdo mang 'dar phyar ma zhes grags pa dang / 'brang mtshams phug chung ma zhes grags pa dang / dga' 'bar ma zhes grags pa dang / dpal snar thang gi gtsug lag khang gi mdo mang rnams kyi mchog tu gyur pa mkhan po chen po mchims kyi thugs dam mdo mang gser gzhung ma dang / phyug rgyal ma dang / dgon gsar ma la sogs pa rnams dang / gzhan yang bla ma gru spang rtsa ba'i thugs dam mdo mang 'dzam gling rgyan dang / shog chung gi gtsug lag khang gi mdo mang drug cu rtsa gnyis dum dang /spun gsum gyi gtsug lag khang gi mdo mang dang / zha lu gser khang gi gtsug 185—236

lag gi mdo mang gzhi ma dang / smon da dho zhes grags pa la sogs pa mdo sna mang zhing go rims legs pa rnams dang bstun pa dang / sher phyogs 'bum la/btsan po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi sku ring la reg zig sngo dmar sogs 'bum tshar drug tsam yod par grags shing / de las mched pa'i khri lde srong btsan gyi dus su bzhengs pa'i bla 'bum chen mo khri lde gtsug gi bla 'bum skya bo/ mjing yon gyi sbug 'bum/ gtsang mi bye 'bum/ ral pa can gyi drug 'bum/ gnam sde lha'i zhal dmar can/ dar ma'i shog ser can sogs dang / 'bangs kyis bzhengs pa'i 'bum tshar bcu dgu sogs dang / de dag rnams las mched pa shin tu mang bar bzhugs pa'i rgyun las bar skabs su ma nyams ma bslad pa'i phyi mo rnams la dbus pa blo gsal dang / lo tsā ba bsod nams 'od zer dang /rgyang ro byang chub 'bum sogs mkhas pa mang pos sgo bstun te dag par gtan la phab pa dang / gsang sngags rgyud 'bum gyi ma phyi'ang bla ma rje btsun chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi zhal snga nas dang / bla ma chen po chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i rgyud kyi dkar chag dang / slob dpon chen po rig pa'i ral gris mdzad pa'i rgyud kyi dkar chag rgyud 'bum rgyan gyi me tog la sogs pa la brten nas gdan sa chen po dpal sa skya'i rgyud 'bum dang / shākya'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po gser ldings pas zhus dag go rims mdzad nas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen skye med ston shes bzhengs pa'i rgyud 'bum dang / dpal thar pa gling gi gtsug lag khang gi dge bshes 'dur phyar gyis bzhengs pa'i rgyud 'bum dang /bla ma gru spang rtsa ba'i phyag dpe dang / 'od dga' spun gsum gyi gtsug lag khang gi rgyud 'bum la sogs pa/ rgyud yang dag pa grangs mang zhing / go rims 105—237

legs la dag pa rnams yin zhing / gzhan yang der ma 'dus pa'i phyi mo rnams kyang khungs bzang zhing / dpyad pa gsum gyis gtan la phab pa kho na la dper mdzad de/ dpal snar thang gi gtsug lag khang chen por/ shākya'i dge slong 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis bzhengs nas dkar chag tu btab pa snar thang bka' 'gyur du grags/ gtso bor de nyid la ma phyi byas te/ tshal pa si tu dge ba'i blo gros kyis tshal gung thang gi gtsug lag khang du bzhengs pa tshal pa bka' 'gyur du grags shing / de nyid la gzhon tshul shākya rgyal mtshan dang / kurma pa chos grags rgya mtsho dang / kun mkhyen mi bskyod rdo rje dang / zhwa dmar spyan snga chos kyi grags pa dang / 'gos lo gzhon nu dpal sogs mkhas pa mang pos legs par brtags shing dpyad nas/ zhus dag mdzad cing mchan bu btab pa sogs bod yul du 'gran zla thams cad dang bral ba'i khungs thub kyi phyi mo dam par gyur te 'phying bar stag rtse'i pho brang du bzhugs pa/ phyis 'jang yul gyi rgyal po kurma mi pham bsod nams rab brtan gyis bsod nams kyi las shugs chen pos spyan drangs te/ gtso bor ma phyi de nyid dang / rgyud kyi skor stag lung rgyud 'bum dang yang sgo bstun nas/ thams cad mkhyen pa zhwa dmar drug pas kyang ljags zhus mdzad de par du bsgrubs pa/ dus dbang gis da lta li thang byams chen rnam par rgyal ba'i chos sder bzhugs pa 'di'i par ma gzhir bzhag cing / de'i steng du a gnyen pak+shi'i thugs dam rten gyi bka' 'gyur shin tu dag pa dang /gzhan yang dpe rgyun rnying ma khungs btsun 'ga' zhig go bsdur nas/ mkhas btsun dam pa bkra shis dbang phyug gis tshig zur phra mo'i snon 'brid kha shas mdzad pa dang / yang rgyal rtse chos rgyal gyis snar thang bka' 'gyur la ma phyi byas 105—238

te bzhengs pa'i tshe/ snyigs dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po ches/dpyad pa gsum gyis gtan la phab cing zhus dag mdzad nas dkar chag kyang bsgrigs / de la ma phyi byas pa'i rgyun las/ 'phags mchog 'jig rten dbang phyug mi'i zol 'dzin ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mcho'i zhal snga nas bka' stsal pa bzhin / sa'i tshangs pa bsod nams rab brtan gyis/ dpal thang po che'i gtsug lag khang du bzhengs pa'i bka' 'gyur skya pod shin tu dngos gtsang ba/bod chen ljongs kyi skye dgu rnams bsod nams mngon par 'phel ba'i slad dang /phyi mo phun sum tshogs pas gsung rab rnams la log par brtags pa'i rnyog ma 'grung bar bgyid pa'i slad du mdo stod lho rdzong gi pho brang du bzhugs su bcug pa spyan drangs te/ de dang yang sgo bstun nas rig par smra ba'i blo gsal du mas 'bad pa chen pos mi bcos su mi rung ba 'ga' zhig bcos te dag par bgyis pa'i thog /kho bo la'ang mi'i dbang po'i bka' nan gser sbram ltar lci ba stsal bas / thun mong lcags khyi lo/ dbo zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi rgyal ba dang po'i tshes nas brtsams te/ slar yang zhus dag gi khur blangs pa yin no/ /de'ang spyir 'jang par gyi bka' 'gyur 'di nyid/ dam pa mang po'i dpyad pa thims pa gong smos ltar gyis gzhi shin tu dag par 'dug na'ang / bar du 'khod skabs thams cad mkhyen pa chos kyi dbang phyug gis thar chags su ljags zhus ma grub pa dang / chos gzabs ches pas/ do dam pa rnams kyi dpyod pas ma khyab pa'i shog bu gong 'og 'khrugs pa dang / chad lhag phran bu sogs kyi skyon cung zad snang ba/ lho rdzong bka' 'gyur la brten nas dag par bcos/ der mi bzhugs pa'i mdo rgyud tshad ldan 'ga' zhig lho rdzong bka' 'gyur dang gzhan las 185—239

rnyed pa'ang bsabs/ 'dul ba phran tshegs sogs la chad nges pa 'ga' zhig 'grel pa dang bstun nas them spang ma bzhin bcug /khyad par sngags skor la/ngan song sbyong rgyud brtag pa phyogs gcig pa dang / gsang ba 'dus pa dang /dpal gtum po khro bo'i rgyud dang / kye rdor brtag gnyis dang / bde mchog nyung ngu dang / bde mchog sdom 'byung rnams rgya dpe'i steng nas zhus dag byas shing / rgya dpe'i khungs mi gcig pa'i tshig khyad byung ba rnams so so'i rgya 'grel la legs par brtags nas gtan la phab/ gzhan rgya 'grel yod rigs phal cher la the tshom gang byung du 'grel pa nyid kyis bcos/ gsang sngags rnams kyang sngags btu yod pa'i rigs la de nyid dang bstun/ med pa rnams la'ang mtha' gcig tu saṃ skṛ ta'i skad du ngos gzung byar mi btub pa 'gro lding ba'i skad dang /bi shā tsi'i skad dang / zur chag dang / gsang ba'i brda'i skad la sogs pa can rnams ni dpe mthun shas che ba gtso bor bzung / legs sbyar dngos yin pa rnams la'ang sgra'i gzhung rnams dang bstun par rang nyid kyi blos dpog pa rnams de bzhin du bgyis/ blos mi dpog pa rnams rang sor bzhag /yig sdeb kyi sbyor ba'ang sngon gyi dpe rgyun rnams su 'dra min mang du byung ba/ de'ang dang po thu mi saṃ bho ṭas bod kyi skad la nye bar mkho ba'i sgra'i bstan bcos brgyad mdzad par grags pa/ phyi dar gyi dus su sum rtags gnyis las gzhan mi bzhugs shing / phyis kyi mkhas pa dag gis gzhung de gnyis rang la brten pa dang / yig rnying rnams dang yang sgo bstun nas brda dag gi bstan bcos rnams brtsams pa yin mod kyi/ 'on kyang rtsa bar yan lag ma tshang ba'i rgyus don 'ga' zhig mi gsal ba dang / ma rdzogs pa rnams la rang stobs kyis dpyad 105—240

pa'i tshul mi mtshungs pa sna tshogs byung ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin pas/ 'dir yang mtha' gcig tu nges pa ma byas par/ 'dul mdo rgyud gsum so sor sdeb sbyor gyi srol mtshungs par byas/ nang gses su sdeb sbyor cung mi 'dra ba phyogs gang byas kyang skyon du mi 'gyur snyam pa rnams 'dra min de ka sor bzhag las/gcig 'gres kho na ma byas shing / ma mya dang sa stsogs dang ral gri la ral gyi sogs / yul skad la shor bar grags pa rnams mkhas pa dag gis kyang mi bzhed pas dor/ da drag ni sum rtags kyi dgongs par 'byor mod kyi phyis blo ldan shes rab sogs kyis yi ge zor yang ba'i ched du bsdus pa bzhin du byas te/dbu'i rgya skad rnams legs sbyar kho na ltar bcos pa dang / gzhi zur chag can 'ga' zhig rang mal du bzhag /yul dang me tog dang srog chags la sogs pa'i mang legs sbyar du yod pa rnams dang / mdo phyogs la sngon gyi lo tsā ba dag gis bod kyis ji bzhin klog bde ba'i khyad kyis/ gi ta ma la 'go'u ta ma sogs bris pa lta bu dang / legs sbyar nyid dang mthun pa sogs ci rigs par snang bas de ga ltar sor bzhag la/ mi bcos su mi rung ba 'ga' zhig bcos/ sngags skor rnams la dpyad bzod pa dag legs sbyar nyid dang sgo bstun nas bcos pa sogs mdor na/ bkas bcad bye brag tu rtogs byed chen mo dang / sgra sbyor bam po gnyis pa dang / thon mi'i sum rtags dang / smra sgo rtsa 'grel dang /gzhan yang mkhas pa dag gis brtsams pa'i brda legs par sbyor ba'i bstan bcos rnams dang bstun te/ sngon rjes kyi 'jug pa gnyis/ de dgos pa ci'i phyir tshul ji ltar 'jug pa/ de so so'i rtags kyi dbye ba dang dus gsum gyi sgrub pa tha dad pa/ de la'ang spyir btang dmigs bsal/ tshig phyi ma dang sbrel ba'i 105—241

mtshams sbyor/ rnam dbye dang tshig phrad la sogs pa tshul ji lta ba bzhin du bgyis te/ kho bos dag bkod byas pa bzhin du blo gsal gzhan dag gis lan mang du bsgrags nas zhus dag legs par bgyis shing / dogs gnas che ba rnams dpyis phyin par rang nyid kyis gtan la phab ste/ gsung rab bzhugs tshogs ches pa dang / zhus dag mkhan po blo gros dman pas phye ma leb kyis nam mkha'i mtha' nyul ba lta bur gyur pa'i phyir ma rtogs pa dang / log par rtog pa gtan med do zhes smra bar mi nus kyang / sngon ṭī na'i yul du gong ma tā min g.yung lo chen pos bka' 'gyur ro cog gi par bzhengs pa dang / 'di nyid kyi ma phyi sa tham rgyal pos bzhengs pa 'di sogs las khyad par du 'phags shing dpyod ldan gyis yid rton pa'i gnas su 'os par sems so// //gsum pa bzhengs tshul dngos ni par yig 'dri ba'i yo byad kyi shog bu dang snag tsha la sogs pa dang / par gzhi'i shing rnams dang bcas pa thams cad la dbang yod kyis mi ser bskul cing khral len pa sogs mi mdzad pa smos ci dgos/rin thang yul dus la dpag pa las lhag par stsal te/ thams cad rgyu dag cing phun sum tshogs par mdzad nas/ gzabs ma 'dri ba'i yi ge pa snga sor bod chen gyi ljongs 'dir ha cang mkhas pa med mod kyi/ legs byas rgya chen po 'di'i dbu btsugs pa tsam nas ma bos par yang bsod nams chen po'i mgron du 'ongs pa'i yi ge pa mang po 'dus pa la so so'i yo byad thams cad bla nas sbyar te / 'jam dbyangs sprul pa thon mi saṃ bho ṭa'i rnal dpyod kyi zlos gar las/bod yul gyi yi ge gsar du byon pa nas brtsams te/ phyis khyung po g.yu khris thig 185—242

khongs nas drangs shing rong pos lhan thabs mdzad pa'i rgyun ji lta ba bzhin du ma chos nyi shu rtsa gcig /bu chos bcu drug /spyi chos gsum bcas chos bzhi bcu'i mtshan nyid tshang bar 'bad pa chen pos sbyong bdar byed du 'jug pa gnang nas/de dag dus thung ngur byangs shing mkhas par gyur pa/ dpon yig pa drug cu lhag tsam gyis lhun grub steng gi bla brang chen mo'i nang du par yig 'dri ba'i grwa btsugs pa dang / de bzhin du par brkos pa bzhi brgya lhag dang / zhus dag pa bcu skor/ shing bzo ba/ shog bu mkhan po/ snag las pa/ shog las pa sogs las chen shin tu mang ba bar ma chad du bsten pa'i rim pas zhus dag zin pa dang par yig 'dri/ de zin nas par yig la yig mkhan so sos bar zhus lan gnyis dang / zhus dag mkhan po rnams kyis lan gnyis te bzhi bzhir zhus dag byed/ de zin nas par brkos pa rnams la so sor sprod pa sogs las spyi'i do dam pa grub dbang byang chub gling pa'i dpon rgyud du skyes shing brda dag par byed pa'i sbyor ba sogs la mkhas pas gsung rab la lta ba'i mig grungs por gyur pa dge slong kurma dpal grub dang / mi dbang nyid kyi zhabs phyi nang 'khor ba yig rtsis dang sgyu rtsal sogs la byang zhing gzhung drang la tshugs thub pa/ khog yangs la dkyel che ba/ phyi rgya bsrungs nas zhib tig mi 'chor pa sogs ya rabs kyi yon tan dang ldan pa drung yig tshe ring 'phel gyis byas te sa bya nas chu glang bar bgrang bya lnga'i ngo mthong bar brtson pa chen pos bsgrubs pa yin no//de dag gi tshe na dus nar mar sbyar dgos pa'i bza' btung dang / bar bar du ston mo dang / dga' spro'i gsol ras sogs bzang zhing rgya che ba mi bgrang bar las tshan so so'i yon dang par shing sogs kyi rin bcas rags pa 105—243

zhig bsdoms par glegs bam brgya phrag gcig dang rnying rgyud dum gsum bcas la bzang ja sbob rtse stong phrag bdun dang drug brgya nyer gnyis song bas mtshon/nam yang zhum pa med pa'i gtong ba chen po'i phyag legs par brkyangs pas thams cad dga' ba dang mgu ba dang rangs pa'i mchog tu gyur to//de ltar par du bsgrubs zin nas kyang zhus dag lan mang du bgyis te yid rton du rung bar gyur pa de ma thag thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i rgyal tshab tu seng ge'i khri chen por mnga' gsol ba mkhan chen maṅga la'i mtshan can gyis rdo rje'i slob dpon gyi bya ba mdzad de lha sngags ting nge 'dzin gyi rnal 'byor la goms pa brtas pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa mang po dang thabs gcig tu dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas ye shes pa mngon sum du gzhug par mdzad pa sogs rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga sbyor dngos mjug gi rim pa tshang zhing ma 'khrugs pa lan du mar bskyar nas 'gro ba lha dang bcas pa thams cad kyis mchod pa'i gnas zla med pa/ 'dod pa legs dgu cog thams cad 'byor par byed pa'i rin po che chen po skye 'gro'i bde skyid dang / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i rtsa lag chen por gyur pa 'di grub pa yin no//'dir smras pa/ mi bdag sa yi tshangs pa ches/ /chos don 'dod thar gdong bzhi las/ /legs spyad rig byed 'di phyung bas/ /nor 'dzin dpal mo kun dgar gyur/ /gang gi grags pa gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /lam gsum nyid du 'ongs pa na/ /srid pa dug can las skyes pa'i/ /nyes pa de dag ring du song / /legs byas rgya chen 'di brtan pa'i/ /kun bzod dkyil 'khor phrag pa la/ /mngon par bkod pa'i lhag ma can/ /ltos 'gro'i snyems pa 'dir ltos shig /705—244

dbreg par byas so snyigs ma'i dus/ /mtshan mor gyur la mi sbyin skyes/ /rtsod pa'i tha mar mchod sdong che/ /snga na med par 'khrungs 'dis so/ /e ma skye 'gror phan bde yi/ /gtong ba chen po sgrub pa'i phyag /snying stobs 'o mtsho las byung bas/ /'dod 'byung sa brtol dbang po bzhin/ /gang gi rang bzhin snying stobs rma med gzhig par mi nus rdo rje nyid yin zho 'thung rus pa de ma yin/ /gang gi legs byas shin tu dkar ba bzhed dgu'i 'dod 'jo dpag bsam dngos yin ko bi da ra de ma yin/ /gang gi grags pa skye rgya'i snying la sim pa ster byed zla ba nyid yin ri bong 'dzin pa de ma yin/ /gang dag yon tan bye ba'i rang bzhin nor bu'i do shal spel legs 'di yin musti ka phreng de ma yin/ /bya dka'i rgya mtsho rlabs chen rgal dka' gegs byed 'jigs rung 'dzin khri'i gnas/ /dus kyi rba rlabs gnam du rkyong tshe byis pa rnams ni dogs pa skye/ /dpa' rnams blo gros nam yang mi nyams thabs shes gdos pa 'dzin pa can/ /'bad pa chen po'i gru chen tshags bcug bde bar pha rol phyin par 'gyur/ /drag pos bsregs pa'i lus kyi lhag mas bye ba khrag khrig dpung bshams te/ /mi bzad me char drag po phab kyang dam pa rnams kyi snying stobs ni/ /zla ba mthong ba'i kun+da bzhin du phyir zhing rgyas pa kho na las/ /bri bar 'gyur min des na de ring bdud las rnam par rgyal 'di ltos/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' gangs can gyi brdas drangs pa'i phyi mo'i tshogs ji snyed pa par du bsgrubs pa'i tshul las nye bar brtsams pa'i gtam bzang po blo ldan mos pa'i kun+da yongs su kha bye ba'i zla 'od gzhon nu'i 'khri shing las rgyal ba'i gsung rab gangs ri'i khrod du deng sang ji tsam snang ba par du bsgrubs pa'i byung ba dngos legs par bshad pa'i yal 'dab ste gsum pa'o/ /105—245

gang zhig mtshan mo'i smag rum stug pos sman gyi nags tshal mdzes byed cing / /gzi byin mtshungs med nyin mo'i dpal yang 'byung po'i bya rnams mun par byed/ /lugs rnams sna tshogs blo ldan dag la phan pa'i mdza' bzhin nyer gnas kyang / /phyi ma'i dus 'dir thub pa'i bstan yang phyogs re'i mig can 'khrul pa'i rgyu/ /kho bo'i lhag bsam pad rtsa lta bus drang po'i gnas su rkang bkod kyang / /gya gyur rgyu ba'i lam srol la brten gzhan gyi 'dod pa dang du blangs/ /de phyir 'di na 'tsham par bsdus pa'i rgyal gsung mā li ka yi phreng / /dri med spel 'di smra mkhas rnams kyis mgrin pa'i rgyan du da longs shig /de ltar par du bsgrub par bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs de dag gi bzhugs byang dkar chag tu bkod pa dngos la mdo sngags kyi tshan gnyis las/ dang po la'ang 'khor lo dang por gtogs pa 'dul ba lung gi skor dang / 'khor lo bar pa shes phyin gyi skor dang / 'khor lo tha ma'i mdo gzhung bzhugs tshogs che ba'i skor dang / mdo mang du grags pa theg pa che chung gi mdo ci rigs pa phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i skor dang bzhi'o//dang po ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston gyis dang por pa'i so thar dang rnam 'byed/ de nas ma'i so thar dang rnam 'byed/ lung gzhi/ phran tshegs/lung zhu ba rnams kyi 'grig rim mdzad cing / gong dkar bas/ thog mar so thar gnyis/ de nas lung gzhi/ rnam 'byed/ zhu ba/ phran tshegs rnams kyi go rims mdzad mod kyi/ 'dir sngon gyi dkar chags 'phang thang ma sogs dang mthun par byung ba'i tshal pa bka' 'gyur sor bzhag ltar gyi sgrig rim byas par/'dul ba gzhi/ pa'i so thar dang rnam 'byed/ ma'i so thar dang rnam 105—247

'byed / phran tshogs/ gzhung bla ma rnams rim par bzhag pa'i dang po gzhi bcu bdun rgyas par ston pa lung gzhir grags pa la sh+lau ka sum khri nyis stong bdun brgya bam po brgya dang dgu bzhugs pa'i glegs bam ka pa la/ rang byung gi gzhi/gso sbyong gi gzhi/ dgag dbye'i gzhi/ dbyar gnas kyi gzhi/ ko lpags kyi gzhi'i stod yan bam po nyi shu rtsa bzhi ba'i bar bzhugs so//kha pa la/ ko lpags kyi gzhi'i smad/ sman gyi gzhi'i stong yan bam po nyi shu rtsa lnga pa nas lnga bcu rtsa bzhi pa'i bar bzhugs so//ga pa la/ sman gyi gzhi'i smad/ gos kyi gzhi/ sra brkyang gi gzhi/ kau shāsbyi'i gzhi/ las kyi gzhi/ dmar ser can gyi gzhi/ gang zag gi gzhi/ spo ba'i gzhi/ gso sbyong gzhag pa'i gzhi/ gnas mal gyi gzhi/ rtsod pa'i gzhi/dbyen gyi gzhi'i stod cha yan bam po lnga bcu rtsa lnga pa nas brgyad cu rtsa gnyis pa'i bar bzhugs so//nga pa la/ dbyen gyi gzhi'i mjug bam po gya gsum pa nas bam po brgya dang dgu'i bar gyis yongs su rdzogs pa bzhugs te kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta sarba dzñā de wa dang /rgya gar gyi mkhan po bit+yā ka ra pra bha dang / kha che'i mkhan po dharmā ka ra dang /bod kyi lo tsā ba ban+de dpal gyi lhun po'i 'gyur la/ slar yang rgya gar gyi mkhan po bit+yā ka ra pra bha dang / lo tsā ba ban+de dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur cing zhus pa'o//ca pa la/ dge slong pa'i khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum mdor bsdus nas ston pa pa'i so thar gyi mdo sh+lau ka bdun brgya/ bam po gnyis pa/ kha che bye brag tu smra ba'i slob dpon dzi na mi tra dang / lo tsā ba cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur cing zhus pa/ de'i don rgya cher bshad pa pha'i rnam 'byed sh+lau ka nyi khri 105—248

bzhi stong dgu brgya bam po brgyad cu rtsa gsum pa las pham pa bzhi dang lhag ma bcu gsum las dbyen byed pa'i lhag ma yan chad bam po nyer gcig pa'i bar bzhugs so//cha pa la/ lhag ma'i 'phro gsum dang / ma nges pa'i chos gnyis/ spang ltung sum cu/ ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu las bcu gcig pa yan bam po nyer gnyis pa nas bam po bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis pa'i bar bzhugs so//ja pa la/ ltung byed bcu gnyis pa nas bdun cu rtsa gnyis pa yan bam po zhe gsum pa nas bam po re gnyis pa'i bar bzhugs so//nya pa la/ ltung byed bdun cu rtsa gsum pa man tshang ba/ sor bshags bzhi / bslab pa'i chos mang po/ rtsod pa zhi byed kyi chos mang po ste pha'i rnam 'byed yongs su rdzogs pa bam po re gsum pa nas bam po gya gsum pa rdzogs pa'i bar slob dpon dzi na mi tra dang / lo tsā ba ban+de klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba bzhugs so//ta pa la/ dge slong ma'i khrims sum brgya drug cu rtsa bzhi bsdus nas ston pa ma'i so thar gyi mdo sh+lau ka brgyad brgya bam po gnyis pa 'gyur byang snga ma dang 'dra ba / de'i don rgyas par ston pa dge slong ma'i 'dul ba rnam 'byed blo ka brgyad stong bzhi brgya dang bam po nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa 'gyur byang lung gzhi dang mtshungs pa dag bzhugs so//tha pa la/ ma tshang ba kha bskang ba 'dul ba lung phran tshegs sgo brgya dkar rdzogs pa sh+lau ka chig khri bdun stong bdun brgya dang bam po lnga bcu rtsa dgu pa las bam po nyi shu rtsa bdun pa yan bzhugs so//105—249

da pa la/ de'i 'phros bam po nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa nas bam po lnga bcu rtsa dgu pa'i bar rdzogs pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po bibyā ka ra pra bha dang / dharmā shrī bha dra dang /lo tsā ba ban+de dpal 'byor gyis bsgyur ba bzhugs so/ /phran tshegs 'di skabs sngon gyi dkar chag rnams su bam tshad sogs sna tshogs byung ba ni lo tsā ba mang pos dum bur bsgyur bas phyogs gcig tu bsdoms pa'i tshe tshang ma tshang ci rigs byung ba'i rkyen gyis yin la sgo brgyad ka yongs su rdzogs pa 'di ni la stod 'ol rgod kyi gtsug lag khang du gnas brtan dar ma seng shes lung sde bzhi bzhengs pa'i tshe dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'dul ba 'dzin pa zhing mo che ba byang chub seng shes phyag len mdzad nas spyir dbus gtsang gi gtsug lag khang rnams na bzhugs pa dang / khyad par du bsam yas mchims phu nas dag chung pa dang / dge slong tshul khrims yon tan gyis rnyed pa'i lung rnams dpe yon dang 'bad rtsol chen pos btsal te/ de dag la gtugs pas lung phran tshegs kha cig la mi bzhugs pa / kha cig la bzhugs pa rnams kyis bskangs nas bsabs pa ni bam po sum cu rtsa gsum sman chen po'i gtam rgyud kyi skabs nas/ sman chen pos smras pa/gal te de lta na skyugs shig dang bden nam rdzun blta'o zhes smras pa dang zhes bya ba nas bam po sum cu rtsa bzhi pa'i dbu/ ji tsam na de grong khyer nas byung ba dang / bram ze mong brtul zhes bya bas gos kyi mtha' ma nas 'jus nas zhes bya ba'i bar du bam po gcig chad pa bskangs/ sdom ni nga yang sman gyis de bzhin no zhes bya ba'i 'og tu yig tshar gcig chad pa bskangs/ de nas bam po sum cu rtsa bzhi pa'i smad ne tso spyod gsal gyi skabs rdzogs pa'i/ e ma'o 'di ltar khyod mkhas pa sha stag dang phrad pa ni bsod nams dang ldan no zhes smras so/ /zhes bya 105—250
