bde skyid dang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gnyi ga'i rtsa lag tu gyur pa 'di lta bu la ni bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po gang gis kyang bsgrun par mi nus pa'i phyir ro/ /khyad par du deng sang snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i mun klong stug por g.yo bas mnyam med shākya'i dbang po'i bstan pa rin po che'ang nub pa la thag mi ring ba'i skabs 'di lta bur dam pa'i chos yun ring du gnas pa'i phyir 'bad pa chen pos bzung ba ni gzhar yang sman yon gyi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa ste/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo las/ gang gis sangs rgyas stong rnams dang / /brgya dang bye ba bgrang dag la/ /bskal pa gaṅgā bye ma snyed/ /de snyed bskal par bkur ba bas/ /'jig rten mgon gyis gsungs pa yi/ /dam chos 'jig tshe gang zhig gis/ /nyin dang mtshan du 'dzin byed pa/ /de ni bsod nams khyad par 'phags/ /chos 'jig dus na chos 'dzin pa/ /sngon gyi sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /sangs rgyas ye shes rab gnas pa/ /nga la des ni mchod pa byed/ /dam pa'i chos ni 'jig pa'i tshe/ /ston pa'i bstan pa srung byed pa/ /bskal pa bye ba stong rnams su/ /de ni nams kyang rgyad mi 'gyur/ /lus kyis bde ba myong 'gyur zhing / /de ni nad kyis btab mi 'gyur/ /de ni yid du mi 'ong bas/ /nams kyang 'phrog par mi 'gyur ro/ /ston pa'i bstan pa bsrung bas na/ /bzod pa phun sum tshogs pa dang / /des dang gsal dang mnyen pa dang / /sems can rnams la byams sems 'gyur/ /'jig tshe rgyal ba mchog gi chos bzung bas/ /bde dang dga' 'thob ma dzod ni mang por 'gyur / /sngon gyi rim gro bya ba 'thob 'gyur zhing / /mi khom brgyad po ma lus zad par spong / /'jig tshe rgyal ba mchog gi chos bzung bas/ /dper na nam 185—349

mkha' skar mas yongs gang ltar/ /rtag tu mtshan gyis go char byas pa dang / /rab tu tshig snyan yid 'ong dbyangs ldan 'gyur/ /'jig tshe rgyal ba mchog gi chos bzung bas/ /gang na yid bde med cing rab sdug pa/ /rigs dman de ni de yis spangs par 'gyur/ /phyug cing shin tu bde la longs spyod ldan/ /'jig tshe rgyal ba mchog gi chos bzung bas/ /mthu dang stobs dang ldan zhing brtson 'grus ldan/ /mi dman sa rnams kun tu rnam par rgyu/ /sangs rgyas brgya stong dag la bsnyen bkur byed/ /'jig tshe rgyal ba mchog gi chos bzung bas / /mchog tu rab mdzes gzugs ldan shes rab ldan/ /mi yi 'jig rten mchog tu bsnyen bkur 'gyur/ /rgyal po mkhas pa mdzangs pa rnams kyis bsngags / /'jig tshe rgyal ba mchog gi chos bzung bas/ /mchog tu gzugs mdzes blta na sdug pa dang / /skyes pa bud med lha rnams dga' ba dang / /bde zhing mkhas la bsngags shing shes rab ldan/ /ston pa stobs bcu mnga' ba lha yi lhas/ /gang gi mdun du mdo 'di rab bshad pa/ /mi de'i lag tu mdo sde 'di 'dra 'di/ /phyi ma'i dus kyi tshe na thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang /gser 'od dam pa las/ nga yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'og tu yang 'thor zhing nub par mi 'gyur bar byed pa de ni bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi rgyu yang dag pa yin pas bsod nams ji snyed cig 'thob par 'gyur ba ni bskal pa gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du brjod kyang mthar thug par mi 'gyur ro/ /dge slong ngam / dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma'am/ gzhan yang rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo la sogs pa gang la la zhig /mchod pa dang bkur sti byas nas yi ger bris te rgya cher spel ba dang / gzhan dag la yang dag 185—350

par ston par byed pas thob pa'i bsod nams gang yin pa de'ang de bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs pa sogs mdo rgyud rnams nas rgya cher 'byung ba ltar ro/ /de'ang dam pa'i chos 'dzin pa dngos ni mdzod las ston pa'i dam chos rnam gnyis te/lung dang rtog pa'i bdag nyid do/ /de 'dzin byed pa smra byed dang / /sgrub par byed pa kho na yin/ /zhes lung gi dam chos thos bsam gyi sgo nas 'dzin pa dang /rtogs pa'i dam chos nyams len gyi sgo nas 'dzin pa gnyis gsungs pa yin zhing /de la gsung rab kyi phyi mo glegs bam gyi phreng bar 'khod pa med na thos bsam byed pa me 'byung la/ de med par yang sgrub pa nyams len mi 'byung bas chos yongs su 'dzin pa'i rtsa ba'ang 'di nyid kho nar shes par bya'o/ /de lta bu'i phan yon chen po dang ldan pa'i glegs bam gyi phyi mo rnams gang du bzhugs pa'i sa phyogs de nyid du'ang dge legs kyi mtshan ma mang po phun sum tshogs par 'byung ba yin te/ bdud rtsi brjod pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo las/ yul gang na mdo sde 'di lta bu 'di 'dzin pa dang / chos smra ba gnas pa'am/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di glegs bam du bris te yod pa'i yul der nad dang / yams kyi nad dang / gnod pa dang / 'go ba'i nad dang / 'khrug pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / de nyid las rgyal ba'i sras po byams pas zhal gyis bzhes pa'i tshul yang / yul gang na mdo sde 'di 'dzin pa de lta bu dag gnas pa'i yul der bdag gis dus ma lags pa'i bser ma dang / dgung char dang / mu ge dang / bro nad ya nga ba dang / mi ngas dang / yams kyi nad dang / 'go ba'i nad dang / gnod pa dang 'khrug pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar bgyi'o/ /yul gang na chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'chang ba dang / glegs 105wa 351

bam du bgyis pa'am/ rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mor btags pa la mchod pa bgyid pa'i yul der bdag gi byin gyis brlabs kyis pha rol gyi dmag tshogs thams cad dang / chom rkun dang / srin po dang / mkha' 'gro ma'i ya nga ba thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /gang dag na chos smra ba 'di lta bu dag dang / mdo sde 'di 'chang ba'i yul der/ bdag gis lo tog dang nor dang 'bru dang me tog dang lo ma dang 'bras bu thams cad phun sum tshogs pa dang / bde ba thams cad 'byung bar byin gyis brlab par bgyi'o/ /zhes 'byung ba dang /gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po las kyang mdo de nyid kyis mtshon nas theg chen gyi mdo rnams gang du bzhugs shing spel ba dang mchod pa'i rgyal po sogs yod pa der rgyal po chen po bzhi sogs kyis skyong bar byed pa'i tshul rgya cher 'byung zhing khyad par du/ bcom ldan 'das mi'i rgyal po gang gi yul du mdo sde'i dbang po 'dzin pa'i dge slong chos smra ba de dag mchi bar 'gyur ba'i yul de dag tu gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di yang bsten par 'gyur ro/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das nam mi'i rgyal pos gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di mnyan te thos nas mdo sde'i dbang po 'di 'dzin pa'i dge slong de dag phyir rgol ba de dag las kun tu srung bar bgyid/yongs su skyob pa dang / yongs su 'dzin pa dang / yongs su skyong bar bgyid na / btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag cag rgyal po chen po bzhis mi'i rgyal po de'i yul thams cad na gnas pa'i sems can rnams kun du bsrung bar bgyi/yongs su bskyab pa dang / yongs su gzung ba dang / yongs su bskyang ba dang /zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur bar bgyi'o/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das mi'i 185—352

rgyal pos nam dge slong ngam dge slong ma'am dge bsnyen nam dge bsnyen ma mdo sde'i dbang po 'dzin pa la bde bar sbyar ba thams cad kyis bde bar bgyid na btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag cag rgyal po chen po bzhis mi'i rgyal po de'i yul thams cad na gnas pa'i sems can rnams la bde ba'i yo byad thams cad kyis bde ba dang yo byad thams cad phun sum tshogs par bgyi'o/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das nam mi'i rgyal pos dge slong ngam dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam dge bsnyen ma mdo sde'i dbang po 'di 'dzin pa la bsti stang bgyid/bla mar bgyid/ rim gror bgyid cing mchod na btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag cag rgyal po chen po bzhis mi'i rgyal po chen po de la rgyal po thams cad bas ches bsti stang du bgyi/ ches bla mar bgyi/ ches rim gror bgyi/ ches mchod par bgyi ste yul thams cad du yang rab tu bsngags par bgyi'o/ /zhes sogs mdo rnams las rgya cher gsungs pa smos kyis mi lang zhing / 'di lta bu'i bde bar gshegs pas gsung rab kyi glegs bam rgyas pa'i phyi mo'i tshul gyis snyigs ma'i dus su 'gro ba'i don mdzad par snang ba'i bdag rkyen bsam sbyor rma med pa'ang rgyal ba nyid kyi rnam par 'phrul par shes dgos te/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi stobs bskyed pa'i cho 'phrul rnam par 'phrul pa bstan pa'i mdo las / kye rgyal ba'i bu dag de bzhin te de bzhin gshegs pa'i thabs mkhas pa dang sems can yongs su smin par bya ba ni mang ngo / /sems can rnams kyi bsam pa ji lta bu dang / ji ltar 'dul ba dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba ji lta bu dang /sems can rnams kyi mos pa sna tshogs kyi spyod pa mkhyen nas chos ston te/sems can kha cig ni byang chub sems dpas 'dul/ zhes sogs nas/ kha 185—353

cig ni sku gzugs byed du gzhug pa dang / ri mo dang / gser dang /dngul dang ra gan gyi sku gzugs byed du gzhug pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba la spro ba bskyed pas 'dul/ kha cig ni dge slong gi dge 'dun la mchod pa dang bkur sti bya ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba la spro ba bskyed pas 'dul/ kha cig ni mdo sde 'dri ba dang / 'drir gzhug pa dang / bklag pa la spro ba bskyed pas 'dul/ kha cig ni mar me dang / spos dang / me tog dang / dri dang / phreng ba dang /byug pa dang / do shal la sogs pas brgyan pa la spro ba bskyed pas 'dul ba yin te zhes pa'i bar dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las 'das kyang sbyor ba sna tshogs kyis ring bsrel mchod pa dang / mchod rten dang /gtsug lag khang dang / sku gzugs byed du gzhug pa dang / rab tu 'byung ba'i phyir khyim nas 'byung ba dang / dge slong gi dge 'dun la mchod pa dang /dam pa'i chos 'dri ba dang / bklag pa dang / kha ton du bya ba la spro ba bskyed pa dag gis kyang sems can thams cad thar bar mdzad ces sogs gsungs pa ltar nges pa'i phyir ro//gsum pa bsngo smon gyi skor la/ spyir theg pa chen po'i bsngo ba'i rnam bzhag /bsngo ba bgyid dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ ji ltar bsngo ba'i tshul/ bsngo smon gyi tshigs su bcad pa dngos so/ /dang po la bsngo ba'i ngo bo nges tshig dbye ba ste gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ rnam dkar gyi yon tan zag bcas dang zag med mtha' dag mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i go 'phang gi phyir blo'i stobs kyis yongs su bsgyur ba ste/ de'ang rgyan las/ brtan pa rnams kyi smon lam 105—354

wa ————————————— — — — — —ni / /sems dpa' 'dun dang bcas pa ste/ /zhes dge rtsa byang chub tu stob par byed pa'i 'dun sems sa bon dang bcas par bshad cing / mngon rtogs rgyan las/ yongs su bsngo ba khyad par can/ /de yi byed pa mchog yin no/ /zhes gsungs so//gnyis pa nges tshig ni legs sbyar gyi skad du ba ri ṇa ta ste yongs su spel ba'am yongs su bsgyur ba la bya bas/ dge rtsa zag bcas rnams zag med du bsgyur ba'am/ 'dzad par 'gyur ba'i dge rtsa rnams mi zad par spel ba'i phyir de skad du grags so//gsum pa dbye ba ni/ spyir skyes bu gsum gyi rim pas gsum dang / de re re la'ang gnyis gnyis te drug tu 'gyur yang / 'dir skyes bu chen po sor baspyag / dbang du btang bar bsngo ba ma dag pa dang / dag pa rnam pa gnyis su 'a ji nga /po/ ni/ shes phyin sdud pa las/ yongs bsngo gal te sems su 'du shes 'byung 'gyur zhing / /byang chub 'du shes yongs bsngo sems can 'du shes na / /'du shes phyir na lta gnas sems ni gsum la chags/ /dmigs pa yod pas yongs su bsngos par chud ma yin/ /zhes dang / gal te mtshan mar byed na de ni bsngo ma yin/ /ci ste mtshan ma med na byang chub bsngo ba yin/ /ji ltar dug dang 'dres pa'i kha zas bzang za ba/ /dkar po'i chos la dmigs pa'ang de 'drar rgyal bas gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gang du bsngo ba'i yul dang /gang bsngo ba'i dngos po dang / gang gis sngo ba'i byed pa po ste 'khor gsum la mtshan mar bzung nas sngo ba byed pa'o//105wa 355

gnyis pa ni/ mdo de nyid las/ gal te 'di ltar chos 'di 'gags shing zad pa dang / /gang du yongs su bsngo ba de yang zad pa dang / /chos kyis chos la nam yang mi bsngo shes gyur na/ /de ltar rab tu shes pas yongs su bsngos pa yin / /zhes gsungs pa ltar 'khor gsum dmigs bral gyi bsngo ba nyid do/ /phyi ma bsngo ba rnam par dag pa 'di nyid la nang gses su dbye na mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan las/ de ni dmigs med rnam pa can/ /phyin ci ma log mtshan nyid do/ /dben dang sangs rgyas bsod nams tshogs/ /rang bzhin dran pa'i spyod yul can/ /thabs mkhas mtshan ma med pa dang / /sangs rgyas rjes su yi rang dang / /khams gsum gtogs pa ma yin dang / /chung dang 'bring dang chen po yi/ /bsngo ba gzhan ni rnam gsum po/ /bsod nams che 'byung bdag nyid do/ /zhes bshad pa ltar rnam pa bcu gcig tu 'gyur te/'phags pa grol sdes nyi khri snang bar/ mi dmigs pa'i rnam pa can gyi yongs su bsngo ba ni/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs dang po bskyed pa nas brtsams te dam pa'i chos gnas pa'i bar gyi tshul khrims la sogs pa'i phung po rnams dang / de yongs su bsdus pa dang / theg pa gsum gyis yongs su smin par byas pa dang / rnam par grol bar byed pa'i sems can rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad gcig tu bsdus te rjes su yi rangs shing yongs su bsngos nas dngos po gang zhig yin zhes bya ba nas brtsams te/ dngos po dang / dmigs pa dang / byang chub kyi sems dang dge ba'i rtsa ba dang / rjes su yi rang byed dang ldan pa'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po ni gang yin zhes bya ba dang /sems ni zad cing 'gags la bral zhing rnam par gyur pa nyid ces bya ba nas/105—356

wa wa ——————————————————chos thams cad dngos po med pa'i rjes su 'gro ba mi dmigs pa'i rnam par yongs su bsngos pa legs pa nyid kyis zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs pa yin no/ /de la dngos po ni rigs so/ /dmigs pa ni chos thams cad do/ /byang chub kyi ched du bya ba'i sems ni 'dzin par byed pa'i rnam par rtog pa'o/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba ni ma chags pa la sogs pa'o/ /bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po ni sems pa'o//zad pa ni bsags pa rnam par 'jig pas so/ /'gag pa ni rgyun gyis 'jig pas so/ /bral ba ni rang bzhin gyis 'jig pas so/ /rnam par gyur pa ni rnam par 'gyur ba'i rnam par 'jig pas so//phyin ci ma log pa'i mtshan nyid kyi yongs su bsngo ba ni/ sems gang gis yongs su bsngo ba'i sems/ de nyid kyi chos nyid kyang de yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong ngo zhes gang gsungs pa yin no//dben pa'i gnas su bsngo ba ni/ gal te byang chub sems dpa' chen pos bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po mngon par 'du bya ba de phung po la sogs pas dben par shes te/ zhes bya ba nas brtsams te/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams sdud sdo nyid kyi ngo bos dben par shes te zhes bya ba'i bar du gang gsungs pa na sa/nga/sa rgyas kyi chos dge ba'i rtsa ba'i rigs su gtogs pa'i rang bzhin dran pa'i yongs su bsngo ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams rigs gang dag yin pa dang / rang bzhin gang yin pa de bzhin du bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po de yongs su bsngo bar byed pa zhes gang gsungs pa yin no//

thabs la mkhas pa'i yongs su bsngo ba ni 'dir byang chub sems dpa' chen pos thabs la mkhas pa de dag la bslab par bya ba la sogs pa gang gsungs pa yin no//mtshan ma med pa'i yongs su bsngo ba ni/ kha zas dug dang bcas pa'i dpes mtshan ma'i 'du shes can gyi yongs su bsngo ba ni dug can zug rngu can te zhes bya ba la sogs pa gang gsungs pa yin no//sangs rgyas kyis rjes su gnang ba'i bsngo ba ni/ ji ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis sangs rgyas kyi ye shes bla na med pas mkhyen pa de bzhin du yongs su bsngo'o zhes bya ba la sogs pa gang gsungs pa yin no//khams gsum du gtogs pa ma yin pa'i yongs su bsngo ba ni/ gzhan yang dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag 'di ltar yongs su bsngo bar bya ste/ ji ltar gzugs khams gsum gyi khongs su chud pa ma yin te zhes bya ba la sogs pa gang gsungs pa yin no//bsod nams chen po 'byung ba'i bsngo ba'ang chung ngu dang / 'bring dang /chen po'i dbye bas rnam pa gsum yin no/ /de la chung ngu ni dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam nas brtsams te mngon par shes pa lnga zhes bya ba'i bar dang / 'jig rten pa'i rtog pa la gnas pa/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can gyi dpes yongs su bsngo ba 'di bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo zhes bya ba'i bar du gang gsungs pa'o/ /'bring ni/ yang de snyed cig kho na rgyun tu zhugs pa nas dgra bcom par gyur pa la bkur sti dang /mchod pa la sogs pa byas pa'i bsod nams kyi dpes/ bsod nams 'di snga ma 105—358

bzhin du gang gsungs pa yin no/ /chen po ni sems can de snyed kho na bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la gnas pa la phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can rnams re res mchod pa'i bsod nams kyi dpes mi dmigs par yongs su bsngo ba'i bsod nams snga ma bzhin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na / de dag thams cad ni mi dmigs pa nyid kyis so zhes bya ba la sogs pa gang gsungs pa yin no/ /zhes mdo dang sbyar nas rgyas par bkral lo//gnyis pa bsngo ba bgyid dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ 'dus byas kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba shin tu stobs che ba dag kyang byang chub tu yongs su bsngo bar ma byas na phal cher lha mi la sogs pa'i bde 'byor gyi 'bras bu phyung nas zad par 'gyur zhing /'ga' zhig ni kun dkris drag po la sogs pa'i rkyen gyis bar ma dor chud za ba'ang yod pas so/ /byang chub tu yang dag par bsngos zin nas nam yang nyams par mi 'gyur te/ blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo las tshig lhug par gsungs pa'i don/ ji ltar chu thigs rgya mtsho che nang lhung / /rgya mtsho ma skems bar du de mi skem/ /de bzhin byang chub yongs bsngos dge ba yang / /byang chub ma thob bar du de mi zad/ /zhes dang / pha rol tu phyin pa lnga bstan pa'i mdo las / ji lta ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su bsngo bar byed pa de lta de ltar pha rol tu phyin pa rnams yongs su 'dzin cing rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang yang nye bar 'gyur te/ gang gi tshe sbyin pa chung ngu'ang dpag tu med par byed pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i thabs la mkhas pa yin par rig par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dpag tu med pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes sogs rgya cher 185—359

'byung ngo //gsum pa ji ltar bsngo ba'i tshul la/ bsngo rgyu'i dge rtsa ngos bzung / de bsngo tshul dngos bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni rgyal ba'i yum las/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams gzhal du med cing grangs med pa yod pa'i phyogs re re'i stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams re rer yang 'das pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das lam chad pa 'jug pa chad pa spros pa dang srid par 'dren pa chad pa mchi ma zad pa tsher ma bcom pa khur shin tu bor ba bdag gi don rjes su thob pa srid par sbyor ba yongs su zad pa yang dag par kun shes pas sems shin tu rnam par grol ba sems thams cad kyi dbang dam pa'i pha rol tu son pa gzhal du med cing grangs med pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das par gyur pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gi sems dang po bskyed pa nas bzung ste/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i bar dang / phung po lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan 'das pa'i dbyangs su yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i bar dang / dam pa'i chos nub par ma gyur pa'i bar te/ de dag gi bar gyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa gang yin pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gi bsod nams mngon par 'du byed pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba mngon par 'du byed pa gang yin pa rnams dang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gi tshul khrims kyi phung po dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi phung po dang / shes rab kyi phung po dang / rnam par grol ba'i phung po dang / rnam par grol ba'i ye shes gzigs 105—360

pa'i phung po gang yin pa rnams dang / phan par bzhad pa gang yin pa dang byams pa chen po gang yin pa dang snying rje chen po gang yin pa dang sangs rgyas kyi yon tan gzhal du med cing grangs med pa gang yin pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis chos gang bshad pa dang / chos de la gang gis bslabs pa dang lhag par mos pa dang gnas pa de dag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba gang yin pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan pa de dag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan pa gang yin pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis gang zag rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa can gang dag rang byang chub tu lung bstan pa de dag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba gang yin pa rnams dang / gang zag nyan thos kyi theg pa can dag gi sbyin pa las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dang tshul khrims las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dang bsgoms pa las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dang slob pa'i zag pa med pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba gang yin pa rnams dang / mi slob pa'i zag pa med pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba gang yin pa rnams dang / chos de la so so'i skye bo gang dag gis dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun pa dang / lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang dri za dang lha ma yin dang nam mkha' lding dang mi'am ci dang lto 'phye chen po dang mi dang mi ma yin pa gang dag gis chos de thos te thos nas kyang dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun pa dang / byol song gi skye gnas su song ba'i sems can gang dag gis chos de thos te thos nas kyang dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun pa dang / sems can gang dag gis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba dang /105—361

yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa de dag la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun pa ste/ zhes dus gsum la sbyar te gsungs pa dang / phal po che'i rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi bsngo ba'i le'u las/ 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang / /byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa rnams/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bdag gzhan 'khor 'das dus gsum bsags yod kyi dge ba ma lus pa rnams bsngo bar bya ba yin no//gnyis pa ni/ bsngo ba byed pa po rang nyid kyis dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa sras dang slob mar bcas pa thams cad dpang por gsol te lhag pa'i bsam pa rtse gcig pas sems can thams cad la snying rje chen pos khyab par bltas te/ de dag gi don bla na med pa bsgrub par bya ba'i ched du rang nyid kyis dge ba'i rtsa ba byas pa dang / bya bar 'gyur ba dang / byed bzhin pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba des mtshon nas bshad ma thag pa'i bsngo rgyu'i dge ba srid do 'tshal de thams cad gcig tu bsdoms shing bsdus te de dag la rjes su yi rang ba dang bcas pas bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi snying po chos kyi dbyings shin tu rnam par dag pa mya ngan las 'das pa chen por dmigs pa med pa'i tshul gyis sgyu ma lta bur yongs su bsngo ba ste/ mdo sdud pa las/ 'das dus sngon gyi sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig gang / /zhing mang mtha' yas bye stong dag na gang bzhugs dang / /gang yang mya ngan 'das pa'i 'jig rten mgon po rnams/ /sdug bsngal zad par bya phyir rin chen chos ston pa/ /dang por byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed bskyed pa nas/ /rnam par 'dren pa rnams kyi dam chos zad kyi dus/ /de bar rgyal ba de dag bsod nams gang yin pa/ /pha rol phyin dang ldan dang sangs rgyas chos gang dang / /gang yang sangs rgyas sras rnams dang ni nyan thos dang / /185—362

slob dang mi slob dge ba zag bcas zag med pa/ /bsdus nas byang chub sems dpa' rjes su yi rang zhing / /'gro ba'i don rgyu byang chub phyir ni thams cad bsngo / /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de'ang 'khor gsum yongs dag gi bsngo ba mtshan nyid pa ni 'phags pa rnams kyi yin pas las dang po pa dag gis ni dang por kun rdzob pa'i bsngo ba 'dun pa drag po can gyis 'phags pa rnams kyi rjes su slob par mos pas/ 'jam dpal dpa' bos ji ltar mkhyen pa dang / /kun tu bzang po de yang de bzhin te/ /de dag mchog gi rjes su bdag slob cing / /dge ba 'di dag thams cad rab tu bsngo/ /zhes pa ltar bsngo ba dang /rjes su don dam pa'i de kho na nyid dran pa blos res 'jog tu bya ba yin no//de ltar bsngo ba'i tshul las brtsams pa'i 'phros don smos nas/ gsum pa legs byas rgya chen po 'di nyid las brtsams pa'i bsngo smon gyi tshigs su bcad pa dngos ni/ daṇ+ḍi'i gzhung lugs las 'byung ba'i tshig gi rgyan phun sum tshogs pas mdzes par byas te cung zad cig smra ba ni 'di lta'o// //maṅga la shrī yaḥsid+dhir+bha ba tu/ gang zhig dang por rig byed rnam 'byin gdong bzhi pa dang shis brjod nyan/ /srid med bu dang drag po skem byed log 'dren la sogs cher snyems dag /mngon par 'dar ldan gtsug gi nor bus gang gi zhabs pad rab brten pa/ /nyi ma'i rigs 'khrungs kun tu bzang po thub pa rnams kyi thub mchog dang / /lha yi rdzing ring yongs su bltams pa'i zhing mang dag na mdzes gyur pa/ /nyi ma lta bu'i rnam 'dren ji snyed de snyed rgyal ba'i myu gu yang / /bsam mi khyab bcas mos pa'i khang bzang rab tu nyams dga' 'dir gshegs la/ /legs byas phreng ba don ldan nyid du mnags pa'i re ba yongs 105wa 363

rdzogs mdzod/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten rgya mtsho rnams su rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas/ /gang dag 'das dang ma byon pa dang da ltar 'tsho zhing gzhes rnams kyi/ /dpag yas yon tan rin chen 'byung gnas mdzad pa med pa'i tshul nyid dang / /rga na 'chi sogs 'dam du bying ba'i 'gro ba rab sgrol phrin las che/ /de bzhin 'jig rten so skye rnams kyis ngang tshul dge bas nyer bskrun pa'i/ /sbyin la sogs pa zla 'od dung dang kun+da lta bu'i legs byas kyi/ /phreng ba rgya chen tshad med nam mkha'i khor yug khongs su rab 'bar ba/ /de dag rjes su yid rab dang ba'i mchod yon ci yang spro bar bya/ /khyad par 'di nas yi dbang phyug yid rab spro ba'i chu mtsho las/ /sngon bsags legs byas gser gyi sgo nga snying stobs drod kyis bgos pa na/ /rnam dkar yon tan srid pa rnam bkod gsung rab phyi mo tshangs pa'i spun/ /gsar du 'khrungs pa'i bsod nams dpag yas pha mtha' med 'di ngo mtshar phul/ /dge ba'i rba rlabs mngon par brtsegs pa grags pa'i spring yig phyogs kun tu/ /'dri ba'i phyag rgya rab tu g.yo ldan bsod nams klung chen 'dis mtshon te/ /srid dang zhi ba zag bcas zag med legs byas chu rgyun ji snyed pa/ /rab zhi'i bde dbyings chu gter chen por ngal 'tsho'i slad du 'jug gyur cig /de yi mthu las bye ba phrag brgya'i 'jig rten 'di dang gzhan yang rung / /chos kyi dbyings kyi mthas gtugs gyur pa'i rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'jig rten du/ /shis pa'i mtshan ma 'byams su klas pas thar mchog 'dod dgur 'jo ba'i 'dzum/ /nyin mor byed pa'i snang ba khrag khrig zil gyis gnon bzhin gsal gyur cig /de dag rnams su sdang dang ser sna rmongs pa'i tshogs kyis byin pa yi/ /mi bzad dmyal dang gshin rje'i ris dag de bzhin dud 'gro 185—364

blun pa rnams/ /rang gi tshul la ngo tsha bzhin du mi bzad rang gi gnas btang nas / /snang ba'i gnas skabs nam yang mi rnyed ming gi lhag ma nyid gyur cig /mi yi 'jig rten thub mchog chos kyi zla ris mdzes pa snang gyur pa'i/ /bsod nams me long dang ba'i mgron gyis yang yang gnyer byas mdza' na mo/ /rdzogs ldan na phra'i phang par 'dzags pa'i skal ba mchog gi dus skabs can/ /nub pa med pa'i go 'phang mchog las rtag tu g.yo bar ma gyur cig /ljongs 'dis nyer mtshon 'dzin ma'i gzhi la legs bris pa rnams dga' sems kyis/ /lag 'gro'i dbang po grogs su sbran nas glang po bsgyings lta'i chu 'dzin phreng / /dus dang dus su stug por bres las bdud rtsi'i zeg char 'gyed pa yis/ /longs spyod du 'os rtsa ba sdong bu lo ma 'bras bcas bdo gyur cig /skye bo mi bsrun dregs pas rab myos mig dmar smin pa bsgyur bzhin du/ /mtshon rnon lhan cig rdul bcas ba spu rnam par gzengs pas g.yul 'gyed dang / /rdeg dang gzhu dang gshegs dang 'ching byed mi bzad dmod pa spro ba sogs/ /sdang ba'i rnam 'gyur ring du spangs nas skye dgu byams pas 'tsho gyur cig /brjed byed la sogs bgegs kyi tshogs dang sha za gtum po brtse med pa/ /khrag dron 'thung la ha ha zhes sgrogs dga' bzhin rgyug par byed rnams kyang / /byams pa'i chab kyis yang yang bkrus pas dga' ba'i 'dzum 'od 'byin pa'i gdong / /skye dgu rnams la gnyen bzhin gnas pas phan pa nyid du spyod gyur cig /nyon mongs rgyas pa'i dmod pa las skyes 'phel zad 'khrugs pa 'dam bu'i tshal/ /skye 'gro'i 'tsho ba birgyu'i rigs rnams nges par 'joms pa'i gshed ma ru/ /rlung mkhris bad kun lcags kyi 'khrul 'khor mngon sum nyid du snang ba dag /drang srong mchog gi dmod pa 'di 105—365

yis slar yang zhi ba nyid gyur cig /ma ma sdu gur yang yang byas pa'i sems can 'di dag dus mtha' yi/ /snyigs ma'i tshogs kyis blong bor gyur pa g.yul gyi sa yi rdul bzhin du/ /bar mtshams med par sdig pa'i khrod du rnam par 'phyan pas nyam nyes pa/ /legs byas mtshungs med sprin gyi myu gus rnal ma nyid du 'tsho gyur cig /dpung skyes rnams kyang rgya mtsho'i gos can dge ba'i tshul gyis legs skyong zhing / /gtsug lag gnyis kyi gdugs dkar rab bzung phan bde'i grib bsil phyogs rdzogs pas/ /'bangs rnams nyer 'tsho'i dpal gyi slad du ngal ba mtha' dag der sangs te/ /lha rnams kyis kyang mgrin pa bstod nas bsngags pa'i me tog 'thor gyur cig /'jig rten kun du phan bde'i rtsa lag thub mchog rnams kyi bstan pa gang / /thos pas bdud rtsi rab tu bzhibs nas dpyod pas ro yang shes byed cing / /bsgoms pas lang tsho yongs su brtag byed thar pa'i bcud kyis len pa de/ /nub pa med pa'i snang byed mchog tu kun nas kun tu gsal gyur cig /bla gos tshogs kyis thun mtshams sprin gyi khengs pa 'phrog byed des 'khyud pa'i/ /'dus pa chen po spong dang klog pa'i 'khor lo gnyis kyis dus 'da' ba/ /rig dang grol ldan skyes bu'i tshogs kyis khyab 'jug rkang pa bkod pa'i gnas/ /dog por byas te chos kyi sgron mas lam gsum yongs su snang gyur cig /thub bstan kun+da rnam par dgod pa'i dpung gnyen rtsa lag mchog gyur pa/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen rigs par smra ba'i ston ma'i zla ba dri med rnams/ /lta ngan ra ri nam yang mi 'dzin gzu bo'i mkha' la rtag shar bas//srid pa'i dgon par dub pa rnams la bsil zer ci yang sbyin gyur cig /nyes brgya bdo ba mā ka ra yi mche ba'i phrag la gnas bcas pa'i/ /dus mtha'i chab 185—366

kyis myur bar bda' byed nyam thag srog chags 'di kun kyang / /zab don mchog gi bdud rtsi ldug pa'i yol go lta bur gyur pa nas/ /chos kyi 'tsho ba yi dgas tshogs kyis dbrog nus min pa nyid gyur cig /khyad par du yang legs byas mchog 'di gang gis rtsom byed mi yi bdag /sras dang btsun mo blon 'bangs bcas pa me tog phreng ltar dngar ba 'di'i/ /dge nas dge ba'i go sar bgrod 'dod re ba'i myu gu ma rmas par/ /don gyi dngos po phun sum tshogs 'byor 'bras bu g.yur du za gyur cig /bgrang yas bskal par 'khor ba'i mun rum zab mo nyid kyi phug nang du/ /mi bzad sdug bsngal bye ba brgya yi ri mo rnam bgod sdig pa'i tshon/ /ci yang 'dus byas phung por spungs na lhun po'i gtos dang mnyam pa gang / /rtsa ba rul pa'i ljon shing bzhin du 'bras 'byin nus pa med gyur cig /tshe rabs 'dir yang grags pa'i spring yig phyogs kyi rgyal phran mgo bo la/ /rnam par 'god pa'i bsod nams phung po chos kyi bzhin ras brgya 'char ba'i/ /nor bu'i rtsig pa yid 'ong mdzes ldan dam pa'i tshul lugs ba gam can/ /nyes pa'i ra ris shin tu dben pa yon tan kun gyi mdzod gyur cig /chos las byung ba'i 'tsho ba phun tshogs rnam sad dbang po'i btung ba yis/ /yang yang gsos pa 'chi med dpal ster mgon po yis kyang byin rlabs nas/ /bgrang bya mang por legs byas rgya chen dza snu'i bu mo'i yab gcig tu/ /gangs can ri yi brtan pa chen po'i dpal ni nye bar gnas gyur cig /gang gi bka' khrims gser gyi 'khor los phyogs phyogs dag tu mnga' bsgyur nas/ /dge bcu'i ra bar 'da' ba med pa'i bka' rtags phyag rgya byin pa yis/ /chab 'bangs mtha' dag rdzogs ldan dang por 'dzeg pa med par brtol nas su/ /sde 185—367

bzhi rgyas pa'i tam+bu ra las kun dga'i glu dbyangs len gyur cig /ngo mtshar gtam gyi 'jug ngogs gcig pu phan bde'i dkyil 'khor rgyas pa can/ /dam pa rnams kyi thugs kyi dpal be'u mdzes par byed pa'i 'od 'phro ba/ /phyi dus 'di na dregs ldan dag gi ral pa'i thor tos yongs btud pa'i/ /sa bdag mchog gi chab srid zla ba nub med mngon par mtho gyur cig /'gro mang sems kyi rjes su 'jug pa thabs mkhas ze'u kha brgya ldan pa'i/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa dri med phyogs las rnam rgyal rgyal mtshan che/ /gang gi snying stobs rdo rjes gtams pa'i phrag par ngal 'tsho rten byed pa/ /rtag tu mi nyams rnam thos bu yi brtan pa'i 'gran zlar 'ongs gyur cig /gtong ba'i phyag ni ring por brkyangs pas phongs pa rnams kyi 'jigs sel zhing / /gtsang zhing dag pa'i tshul khrims chu yis sdig pa rnam sbyangs yon tan gsal/ /bzod dang des pa'i rgya mtsho mi 'khrugs brtul ba'i go cha cher bgos pas/ /mtshan ma'i rdul gyis rnam par dben pa mkha' khyab ting 'dzin thob gyur cig /dngos por 'dzin pa'i tshang tshing dral byed bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi/ /ral gri 'bar thogs thabs la mkhas pa'i 'khrul 'khor mang po'i sbyor thabs mkhan/ /stobs kyi kho lag yongs su rdzogs shing smon lam rgya che'i 'phang rtsal byang / /ye shes mchog gis nges par dpa' bas sred pa'i dgra sde pham byed shog /rus pa'i gzeb 'di mngon par spangs nas byang chub bar gyi tshe rabs su/ /mngon par dga' dang bde ldan zhing sogs zhing mang bye ba mtha' yas par/ /'dren pa rnams drung byang chub skyod pa'i rol rtsed nyid kyis gus bsnyen zhing / /nye bar gdams pa yongs su nod nas 'gro ba rab tu sgrol gyur cig /mtho ris mdzes ma'i lag 185—368

pad rab bskor gdub sil sgra dang bcas pa yis/ /sprin dkar dum bu lhung ba lta bu'i rnga yab g.yob cing lta byed pa/ /gser gyi 'khor los mdun nas rab mdzes nor 'dzin srung ba'i dbang phyug sogs/ /'gro 'di'i bsam kun yongs su rdzogs byed snang brnyan bye ba spro gyur cig /la lar gcig pu nags tshal dag na rtsa ba 'bras bu spyod byed cing / /mang du mi smra zhi ba'i lus kyis mthong na dga' ba'i tshul can dang / /la lar dge zhing spyod lam dul ba ngur smrig gos dang lhung bzed thogs/ /zhi nas zhir gshegs de 'dra'i gzugs kyis skye dgu'i 'dod pa 'jo gyur cig /mdor na bder gshegs rigs khams dag pa bai ḍūr+ya 'dra blo bur gyi/ /dri ma rab bsags sbun pa lta bu lam mchog thabs kyis myur sbyangs nas/ /bral smin yon tan bye ba'i rang bzhin sku gsum bdag nyid rgyal ba yi/ /go 'phang dam pa bde blag bsgrubs nas 'phrin las zer brgya 'phro gyur cig /glang po'i phru gu thal dkar rnam pas dga' ldan gnas nas 'pho ba dang / /lhums su 'jug dang mngon par bltam dang gzhon nu sprul pa'i rol rtsed dang / /byang chub snying por bdud rtsi brnyes dang chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba sogs/ /ngo mtshar mdzad pas 'khor bar bying ba'i yid can 'di dag sgrol gyur cig /legs byas mtha' yas mngon par spel ba'i glegs bam phyi mo rmad phyung ba/ /yid bzhin nor bus phyur bur gtams pa'i sgrom mang yongs su bye 'dra 'di/ /lha yi rdzing ring gzugs su ma gyur de srid rgya mtsho'i gos can gzhir/ /skal ba can rnams chos kyi 'dod 'jo mi zad slad du rtag gyur cig /gang gi drin gyis sa gsum dag na dge mtshan bya ma rtas bkod pa'i/ /bsod nams phung po gser gyi mchod sdong nyin byed bye ba'i snang ba can/ /mi dge'i mun pa rnam par 185—369

snyil byed pha mtha' med par bdal ba yang / /zad pa med par phan bde spro byed bum pa bzang po ltar gyur cig /legs byas rin chen rtsol bas bsgrubs la dngos dang brgyud pas 'brel ba yi/ /skye dgu rnams kyang kun 'byung bud shing bsam yas nyid las skyes pa'i me/ /sdug bsngal rgyud du kun nas 'bar ba sred len dri yi bzhon pa can/ /rmeg med bcom nas chos kyi rgyal sar dbugs dbyung chen po thob gyur cig /bdag kyang rgyal bas legs par gsungs pa'i bdud rtsis nyam stobs rdzogs gyur te/ /'gro ba rnams la rtsi sman mchog dang gter bum dpag bsam rin chen ltar/ /nyer 'tsho'i gzhi dang gtsug lag 'bum gyi shing rta chen por gyur nas kyang / /thar mchog gnas su rgyal sras rnams dang lhan cig rab tu rol gyur cig /de ltar lhag bsam chu mtsho las 'khrungs smon lam puṇ+ḍa rī ku'i tshal/ /rtag tu mi rnying mngon rlom ra ris gos pa med par gsal ba 'di/ /dus gsum gshegs pa'i 'phags chen rnams kyi bzhed pa'i rjes su rab son te/ /thub pa mchog rnams dgyes pa'i zhal gyis chud mi za bar skyong gyur cig /skyon rnams gtan bcom ye shes spyan mnga' drang srong che rnams bden par gsung ba'i bden pa dang / /gang du zhi dang gang gis zhi ba 'gog lam rang bzhin 'dod chags bral ba'i bden pa dang / /rig dang grol ba'i yon tan brgyad ldan 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams mi phyed 'dus pa'i bden pa yis/ /'di ni de ring smon lam bgyis pa myur du 'grub pa'i bde legs chen po 'byung gyur cig /bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' gangs can gyi brdas drangs pa'i phyi mo'i tshogs ji snyed pa bar du bsgrubs pa'i tshul las nye bar brtsams pa'i gtam bzang po blo ldan mos pa'i kun+da yongs su kha bye ba'i zla 'od 185—370

gzhon nu'i 'khri shing las de ltar bzhengs pa'i dgos ched phan yon bsngo smon dang bcas pa legs par bshad pa'i yal 'dab ste lnga pa'o// //de ltar bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab rin po che gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir 'gyur ro cog las deng sang ji tsam bzhugs pa par du bsgrubs pa'i tshul las nye bar brtsams te legs par bshad pa skabs lnga yi bdag nyid can 'di ni/bsod nams mngon par 'du byed pa'i phrin las rgya chen po 'di gang gis bskrun par mdzad pa/ mi'i dbang po chos bzhin du sa skyong ba nyid kyi bka' stsal pa lhur blangs te/ 'jig rten dbang phyug kurma pa'i gsung las skyes pa'i slob 'bangs kyi tha shal/ gnam bskos 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen po'i lung gis kun ting yun thong mya'u chi gī shir 'bod pa/ ming dngos kurma bstan pa'i nyin byed gtsug lag chos kyi snang ba zhes bgyi bas/ bdag cag gi ston pa rnam 'dren shākya'i dbang po dgongs pa zhi dbyings su mnal ba'i tshul bstan nas bgrang bya nyis stong drug brgya bcu gsum 'das pa/ chu mo glang gi lo gro bzhin gyi zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi dus tshes bzang por/ sde bzhi dge bcu'i dpal 'byor mngon par mtho ba'i rgyal khab chen po nyid du bris pa dge legs su gyur cig/ //shu bha mastu sarba dza ga t+t+waṃ// //105—371
ga do stse 4 4do nga tu sgo rme cho4 4

che'i dkar chag bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyi 'od ces bya ba/༄dzi /oṃ swa sti sidhe/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab rin po che'i dkar chag bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyi 'od ces bya ba/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshogs gnyis gser gyi sa 'dzin dbus su kun nas rab brjid sku bzhi'i bang rim mngon par mtho / /rim gnyis zab mo'i gser gyi ri bos kun nas rab bskor dbang bzhi'i rgya mtshor kun nas brjid/ /sgrib gnyis dri ma'i mun tshogs stug po kun nas rab sel 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i 'od zer 'phro/ /bden gnyis don gzigs dus gsum rgyal ba'i lha dbang gis brten bla ma lhun po'i dbang por 'dud/ /mtshan dpe'i dpal gyi phreng bas rab dkrigs yan lag drug cu'i chos kyi sgra chen bsgrogs / /rtag tu mnyam bzhag dngos kun rab mkhyen rnam dag yon tan rgya mtsho'i dpal gyis 'byor/ /phrin las rnam bzhis srid pa'i ji srid 'gro ba'i don — 185—375

mdzad dus gsum rgyal ba'i tshogs/ /rtag tu gus pa'i yid kyis snyan dngags me tog bsnyim pas rab tu mchod par bgyi/ /gang zhig gdod nas rnam dag glo bur dri ma'i chu 'dzin las grol skye 'gro'i gzugs can kun du khyab gyur cing / /rtag chad 'gro 'ong skye 'gag dang bral 'gog pa'i bden pa rgyu skar rnams kyi lam mchog mngon du bya ba'i thabs/ /bdag lta tshang tshing kun nas sreg byed bdag med rtogs pa'i dkyil 'khor rab rgyas phan bde'i pad mo rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /lam gyi bden pa nyin mo'i dbang phyug dang bcas 'jig rten kun gyi mig gcig dam chos de la gus pas 'dud/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i dbang po'i 'bras bus legs bskrun srid gsum skye rgya'i yon gnas bla na med/ /bslab gsum rin chen rgyan gyis kun nas rab klubs theg gsum dam chos sgra chen bsgrog /sa gsum kun nas 'gran gyi dpes dben sum rtsen dbang pos nyer mchod pa'i/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug bse ru'i tshogs dang slob ma'i tshogs bcas 'phags pa'i dge 'dun de la 'dud/ /sdom brtson rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyi gtsug rgyan mkhas pa'i mkhas mchog zhi ba 'tsho/ /sngags 'chang rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyi gtsug rgyan drag pa'i drag mchog pad ma 'byung / /blo gsal rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyi gtsug rgyan rig pa'i gnas rig ka ma la/ /lnga rig rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyi gtsug rgyan rgyal ba'i rgyal sras a ti sha /mkhas brtson rgya mcho1re tshogs kyi gtsug rgyan shākya shrī zhes grags la sogs / /bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyi gtsug rgyan gangs ri'i khrod 'dir brtan pa'o/ /sngon med nyi ma ches cher gsal mdzad ston pa gnyis pa lta bu yi/ /pan chen tshogs rnams bka' drin dran pa'i sgo nas rtag tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam dag smon lam skrun pas gangs ri'i khrod 'dir ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i srol 185—376

gtod cing / /sngon med dam chos nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor legs par bsgyur nas bod yul mun pa yi/ /smag rum 'joms mdzad sgra bsgyur dbang po sad mi mi bdun ka cog zhang gsum sogs/ /'gro ba'i gnyen gcig mtshungs med skyes chen mchog rnams rtag tu gus pa'i yid kyis 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mdzad pa rab mdzad sprul pa'i rnam 'phrul 'gro kun bde mdzad srong btsan sgam po dang //mgon po 'jam dbyangs khri srong lde btsan zhes grags sa chen 'di na 'gran zla med pa'i sa skyong mchog /zhi bas mi 'dul 'gro ba 'dul phyir drag po'i tshul ston rdo rje 'dzin pa ral pa can la sogs/ /bstan pa'i sbyin bdag gangs can chos rgyal btsan por byon pa'i mes dbon rnam gsum rgyal gyur cig /bdud rigs 'byung po'i sprin gyis thub bstan nyi 'od bsgribs pa las/ /slar yang gsal ba'i bdag rkyen mnga' bdag khri pa yab sras dang / /bstan pa'i srog shing dmar g.yo rtsangs gsum bla chen dge ba gsal/ /bstan pa spel mdzad dbus gtsang mi drug sogs la'ang phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngon gyi yab mes mdzad pa gzigs nas bde gshegs bstan pa gsal bya'i phyir/ /rang gi sku 'ang gtong mdzad rgyal bas lung bstan lha'i bla ma ni/ /ye shes 'od dang byang chub thugs mnga' byang chub 'od zhes grags pa la/ /bdag cag dad pas yan lag mchog gis rnam pa kun du 'dud par bgyi/ /sprul pa'i skyes mchog lo chen rin bzang dang / /rgyal bas lung bstan blo ldan shes rab dang / /'jam dbyangs rjes bzungs sa skya paṇa chen dang / /thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston lots+tsha sogs/ /slar yang bka' drin che ba rnams la 'dud/ /rdo rje 'chang chen gdul bya'i don du dge sbyong tshul bzung nas/ /rdo rje gdan mtshungs kun bzang nags khrod seng 105—377

ge'i khrir bzhugs te/ /rdo rje theg pa'i chos 'khor bskor nas dpag med 'gro don mdzad/ /rdo rje rgyal po dpal ldan phag mo grub pa de la 'dud/ /bka' 'gyur tshang dang dag par rtogs phyir dang / /gang gis 'gyur dang gang gis bsgyur ba dang / /bka'i rnam dbye bde blag rtogs bya'i phyir/ /bde gshegs bstan pa'i pad tshal rgyas byed pa'i/ /dkar chag nyi ma'i 'od 'di bdag gis spro / /'dir bdag cag gi bla ma chos thams cad kyi 'byung gnas shākya'i rgyal po des / 'gro ba ma rig pa'i btson dong du lhung ba/ 'dod chags dang zhe sdang gi lcags sgrog dam pos bcings shing / sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyi cho nge 'byin pa mtha' yas pa bskyab pa'i don du zhing ma dag pa mi mjed kyi khams/ sems can ma rungs pa mi dge ba bcu tshang bar spyod pa/ 'tshams med pa lnga byed pa/shin tu gdul dka' ba rnams la thugs rjes lhag par gzigs nas/ smon lam chen po lnga brgyas byang chub du thugs bskyed de/ sems can re re'i phyir du yang bskal pa grangs med gsum du bu dang chung ma dang rgyal srid dag kyang yongs su btang bar mdzad la/ bya dka' ba'i spyod pa mig phyung nas ster ba dang / sku srog kyang phangs pa med par sbyin pa la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po che du mas bdag cag rnams la phan pa mang po bsgrubs shing / sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad mngon du gyur nas 'og min du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te/ rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi mdzad pa sgrub pa'i don du/dga' ldan du dam pa tog dkar du sku 'khrungs pa'i tshe ma pham pa rgyal tshab du dbang bskur nas zas gtsang gi sras don thams cad grub par 'khrungs/bslab par bya ba'i gnas thams cad la mkhas shing rgyal bar mdzad de/ nyes pa 185—378

thams cad 'byung ba'i sgo khab spangs shing / mchod rten rnam dag gi drung du nyid la nyid rab tu byung ste rdo rje'i spo la sangs rgyas pa'i tshul bstan nas chos kyi 'khor lo ma lus pa bskor nas gdul bya rnams smin pa dang grol bar mdzad cing /mthar grong khyer rtswa can gyi yul dang nye ba'i shing sa la zung gi bar du khri bcas byang phyogs su dbu bstan nas bod du chos dar bar byin gyis brlabs te mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan to/ /des gsungs pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo ma lus pa rnams / dus ston pa 'das pa'i phyi lo'i dbyar/ gnas n+ya gro dha'i phug tu/sbyin bdag rgyal po ma skyes dgras byas te/ bsdu ba po 'od srung dang / kun dga' bo dang / nye ba 'khor la sogs pa dgra bcom pa lnga brgyas bka' bsdu ba dang po mdzad do/ /dus ston pa 'das nas lo brgya dang bcu na/ gnas yangs pa can gyi kusma pu ra'i gtsug lag khang du/ sbyin bdag chos rgyal mya ngan med kyis byas te/ dgra bcom pa bdun brgyas/ bka' bsdu ba gnyis pa mdzad do/ /dus ston pa 'das nas lo sum brgya nas/ gnas kha che'i yul gun pa na zhes pa'i dgon par sbyin bdag dzā lan dha ra'i rgyal po ka ni gas byas te / sdud pa po pur ṇa ka la sogs pa dgra bcom pa lnga brgya/ ba su mi tra la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' lnga brgya/ so so'i skye bo paṇa ḍi ta nyis brgya lnga bcus bka' bsdu ba gsum pa byas te/ glegs bam la bris nas gtan la phab pa rnams kyi dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin gnas lnga la mkhas pa'i paṇa ḍi ta mang pos bka'i dgongs pa 'grel pa'i bstan bcos mang po brtsams te bstan pa rgyas par mdzad do/ /de'i rjes su lha mo dri ma med pa'i 'od lung bstan pa'i mdor/nga yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyis stong lnga brgya nas gdong dmar can gyi 185—379

yul du dam pa'i chos dar bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan pa dang rjes su mthun par thub pa dgongs pa 'das nas lo nyis stong lnga brgya tsam nas gangs ri'i khrod 'dir lha mtho dor snyan shal la dam pa chos kyi dbu brnyes/ srong btsan sgam po la sogs pa chos rgyal mes dbon rnams dang / lo pan skyes mchog khyad par can rnams kyis/ rgya gar dang / kha che dang / za hor dang / bal yul dang / li'i yul dang / rgya nag la sogs pa nas bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' bstan bcos dpag tu med pa rgya gar gyi skad las bod kyi skad du bsgyur nas 'chad pa dang / nyan pa la sogs pas srol cher btod/ mnga' bdag khri ral gyi ring la dam pa'i chos mang po bsgyur cing / yab mes dus su bsgyur ba rnams kyang / skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab pa nas ming du brtags pa rnams dkar chag du bris te nam du yang gzhung lugs de las mi 'gyur zhing /kun gyis bslab du rung bar gyis shig ces bka' stsal nas dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa'i rgyal blon byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis sbyin bdag mdzad/ lo paṇa rnams kyis gzhung tshad go rims 'gyur byang la sogs pa gtan la phab pa'i bka' bstan bcos bod du 'gyur ro 'tshal rnams/ pho brang chen po stong thang lhan dkar dang / 'phang thang ka med gnyis na bzhugs shing dkar chag du bkod pa rnams/ rgyal po bdud sdig can gyi dbang du song ba dag gis bstan pa bsgrubs nas thub pa'i gsung rab rnams 'thor te bstan pa me shi ba'i dud pa tsam du gyur to/ /dus phyis sangs rgyas kyi phrin las kyis bstan pa'i me ro smad nas blangs te/ rim gyis chos dar bar gyur cing lha bla ma ye shes 'od dang /lha btsun pa byang chub 'od la sogs pa'i chos rgyal chen po rnams kyis sbyin bdag 185—380

mdzad nas lo paṇa mang pos chos bsgyur/ khyad par du jo bo chen po rje lha gcig zhes pa'i paṇa ḍi ta gdan drangs nas bstan pa shin du rgyas par mdzad do/ /slar yang dbang phyug dam pa'i mnga' bdag bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po se chen gan gyi bdag rkyen la brten nas/ bla ma 'jam dbyangs dpag shis sbyin bdag mdzad de/ mkhas pa chen po bcom ldan ral gri dang / dbus pa blo gsal la sogs pa rnams kyis/ bka' 'gyur ro cog rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs shing dkar chag tu btab ste bzhengs pa'i glegs bam la phyi mo bgyis te/rgya'i yul dang gangs ri'i khrod du rin po che dang gnag tshas bzhengs pa'i glegs bam mang du 'phel bar gyur cing / shin tu rgyas par mdzad do/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' klog pa dang bshad pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas rgyas par mdzad pa'i bod kyi chos grwa rnams su bka' 'gyur gyi glegs bam gyis 'gengs par bzhed nas/ bzhengs pa rnams kyi rnam grangs dang / gang mdo sngags gang du gtogs pa dang / yang dag dang ltar snang gi rnam dbye dang chos kyi 'khor lo'i rnam bzhag la sogs pa bde blag tu rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ chos kyi rnam grangs re re'i bam po dang le'u dang shu lo ku'i grangs dang 'gyur byang la sogs pa'i sgo nas gtan la phab ste dkar chag du bri bar bya'o/ /de yang bcom ldan 'das kyis gdul bya 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug dang / de dag cha mnyam pa la spyod pa'i gang zag nyi khri tshig stong yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa rnams kyang brjod bya bslab pa gsum ston par byed pa'i sgo nas sde snod gsum dang / rjod byed kyi sgo nas gsung rab bcu gnyis dang / gdul bya ma zhugs pa 'jug cing / zhugs pa 105—381

smin pa grol bar byed pa dang / grol ba mthar phyin par byed pa'i dbang du byas te / 'khor lo rim pa gsum la sogs pa'i rnam par bzhag pa mang du mchis kyang 'dir rnam pa gnyis te/ gsang sngags 'bras bu'i theg pa rgyud kyi dbye ba rnam par bzhag pa sngon ska lcog zhang gsum gyis bsgyur ba dang / bstan pa phyi dar la rim par byon pa'i lots+tsha ba chen po rnams kyis/ skad gsar chad la gtan la phab pa las/ slar yang mkhas pa'i dbang po/ bod kyi paṇa ḍi ta chen po lots+tsha ba bu ston kha ches/ rig pa'i gnas lnga'i sgo nas/ so so'i gzhung tshad / theg pa che chung dang rgyud sde'i rnam dbye/ 'gyur byang la sogs gtan la phab pa'i gsung rab kyi rjes su 'brangs nas/ 'dir yang bkod par bya'o//de yang 'dir glegs bam rnams kyi thog ma ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' bod kyi yul du 'gyur ba ji snyed pa'i dkar chag gi rim pa rnam par gzhag pa la don rnam pa gnyis/ gsang sngags 'bras bu'i theg par rgyud kyi dbye ba rnam par gzhag pa dang / mtshan nyid rgyu'i theg pa mdo'i dbye ba rnam par gzhag pa'o//dang po la don rnam pa drug /rnal 'byor chen po bla na med pa'i rgyud kyi dbye ba / rnal 'byor gyi rgyud kyi dbye ba/ spyod pa'i rgyud kyi dbye ba/ bya ba'i rgyud kyi dbye ba/ gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi dbye ba/ gnas skabs su nyer 'kho'i dbye ba bstan pa'o//dang po la gsum/ thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i rgyud shes rab rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud/ thabs rnal 'byor pa'i rgyud do//dang po thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i rgyud ni/ glegs bam thog ma/ ka 185—382

pa la/ rgyud thams cad kyi dbang po tshad mar gyur pa 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i le'u bcu bzhi pa/ paṇa ḍi ta ka ma la gup+ta dang / lots+tsha ba rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba las/ lots+tsha ba shong blo brtan gyis bcos pa gzhung tshad shu log sum brgya nyi shu dang rkang pa gnyis yod do / /'di la la las dkyil 'khor gcig tu bkral/ la las bdun la sogs par bkral mod kyi/ don la drug drug sum bcu rtsa drug rdor dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po ston pa'i rgyud du gsal zhes 'chad do/ /rtsa rgyud dang po'i sangs rgyas stong phrag bcu gnyis pa las phyung ba'i rgyud kyi dum bu dbang mdor bstan pa zhes bya ba/ kha che'i paṇa ḍi ta so ma nā tha dang / 'bro shes rab grags kyis bsgyur ba las/ lots+tsha ba sgra tshad pa rin chen rgyal mtshan gyis dpal nā ro pa'i 'grel pa dang bstun nas dag par bcos pa dang / rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal dus kyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba le'u lnga pa/ paṇa ḍi ta so ma nā tha dang / lots+tsha ba 'bro shes rab grags kyis bsgyur ba las/ dus phyis shong lots+tsha ba rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis dag par byas pa'i steng / lots+tsha ba blo gros rgyal mtshan dang / blo gros dpal gnyis kyis rgyud dang 'grel pa'i rgya dpe mang po la gtugs nas dag par byas pa/ spyir 'di la 'gyur bcu bzhi tsam yod do/ /'di la dkyil 'khor dus kyi 'khor lo la 'khor mang nyung gis phye na du mar 'gyur yang / gtso bo gcig pa'i phyir gcig tu brtsis la/ sku gsung thugs rdo rjes gtso byas pa'i dkyil 'khor gsum gsungs pa dang bzhi/ rdo rje shugs la bsrung 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dang / 'byung po sgrub pa'i dpa' bo gcig pa dang / klu brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor dang gsum dang / rnal 'byor ma rigs sum bcu 105—383

rtsa drug gi dkyil 'khor/ de'i shugs la rnal 'byor pa rigs sum bcu rtsa drug gi dkyil 'khor dang gnyis/ las so so sgrub pa la gtso bo nas dur khrod kyi mthar lha re re ba'i dkyil 'khor du 'gyur bar bshad pas dkyil 'khor lnga brgya dang brgyad cu rtsa drug /'khor lo sdom pa che chung gnyis/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba rigs gsum/ gsang ba 'dus pa rigs drug la gtso bo 'pho bar dngos su bshad pas dkyil 'khor brgya sum bcu rtsa gnyis te/ kun sdoms na dkyil 'khor bdun brgya dang sum bcu rtsa gnyis yod do/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba sogs la gtso bo 'pho bar dngos su ma gsungs/ rigs pa bsgres na du mar 'gyur bar shes par bya'o/ /dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud kyi snying po phyi ma/ gnyan lots+tsha ba dar ma grags kyis bsgyur ba/ bsdus pa'i rgyud kyi bkol ba dum bu'i rgyud kyi snying po zhes bya ba/ paṇa ḍi ta shrī bha dra bo dhi dang / lots+tsha ba gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer gyis bsgyur ba dang / dus 'khor bsdus rgyud las dā ri ka pas phyung ba dbang gi rab tu byed pa/ paṇa ḍi ta sa man ta shrī dang / lots+tsha ba rwa chos rab kyis bsgyur ba 'di bsdus rgyud las phyung ba yin pas de nyid du gtogs so/ /rtsa mi'i rgyud gsum du grags pa lce spyang rol pa dang / rdo rje glu gar dang / bla ma'i yon tan yongs su bzung ba gsum/ rgyud yang dag du mi mdzad pas ma bkod do//gnyis pa shes rab gtso bor ston pa rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud la bdun/ rigs drug ka cha mnyam par ston pa'i rgyud dang / te ru ma'i rigs gtso bor ston pa'i rgyud dang / rnam snang gi rigs gtso bor ston pa'i rgyud dang / rdo rje nyi ma'i rigs gtso bor ston pa'i rgyud dang / pad ma gar dbang gi rigs gtso bor ston pa'i rgyud dang / rta mchog gi rigs gtso bor ston pa'i rgyud dang /185—384

rigs drugapardorje'achangagatsobor/wa zlozlozlo zhe — —————————rte —the —rtewashā dru wa ka cha mnyam par ston pa'i rgyud ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba mkha' 'gro ma sgyu ma bde ba'i mchog ces bya ba'i rgyud bla ma rtsa ba'i rgyud rtog pa bcu pa/ 'di la dkyil 'khor nyi shu rtsa gcig tu 'grel pas bshad/ de'i rgyud phyi ma rtog pa bdun pa'i dpe ma rnyed do/ /de'i rgyud phyi ma'i phyi ma rtog pa lnga pa/paṇa ḍi ta smri ti dzñā na tī rte'i rang 'gyur te/ de gsum rdzogs pa la gzhung tshad khri brgyad stong du bshad do//gnyis pa he ru ma'i rigs gtso bor ston pa'i rgyud la lnga/ kye'i rdo rje'i skor dang / bde mchog 'khor lo'i skor dang / sangs rgyas thod pa'i skor dang /sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i skor dang / a ra li'i skor ro//dang po kye'i rdo rje'i skor la bdud rtsi'i rgyud/ bshad pa'i rgyud/ rgyud phyi ma / phyi ma'i phyi ma/ bshad pa'i rgyud/ snying po'i rgyud/ 'bras bu'i rgyud do//dang po rtsa ba'i rgyud kye'i rdo rje 'bum phrag lnga pa las bsdus pa kye'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po brtag pa dang po le'u bcu gcig pa/ brtag pa gnyis pa le'u bcu gnyis pa/ paṇa ḍi ta gha ya dha ra dang / lots+tsha ba 'brog mi shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba/ 'di la dkyil 'khor drug yod do//gnyis pa de'i bshad rgyud thun mong ma yin pa mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur zhes bya ba le'u bcwa lnga pa/ lo paṇa snga ma dang 'dra/ 'di la dngos su dkyil 'khor bcu / gtso bo 'pho ba'i dbye bas drug cu rtsa gnyis su 'gyur ro//gsum pa rgyud phyi ma phyag rgya chen po'i thig le zhes bya ba rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po le'u nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa/ paṇa ḍi ta shes rab gsang ba dang /105wa 385

lots+tsha ba kum chos kyi ye shes dang / phyug 'tshams dgra bcom gyis bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs so/ /'dis dkyil 'khor gcig ston no// //kha pa la/ bzhi pa rgyud phyi ma'i phyi ma ye shes snying po rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po le'u bzhi pa/ dpal shes rab gsang ba'i rang 'gyur ro/ /'dis dkyil 'khor gcig ston no//lnga pa bshad pa'i rgyud dpal ye shes thig le rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po mchog tu rmad du byung ba le'u sum bcu pa/ dpal shes rab gsang ba'i rang 'gyur ro/ /'dis dkyil 'khor lnga ston no//drug pa snying po'i rgyud grub pa nges bstan ni ma rnyed pas ma bkod do//bdun pa 'bras bu'i rgyud dpal de kho na nyid kyi sgron ma zhes bya ba'i rnal 'byor chen mo'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ dpal shes rab gsang ba'i rang 'gyur ro/ /dgyes pa rdo rje sku gsung thugs gsang ba mdzod kyi rgyud ces bya ba dang ni/sems can ma 'khrul sangs rgyas 'khrul/ /gzhan rig ma 'khrul rang rig 'khrul//zhes sogs kyi tshig yod pa 'di rgyud yang dag yin min the tshom za zhing / gur nas ma rgyud du bshad pa'i gsang ba'i mdzod kyi rgyud ces pa 'di ma yin par 'dug ste/ dbang bskur yang dag sbyin ldan na/ /skye zhing skye bar dbang bskur 'gyur / /zhes sogs rgyud sde'i 'grel pa rnams su lung drangs pa rnams de na mi snang ba'i phyir re shig bzhag go//gnyis pa bde mchog 'khor lo'i skor la/ rtsa ba'i rgyud dang / bshad pa'i rgyud gnyis las/ dang po rtsa ba'i rgyud 'bum pa chen po las bsdus pa'i rgyud/rtsa ba'i rgyud phyi ma'i phyi ma le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig /shu log stong bdun brgya pa/185wa 386

paṇa ḍi ta pad ma ka ra dang / lots+tsha ba rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba las/dus phyis lots+tsha ba grags 'byor shes rab dang / mar ston chos kyi dbang phyug gis bla ma nā ro pa'i phyag dpe la gtugs nas dag par bcos shing gtan la phab pa 'di la dngos su dkyil 'khor gnyis ston cing / 'grel pas kha bskang nas bcu gsum du ston no/ /'gyur 'di la phreng sngags btu ba yod gzhan la med do//gnyis pa bshad pa'i rgyud la gsum/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bshad rgyud dang / thun mong ba'i bshad rgyud dang / bshad rgyud yang dag yin min rtsod pa can gyi skor ro/ /dang po thun mong ma yin pa'i bshad rgyud mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla ma zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po le'u drug cu rtsa dgu pa/ paṇa ḍi ta chen po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzha na dang / lots+tsha ba rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa las/ phyis paṇa ḍi ta dzha na shrī dang / byung po chos kyi brtson 'grus kyis zhus shing / paṇa ḍi ta ā nan ta dang lo chung grags 'byor shes rab kyis chad lhag bsabs nas legs par bcos te gtan la phab pa/'di la dkyil 'khor dngos su sum bcu rtsa brgyad 'grel pas lnga bcu rtsa drug tu bkral / gtso bo 'pho ba'i dbye bas drug du bkral/ gtso bo 'pho ba'i dbye bas drug brgya brgyad cu rtsa gcig tu bstan no/ /dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po le'u lnga bcu pa/ paṇa ḍi ta gha ya dha ra dang / lots+tsha ba 'gos lha btsas kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa rnams bzhugs so/ /'di la dkyil 'khor drug tu gsungs so// //ga pa la/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa/ paṇa ḍi ta rgyal ba'i sde dang / lots+tsha ba dharmā yon tan gyis 185—387

— — ——————————————————wa ————bsgyur ba las/ phyis sum pa dpal mchog dang po'i rdo rje'i bka' dang bstun nas dag par bcos pa/ 'di la dkyil 'khor brgya dang bcu bzhi'am brgya bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis su gsungs so/ /dpal sdom pa 'byung ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po le'u sum bcu rtsa gsum pa/ paṇa ḍi ta gzhan la phan pa mtha' yas dang /lots+tsha ba rgyus smon lam grags kyis bsgyur ba/ 'dis dkyil 'khor gcig bston no / /dpal khrag 'thung mngon par 'byung ba zhes bya ba rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po le'u bzhi bcu rtsa lnga pa/ paṇa ḍi ta a tā ya badz+ra dang / lots+tsha ba la cings yon tan 'bar gyis bsgyur ba/ 'di la dkyil 'khor gsum du gsungs so/ /phag mo mngon par byang chub pa zhes bya ba bshad pa'i rgyud/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzha na ka ra'i zhal snga nas/ lots+tsha ba khu ston dngos grub kyis bsgyur ba 'di la dkyil 'khor gsum yod do/ /'di'i lha'i mngon rtogs mngon brjod bla ma'i le'u bcu gnyis pa dang 'dra bar snang ngo / /rnal 'byor ma'i kun tu spyod pa'i rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa 'di dkyil 'khor gcig yod do/ /dkar chag snga ma rnams su 'gyur byang gi gsal kha mi 'dug cing / bu ston pa'i chos 'byung du 'gos kyi 'gyur du yod par bshad do/ /rnal 'byor ma bzhi'i kha sbyor gyi rgyud brtag pa bdun pa/ lots+tsha ba la chings yon tan 'bar gyis bsgyur ba 'di la dkyil 'khor gcig yod do/ /ral pa gyen brdzes kyi rgyud las phyung ba'i rig pa 'dzin ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ paṇa ḍi ta dza ya ༵ na dang / lots+tsha ba dharmā yon tan gyis bsgyur ba 'di me tri mkha' spyod kyi rgyud na/gnyis pa thun mong ba'i bshad rgyud rgyud thams cad kyi gleng gzhi dpal yang 185—388

dag sbyor ba zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po/ rtsa ba'i rgyud brtag pa bcu pa/brtag pa re re la rab byed bzhi bzhi yod la/ dngos su dkyil 'khor bcu drug yod la/ gtso bo 'pho ba'i dbye bas mang por 'gyur ro/ /de'i rgyud phyi ma dang bcas pa/ paṇa ḍi ta gha ya dha ra dang / lots+tsha ba 'brog shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs/ 'di spyir rgyud sde mang po'i bshad rgyud yin cing / khyad par bde mchog 'khor lo'i bshad rgyud yin te/ 'di'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo rdo rje sems dpa' bde mchog gi khyad par yin pa'i phyir dang / bde mchog gi gleng gzhi la bshad pa byas pa'i phyir dang / bde mchog gi rgya 'grel rnams nas bde mchog gi bshad rgyud du bgrangs pa'i phyir/ thun mong ba'i bshad rgyud yin ces 'chad do//gsum pa bde mchog gi bshad rgyud du 'dod pa'i bshad rgyud yang dag yin min rtsod pa can gzhi rnams kyi thog mar a ra li'i skor la/ thugs gsung sku rnams rgyud brgyad dang / 'phros pa'i rgyud brgyad de sum bcu rtsa gnyis su bzhed pa las/ dang po thugs kyi brgyad la/ dpal gsang ba rdo rje'i rgyud kyi rgyal po le'u bzhi pa/ paṇa ḍi ta rat+na badz+ra dang / lots+tsha ba 'brog mi'i 'gyur/ gsang ba spyod pa'i rgyud/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ dpal nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ dpal nam mkha' chen po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ sku gsung thugs kyi rgyud kyi rgyal po rnams/paṇa ḍi ta gha ya dha ra dang / lots+tsha ba 'brog mi'i 'gyur/ 'di la bu ston pa'i chos 'byung du mkha' 'gro ma dra ba'i sdom pa zhes 'byung ba ming gi rnam grangs yin nam bsam mo/ rin chen phreng ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ paṇa ḍi ta rat+na badz+ra dang /185—389

lots+tsha ba 'brog mi'i 'gyur/ dpal dam tshig chen po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ paṇa ḍi ta gha ya dha ra dang / lots+tsha ba 'brog mi'i 'gyur/ gsung gi rgyud brgyad la/dpal stobs po che'i rgyud kyi rgyal po le'u lnga pa/ 'gyur byang snga ma dang 'dra/dpal ye shes gsang ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ dpal ye shes phreng ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po / dpal ye shes 'bar ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po rnams rnal 'byor ma tsan tra mā le dang / lots+tsha ba 'brog mi'i 'gyur/ dpal zla ba'i phreng ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/paṇa ḍi ta gha ya dha ra dang / lots+tsha ba 'brog mi'i 'gyur/ dpal rin chen 'bar ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ rnal 'byor ma tsan tra mā le dang / lots+tsha ba 'brog mi'i 'gyur/ dpal nyi ma'i 'khor lo'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ dpal ye shes rgyal po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po gnyis/ paṇa ḍi ta gha ya dha ra dang / lots+tsha ba 'brog mi'i 'gyur / sku'i rgyud brgyad la dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po / dpal gsang ba me 'bar ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ dpal gsang ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ dpal dur khrod rgyan gyi rgyud kyi rgyal po rnams paṇa ḍi ta gha ya dha ra dang / lots+tsha ba 'brog mi'i 'gyur/ dpal rdo rje rgyal po'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor ma tsan tra mā le dang / lots+tsha ba 'brog mi'i 'gyur/ dpal ye shes bsam pa'i rgyud/ gha ya dha ra dang / 'brog mi'i 'gyur/ dpal chags pa'i rgyal po'i rgyud/ tsan tra mā le dang / 'brog mi'i 'gyur/ dpal mkha' 'gro ma sdom pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ gha ya dha ra dang / 'brog mi'i 'gyur/ 'phros pa'i rgyud brgyad la/ dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba 'bar ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed rnam par 'joms pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/dpal me'i phreng ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ rdo rje grub pa dra ba sdom pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po 105—390

le'u bzhi pa/ dpal stobs chen ye shes rgyal po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ dpal dur khrod kyi rgyan rmad du byung ba'i rgyud rnams gha ya dha ra dang / 'brog mi'i 'gyur/'dir sku gsung thugs kyi snying po'i don gyi rgyud/ rje btsun gu ru dang / seng dkar shākya 'od kyis bsgyur ba ma rnyed do/ /de rnams kyi steng du rnyog pa med pa'i rgyud / paṇa ḍi ta gha ya dha ra dang / lots+tsha ba 'brog mis bsgyur ba/ 'di bsnan nas 'phros rgyud du 'dod cing / 'di rgyud yang dag yin no/ /snga ma rnams rtsod pa can du grags shing / the tsom gyi gzhi yod par smra'o/ /bod ma yin zer ba mi bden te/ gha ya dha ras/ 'brog mi dang / gnyos lots+tsha la bshad pa'i rgya dpe can yin pas so/ /yang bde mchog nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud le'u gsum pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dzha na badz+ras rang 'gyur du mdzad pa ste/'di la dkyil 'khor gcig yod/ rgyud yang dag yin min the tshom gyi gzhi'o/ /mkha' 'gro ma thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs gnyis su med pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes rdo rje phag mo mngon par 'byung ba'i rgyud/ rtsa ba'i rgyud la le'u bcu/rgyud phyi ma le'u gnyis byas pa gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer gyis bsgyur zer ba 'di/rgyud yang dag yin na khrag 'thung mngon 'byung gi zla ba'i dgongs rgyud yin cing /rdzun ma 'dra bar 'dug zhes smra'o/ /'di mkhas pa rnams kyi bka' 'gyur snga ma rnams na'ang bzhugs 'dugs pa dang / chos spong gi nyes pas skrag nas 'dir yang bris so/ /bka' yang dag yin min ngo shes pa rnams mi bri zhing / the tshom za ba'i gzhi cung zad yod pa bka' 'gyur snga ma rnams na yod pa rnams bris na nyes pas mi reg cing / chos la nyes smod thub pa'i gzhung la bkag /ces gsungs pa bsam par bya'o/ /dpal rdo rje nag po chen po khros pa'i mgon po 185—391

——— ——————————wa wa ———wa —wa ——gsang ba dngos grub 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i rgyud le'u nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ paṇa ḍi ta a bha ya ka ra dang / lots+tsha ba khe rgad 'khor lo grags kyi 'gyur la/ rtsa mi dang tre bo shes rab dpal gyis zhus dag byas pa 'di la dkyil 'khor bdun yod la/'di bde mchog gi phyogs 'thun du bla ma rnams bzhed la/ rgyud las kyang /ye shes mgon po chen po ni/ /khwa gdong la sogs lha mo brgyad/ /rim pa bzhin du yongs su bskor/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /'di la sngags btu ba la/ oṃ shin du ring po dang / hūm̐ dbyangs gnyis su btus pa dang / ma hā'i ring cha chad pa la sogs the tshom gyi gzhi snang bas rgyud yang dag yin min brtag par bya'o zhes 'chad do//gsum pa sangs rgyas thod pa'i skor ni/ dpal sangs rgyas thod pa zhes bya ba rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po le'u bcu bzhi pa/ paṇa ḍi ta gha ya dha ra dang /lots+tsha ba gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer gyis bsgyur ba 'di la dkyil 'khor bzhi yod do/ /'di'i rtsa sdo'i rgyud stong phrag bcu gnyis yod par mi 'jigs pa'i gzhung 'grel du ba/shā pa /sgyu/ 'phrul chen mo'i skor ni/ sgyu 'phral chen mo zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po le'u gsum pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na bha ra darngo / lots+tsha ba 'gos lha btsas kyis bsgyur ba 'di la dkyil 'khor gcig gsungs shing / rgyud las he ru ma'i ming ma byung yang / 'grel pa dang sgrub thabs mdzad pa dag gis he ru kur byas 'dug pas de'i phyogs bris so/ /'di'i rtsa ba'i rgyud rgyas pa la stong phrag bcu drug yod par bshad do//lnga pa la a ra li'i skor ni/ rdo rje a ra li'i zhes bya'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po 105—392

le'u bcu pa dang / ri gi pa'i a ra li'i rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba le'u lnga pa dang gnyis / paṇa ḍi ta gha ya dha ra dang / lots+tsha ba 'brog mis bsgyur ba/ 'di gnyis la dkyil 'khor re re gsungs shing / kha cig 'di gnyis kye rdor gyi cha 'thun du 'dod pa la shes byed med pa 'dra/gsum pa rnam snang gi rigs gtso bor ston pa'i rgyud ni/ rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po dpal gdan bzhi pa zhes bya ba/ gdan bzhi re re la rab byed bzhi bzhi ste bcu drug /paṇa ḍi ta gha ya dha ra dang / lots+tsha ba 'gos lha btsas kyis bsgyur ba 'di la dkyil 'khor gcig gsungs shing / 'di skad bdag thos med pa ni rtsa ba'i rgyud rgyas pa stong phrag bcu gnyis pa las/ bsdus pa'i rgyud yin pas 'dis ma smos pa'o/ /de'i bshad brgyud man tra yod sa ni rgyud rgyas pa las bsdus pa yin pas gleng gzhi med cing / 'gyur byang sngags dang 'dra/ 'di la dkyil 'khor gnyis yod do/ /gdan gzhi las sbyor ba'i rab tu byed pa zhes grags pa rnal 'byor ma thams cad gsang ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po le'u brgya lhag pa/ 'gyur byang snga ma dang 'dra/ 'di la dkyil 'khor dgu yod do / /'di rnam snang gi rigs yin te/ /rgyud las/ ji ltar rnal 'byor nam mkha' nyid/ /de ltar rnam par snang mdzad bdag /ces bshad cing ār+ya de bas kyang / rnal 'byor nam mkha' rnam snang du gsungs so/ /'di'i le'u rnams la grangs kyi rim pa mi snang te/ bar nas chad pa yin min brtags par bya'o / /bod kyi bla ma rngog pas ni grangs rim pa bzhin du mdzad pa snang ngo / /dpal khro bo chen po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po le'u nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ paṇa ḍi ta rad na shrī dang / lots+tsha ba grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs/ 'di 185—393

la dkyil 'khor lnga/ yum yod med kyis phye bas bcu'o// //ca pa la/ 'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i rtog pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po le'u bdun pa/paṇa ḍi ta a tu la dha sa dang / lots+tsha ba mar pa chos kyi dbang phyug gis bsgyur ba'o / /mi g.yo ba gsang ba'i rgyud chen po le'u bzhi pa 'di la dkyil 'khor gcig yod/ khro bo'i rgyal po thams cad gsang sngags gsang ba'i rgyud ces bya ba le'u lnga pa/ 'di la dkyil 'khor gnyis yod do/ /'di gsum rgyud yang dag yin min the tshom gyi bzhir byas 'dug go//bzhi pa rdo rje nyi ma'i rigs gtso bor ston pa'i rgyud ni/ rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rgyud kyi rgyal po le'u bcu gcig pa 'di la dkyil 'khor bzhi yod cing / rin po che'i rigs su rgyud 'grel du gsungs so//lnga pa pad ma gar dbang gi rigs gtso bor ston pa'i rgyud ni/ dpal pad+ma 'bar ba'i rgyud chen po las phyung ba/ rigs kyi 'jig rten mgon po lnga bcu pa le'u bzhi pa/ paṇa ḍi ta bi ma la shrī dang / lots+tsha ba grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba 'di la rgyud na dkyil 'khor mi gsal/ slob dpon dag gis dkyil 'khor yang bshad do/ /sgrol ma ku ru ku l+le'i rtog pa lnga pa/ kriṇ+ḍa paṇa ḍi ta dang lots+tsha ba tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ 'di la dkyil 'khor gcig yod do//drug pa rta mchog gi rigs gtso bor ston pa'i rgyud ni/ sgron ma mngon par 'byung ba'i rgyud le'u lnga brgya bdun cu pa nas phyung ba'i sgrol ma phyag 'tshal nyi shu rtsa gcig gis bstod pa shu log nyi shu rtsa bdun de'i phan yon dang bcas pa/'di nyi ma sbas pas rnal 'byor bla med du bkral zhing / rdul tshon dang lus dkyil 'khor gnyis su bkral lo/ /'di pha rgyud phyogs kyi lha mo'i phyogs su 105—394

gtogs sam brtag par bya'o/ /rdo rje phur pa rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi dum bu/ chos rje sa skya pas bsgyur ba 'di rtsa rgyud las phyung ba yin pas gleng gzhi med/ rigs gang du gtogs pa 'grel pa ma mthong bas gsal bar ma shes na'ang / 'khor mo tshogs shas ches pas bskor bas ma rgyud dang / gsang 'dus nas phur pa khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil par bshad pa'i rigs pa la brten nas las kyi rigs su byas so / /nag po chen po zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po le'u lnga bcu pa/ paṇa ḍi ta sa man ta shrī dang / lots+tsha ba rwa chos rab kyis bsgyur ba/ 'di la mngon rtogs kyis phye na dkyil 'khor drug du 'gyur ro/ /'di la lots+tsha bas ma 'gyur ba'i skad sor bzhag mang po snang ngo / /'di la don yod grub pa'i rigs yin pa'i shes byed chen po mi snang yang / mgon po phrin las kyi lha yin pas don yod grub pa las kyi rigs kyi khongs su bsdus so//bdun pa rigs drug pa rdo rje 'chang gtso bor ston pa'i rgyud ni/ ji bzhin brnyes pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud le'u lnga pa/ paṇa ḍi ta k+ṣa ka ga ṇa dang / lots+tsha ba mang 'or byang chub shes rab kyis bsgyur ba/ 'di la dkyil 'khor gsum yod do//gsum pa thabs gtso bor ston pa rnal 'byor pa'i rgyud la drug /mi bskyod pa'i rigs gtso bor ston pa dang / rnam snang gi rigs gtso bor ston pa dang /rin 'byung gi rigs gtso bor ston pa dang / 'od dpag med kyi rigs gtso bor ston pa dang / don yod grub pa'i rigs gtso bor ston pa dang / rdo rje 'chang gi rigs gtso bor ston pa'i rgyud do//dang po mi bskyod pa'i rigs gtso bor ston pa'i rgyud ni/ dpal gsang ba 105—395

'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa/ paṇa ḍi ta shud+dha ka ra warma dang /lots+tsha ba rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba 'di la gtso bo 'pho ba'i dbye bas/dkyil 'khor sum bcu rtsa gnyis su 'phags skor ba rnams bzhed do/ /de'i rgyud phyi ma le'u bcwa brgyad pa lo paṇa sngar dang 'dra/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba mngon par brjod pa/ rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud thams cad kyi snying po gsang ba rnam par phye ba zhes bya ba le'u drug cu rtsa brgyad pa/ paṇa ḍi ta su dzñā na shrī dang / lots+tsha ba lha bla ma zhi ba 'od kyis bsgyur ba 'di la dkyil 'khor gcig yod do/ /dgongs pa lung ston le'u bcu gnyis pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dharmā shrī bha dra dang / lots+tsha ba rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba'o/ /ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa'i rgyud/ paṇa ḍi ta dzñā na ka ra dang / lots+tsha ba khu dngos grub kyi 'gyur la / paṇa ḍi ta de nyid dang lots+tsha ba nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal bas bcos shing gtan la phab pa/ 'di ni rgyud de'i bde ba chen po'i le'u zhes bya ba le'u gnyis pa logs su phyung bar snang ngo / /rgyud rdzogs pa ni bod na med pa 'dra'o/ /lha mo bzhis yongs su zhus pa'i rgyud le'u bzhi pa/ paṇa ḍi ta smri ti'i rang 'gyur 'di rnams la gsang ba 'dus pa'i bshad rgyud bzhir grags so/ /gsang 'dus kyi bshad rgyud rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud ces bya ba le'u bcu bdun pa/ paṇa ḍi ta ka ma la gup+ta dang / lots+tsha ba mnga' bdag lha ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs/ 'di la/ dngos su dkyil 'khor yang yod do// //cha pa la/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i bshad rgyud 'phags pa gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i rtog pa'i rgyal po chen po le'u nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa/ lots+tsha ba bu ston gyis bsgyur ba/ 'di la dbu nas rgya dpe shog lhe 105wa 396

cig chad pa dang / bar bar nas rgya dpe zubs nas bsgyur rgyu ma byung ba 'ga' re yod kyang / sngar gyi gnyis med rnam rgyal gyi rgyud du 'dod pa/ le'u bdun cu don bdun yod pa/ 'di gnyis med rnam rgyal gyi rgyud yang dag ma yin par rtogs pa'i dgos pa yod do/ /lots+tsha bas rgyud bsgyur ba'i bsham du 'di/ rgyud min rgyud ltar bcos pa yi/ /chos min sun dbyung bya phyir dang / /dam chos snang ba spel ba'i phyir/ /ji ltar nus bzhin bsgyur ba lags/ /zhes gsungs so / /gsang ba 'dus pa'i bshad rgyud du 'dod pa'i rtsod pa can gnyis med rnam rgyal gyi rgyud le'u bdun cu rtsa bdun pa/ paṇa ḍi ta ye shes snying po dang /lots+tsha ba mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyis bsgyur zer ba 'di/ dpe snga ma rnams na yang bris 'dug pa dang / chos spong gi nyes pas 'jigs nas 'dir yang bzhugs so / /mi bskyod pa'i rigs su gtogs pa'i khro bo phyag na rdo rje'i skor du gtogs pa la/ 'phags pa lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can drag po rnam gsum 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud dang / de'i bshad pa'i rgyud gsang ba'i rgyud kyi rnam par 'byed pa drag po gsum 'dul zhes bya ba le'u gsum pa dang gnyis/ paṇa ḍi ta de ba puts+tsha ma ti dang / 'gar chos kyi bzang po'i 'gyur/ 'di la dzā ba ri bas dkyil 'khor bzhi ru bkral lo/ /'phags pa lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi cho ga rdo rje be con gyi rgyud le'u bcwa lnga pa 'di la dkyil 'khor gcig go/ /de'i bshad rgyud dam yan lag gi rgyud phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can rdo rje gdengs pa'i rgyud khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i le'u/ paṇa ḍi ta a tra ya shrī ma ti dang / lots+tsha ba chos kyi dbang phyug gis bsgyur ba 'di le'u gcig logs su phyung bar snang zhing dkyil 'khor zur tsam gcig bstan no/ /phyag na rdo rje gtum po thugs gsang 105—397

ba'i rgyud le'u nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa dang / de'i rgyud phyi ma le'u bcwa lnga pa dang / de'i rgyud phyi ma'i phyi ma le'u brgyad pa gsum/ paṇa ḍi ta a bhi yu ka ti dang / lots+tsha ba chos kyi brtson 'grus kyis bsgyur ba 'di rnams la dkyil 'khor gcig gsungs so / /rmi lam mthong ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs rnams bzhugs so// //ja pa la/ phyag na rdo rje me lce'i rgyud le'u bco lnga pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po rad na girnyi dang / lots+tsha ba dge tshul khyung grags kyis bsgyur ba 'di la dkyil 'khor gcig gsungs so/ /phyag na rdo rje'i me lce'i rgyud le'u bcu gnyis pa/dkyil 'khor gcig yod pa/ lo paṇa sngar dang 'dra ba 'dir ma rnyed do/ /phyag na rdo rje gsang ba bstan pa'i rgyud le'u bdun pa/ 'di la dkyil 'khor mi 'dra bas phye nas dkyil 'khor gsum du gsungs so/ /phyag na rdo rje gsang ba mngon par bstan pa'i rgyud le'u nyi shu rtsa gcig pa dkyil 'khor lnga yod do/ /'di dang snga ma gnyis paṇa ḍi ta wa la tsan tra dang / lots+tsha ba glan chung dar ma tshul khrims kyi 'gyur/ rdo rje snying po rdo rje lce dbab pa zhes bya ba/ lots+tsha ba gnyan dharmā grags kyi 'gyur dkyil 'khor gcig go/ /phyag na rdo rje bde khros kyi rgyud le'u bcu bdun dum bu gsum pa/ dzñā na a kā ra'i 'gyur/ phyag na rdo rje rnal 'byor chen por bkral ba 'di rnams rgyud yang dag yin min the tsam gyi gzhi yin zhes smra'o/ /'dir dpe snga ma na bzhugs pa bzhin bkod do//gnyis pa rnam snang gi rigs gtso bor ston pa'i rgyud la gnyis/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba dang / sku'i rigs kyi khro bo gshin rje gshed kyi skor ro/ /dang po rnam par snang mdzad sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyud le'u bcu pa/ lots+tsha ba rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ 'di la 'grel pas gtso bo 'pho ba'i dbye bas dkyil 'khor brgyad 185—398

cu rtsa lngar bkral lo/ /'di rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud du dus kyi 'khor lo dang /ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa'i rgyud las bshad cing / slob dpon a bha yas kyang bzhed do/ /slob dpon kun snying gis rnal 'byor rgyud du bkral mod kyi/ngo bo rnal 'byor chen por gtogs te gsang 'dus bzhin no//gnyis pa sku'i rigs kyi khro bo gshin rje gshed kyi skor la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs gshin rje gshed nag po zhes bya ba'i rgyud/ le'u bcwa brgyad pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang / lots+tsha ba tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur ba las/ slad kyi lots+tsha ba gnyan dar ma grags kyis bcos la de las kyang lots+tsha ba rdo rje grags kyis dag par byas pa 'di la dkyil 'khor dgu yod do / /gshin rje gshed nag po'i 'khor lo las thams cad grub pa zhes bya ba gzhon nu gdong drug gi rgyud sdom tshig gsum gyis bsdus pa/ paṇa ḍi ta bā ro phyag rdum dang / lots+tsha ba rwa rdo rje grags kyis bsgyur ba 'di la dngos su dkyil 'khor gcig snang / bla ma dag gsum du'ang byed do/ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud rtog pa bdun pa/ lo paṇa sngar dang 'dra/ 'di la dngos su dkyil 'khor gcig gsungs/ paṇa ḍi ta dag gis dkyil 'khor gsum du dgongs pa bkral lo/ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rtog pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po'i las kyi dngos grub brtag pa zhes bya ba'i le'u bzhi pa paṇa ḍi ta a mo gha dang lots+tsha ba mar pa chos kyi dbang phyug grags pas bsgyur ba/ 'jigs byed kyi rtog pa gsum pa dang / gtam rgyud kyi rtog pa gnyis/ dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po le'u bcu dgu pa/ paṇa ḍi ta tsan tra gīrti dang /lots+tsha ba grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba 'di la dkyil 'khor bcu yod do/ /185—399

———— ————— —— ——————wa wa wa wa'adi la shong blo brtan gyi 'gyur yang yod do//gsum pa rin 'byung gi rigs gtso bor ston pa'i rgyud ni ma rnyed do//bzhi pa 'od dpag med kyi rigs gtso bor ston pa'i rgyud ni/ bcom ldan 'das dpal ral pa gcig pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ paṇa ḍi ta badz+ra shrī kha la ru tra dang / khro phu lots+tsha ba'i 'gyur/ 'di la rgyud nas dkyil 'khor gcig gsal/mi pham sbas pa'i bshes gnyen gyis dkyil 'khor gnyis su bkral lo//lnga pa don yod grub pa'i rigs gtso bor ston pa'i rgyud ni ma rnyed do//drug pa rdo rje 'chang gi rigs kyi rgyud la/ dpal zla gsang thig le zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po/ lots+tsha ba rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ 'di la dkyil 'khor lnga yod do/ /de ltar rnal 'byor chen po bla med kyi rgyud spyir bsdoms na/ thabs shes gnyis med kyi rgyud drug /shes rab kyi rgyud bdun cu rtsa bzhi/ thabs kyi rgyud sum bcu rtsa gsum ste dril bas brgya phrag gcig dang bcu gsum bzhugs so/ /thub pa'i gsung rab 'gyur ro cog gi dkar chag ༵༵sa bshad nyi ma'i 'od zer las/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud kyi skabs te dang gnyis pa rnal 'byor gyi rgyud kyi dbye ba la gnyis/ thabs gtso bor ston pa'i rgyud dang / shes rab gtso bor ston pa'i rgyud do/ /dang po la gsum/rtsa ba'i rgyud/ bshad pa'i rgyud/ 'phros pa'am cha 'thun gyi rgyud do/ /dang po rtsa ba'i rgyud ni/ nya pa la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi de kho na nyid bsdus pa zhes bya ba/ rigs lnga rigs bzhir bsdus nas mnyam par ston pa/185—400

rtsa ba'i rgyud dum bu bzhi/ rgyud phyi ma/ phyi ma'i phyi ma/ rgyud nye bar bsdu ba dang bcas pa 'di la dkyil 'khor nyis brgya dang bcu gsum yod do//gnyis pa bshad pa'i rgyud ni/ rdo rje rtse mo'i rgyud rtog pa bcu las/'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa yan chad rdzogs nas/ phyi rol rdo rje rigs kyi mtshan brgya rtsas gsol ba btab pa yan chad/ paṇa ḍi ta kurma badz+ra dang / lots+tsha ba gzhon nu tshul khrims kyi 'gyur/ 'di yan chad la dkyil 'khor dngos su gsungs pa dgu yod cing / bod kyi bla ma dag rtsa rgyud kyi gzungs dkyil gyi gtso bo 'pho ba'i rigs pas brgya nyi shu rtsa dgur bzhed do/ /'di'i 'phro la da dung rtog pa phyed dang lnga ma tshang ngo / /thams cad gsang ba zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ paṇa ḍi ta pad ma ka ra warma dang / lots+tsha ba rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs/ 'di la dkyil 'khor gcig yod do/ /kha gcig 'di bla med du 'chad pa ni mi 'thad de/ slob dpon kun snying gis kyang de nyid bsdus pa'i bshad rgyud du bshad cing / 'di nyid kyi 'grel pa mkhan pos kyang rnal 'byor rgyud du bkral ba'i phyir/ 'di dum bu dang po'i bshad rgyud de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs gtso bor ston pa'o// //ta pa la/ 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa'i rgyal po/rtsa ba'i rgyud phyi ma dang bcas pa 'di la dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu rtsa drug yod do/ /'di dum bu gnyis pa'i bshad rgyud rdo rje'i rigs gtso bor ston pa'o//gsum pa dum bu gnyis pa'i ngan song dgug cing sdig pa dral ba la 'phros pa'i 'phros pa'am cha 'thun gyi rgyud ni/ ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i brtag pa/ paṇa ḍi ta shan ti gar+bha dang / lots+tsha ba ban 105—401

dhe dza ya rak+ṣi tas bsgyur ba las/ ā tsar+ya rin chen mchog gis skad gsar cad kyis bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'di la dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis yod do/ /sangs rgyas ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i brtag pa phyogs gcig pa/ paṇa ḍi ta re wen tra de ba dang / ma ṇi ka shrī dzñā na dang /lots+tsha ba chag chos rje byams pa dpal gyi 'gyur/ 'di la dkyil 'khor bcu gcig yod do/ /rab du gnas pa mdor bsdus pa'i rgyud/ kha che'i paṇa ḍi ta dzñā na badz+ra dang / lots+tsha ba 'byo shes rab grags kyi 'gyur/ 'di de nyid bcu'i sgo nas cho ga sgrub par bshad pas bya ba'i rgyud du byed pa mi 'thad do/ /rnal 'byor rgyud kyi cho ga las 'phros pa'o//gnyis pa shes rab gtso bor ston pa'i rgyud ni/ de nyid bsdus pa'i cha 'thun pa'i rgyud/ dpal mchog dang po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po rtog pa'i rgyal po ni/ dum bu dang po sher phyin gyi dum bu/ paṇa ḍi ta ā tsār+ya shā dha ka ra wa rma dang / lots+tsha ba rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ dum bu gnyis pa rtsa ba'i rgyud/rgyud phyi ma/ dum bu dang po dang gnyis pa'i rtog pa thams cad bsdus pa'i rgyud/dum bu gnyis pa nyid kyi rtog pa thams cad kyi rgyud phyi ma'i rtsa ba'i rgyud dang /gsang ba ras ris kyi cho ga dang phyag rgya'i rgyud/ rtog pa thams cad kyi rgyud phyi ma'i rtsa ba'i rgyud dang / rtog pa thams cad sgrub pa'i cho ga dang / phyag rgya'i rgyud thams cad kyi don gtan la 'bebs pa rtog pa thams cad bsdus pa'i mchog tu gsang ba'i mchog dang / rgyud nye bar bsdu ba dang bcas pa rnams paṇa ḍi ta man tra ka la sha dang / lots+tsha ba lha btsan po zhi ba 'od kyis bsgyur ba 'di la slob dpon kun snying dkyil 'khor brgyad cu rtsa bzhir bzhed/ slob dpon pad ma 105—402
