wa wa wa wawa wa —wa ——wa wawa ——— ————————— ——— ————— ————— ————— —— —badz+ra zhabs kyis dkyil 'khor bdun cu rtsa brgyad du bzhed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa'i tshul brgya lnga bcu pa 'di la dkyil 'khor bcwa lnga/ de la phye na dkyil 'khor nyi shu 'gyur bar 'grel pas bshad cing / 'di dpal mchog sher dum dang 'dra bar 'dug go/ /'di sngags su 'chad pa'i 'grel pa yod pas sngags su'ang mi 'gal zhes bla ma dag gsungs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs gsang ba rgyan gyi bkod pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/paṇa ḍi ta su ga ta shrī dang / chos rje sa skya lots+tsha bas bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs/'di la dkyil 'khor bdun yod do// //tha pa la/ dpal rdo rje snying po rgyan ces bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po/paṇa ḍi ta bde bar gshegs pa'i dpal dang / chos rje sa skya lots+tsha bas bsgyur ba'i 'phro rnams las lots+tsha ba bu ston gyis rgya dpe la gtugs shing / slob dpon rab zhi bshes gnyen gyi 'grel pa dang yang bstun nas bcos shing / zhus dag byas pa'i mjug rnams dpang lots+tsha ba blo gros brtan pas bsgyur ba 'di la dkyil 'khor sum bcu rtsa gnyis yod do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa sgo nyi shu rtsa lnga pa / 'di rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud na yod pa'i sgo nyi shu rtsa lnga pa logs su phyung ba 'am / cha 'thun pa'i rgyud do/ /gsang ba nor bu'i thig le'i rgyud paṇa ḍi ta su ga ta shrī dang / sa skya lots+tsha'i 'gyur/ dkyil 'khor gcig yod do/ /de ltar rnal 'byor gyi rgyud bcu bdun bzhugs so/ /thub pa'i gsung rab 'gyur ro cog k+to /k+ta/ // legs bshad nyi ma'i 'od zer las/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud kyi skabs 105—403

gsum pa spyod pa'i rgyud kyi dbye ba la gsum/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs gtso bor ston pa'i rgyud dang / pad ma'i rigs gtso bor ston pa'i rgyud dang /rdo rje'i rigs gtso bor ston pa'i rgyud do/ /dang po ni rnam par snang mdzad chen po mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa rnam par sprul pa byin gyis brlob pa'i rgyud rtsa ba'i rgyud rim par phye ba nyi shu rtsa drug dang / rgyud phyi ma gsang ba mchog gi rim par phye ba la rim par phye ba bdun rnams/ paṇa ḍi ta shrī len dra bo dhi dang /lots+tsha ba chen po dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ 'di gnyis la bam po drug dang /shu log brgya lnga bcu yod/ 'di'i rtsa ba'i rgyud la dbang bskur ba'i dkyil 'khor gsum / rgyud phyi ma la gcig yod cing / 'di'i rgyud phyi ma da dung ma rdzogs pa 'dra ste/ 'grel par rgyud phyi ma nas drangs pa'i lung rnams ma byung ba'i phyir ro//de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi yum la sogs pa ston pa'i rgyud ni ma rnyed la/de'i rigs su gtogs pa'i bka' nyan mi g.yo ba'i rgyud ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi khro bo'i rgyal po mi g.yo ba'i stobs dpag tu med pa brtul phod pa 'dul bar gsungs pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ paṇa ḍi ta u pa sha ma rak+ṣi ta dang lots+tsha ba glan dar ma blo gros kyi 'gyur/ 'di la dkyil 'khor gsum yod cing rnam snang mngon byang dang cha 'thun par yod pas spyod pa'i rgyud do//gnyis pa pad ma'i rigs gtso bor ston pa'i rgyud ni ma rnyed do//gsum pa rdo rje'i rigs gtso bor ston pa'i rgyud ni/ phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can rdo rje sa 'og gi rgyud le'u bcu gsum pa/ paṇa ḍi ta tshe lu dang / lots+tsha ba zangs dkar 'phags pa shes rab kyi 'gyur/ 'di'i sngags btu ba'i skabs nas / mthar gnas pa'i gsum pa la/ lnga pa yi ni mtha' dang sbyar zhes sogs 105wa 404

nī lām gyi la'i ring cha chad/ ba ra la bha btus/ pā ṇi la pa la ring cha med pa dang / nam log pas btus pas the tsom gyi gzhi'o zhes zer/ dkyil 'khor gcig yod do/ /rdo rje sa 'og gi rgyud le'u bdun pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dī paṃ ka ra dang ske/ lots+tsha ba bya'i gdong can gyis bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs/ 'di la dkyil 'khor gcig yod do// //da pa la/ phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud/ dum bu dang po 'og min du gsungs pa dang / grong khyer dpal yon tan 'byung ba'i gnas su gsungs pa gnyis bam po bcu gnyis pa/ paṇa ḍi ta shrī len dra bo dhi dang / lots+tsha ba chen po ye shes sdes bsgyur ba 'di la dkyil 'khor bzhi yod cing / da dung 'jug cung ma rdzogs pa 'dra'o/ /'phags pa lha mo brgyad kyi gzungs 'di la dkyil 'khor gnyis yod cing / phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i yum gyi skabs nas phyung ba 'dra zhing ma dpe'i dbang gis bya rgyud kyi khrod na yod do/ /rdo rje sa gsum du rgyu ba'i rtog pa le'u lnga pa/ paṇa ḍi ta ku mā ra badz+ra dang / ra byid lots+tsha ba'i 'gyur/ 'di la'ang badz+ra la bha btus pa dang / pā ṇi'i ring cha chad pas the tsom gyi bzhi'o zhes kha cig go/ /'phags pa lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi cho ga zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ paṇa ḍi ta dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang / lots+tsha ba rgya brtson 'grus seng ge'i 'gyur/ lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can zhes bya ba 'jig rten gsum 'dul ba'i rgyud le'u lnga pa/ paṇa ḍi ta snga ma dang 'dra la lots+tsha ba rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ 'di la dkyil 'khor bzhi yod cing / the tsom gyi gzhi yin zhes kha cig go/ /de ltar spyod pa'i rgyud bcu phrag gcig bzhugs so//thub pa'i gsung rab 'gyur ro cog gi dkar chag legs bshad nyi ma'i 'od zer 105wa 405

— ———————————— — ————wa —————wa wawa wa —zhes bya ba las/ spyod pa'i rgyud kyi skabs te gsum pa'o// //bzhi pa bya ba'i rgyud kyi dbye ba la gnyis rigs so so'i rgyud dang / rigs thams cad kyi spyi'i rgyud do/ /dang po rigs so so'i rgyud la drug /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dang / pad ma'i dang / rdo rje'i dang / nor can gyi dang / lnga rtsen gyi dang / 'jig rten pa'i rigs so/ /dang po de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs la brgyad/ rigs kyi gtso bo'i dang / rigs kyi bdag po 'khor los bsgyur ba'i dang / rigs kyi yum gyi dang / rigs kyi gtsug tor gyi dang /rigs kyi khro bo khro mo'i dang / rigs kyi pho nya pho mo'i dang / de bzhin gshegs pasbya rig/rdo su bsdu ba'i byang sems kyi dang / gnas gtsang ma'i lha la sogs pa // po /de/ bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi gtso bo'i rgyud ni/ dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i rgyal po'i rgyud/ kriṇ+ḍa paṇa ḍi ta dang / lots+tsha ba tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ kha cig 'di spyod pa'i rgyud du 'chad mod kyi/ bya ba'i rgyud dang 'thun pa shas che zhing / a bha ya la sogs pas bya ba'i rgyud du bshad pas so/ /'di la bya ba dang rnal 'byor gyi cha gnyis dang ldan pas gnyis ma'i rgyud ces rin chen bzang po'i sngags log sun 'byin du bshad do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa'i mdo/ shu log brgyad brgya pa/paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / shrī len dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis gtan la phab pa/ sman gyi bla bai dur+ya 'od kyi rgyal po'i sngon gyi smon lam khyad par rgyas 185wa 406

pa'i mdo/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad gsar chad kyis gtan la phab pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs bskyed pa'i bai dur+ya'i 'od ces bya ba'i gzungs/paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / su ren dra bo dhe dang / ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa las/ phyis paṇa ḍi ta dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang / lots+tsha ba tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur ba/ sman la sngags kyis gdab pa ni 'di nyid kyi sman bla'i snying po logs su phyung ba yin pas/ rgyud tha dad du mi bgrang ngo / /nor bu zab mo rgyas pa'i gzhal med khang shin tu rab tu gnas pa gsang ba dam pa'i cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po le'u bdun pa/ paṇa ḍi ta bir+sha ka ra pra bhā ba dang / lots+tsha ba dpal gyi lhun pos bsgyur ba las/ slad kyi paṇa ḍi ta de nyid dang / lots+tsha ba chen po dpal brtsegs kyis zhus te gtan la phab pa rnams bzhugs// //na pa la/ byang chub snying po'i rgyan 'bum nas btus pa'i gzungs/'di'i rgyud tshang ba gcig bod du 'gyur yod par 'dug pas btsal bar bya'o/ /mchod rten gcig btab na bye ba btab par 'gyur ba'i gzungs dang cho ga ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi gzhi pa gtsug tor gyi skor yin zhing rnam snang 'od kyi rgyal ba'i gzungs nas bod kyis gang mkho ba rnams btus par snang ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po gsang ba ring bsrel gyi za ma tog ces bya ba'i gzungs/ paṇa ḍi ta bir+sha ka ra pra bhā ba dang / lots+tsha ba brtsangs de ben tra rak+ṣi tas bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa'i mdo/paṇa ḍi ta su ren dra bo dhi dang / lots+tsha ba chen po ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ 'di 185—407

dpe snga ma'i dbang du song nas 'dir bzhugs kyi/ 'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi drug pa pho nya'i skor du shes par bya'o/ /shākya thub pa'i snying po'i gzungs / 'phags pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs/'phags pa rgyal ba'i bla ma'i gzungs/ 'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs bdun pa byang sems kyi skor yin/ las kyi sgrib pa sbyong ba'i gzungs gcig /bde ldan gyi snying po/ 'di gnyis pa pad ma'i rigs kyi gtso bo'i skor ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs dang shu log sum bcu rtsa brgyad dang /sangs rgyas kyi snying po zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs shu log lnga bcu rtsa lnga/sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yan lag dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ shu log sum bcu rtsa lnga/ sangs rgyas bcu gnyis pa zhes bya ba'i mdo/ /sangs rgyas bdun pa zhes bya ba'i mdo/ snang ba mtha' yas kyi gzungs/ snang ba mtha' yas rjes su dran pa'i gzungs/ 'di gnyis gnyis pa pad ma'i rigs kyi gtso bo'i skor yin no/ /zla 'od kyi mtshan rjes su dran pa'i gzungs/ de bzhin gshegs pa spyi'i snying po rjes su dran pa/ sangs rgyas rin chen gtsug tor can gyi mtshan rjes su dran pa/ 'phags pa dri ma med pa'i gzungs shu log brgyad cu rtsa bdun/ khyad par can zhes bya ba'i gzungs shu log bdun cu rtsa lnga pa/'di la rgya gar na sbrul lo la sogs pa'i rnam bzhag med pa la/ de'i rnam bzhag byas pas/ the tsom gyi gzhi gcig tu snang zhes kha cig smra mod kyi/ rad na tī rtis byas zhes zer ba'i gzungs spyi'i cho ga kun snang gsal ba las 'jam dbyangs gzhon nus gsungs pa yi/ /khyad par can gyi gzungs las bsdod/ /ces byas 'dug pa ltar na ni der mi sems so/ /dkyil 'khor brgyad pa zhes bya 185—408

ba'i mdo shu log bdun cu pa/ 'di yang dpe phyi'i dbang du song nas ni 'di bzhugs kyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su bsdu ba'i bdun pa byang sems kyi skor du shes par bya'o/ /de rnams paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / da na shī la dang / lots+tsha ba chen po ye shes sdes bsgyur cing / skad gsar chad kyis gtan la phab pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yi ge nyung ngu / 'di yum gyi rigs su byas na rigs mod kyi/ gzungs spyi'i cho ga kun snang gsal ba las/ thub pa'i gzungs su bshad cing / mdo'i nang nas thub pa'i snying po ston pa yin pas / thub par yang mi 'gal lo/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po zhes bya ba'i mdo/ paṇa ḍi ta bi ma la mi tra dang / lots+tsha ba 'bro rin chen sdes bsgyur cing lots+tsha ba dge slong nam mkha' la sogs pas zhus te gtan la phab pa/'di'ang yum gyi skor du byas na 'thad mod kyi klu sgrub kyis thub pa gtso 'khor lnga pa'i sgrub thabs mdzad pas de la brten nas thub par byas so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa 'di/gzhan gyis mi thub pa zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi gzungs chen po gcig yod par bshad do/ /de nas phyung ba yin pa 'dra ste/ gzhan gyis mi thub gzungs gsan nas/ zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir ro//gnyis pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi bdag po 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyud 'jam dpal gyi skor ni/ 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud le'u sum bcu rtsa drug pa / paṇa ḍi ta ku mā ra ka la sha dang / lots+tsha ba shākya blo gros kyis bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs// //pa pa la/ dpa' bo gcig tu grub pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po le'u bzhi 185—409

pa / paṇa ḍi ta dī paṃ ka ra shri dzha na dang / lots+tsha ba dge ba'i blo gros kyis bsgyur ba las/ lots+tsha ba tshul khrims rgyal bas zhus te gtan la phab pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jam dpal rnon po la bstod pa/ 'jam dpal ngag gi dbang phyug la bu mo brgyad kyis bstod pa/ 'jam dpal gyi zhal nas gsungs pa'i gzungs shu log nyi shu/ paṇa ḍi ta dzña na gar+bha dang / lots+tsha ba klu'i dbang po'i 'gyur la/slad kyi paṇa ḍi ta bi shud dha sing ha dang / lots+tsha ba de ba tsan tras gtan la phab pa / 'jam dpal gyi dmod btsugs pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'jam dpal gyi dam bcas pa'i gzungs/ 'jam dpal gyi mtshan zhes bya ba'i gzungs/'jam dpal gyi shes rab blo 'phel gyi gzungs shu log lnga/ 'jam dpal yi ge 'bru gcig pa'i gzungs/gsum pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi yum gyi rgyud ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa'i mtshan rgya rtsa brgyad pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa kau shi ka zhes bya ba gnyis sangs rgyas kyi yum yin no/ /gser 'od dam pa mchog tu rnam par rgyal ba'i mdo/ le'u sum bcu rtsa gcig pa/ 'gos chos grub kyis rgya'i dpe las bsgyur ba 'di la dkyil 'khor drug yod par gsal la/ gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po le'u nyi shu rtsa dgu pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi dra dang / shrī len tra bo dhi dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad gsar chad kyis gtan la phab pa rnams bzhugs/ 'di la dkyil 'khor drug du gsal 61// //pha pa la/ gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po zhes bya ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ 'di la dkyil 'khor gnyis su gsal lo/ /'di gsum gleng 705—410

gzhi dang bdun na de bzhin gshegs par yang gsal mod kyi/ gser rgyal yum gyi gzungs yin zhing / de'i skabs su yum gyi cho ga gsungs pas 'dir yum gyi phyogs su byas kyi/ gzhan du ji ltar rigs par bya'o/ /kha cig gis gser 'od dam pa rin po che'i tog /dkon mchog ta la la/ mtshan bzang po/'dus pa chen po/ rdo rje snying po/ nyi ma'i snying po/ kun tu rgyu ba dang kun tu rgyu ba ma yin pa dang / 'thun pa la sogs pa bris pa ni nor ba yin te/ mdo rgyud ma 'dres par phye ba'i dkar chag dag tu mdor bshad pa'i phyir/ zhes 'chad do/ /stong chen rab 'joms bam po gnyis/ rma bya chen po shu log bdun brgya/ paṇa ḍi ta shī len dra bo rnyi dang / dzha na si dhi dang / shākya pra bha ba dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad gsar chad kyis gtan la phab pa/so sor 'brang ma shu log bzhi brgya bzhi bcu/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad gsar cad kyis gtan la phab pa/ bsil ba'i tshal gyi mdo shu log nyis brgya brgyad cu/ gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin pa shu log brgya bzhi bcu/ paṇa ḍi ta shrī len dra bo dhi dang / dzña na sid dhi dang / shākya pra bha ba dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad gsar chad kyis gtan la phab pa/ lha mo 'od zer can gyi gzungs shu log nyi shu rtsa gnyis/ paṇa ḍi ta a mo gha badz+ra dang / lots+tsha ba rin chen grags pas bsgyur ba / sgyu ma'i 'od zer can 'byung ba'i rgyud las phyung ba'i rtog pa'i rgyal po dang /'od zer can gyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga /'od zer can 'byung ba'i rgyud/ stong phrag bcu gnyis pa las mchog tu snying por gyur pa'i 'od zer can gyi rtog pa brgya phrag bdun pa phyung ba 'od zer gyi rtog pa 'di bya ba'i rgyud min pa 'dra yang 'od 105—411

zer can phyogs gcig tu bya ba'i phyir zhes kha cig 'chad do/ /par+ṇa sha ba ri'i mdo / ri khrod lo ma can gyi gzungs shu log nyi shu/ 'di gnyis pad ma'i rigs kyi khro mo'i khongs su gtogs shing gzhan nas phyung bar snang ngo / /rdo rje lu gu rgyud kyi rtog pa le'u bzhi pa/ paṇa ḍi ta a tu la dha sa badz+ra dang / lots+tsha ba mar pa chos kyi dbang phyug grags pas bsgyur ba/ 'di gsum pa rdo rje'i rigs kyi pho nya dang bka' nyan pho mo'i khongs su gtogs so/ /lha mo skul byed ma'i gzungs / 'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi lnga pa khro mo yin no/ /dug sel ma'i rig sngags shu log nyi shu rtsa phyed dang gnyis/ dbyig dang ldan pa'i gzungs shu log sum bcu rtsa bdun/ grags ldan ma'i gzungs 'di gnyis pa pad ma'i rigs kyi yum yin no/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rgyal ba can shu log brgya bzhi bcu rtsa lnga/ rgyal ba can gyi gzungs shu log brgyad cu rtsa gcig /'di'i ming du de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po dang phyag rgya zhes bya ba gsungs pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi lha mor byas so/ /de rnams paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad gsar chad kyis gtan la phab pa/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya'i yang snying sgrol ma mchog gi gzungs shu log brgya bzhi bcu/ 'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi dang po gtso bo'i khongs su gtogs so/ /lha mo brgyad kyi gzungs shu log sum cu rtsa gsum pa/ paṇa ḍi ta shrī len dra bo dhi dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sdes bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa/ 'di spyod rgyud kyi gsum pa rdo rje'i rigs kyi rgyud do//bzhi pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi gtsug tor gyi rgyud ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs rtog 705—412

pa dang bcas pa/ 'phags pa ngan 'gro thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ba shu log brgya nyi shu paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / su ren tra bo dhi dang / lots+tsha ba chen po ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ba'i gzungs rtog pa dang bcas pa shu log nyis brgya nyi shu/ paṇa ḍi ta chos kyi sde dang / lots+tsha ba khams pa ba ri ba'i 'gyur/gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i gzungs zhes bya ba'i rtog pa rab byed dang po/thar pa lots+tsha ba nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i 'gyur/ 'di la sngags o dgu ma dang / lha sum cu rtsa gsum gyi dkyil chog yod do/ /yang gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs rtog pa dang bcas pa chung ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor nas byung ba gdugs dkar po can gzhan gyis mi thub ma phyir bzlog pa'i rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo/ 'di la 'grel par dkyil 'khor bzhi bshad do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ phyir bzlog ma chen mo mchog tu grub pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ paṇa ḍi ta ba ra hi ta dang /lots+tsha ba gzu dga' ba rdo rje'i 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba gdugs dkar mo gzhan gyis mi thub ma zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba gdugs dkar po can gzhan gyis mi thub ma zhes bya ba'i gzungs lha yul ma chung bar grags pa/ kha che'i paṇa ḍi ta ma hā dzñā na'i rang 'gyur/ kun nas sgor 'jug pa'i 'od zer gtsug tor dri ma med par snang ba de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po dang dam tshig la rnam par lta ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / shī len dra bo dhi 185—413

dang / lots+tsha ba chen po ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ 'di la 'grel pas dkyil 'khor brgyad gsungs so/ /nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs shu log bcu gsum/ yang nad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs gzhung tshad snga ma dang 'dra / rims nad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs shu log gnyis/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sdes bsgyur ba/ rims nad zhi ba'i gzungs/ mig nad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i mdo/ 'brum bu'i nad zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs shu log bcu/ gzhang 'brum zhi bar byed pa'i mdo shu log nyi shu rtsa gnyis/ de rnams kyi lo paṇa snga ma dang 'dra/ mi rgod rnam par 'joms pa'i gzungs shu log bcwa lnga/ bu mang po rton pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs shu log bcu gsum/ lo paṇa snga ma bzhin/ gzungs sna dgu po 'di rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi drug pa pho nya pho mo'i khongs su gtogs so/ /stong 'gyur ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs shu log bdun/ 'di gnyis pa pad ma'i rigs kyi bdag po'i khongs su gtogs so/ /ye shes ta la la zhes bya ba 'gro ba thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i gzungs shu log nyi shu/ 'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi dang po gtso bo'i khongs su gtogs so/ /'od zer dri ma med pa rnam par dag pa'i 'od ces bya ba'i gzungs shu log brgyad cu rtsa bdun pa/ paṇa ḍi ta bir+sha ka ra sing ha dang / lots+tsha ba dpal gyi lhun po'i sdes bsgyur ba/ 'di gtsug tor dngos ma yin yang gtsug tor dang cha 'thun zhing / mchod rten bya ba'i tshul dang cho ga 'thun pas gtsug tor gyi skor ro/ /shes pas thams cad mthar phyin par grub pa'i mchod rten zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'di gtsug tor dri med kyi lag len du snang ste/ rgyud rang yin min dpyad par bya'o zhes kha cig go/ /rten 105wa 414

cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i snying po'i cho ga'i gzungs/ dge slong ner pan rak+ṣi tas tho dkar gyi yul nas rnyed pa/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i mdo / rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i snying po/ 'di gsum de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi dang po gtso bo'i khongs su gtogs so/ /sngon gyi rgyud 'bum rnams su bris pa'i rin po che bdar ba'i gzungs/ gtsug tor 'bar ba'i gzungs / sman bla las phyung ba'i sman la sngags kyis gdab pa'i gzungs/bskor ba bya ba'i gzungs gnyis/ yon yongs su sbyong ba'i gzungs gnyis/bdun po 'di mdo rgyud tha dad nas phyung bar snang bas/ gang nas phyung ba de'i khongs su gtogs so/ /thos pa 'dzin pa'i gzungs 'di/ gnyis pa pad ma'i rigs kyi bdag po'i skor yin/ yang thos pa 'dzin pa'i gzungs/ shes rab bskyed pa'i gzungs/ paṇa ḍi ta dzñā na gar+bha dang / lots+tsha ba klu'i dbang pos bsgyur ba las/ slad kyi paṇa ḍi ta bir+ya ka ra sing hā dang / lots+tsha ba de ba tsan tras zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'di gnyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su bsdu ba'i bdun pa byang sems kyi skor yin/ shes rab bskyed pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/yang shes rab bskyed pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ de gnyis lo paṇa snga ma dang 'dra'o / /shu log brgya lobs pa cha gnyis/ shu log stong lobs pa cha gsum/shu log sum stong lobs pa'i gzungs/ mi brjed pa'i gzungs/ dgu po 'di gnyis pa pad ma'i rigs kyi bdag po'i khongs su gtogs so/ /phyag bya ba dang /gos brgya thob pa/ mi dga' bar byed pa/ gsum po 'di yang gzhan nas phyung bar snang ngo / /'phags pa pad ma'i spyan zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'di yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi dang po gtso bo'i skor ro/ /ngan song thams cad 105—415

yongs su sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'di rnal 'byor gyi rgyud kyi 'phros pa'i rgyud sbyong rgyud kyi rtsar bri rgyu yin no/ /skran zhi ba'i gzungs/ ma zhu ba'i nad 'byang ba/ sdang ba zhi bar byed pa/ sdig pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa/khro ba zhi bar byed pa/ khros pa zhi ba/ tshig btsan pa/ bdag srung ba/ yid du 'ong ba/ mgrin pa snyan pa/ don thams cad grub pa/ las grub pa/dug thams cad zhi bar byed pa/ bcings pa las grol ba/ bdud skrag par byed pa/ rma 'byor bar byed pa/ me'i zug rngu rab tu zhi bar byed pa/ mkhris pa'i nad sel ba/ bad kun gyi nad sel ba/ k+ṣa ya'i nad sel ba/ rims dang srog chags kyis mi tshugs pa/ stong chen mo nas phyung ba sman la sngags kyis gdab pa/ mchog thob pa'i rig sngags zhes bya ba lha mo dung can ma'i snying po 'di pad ma'i rigs kyi khro bo khro mo'i khongs su gtogs so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa/ 'phags pa brgyad stong pa rnams kyi gzungs/ phar phyin drug gi snying po/ phyin drug thob par 'gyur ba'i gzungs / pha rol du phyin pa bcu thob par 'gyur ba'i gzungs/ tshad med pa bzhi thob par 'gyur ba'i gzungs/ stong phrag brgya pa/ phal po che/ sdong po bkod pa/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal po'i mdo/ rma bya chen mo/ so sor 'brang ba chen mo rnams bzung bar 'gyur ba'i gzungs/ lang shar gshegs pa'i mdo thams cad klags par 'gyur ba'i gzungs rnams bzhugs/ stong phrag brgya pa'i gzungs la sogs pa 'di dag mdo sde'i nang nas phyung ba yin pas rgyud dngos ma yin yang gzungs phyogs gcig tu bya ba'i phyir sngar gyi rgyud 'bum rnams su bris/gzhan yang gzungs phran mang po de dang 'dra ste/ gang nas btus pa'i khongs su 185—416

shesaparadra/'o( wa wa —wa wa———wa wa—wa ———— ——— ———————— — — —ba pa la/ mchod pa'i sprin ces bya ba'i gzungs shu log bcu drug /'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi dang po gtso bo'i skor ro/ /yon tan bsngags pa dpag tu med pa'i gzungs shu log bcwa lnga/ 'di gnyis pa pad ma'i rigs kyi gtso bo'i khongs su gtogs so/ /chos thams cad kyi yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs shu log dgu/ 'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi gsum pa yum gyi khongs su gtogs so/ /phyir bzlog pa stobs can zhes bya ba'i gzungs shu log bcu gsum/ 'di gnyis pa pad ma'i rigs kyi khro bo khro mo'i skor ro/ /mdangs phyir mi 'phrog pa zhes bya ba/ 'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi drug pa pho nya pho mo'i khongs su gtogs so/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo dbugs chen po zhes bya ba shu log bzhi bcu/ paṇa ḍi ta pradzñā warma dang / lots+tsha ba chen po ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ 'di drug pa 'jig rten pa'i rigs so/ /'di ni mtshon pa ste mdo sde rnams su 'jig rten pa'i lha la sogs pas rig pa phul zhing ston pas byin gyis brlabs pa thams cad kyang ston pa la brten pa'i rigs gsungs so//lnga pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi khro bo khro mo'i rgyud ni/ khro bo rnam par rgyal ba shin tu gsang ba'i rgyud/ rtsa ba'i rgyud/ rgyud phyi ma phyi ma'i phyi ma dang bcas pa le'u nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa/ gtsug gi nor bu zhes bya ba'i gzungs/paṇa ḍi ta shī len dra bo dhi dang / lots+tsha ba chen po ye shes sdes bsgyur ba/ 'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi gsum pa yum gyi khongs su gtogs so/ /tsan dan gyi yan lag ces bya ba shu log sum bcu rtsa dgu/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang /dā na shī la dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad gsar chad kyis gtan la 785—417

phab pa/ 'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi dang po gtso bo'i skor ro/ /phyir log pa rnam par rgyal ba'i gzungs/ shu log sum bcu rtsa bdun/ 'di gnyis pa pad ma'i rigs kyi khro bo khro mo'i skor ro/ /mdangs phyir 'phrog pa zhes bya ba'i mdo shu log bcu bdun/ 'di yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi drug pa pho nya pho mo'i khongs su gtogs so/ /gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i rin chen phreng ba shu log sum cu rtsa drug /paṇa ḍi ta shī len dra bo dhi dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sdes bsgyur ba/ gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/shu log sum cu rtsa bzhi/ paṇa ḍi ta pradzñā warma dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sdes la sogs pas bsgyur ba/ 'di yang gnyis pa pad ma'i rigs kyi bdag po 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rigs su gtogs so/ /gdon mi za ba'i gzungs/ gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i rig sngags chen mo/ 'di gnyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi dang po gtso bo'i khongs su gtogs so/ /thams cad la rab tu mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang /lots+tsha ba ye shes sdes bsgyur cing / skad gsar chad kyis gtan la phab pa/dbang bskur ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ shu log sum cu rtsa gsum pa/ lo paṇa snga ma dang 'dra'o/ /'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi gsum pa yum yin no/ /mig rnam par sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i rig sngags/ shu log sum cu rtsa gnyis/'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi drug pa pho nya pho mo'i khongs su gtogs so/ /bar du gcod pa thams cad rnam par sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs shu log nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sdes bsgyur ba/ bar du gcod pa thams cad sel ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/185—418

'di'ang de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi drug pa/ pho nya pho mo'i skor du gtogs so / /'gro lding ba'i rig sngags kyi rgyal po shu log bzhi bcu rtsa lnga pa/ lo paṇa snga ma dang 'dra'o/ /'di 'phags pa ra wi ti'i rig sngags dang gnad gcig go//khro mo'i skor la/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan zhes bya ba'i gzungs shu log bzhi bcu/ lo paṇa snga ma rnams dang 'dra'o/ /gong du song ba'i skul byed ma'i gzungs gnyis so/ /sa'i dbang po zhes bya ba'i gzungs shu log sum cu rtsa phyed dang brgyad/ 'gyur byang snga ma rnams dang 'dra ba 'di yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi dang po gtso bo'i khongs su gtogs so/ /'di dang rig sngags kyi rgyal mo kun nas 'od ces bya ba gnyis/ 'gyur khyad ma gtogs pa gcig go/be con chen po zhes bya ba'i gzungs shu log bzhi bcu pa 'di yang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi lnga pa khro bo'i khongs su gtogs so//drug pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi pho nya pho mo'i rgyud ni/ sgo bzang po zhes bya ba'i gzungs shu log brgya phrag gcig dang bcu yod pa 'di dang / snga ma de paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad gsar chad kyis gtan la phab pa/ 'di la khro bo'am/ pho nya pho mo ci rigs su yod do/ /chos kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ paṇa ḍi ta su ren dra bo dhi dang / pradzñā warma dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sdes bsgyur ba/ 'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi brgyad pa/ gnas gtsang ma'i lha la sogs pa'i rigs su gtogs so/ /tshigs su bcad pa gnyis pa'i gzungs/ 'di sngags don la de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi lnga pa khro bor gsal lo/ /sgo drug pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs / 'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi dang po gtso bo'i skor ro/ /185—419

'phags pa yi ge drug pa zhes bya ba'i rigs sngags shu log bcu dgu/ 'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi gsum pa yum gyi khongs su gtogs so/ /gser can zhes bya ba'i gzungs shu log lnga bcu/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / lots+tsha ba chen po ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad gsar chad kyis gtan la phab pa/ 'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi drug pa pho nya pho mo'i khongs su gtogs so/ /snying rje mchog ces bya ba'i gzungs shu log lnga bcu/ 'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi bzhi pa'i gtsug tor yin te/ gtsug tor nas byung ba snying rje'i mchog ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /me tog brtsegs pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs shu log lnga bcu rtsa lnga/ 'phags pa gzungs chen po shu log lnga bcu rtsa bdun/ de rnams kyi 'gyur byang snga ma dang 'dra'o/ /'di gnyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi dang po gtso po'i khongs su gtogs so/ /pho nya'i 'khor du gtogs pa bka' nyan pho mo la/ 'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i gzungs le'u dgu pa / paṇa ḍi ta dharmā shrī mi tra dang / lots+tsha ba chos kyi bzang po'i 'gyur/ khro bo'i rgyal po rtog pa bsdus pa'i rgyud ces pa le'u bcu pa 'di gnyis gnyis ka la sngags btu ba'i skabs su bla btsongs 'dug pas the tshom za'o zhes kha cig zer ro//bdun pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su bsdu ba'i byang sems kyi rgyud ni/spyan ras gzigs/ byams pa/ nam mkha'i snying po/ kun tu bzang po/lag na rdo rje / 'jam dpal/ sgrib pa rnam sel/ sa'i snying po rnams kyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa sde brgyad po 'di/ sngar gyi glegs bam rnams su sangs rgyas kyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa dang sbrel nas 'byung zhing / gleng gzhi'ang phal cher 'brel nas 'dug pas rgyud gcig nas phyung ba 185—420

yin na de'i khongs su gtogs la/ sems dpa' so so'i rgyud las phyung ba yin na sems dpa'i khongs su gtogs pas brtag par bya'o/ /'dir re shig sems dpa'i dbang du byas so zhes dkar chag mkhan snga mas bkod do/ /de'i ma dpe'i dbang gis 'dir yang ngo / /spyan ras gzigs kyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa rgyal ba thams cad kyi ring bsrel za ma tog ces bya ba shu log bzhi bcu'o/ /'di gnyis pa pad ma'i rigs kyi bdag po 'khor los bsgyur ba'i skor ro/ /'jam dpal gyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa snying po dang bcas pa/ byams pas dam bcas pa'i gzungs/ paṇa ḍi ta badz+ra pā ni dang / lots+tsha ba chos kyi shes rab kyis bsgyur ba/ gnod 'dzin gyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ 'di bya rgyud kyi bzhi pa nor can gyi khongs su gtogs so// //brgyad pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi gnas gtsang ma'i lha la sogs pa'i rgyud ni/ mdo chen po 'dus pa chen po'i mdo dang / mdo chen po kun du rgyu ba dang / kun du rgyu ba ma yin pa dang 'thun pa'i mdo gnyis/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / pradzñā warma dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ sprin chen po'i mdo las char dbab pa zhes bya ba le'u drug cu rtsa bzhi pa cho ga dang bcas pa/paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / shrī len dra bo dhi dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur cing gtan la phab pa/ sprin chen po rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi le'u klu thams cad kyi snying po zhes bya ba'i mdo/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / su ren dra bo dhi dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ klu'i rgyal po gzi can gyis zhus pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs sh+lau ka sum cu/ tshogs kyi bdag po'i rgyud dngos grub 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i le'u bcwa lnga pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang / lots+tsha ba 'brom 105—421

rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi 'gyur/ 'di la'ang sngags btu ba'i skabs nas the tshom gyi gzhi yod ces kha cig 'dod do/ /tshogs kyi bdag po'i snying po shu log bcu drug /gza' rnams kyi yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgyal blon gyi dus su bsgyur ba las/ dpal sa skya'i dge bsnyen grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis dag par byas pa/ yang gza' rnams kyi yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ nor gyi rgyun zhes bya ba'i gzungs shu log brgyad cu rtsa drug /nor rgyun ma'i rtog pa/ nor rgyun ma'i gzungs kyi rtog pa/ dpal nag po chen po'i rgyud le'u brgyad pa/ paṇa ḍi ta a mo gha badz+ra dang / lots+tsha ba phur bu 'od kyi 'gyur/ 'di rgyud yang dag yin min the tsom za zhing / yin du bcug kyang bya rgyud yin pa'i nges pa mi 'dug ces dkar chag pa snga ma 'ga' zhig go/ /'dir ni dpe snga ma rnams kyis bya rgyud kyi skabs na bris pa bzhin bkod do/ /dpal mgon po nag po'i gzungs shu log phyed dang bdun/ lha mo nag mo chen mo'i gzungs shu log bcu gsum/ nag po chen po'i gzungs rims nad thams cad las thar bar byed pa zhes bya ba/ paṇa ḍi ta pradzñā warma dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ dpal lha mo nag mo'i bstod pa'i rgyal po'i rgyud/ de'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ dpal lha mo la brgya byin gyis bstod pa/ 'di gsum yang rgyud yang dag dang bya rgyud yin min the tshom gyi gzhi'o zhes zer ro/ /ro langs bdun pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs shu log brgyad cu rtsa dgu/ paṇa ḍi ta bi shu dha sing ha dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes snying pos bsgyur ba las/ slad kyi paṇa ḍi ta bir+sha ka ra sing ha dang / lots+tsha ba chen po ye shes sdes zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi drug pa pho nya pho mo'i skor yin no/ /su rū pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'di de bzhin 105—422

—wa wa ——— ——wa —————— —— — —— ——————gshegs pa'i rigs kyi dang po gtso bo'i khongs su gtogs so/ /ye shes skar mda'i snying po bdud rtsi 'byung ba'i gzungs/ yi dgas kha 'bar ma dbugs dbyung ba'i gtor ma'i cho ga shu log nyi shu/ yi dgas kha nas me 'bar ma la skyabs mdzad pa'i gzungs/ 'di bzhi byang chub sems dpa'i bya ba yin pas de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi bdun pa byang sems kyi skor ro/ /'jur 'gegs sel ba'i gzungs 'di bod ma yin par 'dug ces 'chad do/ /mchil ma dang /lud pa dang / snabs dang / lus kyi dri ma/ dri chen/ dri chu rnams sbyin par btang ba'i gzungs/ 'chi med rnga sgra'i gzungs/ tshe dpag med kyi yang snying rnams ni/ mdo rgyud tha dad nas btus par snang bas gang nas btus pa de'i phyogs su shes par bya'o// //gnyis pa pad ma'i rigs kyi rgyud la lnga/ rigs kyi gtso bo dang / rigs kyi bdag po dang / rigs kyi yum dang / rigs kyi khro bo khro mo dang / rigs kyi bka' nyan pho mo'i rgyud do/ /dang po ni/ tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa zhes bya ba'i theg pa chen po'i mdo/ o gsum byas pa bar na puṇa yod pa gcig dang / o gnyis byas pa bar na put+ta med pa gcig ste cha gnyis/ tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa zhes bya ba'i snying po zhes bya ba 'chi med rnga sgra'i gzungs/paṇa ḍi ta put+ta saṃ bhā ba dang / lots+tsha ba pa tshab nyi ma grags kyi 'gyur/ 'di rnams sngags dang ston pa po'i mtshan nyid la dpyad na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ri/sa t+t+waṃ gsal yang / bla ma dag 'od dpag med pad ma'i rigs kyi gtso bor ba / nyis// pa ri//gas kyi bdag po 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyud ni/ spyan ras 105—423

— —————————————————— ——wa wa————wa wagazigs kyi rgyud la/ spyan ras gzigs rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po pad ma dra ba zhes bya ba le'u bcu gnyis pa/ paṇa ḍi ta so ma shrī bha bya dang / lots+tsha ba kyu ra tshul khrims 'od zer gyis bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs/ 'di la dkyil 'khor nyi shu rtsa bdun yod cing / rgyud legs por grags so// //ma pa la/ 'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i bsgyur 'phro bam po nyi shu rtsa bzhi tshang ba/ bu ston rin po che'i chos 'byung du bam po nyi shu rtsa drug tu byas 'dug /don yod zhags pa'i snying po zhes bya ba'i mdo shu log brgya sum cu pa/ paṇa ḍi ta a mo gha badz+ra dang / lots+tsha ba ba ri rin chen grags kyi 'gyur/ 'di cho ga zhib mo'i mgon yod pa'i snying po dang spyir 'dra ba la sngags la mang nyung khyad che bar snang ngo / /don yod zhags pa'i snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs ni sngar gyi gzungs las snying po logs su bkol nas khrus chog byed tshul dang bcas pa/ bod kyis logs su phyung bar snang ngo / /de 'dir ma rnyed do/ /don yod zhags pa'i phar phyin drug yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i gzungs/ paṇa ḍi ta mañdzu shrī warma dang /lots+tsha ba blo ldan shes rab kyis bsgyur ba las/ lots+tsha ba chos kyi shes rab kyis bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa/ spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong dang ldan pa'i cho ga zhib mo/ 'di la dkyil 'khor gcig yod do/ /spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong dang ldan pa thogs pa mi mnga' ba'i thugs rje chen po'i sems rgya cher rdzogs pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ lots+tsha ba 'gos chos grub kyis rgya'i dpe las bsnar ba rnams bzhugs/ /'di snga ma dang gnyis 'dra la 'dra min cig 'duX pa/ /la //spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gsang ba'i mdzod thogs pa med pa 105—424

yid bzhin gyi 'khor lo'i snying po le'u drug pa shu log nyis brgya bzhi bcu pa/lots+tsha ba chos grub kyis rgya'i dpe las bsgyur ba/ spyan ras gzigs kyi gzungs/spyan ras gzigs kyi snying po/ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug zhal bcu gcig pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs shu log lnga bcu rtsa bzhi/ paṇa ḍi ta shī len dra bo dhi dang /lots+tsha ba ye shes sdes bsgyur ba/ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug zhal bcu gcig pa'i rigs sngags kyi snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ lots+tsha ba chos grub kyis rgya'i dpe las bsgyur ba/ thugs rje chen po pad+ma cod pan gyi rgyud le'u bcu gcig pa/paṇa ḍi ta dharmā shrī mi tra dang / lots+tsha ba chos kyi bzang po'i 'gyur/ 'di rgyud yang dag yin min dpyad par bya'o/ /zhes 'ga' zhig smra/ 'jig rten dbang phyug gi rtog pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dzam bha la dang / lots+tsha ba ba ri'i 'gyur/ 'di bya rgyud yin min brtag go/ /kun du bzang po zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad gsar chad kyis gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa nī la kun ṭha zhes bya ba'i gzungs shu log bzhi bcu/ spyan ras gzigs ha ya spyi ba'i gzungs shu log sum bcu / 'di pad ma'i rigs kyi bzhi pa khro bo yin no/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po'i gzungs phan yon mdor bsdus pa zhes bya ba/lots+tsha ba 'brog mi'i 'gyur/ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa rgyal ba thams cad kyi ring bsrel za ma tog ces bya ba/ 'di dang gong gi mtshan brgya rtsa lhug par yod pa gnyis 'gyur khyad min pa gcig go/ /gnod 'dzin chu dbang snying rje can gyi gzungs/ 'di bya rgyud kyi bzhi pa nor can gyi rgyud kyi skor ro/ /klags pas grub pa sor mo can zhes bya ba'i rig sngags kyi rgyal 105—425

mo 'di sngar gyi dug sel ma dang gnad gcig go/ /'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi gsum pa yum gyi skor ro/ /lus kyi dbyibs mdzes pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs / paṇa ḍi ta pradzha warma dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ seng ge sgra'i rgyud/ paṇa ḍi ta pradzñā ka ra dang / lots+tsha ba 'gos khug pa lhas btsas kyi 'gyur / spyan ras gzigs seng ge sgra'i gzungs/ rje btsun ma rdo rje sems ma dang / lots+tsha ba 'gar shes rab 'byung nas kyi 'gyur/ seng ge sgras dam bcas pa'i gzungs/ paṇa ḍi ta ngag gi dbang phyug dang / lots+tsha ba klog skya shes rab brtsegs kyis bsgyur ba/ snying rjes mi bshol ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/gsum pa rigs kyi yum gyi rgyud ni/ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / lo chen ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad gsar chad kyis bcos pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yum sgrol ma las sna tshogs 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i rgyud le'u sum cu so lnga pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dharmā shrī mi tra dang / lots+tsha ba chos kyi bzang po'i 'gyur/'di bya rgyud yang dag yin min brtag go/ /de'i nang nas phyung ba'i phyag 'tshal nyi shu rtsa gcig ma ni rgyud de nyid du gtogs so/ /rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ yang lha mo sgrol ma'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa sgrol ma mchog ces bya ba'i gzungs dang bcas pa/ 'phags ma sgrol ma'i gzungs/ sgrol ma rang gi dam bcas pa'i gzungs/ sgrol ma 'jigs pa brgyad las skyob pa'i mdo rnams so/ /'jigs pa brgyad las sgrol ba'i gzungs shu log bcu/ 'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi dang po gtso bo'i skor yin no//bzhi pa rigs kyi khro bo khro mo'i rgyud ni ma dpe'i dbang gis gong du song nas/105—426

lnga pa rigs kyi bka' nyan pho mo'i rgyud ni/ lha mo sgra dbyangs la bstod pa sngags dang bcas pa 'di rgyud yin min the tshom gyi gzhir byed/ lha mo dpal lung bstan pa'i mdo/ dpal chen mo'i mdo shu log bcu gnyis pa dang / dpal lha mo'i mtshan bcu gnyis pa shu log brgyad pa gnyis/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang /lots+tsha ba ye shes sdes bsgyur ba/gsum pa rdo rje'i rigs kyi rgyud la lnga/ rigs kyi gtso bo dang / rigs kyi bdag po dang / rigs kyi yum dang / rigs kyi khro bo khro mo dang / rigs kyi pho nya dang bka' nyan pho mo'i rgyud de/ dang po ni/ las kyi sgrib pa thams cad sbyong ba zhes bya ba mi 'khrugs pa'i gzungs/ 'di bla ma dag rdo rje'i rigs kyi gtso bor bzhed do//gnyis pa rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyud ni/ phyag na rdo rje rig pa mchog gi rgyud chen mo/ paṇa ḍi ta bibyā ka ra pra bha dang / lots+tsha ba ban de dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs/ 'di'ang cung ma rdzogs pa 'dra'o// //tsha ba la/ rdo rje sa 'og gi rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba le'u nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/paṇa ḍi ta bde bar gshegs pa'i dpal dang / chos rje sa skya lots+tsha ba'i 'gyur/phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed kyi rgyud stong phrag bcu drug pa las/ ji snyed pa rim par phye ba gnyis pa/ paṇa ḍi ta bud dha ka ra warma dang / lots+tsha ba chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ lag na rdo rje'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gsang sngags dang bcas pa/ 'di rig pa mchog gam gzhan gcig nas phyung ba 'dra'o/ /lag na rdo rje'i snying po brgyad kyi ya kyal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba shu log sum cu rtsa lnga/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / lo chen ye shes sde'i 185—427

—————————— ——————— ————wa wa'agyur / de'i bshad rgyud rdo rje ri rab chen po'i rtse mo'i khang pa brtsegs pa'i gzungs shu log bdun brgya/ paṇa ḍi ta shī len dra bo dhi dang / dzha na si dhī dang / lots+tsha ba chen po ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad gsar chad kyis bcos pa/gsum pa rigs kyi yum gyi rgyud ni/ rdo rje mi pham pa me ltar rab tu rmongs byed shu log bdun cu/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shrī la dang / lots+tsha ba ye she/ sde'i 'gyur/ 'di phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud nas yum du bshaX zhi /pa/ rigs kyi khro bo khro mo'i rgyud ni/ rdo rje phra mo thogs pa med pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'di sngags rnam 'joms kyi snying po dang gcig te/ khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa sgom par bshad pas rigs kyi khro bo yin no/ /lag na rdo rje'i bcu'i snying po shu log nyi shu rtsa gsum pa/ lo paṇa snga mar bshad pa dang 'dra/'di phyag rdor gyi rigs dang khro bo yin rgyu med kyang / lag na rdo rje'i ming 'thun pa tsam mo zhes 'dod do//lnga pa rigs kyi pho nya dang bka' nyan pho mo'i rgyud ni/ rdo rje mchu zhes bya ba klu'i dam tshig bam po gnyis/ rdo rje gnam lcags mchu zhes bya ba'i gzungs/lcags mchu'i gzungs gnyis/ lcags mchu nag po'i gzungs/ 'phags pa stobs po che zhes bya ba'i mdo shu log nyis brgya lnga bcu/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi gzungs paṇa ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang / lots+tsha ba skyo 'od 'byung gi 'gyur/'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi lnga pa khro bo khro mo'i skor ro/ /bdud rtsi thab sbyor gyi snying po bzhi pa shu log bzhi bcu/ 'di gsum pa rdo rje'i rigs kyi rgyud kyi khro bo khro mo'i khongs su gtogs shing / gzhan zhig nas phyung bar snang ngo / /khro 185—428

wa wa wa —————wa ———————————————————————— —bo'i rgyal po me brtsegs la bstod pa sngags dang bcas pa/ 'di rgyud yin min brtag go/ /bgegs sel ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs shu log bcu/ 'di de bzhin /she/ros pa'i rigs su gtogs pa'i brgyad pa gnas gtsang ma'i lha la sogs pa'i ra bzhi// pa nor can gyi rigs kyi rgyud ni/ nor bu bzang po'i gzungs shu log bcwa lnga/ paṇa ḍi ta birgyu ka ra sing ha dang / lots+tsha ba klu'i dbang po'i 'gyur/nor bu bzang po'i rtog pa/ paṇa ḍi ta mañdzu shrī dang / lots+tsha ba ba ri'i'agyur/gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon gar mkhan mchog gi brtag pa/ 'dir cung ma tshang ba 'dra / gzhan du brtag pa snga phyi gnyis rab zhi bshes gnyen gyi 'gyur/ zhes chad pa cig bstan nam sems so/ /gnod 'dzin dpal zhes bya ba'i gzungs/'phags pa gnod gnas kyi dbang po ji ltar 'byung ba'i rtog pa zhes bya ba/paṇa ḍi ta sgeg pa'i rdo rje dang / lots+tsha ba rwa rdo rje grags kyi 'gyur/lnga pa lnga rtsen gyi rigs kyi rgyud ni/ me kha la zhes bya ba'i gzungs shu log nyis brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga/ paṇa ḍi ta pradzñā warma dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/drug pa 'jig rten pa'i rigs kyi rgyud ni rig sngags kyi rgyal po dbugs chen po gong du song ngo //de ltar bya ba'i rigs so so'i rgyud rnams bkod nas/ gnyis pa rigs thams cad kyi spyi'i rgyud ni/ gsang sngags kyi spyod pa thams cad spyir ston pa dpung bzangs kyis zhus pa'i rgyud le'u bcu gcig pa/ 'jug pa'i spyod pa dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba ston pa'i gsang ba spyi rgyud/ ting nge 'dzin gyi spyod pa khyad par du ston pa bsam gtan phyi ma'i rgyud/ sgrub pa'i spyod pa legs 105—429

par ston pa legs par grub pa'i rgyud do/ /mjug na dgongs pa'i rgyud kyi phreng ba chen po byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par nges pa chen po bstan pa las nor bu rin po che la mkhas pa bstan pa yongs su bsngo ba chen po'i rgyal po/ paṇa ḍi ta dharmā ka ra dang / lots+tsha ba dpal 'byor gyis bsgyur ba las/ paṇa ḍi ta bisto ka ra pra bha ba dang / lots+tsha ba dpal brtsegs kyis bcos/ yongs su bsngo ba'i rgyal po sngags dang bcas pa ji snyed pa/ 'gyur byang gong dang 'dra ba rnams bzhugs / yang rgyud dngos ma yin yang sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams kyi rgyud 'bum rnams kyi zhabs su skabs su bab nas bris pa ni/ legs par grub pa las 'byung ba'i smon lam/ yid bzhin nor bu'i rtog pa las 'byung ba/ stong chen rab 'joms dang / rma bya chen mo las 'byung ba/ sbyin pa'i rabs las byung ba rnams kyi smon lam/ yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa/ lhas zhus pa/bde legs su 'gyur ba rnams kyi bde legs kyi tshigs bcad/ lhas zhus pa/yo ga las 'byung ba'i lha sum cu rtsa bdun/ sangs rgyas rabs bdun/ rigs lnga / rigs gsum/ dkon mchog gsum/ yang rigs gsum/ dkon mchog dang mdzad pa bcu gnyis rnams kyi bkra shis/ paṇa ḍi dzi na mi tra dang /lots+tsha ba ye shes sdes bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag des pa la gsungs pa'i bkra shis rnams bzhugs/ sngar gyi rgyud 'bum rnams su rgyud sde so so'i rigs ma phyed par 'chol bar song ba rnams/ phyi rabs kyi skye bos rtogs par sla ba'i don du/ sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams kyis rgyud so so'i rnam gzhag mdzad pa'i dkar chag dang / mkhas pa'i dbang phyug bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa'i rgyud sde spyi'i rnam par gzhag pa la brten nas de dag dang 185—430

—wa —————————————————— —— — —mthun par bkod do/ /tshul 'di yang rab dbang po'i theg pa ste/ /bdag ni blo dman sbyangs pa zhan pa'i mthus/ /'di la 'khrul zhing nongs pa'i tshogs mchis na/ /bla ma rnams dang mkha' 'gros bzod par gsol/ /de ltar bya ba'i rgyud sum brgya dang gcig bzhugs so/ /thub pa'i gsung rab 'gyur ro cog ṭ+wāṃ //shā chag legs bshad nyi ma'i 'od zer las/ bya ba'i rgyud kyi skabs te lnga pa/ gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi dbye ba bstan pa la don rnam pa dgu/a ti yo ga'i dang / a nu yo ga'i dang / ma hā yo ga'i dang / yo ga'i dang /u pa'i dang / tri ya'i dang / byang sems kyi dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi dang /nyan thos kyi theg pa'o//dang po a ti yo ga'i theg pa ni/ dza pa la/ chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po rtsa ba'i rgyud mdo lung lnga bcu rtsa bdun pa/paṇa ḍi ta shrī sing ha pra bha ba dang / lots+tsha ba chen po be+e ro tsa nas bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa/ rgyud phyi ma mdo lung bcu gnyis pa/ phyi ma'i phyi ma mdo lung brtswa lnga pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dpal gyi seng ge mgon po dang / lots+tsha ba bai ro tsa nas bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa rnams dril bas mdo lung brgyad cu rtsa bzhi rdzogs pa/gnyis pa a nu yo ga'i theg pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa 'dus pa'i mdo/ bam po bcu dang le'u bdun cu rtsa lnga pa/ byung tshul bcu gnyis shu log nyis brgya dang lnga bcu rtsa gnyis 185wa 431

pa / paṇa ḍi ta dharmā bo dhi dang / dā na ra k+ṣi ta dang lots+tsha ba che btsan skyes kyi bru' sha'i yi ge las bru' sha'i yul gyi khrom du bsgyur ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba gsang ba'i mdzod chen po/ mi zad pa gter gyi sgron ma brtul zhugs chen po grub pa'i rgyud/ ye shes rngam pa glog gi 'khor lo'i le'u bcu drug pa dang / de'i gsang ba phyi ma'i le'u bcu bdun pa gnyis/ paṇa ḍi ta badz+ra bi shwa mi tra dang / lots+tsha ba bai ro tsa na rak+ṣi tas bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs/wa pa la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po'i khro bo rdo rje'i rigs kun 'dus rigs pa'i mdo rnal 'byor rig pa'i rgyud ces bya ba'i mdo le'u sum cu rtsa gsum pa/ sems dang ye shes rang snang du ston pa rtsa ba'i rgyud/ dpal gsang ba'i snying po'i de kho na nyid rnam par nges pa le'u nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa dang / bshad pa'i rgyud rdo rje sems dpa'i sgyu 'phrul dra ba gsang ba thams cad kyi me long zhes bya ba'i rgyud le'u bcu gsum pa dang gnyis paṇa ḍi ta bi ma la mi dra dang / lots+tsha ba dzñā na ku mā ras bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa/ ye shes mthar phyin par ston pa gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa sgyu 'phrul brgyad cu pa/ thabs kyi zhags pa pad mo'i phreng ba le'u bzhi bcu rtsa gcig pa rnams bzhugs/ zha pa la/ rol pa mngon par brjod pa lha mo sgyu 'phrul dra ba chen mo le'u bcu gsum pa/ gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa'i sgyu 'phrul bla ma chen po le'u bcu gsum pa rnams so//gsum pa ma hā yo ga ni/ gsang sngags sgrub pa bka' brgyad la/ dang po 'jam dpal sku'i rgyud la/ 'jam dpal las bzhi'i 'khor lo rtsa ba'i rgyud le'u bcu gsum pa/ rgyud phyi ma'i rim par bkod pa le'u bcu bzhi pa/ gnyis pa 185—432

pad ma gsung gi rgyud la/ rta mchog rol pa'i rgyud le'u sum cu pa/ gsum pa yang dag thugs kyi rgyud la/ snying rje rol pa'i rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa/ lots+tsha ba bal po shrī ki rtis bsgyur cing skad gsar chad kyis bcos pa/ gsar ma'i rgyud 'bum rnams su snga rabs rnams kyis bris mos kyi/ 'di rnying ma'i yang dag thugs kyi rgyud du 'dus pas 'dir bzhugs so/ /bzhi pa bdud rtsi yon tan gyi rgyud la/ thams cad bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin dngos grub chen po nye ba'i snying po mchog bam po chen po brgyad pa/ paṇa ḍi ta bi ma la mi tra dang / lots+tsha ba dzñā na ku ma ras bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa/ lnga pa phur pa phrin las kyi rgyud la/phur pa rtsa ba'i rgyud dum bu/ slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas kyis bsgyur ba/drug pa ma mo rbod gtong gi rgyud la/ mkha' 'gro ma me lce 'bar ba'i rgyud le'u nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa 'gyur byang snga ma dang 'dra/ bdun pa dmod pa drag sngags kyi rgyud la/ drag sngags 'dus pa'i rtsa ba'i rgyud le'u bcu gcig pa dang / brgyad pa 'jig rten mchod bstod kyi rgyud la/ 'jig rten mchod bstod sgrub pa rtsa ba'i rgyud le'u bcu gcig pa/ de gnyis slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas dang /lots+tsha ba bai ro tsa nas gtan la phab pa rnams bzhugs/bzhi pa yo ga'i theg pa ni/ thun mong gi gnas sum bcu rtsa gsum dang /khyad par gnas 'og min chen por/ bcom ldan 'das longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dpal rnam par snang mdzad kyis yo ga gzhung chen po dang / yo ga lung sems dpa' gnyis la sogs pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba rnams su 'dod la/lnga pa u pa'i theg pa ni/ brtson 'grus mngon par grub pa'i rgyud la sogs pa spyod rgyud rnams su 'dod do//185—433

drug pa tri ya'i theg pa ni/ tri ya dpung bzang gi rgyud la sogs pa bya rgyud rnams su 'dod do//bdun pa byang sems kyi theg pa ni/ rgyal po'i khab dang / pad ma dam can la sogs par mtshan nyid med pa dang nges pa don gyi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba rnams su 'dod la/brgyad pa rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa ni/ yul ma hā dha ru la sogs par rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba rnams su 'dod cing /dgu pa nyan thos kyi theg pa ni/ sprul pa'i sku shākya thub pas/ yul bā rā ṇa sī drang srong lhung ba'i nags la sogs par bden bzhi'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba rnams su 'dod ces grags go/ /go rims ni mtho shos nas rim par bkod pa yin no/ /de ltar snga 'gyur gyi rgyud nyi shu rtsa gnyis bzhugs so/ /lots+tsha ba rin chen bzang po dang / 'gos khug pa lha btsas la sogs pas snga 'gyur rnams sngags yang dag ma yin par 'dod la/ rig ral la sogs pa'i mkhas pa dag bsam yas nas rgya dpe rnyed pa'i phyir dang / phur pa rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi dum bu'i rgya dpe bal por yang snang bas yang dag yin gsungs so/ /kho bo ni/'phags pa rnams kyis dpyad par bya ba'i gnas la/ so so'i skye bos bsgrod par dka' bas/ mkhas pa'i gsung las/ yid kyi nyes pa rang bzhin 'dug pa ste//mi rigs pa'i gzugs la'ang mi rigs na/ /the tshom za ba'i chos la smos ci dgos / /de phyir btang snyoms bzhag la nyes pa med/ /ces 'byung ba ltar ro/ /yang na gang zhig su dag gang las thar 'dod pa/ /sku gzugs glegs bam skye bo thams cad la'ang / /ston dang ston thabs ston pa'i rgyu'o zhes/ /kun la ston 185—434

pa bzhin du gus par bya/ /zhes 'byung ba bzhin yin no/ /thub pa'i gsung rab 'gyur ro cog gi dkar chag legs bshad nyi ma'i 'od zer las/ gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi skabs te lnga pa'o// //drug pa gnas skabs su nyer mkho'i dbye ba bstan pa ni/ za pa la/gsang sngags rgyud sde bzhi'i gzungs dang snying po byin rlabs can rnams phyogs gcig tu rin po che bu ston pas bkod pa/ stod na bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan 'bum mang po dang bcas pa rnams bzhugs// //'a pa la/ spyan 'dren rgyud gsum pa/ dkon mchog ta la la'i gzungs/ye shes ta la la'i gzungs/ tshe dpag med kyi mdo/ de'i gzungs 'chi med rnga sgra'i mdo/ yon tan bsngags pa dpag tu med pa'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas bdun pa/ sangs rgyas bcu gnyis pa/ sangs rgyas kyi snying po/ sangs rgyas kyi snying po'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas kyi yan lag dang ldan pa/ tsan dan gyi yan lag sgrol ma mchog /dbang bskur ba/ shākya thub pa'i snying po/ rnam par snang mdzad/ sman bla/ rgyal ba'i bla ma/ snang ba mtha' yas/ 'od dpag med mthong bar 'gyur ba'i/ pad ma'i spyan gyi/ snang ba mtha' yas rjes su dran pa'i/ zla 'od kyi mtshan rjes su dran pa'i/ de bzhin gshegs pa bcu'i snying po rjes su dran pa'i/ rin chen gtsug tor can gyi mtshan rjes su dran pa/dri ma med pa'i/ khyad par can zhes bya ba rnams kyi gzungs/ sangs rgyas kyi/spyan ras gzigs/ byams pa/ nam mkha'i snying po/ kun tu bzang po/lag na rdo rje/ 'jam dpal/ sgrib pa rnam sel/ sa'i snying po rnams kyi 185—435

mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa/ dkyil 'khor brgyad pa zhes bya ba'i mdo/ gsang ba ring bsrel gyi za ma tog /mthar phyin par grub pa'i mchod rten/ nor bu rgyas pa'i gzhal med khang / me tog brtsegs pa/sa'i dbang po rnams kyi gzungs/ 'phags pa gzungs chen po/ bde ldan gyi snying po/ byams pas dam bcas pa'i/ sgrib pa rnam par sel ba'i 'jam dpal gyi zhal nas gsungs pa'i/ 'jam dpal gyi dmod btsugs pa rnams kyi gzungs / 'jam dpal gyi mtshan de'i shes rab blo 'phel gyi gzungs/ 'jam dpal gyi yi ge 'bru gcig pa'i/ spyan ras gzigs kyi skor la/ phyag stong spyan stong thogs pa mi mnga' ba'i gzungs/ yid bzhin 'khor lo'i snying po/ zhal bcu gcig pa'i gzungs/ mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ don zhags kyi snying po/sa bcu pa'i gzungs/ don zhags kyi phar phyin drug rdzogs pa'i gzungs/ kun du bzang po/ nī la kuṇa ṭha'i/ ha ya gri ba'i/ me kha la'i/ snying rjes mi bshol ba'i/ spyan ras gzigs kyi yum zhes bya ba'i/ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gzungs/ de'i snying po/ seng ge sgras dam bcas pa'i/ snying rje mchog /sgo mtha' yas pa/ sgo bzang po/ sgo drug pa zhes bya ba rnams kyi gzungs / yi ge drug pa'i rigs sngags tshigs su bcad pa gnyis pa'i/ lus kyi dbyibs mdzes pa/ byang chub rgyan 'bum/ mchod rten gcig btab na bye ba btab par 'gyur ba'i/ gtsug gi nor bu/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan/gser can/ thams cad la mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa/ bar gcod rnam par sbyong ba rnams kyi gzungs/ 'gro lding ba'i rig sngags kyi rgyal po/ gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa zhes bya ba/ gzhan gyis mi thub pa rin po che'i 185—436

phreng ba/ stong 'gyur ba dang / 'jigs pa brgyad las sgrol ba dang / sher phyin stong phrag brgya pa rnams kyi gzungs/ stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa dang / brgyad stong pa gnyis gzung bar 'gyur ba'i gzungs re re/ phar phyin drug gi snying po'i gzungs / de bzung bar 'gyur ba'i gzungs/ par phyin bcu dang / tshad med bzhi thob par 'gyur ba'i gzungs re re/ stong phrag brgya pa dang / phal chen sdong po bkod pa/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal po/ rma bya chen po/ so so 'brang ma rnams gzung bar 'gyur ba'i gzungs/ lang kur gshegs pa'i mdo/thams cad klags par 'gyur ba'i gzungs sngags rnams bzhugs// //ya pa la/ rdo rje ri rab chen po'i rtse mo'i khang pa brtsegs pa/ stobs po che/lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi cho ga /rnam 'joms/ lag na rdo rje'i mtshan brgyad pa sngags dang bcas pa/ lag na rdo rje bcu'i snying po/ lag na rdo rjes rmi lam bstan pa'i/ phyag rdor gnod sbyin bdag po/ rdo rje mi pham pa me ltar rab tu rmongs byed/ rdo rje phra mo thogs pa med pa'i/ rdo rje 'jigs byed/bdud rtsi thab sbyor gyi snying po bzhi pa/ be con chen po/ bgegs sel ba/phyir bzlog pa stobs can/ mi rgod rnam par 'joms pa/ gtsug tor 'bar ba / mi g.yo ba/ rdo rje mchu zhes bya ba klu'i dam tshig /gnam lcags mchu/lcags mchu nag po/ mdangs phyir 'phrog pa/ phyir bzlog pa rnam par rgyal ba can / dbugs chen po/ nor bu bzang po/ gnod 'dzin chu dbang snying rje can / gnod 'dzin gyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ gnod 'dzin dpal zhes bya ba / 'phags pa mtshan mo bzang po/ chos kyi rgya mtsho/ bu mang po rton pa/gdon mi za ba/ gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i rig pa chen mo/ rten 'brel gyi snying 105—437

po'i cho ga /rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba/ rten 'brel gyi snying po/ 'od zer dri med rnam par dag pa'i 'od/ gtsug tor dri med snang ba/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal/ gtsug tor gdugs dkar lha yul ma/ gdugs dkar mi yul ma/gtsug tor nag mor grags pa rol pa'i tan tra/ 'od zer can/ skul byed ma de rnams kyi gzungs/ dug sel zhes bya ba'i rigs sngags/ dbyig dang ldan pa zhes bya ba/ grags ldan ma/ sor mo can/ par+ṇa sha ba ri/ ri khrod lo ma gyon / chos thams cad kyi yum/ gza' yum che chung gnyis/ lha mo brgyad/sgrol ma mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ sgrol ma/ sgrol ma rang gi dam bcas pa/rgyal ba can de'i gzungs/ dpal chen mo/ dpal gyi lha mo'i mtshan bcu gnyis pa/ nor rgyun ma/ mig rnam par sbyong ba/ las kyi sgrib pa rnam par sbyong ba/ bar du gcod pa thams cad sel ba/ yon yongs su sbyong ba gnyis/ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba/ nad zhi ba gnyis/ rims nad zhi ba gnyis / mig nad zhi ba/ 'brum nad zhi ba/ gzhang 'brum zhi ba/ ma zhu ba 'byang ba/ sdang ba zhi ba/ sdig pa zhi ba/ sdug bsngal zhi ba/ khro ba zhi ba/khros pa zhi ba/ tshig btsan pa/ bdag bsrung ba/ don thams cad 'grub pa/las grub pa/ gos brgya thob pa/ mi dga' bar byed pa/ yid du 'ong ba/'grin pa snyan pa/ bcings pa grol ba/ mchog thob pa/ shes rab bskyed pa'i gsum/ thos pa 'dzin pa gnyis/ nyin rer shu log brgya lobs pa gnyis/stong lobs pa gsum/ shu log sum stong lobs pa rnams kyi gzungs/ mi brjed pa/ phyag bya ba/ rims dang srog chags kyis mi tshugs pa/ dug zhi bar byed pa/ mdangs phyir mi 'phrog pa/ bdud skrag par byed pa/ rma 185—438

'byor bar byed pa/ me'i zug rngu zhi bar byed pa/ 'khris pa sel ba bad kun sel ba/ k+ṣa ya'i nad sel ba rnams kyi gzungs/ stong chen mo nas phyung ba sman la sngags kyis gdab pa/ sman bla las phyung ba sman la sngags gdab pa/skran zhi ba'i gzungs/ kun tu rgyu ba dang kun tu rgyu ma yin pa dang 'thun pa'i mdo / mdo chen po 'dus pa/ sprin chen po/ stong phrag brgya pa las char dbab pa rlung gi dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba'i le'u drug cu rtsa bzhi pa/ cho ga dang bcas pa/ sprin chen po rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi le'u/ klu'i rgyal po gzi can gyis zhus pa/ sdong po rgyan gyi mchog /snang brgyad/ mchod pa'i sprin/ phyag stong dang mchod pa'i sprin 'byung ba/ rin po che bdar ba/ bskor ba'i gnyis/ye shes skar mda'/ su rū pa/ yi dgas kha 'bar ma/ dbugs dbyung ba'i gtor chog /yi dgas kha nas me 'bar ba la skyabs mdzad pa/ 'jur 'gegs / lus kyi zag pa rnams sbyin par gtang ba/ ro langs bdun pa/tshogs bdag gi snying po/ dpal mgon nag po/ nag po'i chen po'i gzungs/rims nad thams cad las thar bar byed pa/ lha mo nag mo chen mo rnams kyi gzungs / lha mo nag mo'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ dpal lha mo la brgya byin gyis bstod pa/ nad kyi bdag mo la bstod pa/ nam gru la bstod pa/ lha mo sgra dbyangs la bstod pa/ yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa'i mdo/ spyan ras gzigs yid bzhin nor bu'i rtog pa las 'byung ba'i smon lam/ bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam/ byams pa/ mchog gi spyod pa/ stong chen rab 'joms las 'byung ba/ rma bya chen mo las 'byung ba rnams kyi smon lam/ lhas zhus pa'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ lhas zhus pa'i bde legs kyi tshigs su bcad 185—439

pa / bde legs su 'gyur ba'i tshigs su bcad pa/ dkon mchog gsum dang /mdzad pa bcu gnyis dang / sangs rgyas rabs bdun dang / de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa rnams dang / rigs gsum gyi bkra shis rgya rol gyi ga gon dang bzang po'i le'u las 'byung ba dang / des pa la gsungs pa'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa rnams bzhugs/ de ltar gzungs dngos dang dngos ma yin pa mdo sde nas phyung ba'i bden tshig /smon lam/bkra shis rnams kyi dge ba dang bkra shis 'phel ba'i phyir dpe snga ma bzhin bkod do / /snang brgyad sdong po rgyan gtsug tor nag mo rnams bka' yin min the tsom za zhes kha cig 'dod na'ang / gdul bya'i ngor klog dgos pa'i ched du ma dpe ltar bris so/ /de rnams kyi 'gyur byang dang bcas pa gong du bstan pa las shes par bya'o/ /de ltar gnas skabs su nye mkho'i gzungs dang snying po de snying la sogs dril bas nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa dgu bzhugs so/ /thub pa'i gsung rab 'gyur ro cog gi dkar chag legs bshad nyi ma'i 'od zer las/ gnas skabs su nyer mkho'i rgyud kyi skabs te drug pa'o// //gnyis pa mtshan nyid rgyu'i theg par mdo'i dbye ba rnam par bzhag pa gsum/bka' bar pa mtshan nyid med pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i rim pa dang /bka' 'khor lo'i gsum pa/ don dam pa rnam par nges pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i rim pa dang / bka' 'khor lo dang po bden pa bzhi'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i rim pa rnam par bzhag pa'o// //de yang sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams kyis dkar chag snga ma rnams su/ theg pa che 105—440

wa wa wa wa ———————— — — — — —chung gi mdo sde rnams phyogs gcig tu bya ba'i phyir/ bka' bar pa nas thog mar bkod pa'i lugs bzhin de dag gi rjes su 'brangs nas/ dang po bka' baX pa mtshan nyid med pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i rim pa rnam par bzhag pa dka/ pa nas pha pa'i bar la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/bam po sum brgya dang / le'u bdun cu rtsa gnyis bzhugs so/ /'di la nyang khams pa go cha/ be+e ro tsa na/ lce khyi 'brug /zhang ye shes sde la sogs pa'i 'gyur byang drug yod par grags so/ /yang ka pa'i sde tshan bzhi la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa bam po bdun cu rtsa brgyad dang / le'u bdun cu rtsa drug bzhugs so// //yang ka pa dang kha pa dang ga pa'i stod yan chad la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa khri brgyad stong pa/ bam po drug cu dang / le'u brgyad cu rtsa bdun pa lots+tsha ba ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur ba bzhugs/ga pa'i smad dang / nga pa la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa khri pa/ bam po sum cu rtsa bzhi dang / le'u sum cu rtsa gsum pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang /pradzñā waṅgā dang / lots+tsha ba chen po ye shes sdes bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa rnams bzhugs / / //yang ka pa la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad stong pa bam po nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang / le'u sum cu rtsa gnyis pa/ lots+tsha ba rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba las / paṇa ḍi ta dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang / lots+tsha ba 'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyis bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa las/ slad kyis lots+tsha ba chen po rngog blo 185—441

ldan shes rab kyis legs par bcos shing gtan la phab pa bzhugs// //yang ka pa la/ sdud pa tshigs su bcad pa bam po gcig dang / shu log nyis brgya paṇa ḍi ta bit+yā ka ra sing ha dang / lots+tsha ba dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rab kyi rtsal gyis rnam par gnon pas zhus pa/ bam po bdun dang / shu log drug cu pa/ le'u bdun pa/paṇa ḍi ta shī len dra bo dhi dang / dzi na mi tra dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad gsar chad kyis bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ dkar chag snga ma dag la bam grangs 'di bzhin byung zhing / chos la bam po drug pa ste tha ma bya ba 'dug shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bdun brgya pa/ skad gsar chad kyis bcos pa/ 'di dkon mchog brtsegs pa'i 'dus pa bzhi bcu rtsa drug pa phyung ba yin / shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa lnga brgya pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa rdo rje bcod pa bam po gcig pa dang gnyis skad gsar chad kyis bcos pa/shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa lnga bcu pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa yi ge gcig ma/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyi ma'i snying po/ sher phyin zla ba'i snying po/ sher phyin kun du bzang po/ sher phyin lag na rdo rje/ sher phyin rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi mdo rnams te/ chos kyi rnam grangs bcu bdun bzhugs so/ /sher phyin brgya lnga bcu pa la sogs pa kha cig /rgya gar gyi mkhas grub rnams kyis rgyud du mdzad nas 'grel pa dang dbang chog gsal ka yod pa rnams 'dir yang rgyud na bzhugs so//thub pa'i gsung rab 'gyur ro cog gi dkar chag legs bshad nyi ma'i 'od zer las/ bka' 'khor lo bar pa mtshan nyid med pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor 185—442

——————————ba'i rim pa rnams rnam par bzhag pa'i skabs te bdun pa'o// //'dir shes rab sna tshogs kyi spod kha slong ba'i phyir/ mdo gsar du 'gyur ba kha cig bzhugs pa ni/ chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor ba'i mdo/ skyes pa rabs kyi gleng gzhi/ lcang lo can gyi pho brang gi mdo/ 'dus pa chen po'i mdo/byams pa'i mdo/ byams pa sgom pa'i mdo/ bslab pa lnga'i phan yon gyi mdo/ri'i kun dga' bo'i mdo/ klu'i rgyal po dga' bo nye dga' 'dul ba'i mdo/'od srung chen po'i mdo/ nyi ma'i mdo/ zla ba'i mdo/ bkra shis chen po'i mdo rnams bzhugs bcu gsum po 'di/ paṇa ḍi ta a nan da shī dang / lots+tsha ba nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos gsar du bsgyur ba yin cing / sngar gyi mdo rnams dang zlos mi zlos dang / bka' 'khor lo rim gsum gang du gtogs pa blo dang ldan pa rnams kyis dpyad par bya'o// //de ltar bka' bar pa'i bka' rnams bkod nas/ gnyis pa bka' 'khor lo gsum pa don dam rnam par nges pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i rim pa rnam par bzhag pa la/ka pa nas cha pa'i bar drug la/ sangs rgyas phal po che dang / byang chub sems dpa' bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdzad pa dang / zhing khams dang /'khor dang 'jig rten gyis khams kyi bkod pa dang / zab pa dang rgya che ba'i don mtha' dang dbus med par ston pa sangs rgyas phal po che'i 'jig rten gyi dbang po thams cad kyi rgyan gyi le'u nas/ sdong pos brgyan pa'i le'u yan chad la bam po brgya dang bcwa lnga yan chad dang / le'u bzhi bcu rtsa lnga dang / kun 185—443

du bzang po'i smon lam yan chad bzhugs pa la/ phal che'i le'ur gtogs pa la bam po bcu bzhi dang / le'u bcu gcig pa yan chad/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi bsngo ba'i le'ur gtogs pa la bam po sum bcu dang / le'u sum bcu pa yan chad / sa bcu pa'i le'ur gtogs pa la bam po dgu dang / le'u so gcig pa yan chad/ kun du bzang po'i spyod pa bstan pa'i le'ur gtogs pa la bam po bcu drug dang / le'u zhe gnyis pa yan chad/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i skye ba 'byung ba bstan pa'i le'ur gtogs pa la bam po lnga dang / le'u zhe gsum pa yan chad/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i le'ur gtogs pa la bam po bcu gcig dang / le'u zhe bzhi pa yan chad/ sdong pos brgyan pa'i le'ur gtogs pa la bam po sum cu dang / le'ur bzhi bcu rtsa lnga pa/ nor bzangs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsnyen bkur ba'i spyod pa phyogs gcig pa dang / kun du bzang po'i smon lam yan chad ji snyed pa rnams/ paṇa ḍi ta su ren dra bo dhi dang /lots+tsha ba chen po ban dhe bai ro tsa na rak+ṣi tas zhus te gtan la phab pa rnams rdzogs par bzhugs/ 'di la shin tu rgyas pa'i sde snod dang / snyan gyi gong rgyan dang /pad ma'i rgyan dang / shin tu rgyas pa'i mdo 'chad do// //yang ka pa nas cha pa'i bar drug la/ 'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa chen po'i chos kyi rnam grangs le'u stong phrag brgya pa las/ le'u bzhi bcu rtsa dgu pa yan chad ji snyed pa bzhugs pa la/ ka pa la/ le'u dang po sdom pa gsum bstan pa bam po gsum/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi dang / su ren dra bo dhi dang /lots+tsha ba ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad gsar chad kyis gtan la phab pa le'u gnyis pa sgo mtha' yas pa rnam par sbyong ba bstan pa bam po bzhi pa/ paṇa ḍi ta 105—444

————wa wa wa ————— —————— — — —su rin dra bo dhi dang / lots+tsha ba dpal brtsegs rak+ṣi tas bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa/ le'u gsum pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa bam po bcu dang le'u nyer lnga pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / mu ni warma dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sdes bsgyur cing skad gsar chad kyis gtan la phab pa/ 'di la dkar chag snga ma dag las bam po bcu gcig dang shu lo ka nyis brgyar byas pa bam kha che chung yin nam brtag par bya'o/ /le'u bzhi pa rmi lam bstan pa bam po gsum pa/ le'u lnga pa 'od dpag med kyi zhing gi bkod pa bam po gsum pa/ 'di la bam po gnyis su byas pa'ang 'dug go/ /paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sdes bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs so// //kha pa la/ le'u drug pa mi 'khrugs pa'i zhing gi bkod pa bam po lnga dang le'u drug pa/ le'u bdun pa go cha'i bkod pa bstan pa bam po drug pa/ le'u brgyad pa chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin dbyer med par bstan pa bam po gnyis dang shu log lnga bcu pa/ le'u dgu pa chos bcu pa shu log lnga brgya pa/ le'u bcu pa kun nas sgo'i le'u zhes bya ba shu log nyis brgya drug cu pa rnams/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / su ren dra bo dhi dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sdes bsgyur ba/le'u bcu gcig pa 'od zer kun tu bkye ba bstan pa bam po lnga pa/ le'u bcu gnyis pa byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod bstan pa/ bam po nyi shu dang le'u bcu gcig pa las/ bam po gsum pa yan chad dang / le'u bzhi pa'i stod yan chad r+sha sdugasdu// de/'i/ 'phro rdzogs par bzhugs shing / paṇa ḍi ta ā tsar+ya su rin 185—445

dra dang / shī len dra dang / lots+tsha ba chos nyid tshul khrims kyis bsgyur cing skad gsar chad kyis bcos pa/ le'u bcu gsum pa dga' bo la mngal na gnas pa bstan pa bam po gsum pa/ 'di la'ang dkar chag snga ma la lar bam po gnyis su byas 'dug /le'u bcu bzhi pa dga' bo la mngal du 'jug pa bstan pa bam po gcig pa/ le'u bcwa lnga pa/ 'jam dpal gyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi bkod pa bstan pa bam po phyed dang bzhi pa/ paṇa ḍi ta shī len dra bo dhi dang / dzi na mi tra dang / lots+tsha ba chen po ye shes sdes bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs// //nga pa la/ le'u bcu drug pa yab sras mjal ba bam po bcwa lnga dang / le'u nyer bdun pa/ paṇa ḍi ta shī len dra bo dhe dang / dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ le'u bcu bdun pa gang pos zhus pa bam po drug dang le'u brgyad pa/ le'u bcwa brgyad pa yul 'khor skyong gis zhus pa bam po gsum dang shu log brgya/ le'u gnyis pa/ lo paṇa snga ma dang 'dra ba'i steng du/ mu ne warma dang bcas pas bsgyur/ le'u bcu dgu pa khyim bdag drag shul can gyis zhus pa bam po phyed dang gsum pa/ paṇa ḍi ta su ren dra bo dhi dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sdes bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs// //ca pa la/ le'u nyi shu pa glog thob kyis zhus pa bam po gnyis pa/ le'u nyer gcig pa sgyu ma mkhan bzang po lung bstan pa bam po gcig dang shu log brgya sum cu pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / pradzñā lharmā dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur / le'u nyer gnyis pa cho 'phrul chen po bstan pa lha'i bu ded dpon gyis zhus pa bam po gsum pa/ le'u nyer gsum pa byams pa seng ge'i sgra chen po bstan pa bam po bzhi pa/ le'u nyer bzhi pa 'dul ba rnam par gtan la dbab 185—446

pa nye ba 'khor gyis zhus pa bam po gnyis/ le'u nyer lnga pa lhag pa'i bsam pa bskul ba bam po gnyis pa rnams/ lo paṇa sngar dang 'dra ba'i steng du su ren dra bo dhi dang bcas pas bsgyur/ le'u nyer drug pa lag bzangs kyis zhus pa bam po gnyis dang shu log brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ dha na shī la dang/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ le'u nyer bdun pa des pas zhus pa bam po gcig pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / su ren dra bo dhi dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ le'u nyer brgyad pa khyim bdag dpa' bas byin gyis zhus pa bam po gcig pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ le'u nyer dgu pa bad sa'i rgyal po 'char byed kyis zhus pa shu log nyis brgya pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / su ren dra bo dhi dang /lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ le'u sum cu pa bu mo blo gros bzang mos zhus pa bam po phyed pa/ 'gyur byang snga ma dang 'dra ba/ le'u so gcig pa gang gā'i mchog gis zhus pa shu log brgyad cu pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ le'u so gnyis pa mya ngan med kyis byin pa lung bstan pa bam po gcig pa/ le'u so gsum pa dri ma med kyis byin pas zhus pa lung bstan pa bam po phyed dang gnyis pa gnyis/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang /su ren dra bo dhi dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sdes bsgyur ba/ le'u so bzhi pa yon tan rin chen me tog kun du rgyas pas zhus pa shu log brgya bzhi bcu pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / pradzñā waṭ+wā dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ le'u so lnga pa sangs rgyas kyi yul bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa bam po gnyis pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / mu ni warma dang / ye shes sde'i 'gyur/185wa 447

le'u so drug pa lha'i bu blo gros rab gnas kyis zhus pa/ bam po bzhi pa'i bam po gnyis pa yan chad rnams bzhugs// //cha pa la/ bam po gsum pa nas bzhi pa yan chad/ lots+tsha ba klu'i rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ le'u so bdun pa seng shes zhus pa shu log drug cu pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dā na shī la dang / mu ne kharmā dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sdes bsgyur ba/le'u so brgyad pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang chen thabs la mkhas pa/ byang chub sems dpa' ye shes dam pas zhus pa bam po bzhi pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dā na shī dang / kurma warma dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sdes bsgyur ba/ le'u so dgu pa tshong dpon bzang skyong gis zhus pa/ bam po gnyis pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang /su rin dra bo dhi dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ le'u bzhi bcu pa bu mo rnam dag dad pas zhus pa bam po gcig pa/ 'di la dkar chag la lar bam po phyed du byas 'dug go/ /le'u zhe gcig pa byams pas zhus pa bam po gcig pa/lo paṇa snga ma dang 'dra'o/ /le'u zhe gnyis pa byams pas zhus pa chos brgyad pa/'di la dkar chag snga mar shu log bdun cu byas 'dug /la lar bam po gcig tu byas 'dug /paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ le'u zhe gsum pa 'od srung gis zhus pa bam po gsum pa/paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / shī len dra bo dhi dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/le'u zhe bzhi pa/ rin po che'i phung po lung bstan pa bam po gnyis dang shu log bdun cu pa dang le'u bdun pa/ le'u zhe lnga pa blo gros mi zad pas zhus pa shu log nyis brgya pa/ le'u zhe drug pa sher phyir bdun brgya pa bam po gnyis dang /shu log brgya pa rnams/ paṇa ḍi ta su ren dra bo dhi dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 185—448

'gyur / le'u zhe bdun pa gtsug na rin chen gyis zhus pa bam po gsum pa/paṇa ḍi ta ka ma shi la dang / lots+tsha ba chos nyid tshul khrims kyis bsgyur/ le'u zhe brgyad pa lha mo dpal phreng gi seng ge'i sgra bstan pa bam po gnyis pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / su ren dra bo dhi dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ le'u bzhi bcu rtsa dgu pa drang srong rgyas pas zhus pa bam po gnyis pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa'i 'dus pa bzhi bcu rtsa dgu pa yan chad tshang bar bzhugs so// //'dir 'khor lo gnyis pa'i chos skad mang zhing 'khor lo dang po snang yang /'dir 'khor lo gsum pa'i mdo sdebs pa ni sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams bzhed cing de'i rjes su 'brangs pa'o/ /phal chen dkon mchog brtsegs pa la theg chen gyi mdo lnga bcu tham pa bzhugs so// //theg pa chen po'i mdo sde sna tshogs kyi skor ni/ ka pa la/ bskal pa bzang po shu log bdun stong brgyad cu pa/ bam po nyi shu rtsa drug pa/ paṇa ḍi ta berā ka ra sing ha dang / lots+tsha ba dpal gyi dbyangs kyis bsgyur cing / lots+tsha ba ban dhe dpal brtsegs kyis zhus nas gtan la phab pa bzhugs// //kha pa la/ rgya cher rol pa bam po bcwa brgyad dang / le'u nyi shu bdun pa paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / mu ne warma dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ 'jam dpal rnam par rol pa bam po gnyis pa/ paṇa ḍi ta su rin dra bo dhi dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ 'jam dpal rnam par 'phrul pa'i le'u bam po gcig dang shu log dgu bcu rtsa bzhi pa/ paṇa ḍi ta shī len dra bo dhi dang / dzi na mi tra dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ de bzhin 105wa 449

gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs sems can la gzigs shing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi bkod pa kun du ston pa zhes bya ba bam po gnyis pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / su ren dra bo dhi dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde dang / lots+tsha ba klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis sgyur cing gtan la phab pa rnams bzhugs// //ga pa la/ bcom ldan 'das kyi ye shes rgyas pa'i mdo sde rin po che mtha' yas pa mthar phyin pa bam po nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ paṇa ḍi ta pradzñā warma dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes snying pos bsgyur ba las/ slad kyis paṇa ḍi ta bi shud dha sing ha dang /sarba dzñā de ba dang / lots+tsha ba ban dhe dpal brtsegs kyis zhus te gtan la phab pa/sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yul la 'jug pa ye shes snang ba'i rgyan/ bam po gsum dang / shu log lnga bcu pa/ paṇa ḍi ta su rin dra bo dhi dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sdes bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa rnams bzhugs// //nga pa la/ dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su 'dzin pa zhes bya ba bam po bcwa brgyad dang / le'u bcwa lnga pa/ paṇa ḍi ta pradzñā warma dang / lots+tsha ba ban dhe legs kyi sdes bsgyur ba las/ slad kyi paṇa ḍi ta pradzñā warma dang / dzñā na gar+bha dang /lots+tsha ba ye shes sdes bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa/ zung gi mdo bam po bzhi pa/paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/khye'u snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pas bstan pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs shu log gnyis brgya bdun cu pa/ paṇa ḍi ta su rin dra bo dhi dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan brjod pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs/ dkyil 'khor brgyad ces bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs shu log drug cu pa/ lots+tsha ba ye shes sdes bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs// //185—450

wa —— ——————— —— —— —ca pa la/ dgongs pa nges par 'grel pa bam po bzhi dang le'u bcu pa/lang kur gshegs pa ji snyed pa bam po dgu dang / le'u brgyad pa rgya gar las bsgyur ba/ lang kur gshegs pa rin po che'i mdo las sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi snying po'i le'u bam po brgyad pa/ lots+tsha ba 'gos chos grub kyi rgya'i slob dpon wen tī yis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa dang sbyar nas rgya las bsgyur ba/ ga ya gi rī mdo shu log brgya brgyad cu rtsa brgyad pa/ paṇa ḍi ta su ren dra bo dhi dang /lots+tsha ba ye shes sdes bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs// //cha pa la/ rgyan stug po bkod pa'i mdo ji snyed pa bam po bzhi dang le'u dgu pa / snying rje chen po pad ma dkar po bam po drug dang le'u bcu gsum pa/paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / shī len dra bo d+dha dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/snying rje pad ma dkar po bam po bcwa lnga pa dang le'u drug pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / su ren dra bo dhi dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sdes bsgyur ba rnams bzhuXs pa / / la/ // dam pa'i chos pad ma dkar po bam po bcu gsum pa dang le'u nyer bdun pa/ paṇa ḍi ta su ren dra bo dhi dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/chos thams cad kyi yon tan bkod pa'i rgyal po shu log bzhi brgya pa/ 'di'i ma dpe'i dkar chag tu grangs de bzhin du byung la/ bu ston pa'i chos 'byung du bam po drug tu byas 'dug pa de gnyis gang zhig yin dpyad par bya'o/ /bde ba can gyi bkod pa shu log sum cu pa/ 'di la'ang chos 'byung du brgya sum cu par byas 'dug /de gnyis paṇa ḍi ta pradzñā warma dang / su ren dra bo dhi dang /lots+tsha ba ye shes sdes bsgyur ba/ za ma tog bkod pa bam po phyed dang lnga le'u 785—451

————————wa wa————wa ——————————wa wa—————————————gnyis pa/ dkon mchog gi za ma tog bam po bzhi pa/ lots+tsha ba rin chen mtshos bsgyur cing skad gsar chad kyis gtan la phab pa/ rin po che'i mtha' shu log nyis brgya bcu pa/ paṇa ḍi ta pradzñā warma dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sdes bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs// //nya pa la/ mya ngan las 'das pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya nag las bsgyur ba bam po lnga bcu rtsa drug dang / le'u bcwa lnga pa las bam po nyer brgyad pa yan chad dang le'u dgu pa yan chad rnams bzhugs// //ta pa la/ de'i 'phro bam po lnga bcu rtsa drug pa yan chad dang / le'u bcwa lnga pa yan chad la mu stegs kyi rgyal po ba la shas gdung ma thob yan chad tshang bar bzhuXs pa / / la/ // yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po'i le'u khri lnga stong pa las lha dang mi la sogs pas zhus pa'i le'u bam po bcu gsum dang le'u lnga pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / dzñā na gar+bha dang / lots+tsha ba de ba tsan dras bsgyur ba/mya ngan las 'das pa'i mdo chung ba/ paṇa ḍi ta ka ma la gup+ta dang / lots+tsha ba rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ 'da' ka ye shes shu log bcu rgya las bsgyur bar dkar chag lhan dkar mar bris 'dug /sangs rgyas kyi mdzod kyi ye shes chos kyi yi ge bam po bzhi le'u bcu gcig pa rgya las bsgyur ba/ 'di dkar chag chen mo gsum du mdor mdzad/ kha cig the tshom gyi gzhir 'chad do/ /dkar chag la lar 'di la bam po lngar byas 'dug /dkon mchog 'byung gnas zhes bya ba'i mdo bam po bdun pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / su rin dra bo dhi dang /lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ gser gyi mdo dang / gser gyi bye ma lta'i bu mdo 185—452
