shu log brgyad cu pa/ paṇa ḍi ta su rin dra bo dhi dang / pradzñā warma dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sdes bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs// //da pa la/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin mnyam pa nyid rnam par spros pa ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po bam po bcwa lnga pa dang / le'u so dgu pa yan chad tshang ba / paṇa ḍi ta shī len dra bo dhi dang / lots+tsha ba chos nyid tshul khrims kyis bsgyur ba / chos nyid rang gi ngo bo stong pa nyid las mi g.yo bar tha dad par thams cad la snang ba'i mdo shu log dgu bcu pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dā na shī la dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ rab tu zhi ba rnam par nges pa'i cho 'phrul gyi ting nge 'dzin bam po gsum pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin bam po phyed dang gnyis pa/paṇa ḍi ta su ren dra bo dhi dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i ting nge 'dzin bam po gnyis dang / shu log drug cu pa 'gyur byang sngar dang 'dra ba/ dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin bam po lnga pa/ paṇa ḍi ta shākya pra bha dang / lots+tsha ba ban dhe rad na rak+ṣi tas bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs// //na pa la/ da ltar gyi sangs rgyas mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i ting nge 'dzin zhes bya ba bam po bdun dang le'u nyi shu rtsa drug pa/ paṇa ḍi ta shākya pra bha dang /lots+tsha ba ban dhe rad na rak+ṣi tas bsgyur ba/ bsod nams thams cad bsdus pa'i ting nge 'dzin ces bya ba/ bam po bzhi dang le'u gnyis pa/ paṇa ḍi ta pradzñā warma dang / shī len dra bo dhi dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin gyi chos kyi yi ge bam po gnyis dang le'u dgu rgya las bsgyur ba/ dkar 185—453

chag snga ma gnyis la bam po drug du bshad byung / khye'u bzhi'i ting nge 'dzin bam po gsum pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / pradzñā warma dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ ting nge 'dzin mchog dam pa bam po gcig pa/ 'dus pa rin po che tog gi gzungs bam po brgyad dang le'u bcu gsum pa/ paṇa ḍi ta shī len dra bo dhi dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ rdo rje snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs bam po gcig pa/ paṇa ḍi ta shī len dra bo dhi dang lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/sgo mtha' yas pa sgrub pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs shu log nyis brgya dang bcu pa/ sgo drug pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs shu log bcwa brgyad pa rnams bzhugs// //pa pa la/ rnam par mi rtog pa la 'jug pa'i gzungs shu log brgya nyi shu pa/paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / lots+tsha ba ska ba dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur ba/ tshigs su bcad pa gnyis pa'i gzungs/ gzungs kyi ming can 'di dag mdo yin te/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis/ sgo drug pa mdor bkral zhing / kā ma la shī las/ rnam par mi rtog par 'jug pa mdor bkral la / tog dang rdo rje snying po la sogs pa dkar chag chen mo dag las mdor bshad pa bzhin yin no/ /theg pa chen po la dad pa rab tu sgom pa bam po gnyis dang shu log dgu bcu le'u bzhi pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod yul gyi thabs kyi yul la rnam par 'phrul pa ston pa bam po lnga dang le'u bcu pa/ paṇa ḍi ta pradzñā warma dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying rje chen po nges par bstan pa'i mdo/ gzungs kyi dbang phyug rgyal pos zhus pa bam ngo bdun pa/ paṇa ḍi ta shī len dra bo dhi dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 105—454

'gyur / nam mkha' mdzod kyis zhus pa bam po brgyad pa/ paṇa ḍi ta pi tsa ya shī la dang / shī len dra bo dhi dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ byams pas zhus pa'i mdo chung ngu shu log bcu drug /spyan ras gzigs kyis zhus pa'i chos bdun pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang / lots+tsha ba dge ba'i blo gros kyis bsgyur ba/ spobs pa'i blo gros kyis zhus pa bam po gcig pa/ paṇa ḍi ta pradzñā warma dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sdes bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs// //pha pa la/ blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa bam po bcu dang / le'u bcu gnyis pa/paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / bud dhā pra bha ba dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos zhus pa che ba bam po bdun dang le'u bcu pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / pradzñā warma dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos zhus pa 'bring po dge ba bcu bshad pa shu log nyis brgya pa dang / klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos zhus pa chung ngu shu log bcu pa gnyis / paṇa ḍi ta su ren dra bo dhi dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ klu'i rgyal po ma dros pas zhus pa bam po bzhi pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde dang / yi ge pa dgon gling rma la sogs pas bsgyur ba/ mi 'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pas zhus pa bam po lnga pa/ lots+tsha ba dpal gyi lhun po dang / dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs// //ba pa la/ tshangs pas zhus pa shu log nyis brgya pa paṇa ḍi ta dzi na tra dang /lots+tsha ba chen po ye shes sdes bsgyur ba/ tshangs pas byin gyis zhus pa bam po gcig pa/ paṇa ḍi ta su ren dra bo dhi dang / pradzñā warma dang / lots+tsha ba chen po ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ tshangs pa khyad par sems kyis zhus pa bam po drug /'di 105—455

la lar bam po bdun du byas 'dug paṇa ḍi ta shākya pra bha dang / dharma pā la dang / dzi na mi tra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba dharmā tā shī la dang / bar zhus kyi lots+tsha ba lha'i dbang po srung ba dang / gzhon nu srung ba la sogs pas bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa/ lha'i bu rab rtsal sems kyis zhus pa bam po gsum pa/paṇa ḍi ta pradzñā warma dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ dpal dbyig gis zhus pa shu log brgya rtsa bcwa lnga 'gyur byang snga ma dang 'dra ba/ rin chen dra ba can gyis zhus pa bam po gcig dang shu log drug cu pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dzñā na gar+bha dang / lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes snying pos bsgyur ba las/ slad kyi lots+tsha ba dpal brtsegs kyis gtan la phab pa/ rin chen zla bas zhus pa shu log nyis brgya rtsa bdun pa/ paṇa ḍi ta bi shud dha sing ha dang / lots+tsha ba dge ba'i dpal gyis bsgyur ba las/ slad kyi paṇa ḍi ta bir+ya ka ra sing ha dang / lots+tsha ba de ba tsan dras gtan la phab pa/ bde byed kyis zhus pa shu log brgyad cu pa/ paṇa ḍi ta pradzñā warma dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sdes bsgyur ba/ yul 'khor skyong gis zhus pa shu log bdun cu rtsa gsum pa/ rnam par 'phrul pa'i rgyal pos zhus pa bam po gsum pa/ paṇa ḍi ta pradzñā warma dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ dri ma med pa'i 'od kyis zhus pa bam po bzhi pa/ dkar chag snga ma rnams su bam po drug tu byas 'dug /theg pa chen po'i man ngag ces bya ba'i mdo bu mo rin chen gyis zhus pa bam po bzhi pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang /lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ bram ze mo dpal ldan mas zhus pa shu log dgu bcu pa / bgres mos zhus pa shu log brgya rtsa bcu pa/ lo paṇa snga ma dang 'dra ba rnams bzhugs// //185wa 456

ma pa la/ 'jam dpal gyis dris pa shu log dgu bcu pa/ bdag med pa dris pa paṇa ḍi ta ka ma la gup+ta dang / lots+tsha ba rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba/'jig rten 'dzin gyis yongs su dris pa bam po bzhi dang / le'u bcu gnyis pa/blo gros mi zad pas bstan pa bam po bdun pa dang / dri ma med par grags pas bstan pa bam po drug dang le'u bcu gnyis pa gnyis/ lots+tsha ba chos nyid tshul khrims kyis bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa/ 'jam dpal gyis bstan pa shu log phyed dang bco lnga pa 'di'i ma dpe'i dkar chag tu byas 'dug /dkar chag snga ma la lar shu log sum cu par byas 'dug /byang chub kyi phyogs bstan pa shu log dgu bcu gnyis pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / dzñā na si dhī dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i bden pa bstan pa bam po gnyis pa/ paṇa ḍi ta shākya pra bha dang / dzi na mi tra dang / lots+tsha ba dharma tā shī la la sogs pas bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa/ chos thams cad 'byung ba med par bstan pa bam po gsum pa/ lots+tsha ba rin chen mtshos bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa rnams bzhugs// //tsa pa la/ pha rol du phyin pa lnga bstan pa bam po drug dang le'u nyer bzhi pa/paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ sbyin pa'i pha rol du phyin pa bstan pa bam po gnyis pa/ paṇa ḍi ta pradzñā warma dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ sbyin pa'i phan yon bstan pa shu log sum cu pa/ paṇa ḍi ta su ren dra bo dhi dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bstan pa shu log nyis brgya nyi shu pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / pradzñā warma dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan dang ye 705—457

shes bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yul la 'jug pa bstan pa bam po gsum dang shu log nyi shu pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dzñā na gar+bha dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ sangs rgyas kyi stobs bskyed pa'i cho 'phrul rnam par 'phrul pa bstan pa/ bam po gcig dang shu log lnga bcu pa/ sangs rgyas kyi chos bsam gyis mi khyab par bstan pa'i le'u bam po gsum pa/ mar me mdzad kyis lung bstan pa shu log nyis brgya bcu/paṇa ḍi ta bi shud dha sing ha dang / lots+tsha ba dge ba'i dpal gyis bsgyur ba las/slad kyi paṇa ḍi ta dzñā na gar+bha dang / lots+tsha ba klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis gtan la phab pa / tshangs pa'i dpal lung bstan pa shu log bzhi bcu pa/ paṇa ḍi ta bi shud dha sing ha dang / lots+tsha ba dge ba'i dpal gyis bsgyur ba las/ slad kyi paṇa ḍi ta bir+sha ka ra sing ha dang / lots+tsha ba de ba tsan dras gtan la phab pa/ bud med 'gyur ba lung bstan pa bam po gnyis pa dang / bu mo zla mchog lung bstan pa bam po gnyis pa gnyis/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur / bde ldan ma lung bstan pa shu log bdun cu pa/ lha mo chen mo dpal lung bstan pa shu log brgya pa/ rgyal ba'i blo gros zhes bya ba shu log bcu gcig pa/spyan ras gzigs zhes bya ba'i mdo bam po gcig dang shu log drug cu pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/'jam dpal gnas pa zhes bya ba shu log brgya bzhi bcu pa/ paṇa ḍi ta su ren dra bo dhi dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ bdud rtsi brjod pa zhes bya ba shu log brgyad cu pa/ byams pa 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i mdo bam po gnyis pa/ paṇa ḍi ta pradzñā lharmā dang / dzi na mi tra dang / su ren dra bo dhi dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ 'jig rten gyi rjes su 'thun par 'jug pa shu log brgya bcu gcig 185—458

wa wa wa wa ———————— ————— pa / paṇa ḍi ta dā na shī la dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sdes bsgyur ba rnams bzhurtis pa / / la/ // dad pa'i stobs bskyed pa la 'jug pa'i phyag rgya bam po lnga dang shu log bdun cu pa/ paṇa ḍi ta su ren dra bo dhi dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur / nges pa dang ma nges par 'gro ba'i phyag rgya la 'jug pa bam po gcig pa/paṇa ḍi ta pradzñā lharmā dang / su ren dra bo dhi dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/chos kyi phyag rgya shu log brgyad cu pa/ mar me 'bul ba bam po gcig pa/ paṇa ḍi ta pradzñā warma dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ grong khyer gyis 'tsho ba zhes bya ba shu log brgya pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dzñā na gar+bha ba dang / lots+tsha ba klu'i dbang pos bsgyur ba las/ slad kyi paṇa ḍi ta bir+sha ka ra sing ha dang / lots+tsha ba de ba tsan dras gtan la phab pa/ zas kyis 'tsho ba rnam par dag pa shu log sum bcu rtsa brgyad pa/ glang po'i rtsal bam po gcig dang shu log drug cu pa/ sgra chen po shu log drug cu rtsa bzhi pa/ paṇa ḍi ta bi shud dha sing ha dang / lots+tsha ba dge ba'i dpal gyis bsgyur ba las/ slad kyi paṇa ḍi ta bir+sha ka ra sing ha dang / lots+tsha ba de ba tsan dras gtan la phab pa/ seng ge'i sgra bsgrags pa bam po gcig pa/paṇa ḍi ta birgyu ka ra sing ha dang / lots+tsha ba rba rje ye shes snying pos bsgyur ba/'di la dkar chag snga ma dag tu bam po gcig tu byas byung / chos la bam po sum cha tsam gcig 'dug pas dpe gzhan dang bstun la dpyad 'tshal/ sa lu ljang pa'i mdo shu log nyis brgya nyi shu rtsa drug pa/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba dang po dang rnam par dbye ba bstan pa shu log sum bcu pa/ 'di theg chung du grags kyang / slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis 'grel par rnam shes tshogs brgyad 105wa 459

— —— ——— —————————————————————— ——— ————wa ———wa —wa wa wa wa wa wadang / rig byed ma yin pa gzugs min pa la sogs pa bstan pa'i phyir theg pa thun mong du 'thad ces mkhas pa bu ston gsung ngo / /rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba shu log bcu gsum pa/ sor mo'i phreng ba la phan pa bam po bdun pa/paṇa ḍi ta shākya pra bha dang / lots+tsha ba dharmā ta shī la dang / rgya'i lots+tsha ba tong ā tsar+ya la sogs pas bsgyur ba/ rgyal po gzugs can snying po la gdams pa/paṇa ḍi ta dā na shī la dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ bad sa'i rgyal po 'char byed la gdams pa/ 'gyur byang snga ma dang 'dra ba/ ma skyes dgra'i 'gyod pa bsal ba bam po lnga pa/ paṇa ḍi ta mañdzu shrī gar+bha dang / lots+tsha ba rin chen mtshos gtan la phab pa/ dpal sbas kyi mdo bam po gcig dang shu log drug cu pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shrī la dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ las kyi sgrib pa rnam par dag pa bam po gcig dang shu log bzhi bcu pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / pradzñā warma dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur / las kyi sgrib pa rgyun gcod pa shu log nyis brgya sum bcu pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sdes bsgyur ba rnams bzhupas pa / / la/ // sangs rgyas kyi sne snod tshul khrims 'chal pa tshar gcod pa bam po bdun dang le'u dgu pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dharma shrī pra bha dang / lots+tsha ba dpal gyi lhun po'i 'gyur/ rgyal po la sadams pa shu log brgya drug cu pa/ rnga bo che chen po'i le'u bam po lnga pa/ paṇa ḍi ta bir+sha ka ra pra bha dang / lots+tsha ba dpal gyi lhun pos bsgyur ba las/ slad kyi lots+tsha ba dpal brtsegs kyis gtan la phab pa/sum bcu rtsa gsum pa'i le'u bam po gsum pa/ paṇa ḍi ta pradzñā warma dang /185wa 460

wa wa———wa ———————— —————— — — —lots+tsha ba ye shes sdes bsgyur ba/ lhag pa'i bsam pa bstan pa'i le'u/ paṇa ḍi ta su ren dra bo dhi dang / pradzñā warma dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ 'di la dkar chag snga ma rnams su bam po bzhir byas byung / chos la bam po gcig gi tshod las mi 'dug pas/ phyi mo gzhan la gtugs te dpyad par bya'o/ /gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba zhes bya ba shu log sum bcu pa/ paṇa ḍi ta sarba dzñā de ba dang /lots+tsha ba dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ srid pa 'pho ba shu log bdun cu pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ rnam par 'thag pa thams cad bsdus pa bam po gcig dang shu log drug cu pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / mu ne warma dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ sangs rgyas bgro ba bam po gsum pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa bgro ba bam po gsum dang /shu log bdun cu rtsa lnga pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dzñā na gar+bha dang / lots+tsha ba dpal gyi dbyangs kyis bsgyur cing / lots+tsha ba dpal brtsegs kyis gtan la phab pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa dpal gyi dam tshig bam po gsum dang le'u bzhi pa/ paṇa ḍi ta sarba dzñā de ba dang / lots+tsha ba dpal brtsegs kyis gtan la phab pa rnams bzhu/sapa / la // dkon mchog sprin ces bya ba bam po brgyad pa/ lots+tsha ba rin chen mtsho dang / chos nyid tshul khrims kyis bsgyur ba/ sprin chen po bam po bcu dang le'u so brgyad pa/ paṇa ḍi ta su ren dra bo dhe dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ sprin chen po las phyogs bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho 'dus pa'i dga' ston chen po la rtse ba zhes bya ba'i le'u/ bam po gsum dang shu log nyis brgya nyi shu pa/ lo pan sngar dang 'dra ba/ sprin chen po'i rlung gi 705wa 461

dkyil 'khor gyi le'u bam po gcig pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / su ren dra bo dhi dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ sprin chen po las char dbab pa'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi le'u drug cu rtsa bzhi pa/ cho ga dang bcas pa bam po phyed dang gsum dang shu log bdun cu pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / shī len dra bo dhi dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ 'di gnyis bya rgyud kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi brgyad pa gnas gtsang ma'i lha'i la sogs pa'i khongs su gtogs la/ 'dir ma dpe'i dbang gis mdo'i khrod du 'dems nas bris 'dug cing bam grangs kyang dkar chag la lar 'di bzhin byung yang / dkar chag 'phang thang mar sprin chen po nyung ngu na shu log nyis brgya nyi shu/ sprin chen po'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi le'u bam po gcig bya ba byung bas/ gnyis po 'di de bzhin yin par sems shing rgyud 'bum na bzhugs/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyod pa dpa' bar 'gro ba'i mdo/ le'u stong phrag bcu pa las le'u bcu pa bam po gnyis pa 'di bka' yin min the tshom gyi gzhir klu mes dbang phyug grangs 'chad do/ /gtsug tor bam po dgu pa las bdud kyi le'u nyi tshe phyung ba bam po gnyis pa rgya las bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs/ 'di yang snga ma bzhin du snang mod kyis/ sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams kyis dkar chag snga ma gsum kur bkar bshad do// //zha pa la/ chos yang dag par sdud pa bam po bdun pa le'u bcu gnyis/paṇa ḍi ta mañdzu shrī gar+bha dang / bi dza ya shī la dang / shī len dra bo dhi dang /lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ 'di la mtshan gzhan chos bgro ba yang zer bas/chos kun bgro ba dang gcig mi gcig brtag par bya'o/ /sa'i snying po 'khor lo 185—462

———————————————————— —— —————bcu pa bam po bcu gsum dang le'u brgyad pa/ rgya'i mkhan po hā shang zab mo la sogs dang / lots+tsha ba ban dhe rnam par mi rtog pas bsgyur ba/ dkar chag snga ma rnams su bam grangs 'di bzhin byung zhing / chos la bam po bcu par byas 'dug cing / le'u lnga pa'i grangs chad 'dug /phyir mi ldog pa 'khor lo'i mdo bam po drug pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / mu ne warma dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ ting nge 'dzin gyi 'khor lo'i mdo/yongs su bsngo ba'i 'khor lo'i mdo/ lots+tsha ba ban dhe rnam par mi rtog pas rgya'i dpe las bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs/ 'di la dkar chag snga ma rnams su bam po gnyis su byas 'dug cing / chos la bam po sum cha tsam gcig las mi 'dug pas tā sprad la/// cho//sa kyi rgyal po bam po gcig dang shu log brgya pa/ chos kyi tshul zhes bya ba bam po gcig pa paṇa ḍi ta pradzñā warma dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur / chos kyi phung po shu log brgya lnga bcu pa/ lo paṇa snga ma dang 'dra ba/don dam pa'i chos kyi rnam par rgyal ba shu log nyis brgya brgyad cu pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ chos dang don rnam par 'byed pa/ shu log dgu bcu 'gyur byang snga ma dang 'dra ba/ so sor thar pa chos bzhi sgrub pa/ bam po gcig dang shu log brgya pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang / lots+tsha ba shākya blo gros dang / dge ba'i blo gros kyis bsgyur ba/ chos bzhi bstan pa zhes bya ba shu log bcu gsum pa/ paṇa ḍi ta su ren dra bo dhi dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sdes bsgyur ba/ chos bzhi pa shu log bcu pa / chos bzhi ma btang ba zhes bya ba'i mdo/ bzhi bsgrub pa shu log nyis brgya 105—463

drug cu pa/ chos gsum pa'i mdo/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / lots+tsha ba de ba tsan dras bsgyur cing / lots+tsha ba dpal brtsegs kyis gtan la phab pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi mdo/ chos kyi rgya mtsho shu log brgyad cu pa/ chos kyi rgya mo bam po gnyis pa rgya las bsgyur ba/ shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i sde'i nyi ma'i snying po bam po bcu gsum dang le'u bcu gnyis pa/ paṇa ḍi ta sarba dzñā de ba dang / bir+sha ka ra pra bha dang / dharma ka ra dang / lots+tsha ba ban dhe bzang skyong gis bsgyur cing /lots+tsha ba dpal brtsegs kyis gtan la phab pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po bam po gcig pa/ paṇa ḍi ta shākya pra bha dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sdes bsgyur ba/yi ge med pa'i za ma tog rnam par snang mdzad kyi snying po shu log brgya pa/ nam mkha'i snying po bam po gcig dang shu log brgya bdun cu rtsa lnga pa/ thabs la mkhas pa bam po gnyis pa rnams bzhugs// //'a pa la/ sangs rgyas kyi mtshan lnga stong bzhi brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum pa/bam po brgyad pa/ yang dag par spyod pa'i tshul nam mkha'i mdog gis 'dul ba'i bzod pa bam po gcig pa dang le'u bcu gnyis pa/ rgya las bsgyur ba/thar pa chen po phyogs su rgyas pa 'gyod tshangs kyis sdig sbyangs te sangs rgyas su grub pa rnam par bkod pa bam po gnyis dang shu log brgya bcu gnyis pa/ rgya las bsgyur ba/ 'di la dkar chag 'phang thang mar bam po phyed dang bzhir mdzad 'dug pas de yin pa 'dra/ rtogs pa chen po yongs su rgyas pa'i mdo las phyag 'tshal ba'i cho ga dang mtshan nas brjod pa'i yon tan gyi gleng gzhi/me tog gi tshoms kyi mdo/ bam po gsum pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dzñā na sid dhi dang /lots+tsha ba ban dhe dharmā tā shī la la sogs pas bsgyur cing / gtan la phab pa rnams 105—464

bzhugs ngewa —— ———————————————————————————————— —— ya pa la/ dpang skong phyag brgya pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyal po shu log bdun cu rtsa lnga pa/ phyogs bcu'i mun sel shu log brgya lnga bcu pa/ paṇa ḍi ta bi shud dha sing ha dang / lots+tsha ba rtsangs de ben dra rak+ṣi tas bsgyur cing /lots+tsha ba klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis gtan la phab pa/ sangs rgyas bdun pa shu log brgya rtsa lnga pa/ sangs rgyas brgyad pa shu log dgu bcu pa/ sangs rgyas bcu pa'i mdo/ mtshan gcig ni yon tan rin chen me tog rgyas pas zhus pa zhes bya ste shu log brgya bzhi bcu pa/ sangs rgyas bcu gnyis pa shu log bdun cu rtsa bdun pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ 'di dang sangs rgyas bdun pa gnyis ma dpe'i dbang gis 'dir 'dabs 'dug cing / bya ba'i rgyud kyi dang po de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi gtso bo'i khongs su gtogs shing rgyud 'bum na bzhugs so/ /sangs rgyas kyi dbu brgyan shu log nyis brgya pa/ paṇa ḍi ta shākya sing ha dang / lots+tsha ba ban dhe de ben tra rak+ṣi tas bsgyur ba/ sangs rgyas kyi sa zhes pa shu log nyis brgya pa/paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra/ shī len dra bo dhi dang / pradzñā warma dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sdes ḍi ka dang sbyar te gsar du bsgyur ba/ sangs rgyas mi spang ba zhes bya ba'i mdo shu log brgya nyi shu pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / pradzñā warma dang /lots+tsha ba ye shes sdes bsgyur ba/ dkyil 'khor brgyad pa shu log bdun cu pa/'gyur byang snga ma dang 'dra ba/ 'dir ma dpe'i dbang gis 'dabs 'dug cing bya rgyud kyi dang po de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi bdun pa byang sems kyi khongs su gtogs shing rgyud 'bum na bzhugs so/ bkra shis brgyad pa zhes bya ba shu 185wa 465

log lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa/ dkon mchog gsum rjes su dran pa/ bslab pa gsum gyi mdo/ sku gsum pa'i mdo/ phung po gsum pa'i mdo shu log lnga brgya sum bcu pa/ bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i yongs su bsngo ba shu log lnga bcu pa/ 'gro ba thams cad yongs su skyob pa'i bsngo ba shu log bzhi bcu pa/ paṇa ḍi ta bir+sha ka ra ya pra bha dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes snying pos bsgyur cing / lots+tsha ba dpal brtsegs kyis gtan la phab pa/ sngar 'gyur ba da ltar ma rnyed pa la/ spyod yul yongs su dag pa bam po gcig /dpal chen po'i mdo bam po gsum/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dpal phun sum tshogs pa bam po gsum / rdo rje snying pos zhus pa/ zla mchog gi snying pos zhus pa/ gsal rgyal gyis zhus pa/ rab dgas zhus pa/ stag mo'i bus zhus pa/ pha rol du phyin pa bcu bstan pa/ ri mo'i mtshan nyid bstan pa/ tshad med pa bstan pa/dkyil 'khor dbul ba'i phan yon bstan pa/ byang chub sems dpa' lung bstan pa/ tshangs pas lung bstan pa/ rin po che chen po'i mdo bam po lnga pa/de bzhin gshegs pa'i lung gi le'u/ 'dul ba rnam par gdon mi za ba bam po gcig /ye shes rgyas pa chung ngu bam po gcig /yang dag pa'i legs pa'i yon tan bshad pa shu log brgyad cu/ pha rol du phyin pa bsdus pa/ shes rab bskyed pa/ stobs bskyed pa/ ye shes bsdus pa'i mdo/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bsngo ba la mkhas pa shu log brgya drug cu la sogs pa mdo sna sum bcu tsam ma rnyed do/ /zung gi mdo'i chos kyi rnam grangs dang / bdag med pa dris pa la sogs pa klu mes dbang phyug grags mdo min par smra ba ni mi 'thad de/ bdag med pa dris pa lots+tsha ba rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing / zung gi mdo gsung 105wa 466

wa wawa wa—— —— —— ——— —rab la tshad mar gyur pa'i lo paṇa rnams kyis mdzad pa'i dkar chag chen mo las mdor bshad pa'i phyir zhes kha cig 'chad do/ /dkar chag 'phang thang mar/me 'gel 'tsho ba'i mdo/ rta mgrin gnam sa bkod pa'i mdo zhes pa li las bsgyur ba yod par bshad do/ /mdo sna mang po ma rnyed par lnga bcu nga bdun nam nga dgu la sogs pa 'gyur la/ kau shi / blo gros bzang mo chung ba/ ljon shing gi mdo la sogs pa/ sa skya pan chen dang / klu mes la sogs pas mdo yang dag ltar snang phye ba bzhin rtogs par bya'o/ /de ltar mdo brgya phrag gnyis dang so drug bzhugs/ thub pa'i gsung rab 'gyur ro cog gi dkar chag legs bshad nyi ma'i 'od zer las/ bka' 'khor lo gsum pa don dam rnam par nges pa'i ༵༵ kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i rim pa rnam par bzhag pa'i skabs te skabs brgyad gsum pa/ bka' 'khor lo dang po bden pa bzhi'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i rim pa rnam par bzhag pa la/ dus phyis gsungs pa dang ci rigs su yod kyang theg chung rnams phyogs gcig tu bstan par bya ste/ thog mar dam pa'i chos dran pa nyer bzhag chen po/ bam po nyi shu pa yan chad rnams bzhugs// //ra pa la/ bam po nyer gcig pa nas bam po zhe lnga pa yan chad bzhugs/'di nas bam grangs kyi nges pa mi snang zhing /la pa la/ de'i 'phro nas 'thab bral gyi lha rnams kyi sa las rtag tu bde ba'i sa ste brgyad pa yan chad dang / mu su lun dha'i rdzu 'phrul chen po zhes bya ba yang rdzogs pa'i bar rnams bzhugs// //105—467

sha pa la/ de'i 'phro nas dran pa nyer bzhag gi 'jug rnams rdzogs pa/paṇa ḍi ta shākya rak+ṣi ta dang / bhu ti tsan dra dang / a ḍi ta la sogs pa rnams kyi zhal snga nas/ lots+tsha ba dge slong pa tshab tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyis sngar bsgyur ba'i 'phro rnams bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa 'di/ lots+tsha ba theg chen du mdzad / dkar chag chen mo dag las theg chung du bshad do/ /mdo chen mo sgyu ma'i dra ba bam po gcig dang shu log bzhi bcu pa/ mdo chen mo gzugs can snying pos bsu ba bam po phyed pa/ mdo chen po stong pa nyid ces bya ba shu log sum bcu pa/ mdo chen po stong pa nyid chen po bam po phyed pa/ mdo chen po rgyal mtshan mchog shu log bzhi bcu pa/ mdo chen po rgyal mtshan dam pa shu log bzhi bcu pa/ mdo chen po lnga gsum pa shu log nyis brgya nyi shu pa rnams/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / dra dzñā parmā dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sdes bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa/ rdo 'phangs pa'i mdo bam po gnyis pa/ gzhon nu dpe'i mdo shu log nyi shu pa/ khams mang po ba'i mdo shu log nyis brgya pa/ gaṇa ḍi'i mdo shu log bcu/ paṇa ḍi ta dharma shrī bha dra dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong tshul khrims yon tan gyis bsgyur cing / lots+tsha ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos zhus te gtan la phab pa/ gaṇa ḍi'i dus kyi mdo/ paṇa ḍi ta dī paṃ ka ra shrī rnyo na dang /lots+tsha ba dge ba'i blo gros kyis bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa'i mdo rnams bzhugs// //sa pa la/ mngon par 'byung ba'i mdo/ paṇa ḍi ta ā tsār+ya dharmā shrī bha dra dang / lots+tsha ba rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa/ dge slong la rab tu gces pa'i mdo/ tshul khrims yang dag par ldan pa'i mdo/ ltung ba 185—468

sde lnga'i dge ba dang mi dge ba'i 'bras bu brtag pa'i mdo/ paṇa ḍi ta ā tsār+ya dzñā na shrī gup+ta dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya blo gros kyis bsgyur ba/ mchog tu gtags pa'i mdo/ rnam par grol ba'i lam las sbyangs pa'i yon tan bstan pa/paṇa ḍi ta bir+sha ka ra pra bha dang / lots+tsha ba dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur ba/ 'di dkar chag chen mo dag las mdor mdzad la/ kha cig bstan bcos su 'dod do / /tshe'i mtha'i mdo shu log nyis brgya lnga pa/ paṇa ḍi ta bi shud dha sing ha dang / lots+tsha ba dge ba'i dpal gyis bsgyur cing / paṇa ḍi ta bir+ya ka ra sing ha dang / lots+tsha ba dpal brtsegs kyis gtan la phab pa/ 'chi 'pho ba ji ltar 'gyur ba bstan pa'i mdo/ mi rtag pa nyid kyi mdo shu log bcwa lnga pa/ paṇa ḍi ta su ren dra bo dhi dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ 'du shes bcu bstan pa'i mdo shu log brgyad pa/ 'du shes bcu gcig bstan pa'i mdo shu log bcu gcig pa 'di bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal chems yin no/ /yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa'i mdo chen po/ shu log brgya pa 'di ma dpe'i dbang gis 'dabs 'dug cing / bya rgyud kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi drug pa pho nya'i khongs su gtogs shing rgyud 'bum na bzhugs so/ /mtshan mo bzang po'i mdo shu log lnga bcu rtsa phyed dang gnyis pa/ mun gyi nags tshal gyi sgo'i mdo/ pha ma'i mdo/bden pa bzhi'i mdo/ don dam rnam par nges pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs/ 'di la dkar chag 'phang thang mar shu log bdun cur mdzad 'dug kyang / bam po gcig dang shu log bdun cu'i tshod gcig 'dug /don rgyas pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs shu log brgya pa/ 'di'i mjug ma tshang / rmad du byung ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs shu log bdun cu pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / su ren dra bo dhi dang /105—469

lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs brnyan bzhag pa'i phan yon brjod pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs shu log drug cu pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dharmā ka ra dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes snying pos bsgyur cing / lots+tsha ba dpal brtsegs kyis gtan la phab pa/ mchod rten bskor ba'i tshigs su bcad pa shu log bdun cu pa / gsal rgyal gyi tshigs su bcad pa shu log brgya pa/ tshigs su bcad pa gcig pa tshigs su bcad pa bzhi pa/ klu'i rgyal po rnga sgra'i tshigs su bcad pa shu log brgya pa/ ched du brjod pa'i tshoms bam po bzhi dang tshoms sum bcu rtsa gsum pa/ paṇa ḍi ta birā ka ra pra bha dang / lots+tsha ba rin chen mchog gis bsgyur cing / lots+tsha ba dpal brtsegs kyis gtan la phab pa/ 'dir sngar gyi dkar chag dag las bstan bcos su bgrangs pa/ da ltar bkar grags so/ /skyes bu dam pa'i mdo shu log nyis brgya/ paṇa ḍi ta dharmā ka ra dang / lots+tsha ba bzang spyod kyis bsgyur cing / lots+tsha ba dpal brtsegs kyis zhu chen bgyis pa/dga' bo rab tu byung ba'i mdo shu log lnga bcu pa/ lots+tsha ba rtsangs de ben dra'i 'gyur / lha'i mdo shu log sum bcu rtsa bdun pa/ lha'i mdo nyung ngu shu log bcu bdun pa/ lots+tsha ba ye shes sdes bsgyur ba/ zla ba'i mdo shu log bcu gsum pa/ khang bu brtsegs pa'i mdo shu log drug cu pa/ lots+tsha ba rab rak+ṣi ta'i 'gyur/ gnas 'jog gi mdo shu log nyi shu pa/ paṇa ḍi ta sarba dzñā de ba dang / lots+tsha ba ban dhe dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur ba/ dga' ba can gyi mdo shu log nyis brgya pa/ mkhar bsil gyi mdo dang / mkhar bsil 'chang ba'i kun du spyod pa'i cho ga gnyis bam po gcig pa/ chos kyi 'khor lo'i mdo/las kyi rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu'i mdo/ lots+tsha ba rgya nag lha btsun chos kyi 105—470

rin chen gyis dpal ldan sa skyar bsgyur ba/ las rnam par 'byed pa chen po bam po gnyis pa/ 'dir las rnam 'byed chung ngu bam po gcig ye shes sdes bsgyur ba ma rnyed/ las kyi rnam par 'gyur ba zhes bya ba'i gzhung shu log nyis brgya bdun cu pa rnams bzhugs// //ha pa la/ las brgya tham pa bam po sum bcu rtsa bdun pa las/ bam po nyi shu rtsa drug pa yan chad dang / sdom gyi tshigs su bcad pa drug pa yan chad dang /bdun pa'i stod nas dang po rnams bzhugs// //a pa la/ de'i 'phro bam po nyer bdun pa dang / sdom gyi tshigs su bcad pa bdun pa gnyis pa nas/ bam po sum bcu rtsa bdun pa yan chad dang /sdom gyi tshigs su bcad pa bcu pa yan chad de las brgya pa rdzogs pa dang /'dzangs blun zhes bya ba'i mdo bam po bcu gnyis dang le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa rgya las bsgyur ba/ 'dir dkar chag la lar bam po bcu gsum du byas 'dug /kun du rgyu sen rings kyis zhus pa shu log sum bcu rtsa bdun pa/ byams pa'i mdo / paṇa ḍi ta ā nan ta shrī dang / lots+tsha ba sa skya paṇa chen gyis bsgyur ba/byams pa lung bstan pa shu log brgya pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / lots+tsha ba dpal brtsegs rak+ṣi tas bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs// //e pa la/ gang po la sogs pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa brgya pa bam po nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / lots+tsha ba ban dhe de ba tsan tras bsgyur ba / sangs rgyas kyi rtogs pa brjod pa shes ldan gyi mdo shu log brtswa lnga pa/paṇa ḍi ta bir+sha ka ra sing ha dang / sarba dzñā de ba dang / lots+tsha ba dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur ba/ phag mo'i rtogs brjod shu log brgya pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi 185—471

na mi dra dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sdes bsgyur ba/ ma ga dha bzang mo'i rtogs brjod / paṇa ḍi ta dharmā shrī bha tra dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong tshul khrims yon tan gyis bsgyur cing / lots+tsha ba rin chen bzang pos bsgyur te gtan la phab pa rnams bzhugs// //aḥpa la/ bsod nams stobs kyi rtogs brjod bam po gnyis pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / lots+tsha ba de ba tsan dras bsgyur ba/ 'di la dkar chag la lar shu log nyis brgya lnga bcur byas 'dug /zla 'od kyi rtogs pa brjod pa dang /dpal gyi sde'i rtogs pa brjod pa gnyis/ paṇa ḍi ta dharma shrī bha dra ba dang /lots+tsha ba dge slong shes rab legs pas bsgyur cing / lots+tsha ba rin chen bzang pos gtan la phab pa/ gser mdog gi sngon gyi sbyor ba shu log bcu bdun pa/rgyal bu don grub kyi mdo bam po gcig pa/ tshangs pa'i dra ba'i mdo bam po gnyis pa/ sangs rgyas kyi drin lan gsab pa'i mdo bam po phyed dang brgyad dang le'u dgu pa/ legs nyes kyi rgyu 'bras bstan pa zhes bya ba/ lots+tsha ba mgos chos grub kyis rgya gar dang / rgya'i dpe las bsgyur ba/ dge mi dge'i las kyi rnam smin bstan pa bam po gcig pa/ zla ba'i snying pos zhus pa'i mdo las sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas bstan pa gnas pa dang 'jig pa'i tshul lung bstan pa/ glang ru lung bstan pa bam po gcig pa/ stag sna'i mdo/ paṇa ḍi ta a dzi ta shrī bha dra dang / lots+tsha ba shākya 'od kyis bsgyur ba/ sme bdun zhes pa skar ma'i mdo/ rgya gar nas rgya nag du 'gyur cing / rgya nag nas bod du lots+tsha ba ma hā pha la dang / shrī a nan ta badz+ras gung thang gi gtsug lag khang du bsgyur ba / mig bcu gnyis pa'i mdo/ stag sna dang 'di gnyis klu mes dbang phyug 105—472

grags bka' min par smra'o/ /sngar 'gyur nges pa da lta ma rnyed pa la/ bsod nams kyi mdo shu log brgya rtsa/ bsod nams kyi gdugs kyi mdo shu log brgya/gang zag gi mdo shu log brgya rtsa/ khyim bdag 'du shes kyi mdo shu log lnga bcu/ched du brjod pa'i mdo/ lus 'phags mo'i mdo/ dran pa nye bar bzhag pa'i tshig le'u byas pa shu log brgya pa/ 'di la dkar chag lhan dkar mar bstan bcos su bgrangs pas de nyid yin par sems so/ /dran pa nye bar bzhag pa'i mdo chung ngu / sems can la skye shi'i rtsa ba bstan pa bam po gcig /'jig rten pha rol sgrub pa bam po gnyis/ dge ba bcu yid dam du blang ba'i cho ga shu log brgya/ bzang sbyin gyi mdo bam po gnyis/ byams pa dkar gyi mdo/dad pa la rab tu 'jug pa'i mdo/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan bshad pa'i mdo/smon lam gyi mdo/ sa'i mdo/ 'dod pa la gdams pa'i mdo/ yul 'khor skyong gis zhus pa'i mdo chung ngu shu log bdun cu rtsa gsum/ las rnam 'byed chung ngu bam po gcig /mang po bsdus pa'i mdo shu log nyis brgya ste nyi shu rtsa gcig go/ /'di dag las drin lan gsab pa dang / 'dzangs blun dang /sems can la skye shi'i rtsa ba bstan pa la sogs mang po zhig /theg chen du dkar chag chen mo dag las bshad pas brtag par bya'o/ /de ltar 'di theg chung gi mdo bdun cu rtsa drug bzhugs so// //bka' 'khor lo dang po'i khongs su gtogs pa'i dam pa'i chos 'dul ba'i skor ni/ ka pa nas pa pa'i bar bcu gsum la lung sde bzhi tshang bar bzhugs pa las thog mar 'dul ba lung sde bzhi'i dang po lung bzhi la/ shu log sum khri nyis stong bdun brgya ste/ bam po brgya dang dgu bzhugs pa las/185wa 473

ka pa la/ bam po nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa yan chad bzhugs// //kha pa la/ de'i 'phro nas bam po nga bzhi pa yan chad bzhugs// //ga pa la/ de'i 'phro nas bam po gya gnyis pa yan chad bzhugs// //nga pa la/ de'i 'phro nas bam po brgya dgu pa yan chad rnams la 'dul ba gzhi rdzogs pa/ paṇa ḍi ta sarba dzñā de ba dang / bisto ka ra pra bha dang / dharma ka ra dang / lots+tsha ba ban dhe dpal gyis lhun pos bsgyur cing / slad kyis paṇa ḍi ta bir+sha ka ra pra bha dang / lots+tsha ba ban dhe dpal brtsegs kyis gtan la phab pa rnams bzhugs/ lung sde bzhi'i gnyis pa lung rnam 'byed la/ dge slong gi so sor thar pa bam po gnyis pa dang / pa'i rnam 'byed shu log nyi khri bzhi stong dgu brgya ste bam po brgyad cu rtsa gsum pa dang / dge slong ma'i so sor thar pa bam po gnyis dang shu log nyis brgya pa dang / ma'i rnam 'byed bam po nyi shu brgyad pa rnams bzhugs pa las/ca pa la/ dge slong gi so sor thar pa'i mdo bam po gnyis pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / lots+tsha ba klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba/ pa'i rnam 'byed kyi bam po nyer gcig pa yan chad bzhugs// //cha pa la/ de'i 'phro nas bam po zhe gnyis pa yan chad bzhugs// //ja pa la/ de'i 'phro nas bam po re gnyis pa yan chad bzhugs// //nya pa la/ de'i 'phro nas bam po brgyad cu rtsa gsum pa/ yan chad rnams la / dge slong pa'i rnam 'byed rdzogs pa paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / lots+tsha ba klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs// //ta pa la/ dge slong ma'i so sor thar pa'i mdo bam po gnyis dang shu log 185—474

wa wa wa ———wa ———————— — —————nyis brgya pa/ lo paṇa snga ma dang 'dra ba/ ma'i rnam 'byed bam po nyi shu brgyad yan chad rdzogs pa/ paṇa ḍi ta sarba dzñā de ba dang / dharmā ka ra dang / bir+sha ka ra pra bha dang / lots+tsha ba dpal gyi lhun pos bsgyur cing / slad kyi paṇa ḍi ta bir+sha ka ra pra bha ba dang / lots+tsha ba dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs/lung sde bzhi'i gsum pa lung phran tshegs sgo brgyad kur rdzogs pa bam po lnga bcu rtsa dgu ༵ ༵ dī/ lung phran tshegs kyi bam po nyer bdun pa yan chad bzhugs// //da pa la/ de'i 'phro nas bam po lnga bcu rtsa dgu pa yan chad rnams phran tshegs sgo brgyad kur rdzogs pa/ paṇa ḍi ta bir+sha ka ra pra bha dang / dharma shrī pra bha dang / lots+tsha ba dpal 'byor gyis bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs/ lung phran tshegs la kha cig sgo brgyad las drug pa yan chad las ma 'gyur zer ba dang /dpe kha cig las phran tshegs bsgyur ba'i dus su/ lots+tsha ba mang pos bgos nas bsgyur bas bam po sum bcu rtsa dgu pa dang / bzhi bcu rtsa gsum pa chad pas gnyis po 'di dang po nas 'gyur tam/ ma 'gyur yang / lots+tsha ba chen po dpal 'byor la'ang zhu zhing brtag /sgra bsgyur sa'i dpe reg zid dang yang gtugs zhes pa dang / 'chims phu'i dkar chag las/ 'dul ba phran tshegs bsgyur 'phro bam po lnga bcu rtsa gnyis zhes pa dang / dkar chag lhan dkar mar 'dul ba phran tshegs kyi gzhi shu log nyi khri bzhi stong drug brgya ste bam po bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis zhes pa la sogs pa the tshom gyi gzhi mang du yod pas na tha snyad kyi rjes su mi 'brang bar phran tshegs sgo brgyad kur rdzogs pa slob dpon tshul khrims bskyangs kyis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa/ phran tshegs kyis tshig gi rnam par bshad pa dang 105—475

gtugs pa bam po lnga bcu rtsa dgu pa/ lots+tsha ba dpal 'byor gyis bsgyur ba 'di tshad mar bya'o/ /lung sde bzhi'i bzhi pa/ gzhung bla ma'i zhu ba ma rdzogs pa bam po bcu gnyis dang / zhu ba rdzogs pa bam po lnga bcu rtsa gsum pa las/na pa la/ gzhung bla ma'i zhu ba ma rdzogs pa bam po bcu gnyis dang / zhu ba rdzogs pa'i bam po nyer gnyis pa yan chad bzhugs// //pa pa la/ de'i 'phro nas bam po lnga bcu rtsa gsum pa yan chad la gzhung bla ma'i zhu ba ma rdzogs pa 'di dang / zhu ba rdzogs pa bam po lnga bcu rtsa gsum pa gnyis ka /lots+tsha ba klu'i rgyal mtshan la sogs pa'i dus su 'gyur mod kyi/ zhu ba ma rdzogs pa'i dpe bod du ma dar zhing / zhu ba rdzogs pa'i yi ge ma dag pa la brten nas lag len la 'khrul pa ci rigs su byung ba las/ dus phyis bsam yas 'chims phu nas dag phyung ba dang / dge slong tshul khrims yon tan gyis dpe dag po rnyed pas lag len mi mthun pa'i sgro 'dogs rnams kyang chod cing /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa'ang da lta ma rdzogs pa'i 'grel par byung bas/ de gnyis mi 'thun pa byung na zhu ba ma rdzogs pa la brten par bya'o / /kha cig zhu ba ma rdzogs pa ni gzhung bla ma yin la/ rdzogs pa ni gzhung dam pa yin no zhes pa 'di ni mi rigs te/ ud ta ra zhes pa bla ma dang dam pa gnyis gar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /de dag gi lung bzhis rab byung gi gzhi la sogs pa nas gnas mal gyi gzhi'i bar gzhi bcu bdun ston/ dge slong pa'i rnam 'byed kyis dge slong gi khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum ston/ dge slong ma'i rnam 'byed kyis dge slong ma'i khrims sum brgya drug cu ston/ so sor thar pa'i mdo gnyis po/ dge slong dang dge slong ma'i dgag pa'i bslab pa rgyas par 785—476

gsal bar byed pa rnam 'byed gnyis po'i rtsa ba'am mdo lta bu yin pas/ de'i phyir rnam 'byed gnyis po'i dbu nyid du bris so/ /gzhung bla ma gzhi dang rnam 'byed kyi don zhib tu 'chad pa'i 'grel pa lta bu yin/ phran tshegs de rnams kyi ma tshang ba kha skong lta bu yin no/ /so sor thar pa'i mdo gnyis po dgra bcom pa chos kyi tshong dpon gyis byas pas bka' ma yin zer ba dang / kha cig bka' yin yang / ston pa bzhi yin te sangs rgyas dang / nye ba 'khor dang / chos kyi tshong dpon dang / dri med bshes gnyen dang bzhi'o zer te/ bstan pa gcig la ston pa bzhi ngo mtshar che'o zhes gsung ngo / /kha cig lung sde bzhi dang /mngon par 'byung ba'i mdo bstan bcos su bzhed pa ni bzhed pa tsam du zad do/lung sde bzhi'i go rims ni/ gzhi dang / rnam par 'byed pa dang / de dag gi dka' ba'i gnas zhus lan gyis gtan la 'bebs pa gzhung bla ma dang / de dag tu ma tshang bar kha skong ba phran tshegs so/ /don gyi go rim de ltar yin yang /mkhas pa rnams kyis gzhi dang rnam par 'byed pa'i rjes la phran tshegs dang /de'i rjes la gzhung bla ma nyid bris shing / ska cog la sogs pas mdzad pa'i mtshan byang dkar chag las kyang / rim pa de kho na ltar 'byung bas/ 'dir yang gzhung bla ma 'jug nyid du bris so/ /'di rnams kyi bam po'i grangs ni shu log sum brgya la bam po re rer byas nas/ lung gzhi la bam po brgya dang dgu/dge slong pha'i rnam 'byed la bam po brgyad cu rtsa gsum/ dge slong ma'i rnam 'byed la/ bam po nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ phran tshegs la bam po lnga bcu rtsa dgu/gzhung bla ma'i zhu ba ma rdzogs pa bcu gnyis/ zhu ba rdzogs pa la bam po lnga bcu rtsa gsum ste/ spyir bsdoms na lung sde bzhi tshang ba la bam po sum brgya dang bzhi 105—477

bcu rtsa bzhi bzhugs so/ /de ltar 'dul ba'i gsung rab brgyad bzhugs so/ /thub pa'i gsung rab 'gyur ro cog gi dkar chag legs bshad nyi ma'i 'od zer las / bka' 'khor lo dang po bden pa bzhi'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i rim pa rnam par bzhag pa'i skabs te dgu pa'o// //de ltar gsung rab mtha' dag bkod pa rdzogs nas mthar gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi don thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir/ mjug bsdu ba'i tshul gyis bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa rnams bris pa theg pa mtha' dag gi mdo dang gzungs rnams las phyung ba ni/ bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam/ byams pa'i smon lam/ mchog gi spyod pa'i smon lam/ paṇa ḍi ta pradzñā warma dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ rgyal po gser gyi lag pa'i mar me'i smon lam/ gser 'od kyi bshags pa'i smon lam/ stong chen rab 'joms las byung ba'i smon lam/ rma bya chen mo las byung ba'i smon lam dang bden tshig /yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa'i bde legs kyi tshigs bcad/ lhas zhus pa'i bde legs kyi tshigs bcad/ bde legs su 'gyur ba'i tshigs bcad/ rgya chen rol pa las 'byung ba'i tshong dpon ga gon dang bzang po la gsungs pa'i shis pa brjod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag des pa la gsungs pa'i dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / lots+tsha ba ye shes sdes bsgyur ba/ phal po che las 'byung ba'i bcom ldan 'das la brgya byin gyis bstod pa'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/bcom ldan 'das la lha'i rgyal po rab mtshe ma'i bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad/bcom ldan 'das la/ lha'i rgyal po rab dga' ldan gyis bstod pa'i bkra shis kyi 185—478

tshigs bcad/ lhas zhus pa'i bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad/ sangs rgyas rabs bdun gyi bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad/ dkon mchog gsum dang mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang /lots+tsha ba ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa rnams bzhugs/ lots+tsha ba chen po ye shes sdes bsgyur ba rnams skad gsar chad kyis bcos pa phal che'o/ /de ltar bkra shis smon lam brtswa brgyad bzhugs so//gang gis bsgrubs pa'i bsod nams rlabs chen 'dis/ /mtha' yas skye dgu'i rgyad pa nyer zhi zhing / /thub bstan bstan pa 'phel ba'i rkyen gyur nas/ /'jig rten khams 'dir bkra shis byed gyur cig /de ltar sdeb legs tshig gi rlabs 'phreng g.yo/ /dgongs don zab mo'i gting mtha' rtogs par bka'/ /rin chen bye bas gtams pa'i mtsho chen bzhin/ /blo gsal klu dbang tshogs kyis brten par mdzod/ /de ltar pha rol du phyin pa la ma grags pa'i sngags kyi khyad par gyi chos gtso che chung gi sgo nas/ mdo sde dang / rgyud sde 'ga' zhig thun mong ba ltar snang ba rnams kyang so sor phye ste/ rgyud du gtogs pa la rgyud sde bzhi/gsang sngags snga 'gyur dang / bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gzugs bzhengs pa la/nang bzhugs kyi gzungs gal che zhing / gzungs 'khrugs pa dang / gong 'og 'dzol ba la sogs byung na/ rten de la'ang byin rlabs mi 'jug pa dang /sbyin bdag la'ang bkra mi shis pa 'byung ba dgongs nas/ rgyud sde thams cad kyi gzungs sngags rnams/ rgyud sde so so'i go rims ma 'dzol bar/ chos kyi rje thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston kha ches sdebs pa'i nyer mkho'i gzungs rnams dang bcas pa la chos kyi rnam grangs bdun brgya dang nyi shu rtsa gnyis/ mdor gtogs 105—479

pa la/ sher phyin gyi chos kyi rnam grangs bcu bdun/ shes rab sna tshogs kyi spod zhabs nas gsar du bsgyur ba'i mdo bcu gsum/ phal po che dang /dkon mchog brtsegs pa gnyis la/ mdo sna lnga bcu/ gzhan theg pa chen po'i mdo sna nyis brgya dang so drug /theg pa thun mong gi mdo bdun cu rtsa drug /'dul lung brgyad/ bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis ba'o brgyad rnams dril bas/chos kyi rnam grangs stong dang brgya phrag gcig dang / bzhi bcu bzhugs pa las/'ga' zhig dgos pa'i dbang gis zlos te bris par zad kyi/ gzhan du brgyad brgya drug cu rtsa gsum du nges par bya'o/ /'gro 'ong med pa'i de nyid gzigs kyang 'gro ba'i don du 'byon dang bzhud par ston/ /brjod du med pa'i don dam gzigs kyang rang rang bsam pa'i dbang bzhin chos 'khor bskor/ /rnam pa kun du bya byed spangs kyang phan bde rgyas mdzad thub pa'i dbang po de/ /ku sha'i grong du mya ngan 'das kyang glegs bam gzugs kyis gzhan phan mdzad pa bzhin/ /de yang / ston pa nyid kyis/ ma 'ongs dus na nga nyid ni/ /yi ge'i gzugs kyis rnam par gnas/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' 'di dag bcom ldan 'das nyid yin par blo dang ldan pa rnams kyis rig par bya ste / bcom ldan 'das kyis gang mdzad pa de dag 'dis kyang mdzad pa'i phyir de yang bdag nyid chen po rnams ni/ rang gi bde ba 'chil ma'i thal ba bzhin bor nas mtha' yas pa'i 'gro ba rnams la bu gcig pa'i ma bzhin du rjes su brtse bas / sems can re re'i ched du yang / bskal pa mang por thabs kyi rnam pa dpag tu med pa goms par mdzad pas/ ji lta ba dang / ji snyed pa'i chos rnams ma lus par thugs su chud cing / smon lam rgya mtsho'i pha rol du son pas 185—480

lhun gyis grub pa dang rgyun mi 'chad pa'i 'phrin las kyi tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba la brten nas/ 'jig rten gyi rgyal po la sogs pa sems can gyi tshogs shin du mang po la phan pa dang gnod par nus pa rnams su skye ba bzhes shing /yul thag shin tu ring ba rnams kyang sems shin tu nye bar mdzad nas/ 'gro ba mang po phan pa dang bde ba la 'god par mdzad do/ /de yang 'di ltar byang phyogs kyi rgyud/ gangs ri mu tig gi phreng ba mtshar du dngar ba lta bus kun nas bskor ba'i dbus/ yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chu klung rgya mtsho chen por dal gyis 'bab pa'i gzhi/ ro dang / bcud dang / nus pa phun sum tshogs pa'i sman sna tshogs kyi 'byung khungs su gyur pa'i bod kyi yul 'dir/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po 'jig rten dbang phyug des/ srong gtsan sgam po zhes bya ba'i rgyal por skye ba blangs te/ byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa/ rgya'i rgyal po chen po thang tha'i dzung zhes pa dang / yul thag ring yang thugs shin tu 'thun par mdzad de/ rgyal po de'i sras mo wang shing kong jo khab tu bzhes shing / kong jo des / gtsug lag khang brtsigs te/ bod du dam pa'i chos dar bar mdzad pa nas bzung ste/ rgyal bod gnyis 'brel pa shin du zab cing / de nas bgrangs pa'i gdung rabs lnga brtsigs pa bod kyi rgyal po mes ag tshom gyis/ rgya'i rgyal po dzung dzung gi nu bo cing dbang bya ba'i bu mo kim shing kung dzu khab tu bzhes pa la 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa chos skyong ba'i rgyal po chen po khri srong lde btsan 'khrungs nas/ rgya bod kyi 'brel pa ches zab cing / 'gro ba dpag tu med pa phan bde la bkod do/ /de'i dbon po/ phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa mnga' bdag ral pa can gyis dus su/ dbon zhang cung thugs ma mthun pas/ rgyal po ral 185—481

pa can gyis rgya'i yul du/ mi dang mi ma yin pa'i dmag mang du drangs nas byon pa'i skabs su/ dbon zhang mjal 'dum mdzad de sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang de dag bka' sdod chos skyong srung ma rnams dang / 'jig rten gyi lha 'dre dregs rtsal can thams cad bar du btsugs te/ sngar bod dang rgya gnyis yar mar du dmag khyer la sogs byed res mang du byung 'dug na'ang /dus de nas bzung ste bod dang / rgya gnyis dmag 'dren pa la sogs gcig gis gcig la gnod pa mi skyel zhing / phan ci thogs byed pa'i mna' dang rtsigs mdzad de/ chos 'khor chen po lha sa dang / rgya bod kyi sa mtshams gong bu smig ru zhes pa'i sa char/ rdo rings la yi ge bris so/ /de'i rten 'brel gyis de nas bzung ste/ deng sang gi bar du rgya bod gnyis 'brel zab cing chos 'jig rten gyi sgo nas/ phan ci thogs byed pa'i 'brel pa shin tu zab par gyur pa yin no / /bkra shis dang bde legs chen pos khyab par gyur cig/ //o ye dharma he tu pra bha wa he turnye gan ta thā ga to/ h+ya ba dad te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e baṃ bā dhi ma hā shra maṇaḥ// //105—482

legs tshogs 'dab stong 'dzum pa'i nyi 'od ces bya ba bzhugs so//༄༅na /skye rgya'i ral pa'i khri 'phang du/ /zhabs sen 'od ris rnam 'god pa / /stobs bcu'i me tog rgod pa'i lha/ /mdzad 'phrin nam mkha'i rgya khyon yangs / /shar phyogs gnam bskos tshangs pa che'i/ /thugs bskyed gser gyi 'phrul 'khor las/ /bka' gsung glegs bam ngo mtshar brgya/ /'di phyir dge ba'i dpal du bshams/ /de la 'dir gnam bskos gong ma chen po khang shis sam bde skyid rgyal pos par du bzhengs pa'i rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi dkar chag zhib tu 'god pa la/ 'di'i chos tshan gyi sgrig rim ni/ spyir chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i rim pa dang mthun par bka' dang po bden bzhi'i chos 'khor gyi khongs su gtogs pa 'dul ba lung sde bzhi dang por 'god pa'i lugs dang / theg pa mtho dman gyi dbang du byas nas rgyud sde'i skor rnams dang por bkod de / rim par theg pa che chung gi sde snod rnams go rim ltar 'god pa'i 785—483

lugs gnyis mchis pa las/ 'dir gnyis pa'i dbang du byas te bkod yod pa 'di ltar/thog mar gsang sngags rgyud 'bum gyi skor la/ o pa la/ gsang sngags rgyud sde bzhi'i gzungs sngags dang snying po byin brlabs can rnams phyogs gcig tu rin po che bu ston pas bkod pa stod na bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan 'bum mang po dang bcas pa bzhugs/ka pa la/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa/ sgra bsgyur gyi lots+tsha ba blo gros brtan pas/ bsam gtan gling gi dben gnas su legs par bsgyur cing dag par byas pa/ dbang mdor bstan pa/ kha che'i paṇa ḍi ta so ma nā tha dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba 'bro dge slong shes rab grags pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa las/ slar yang sgra tshad pa rin chen rgyal mtshan gyis/ dpal nā ro pa'i 'grel bshad dang mthun par bsgyur cing zhus te dag par byas pa/ mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas las phyung ba rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal dus kyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba/ kha che'i paṇa ḍi ta so ma nā tha dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba 'bro dge slong shes rab grags kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa las/ dus phyis yon tan phul du byung ba dpag tu med pas spras pa'i bla ma dam pa chos kyi rgyal po'i bka' lung dang / dpon chen shākya bzang po'i gsung bzhin du/ mkhas pa chen po zhang ston mdo sde dpal dang / dus kyi 'khor lo'i tshul khong du chud pa'i dge slong tshul khrims dar gyis don gyi cha la legs par dpyad cing bskul te/ legs par sbyar ba'i skad kyis brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos rig pa'i dge slong shong ston gyis dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang chen por 105—484

yul dbus kyi rgya dpe gnyis la gtugs shing legs par bcos te gtan la phab/slar yang dpal ldan bla ma dam pa chos kyi rje thams cad mkhyen pa dang / dpal dus kyi 'khor lo pa chen po dharma shīrti shrī bha dras/ 'di'i don rnams legs par dgongs shing bka' yis bskul nas de dag gi gsung bzhin du/ paṇa ḍi ta chen po sbi ra ma ti'i bka' drin las/ legs par sbyar ba'i tshul rig pa lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong blo gros rgyal mtshan dang / blo gros dpal bzang pos/ rgyud dang 'grel ba'i rgya dpe mang po la gtugs nas/ dag pa rnams dang mthun par bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud phyi ma rgyud kyi snying po zhes bya ba/ shākya'i dge slong dhar ma grags kyis bsgyur ba/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi snying po/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī bha dra bo dhi la sogs pa'i zhal snga nas dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba gyi jo ban+de zla ba'i 'od zer gyis 'bro dge slong gi phyir bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ dbang gi rab tu byed pa/ rgya gar gyi paṇa ḍi ta mkhas pa chen po sa man ta shrī dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong chos rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ dpal sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ mkha' 'gro ma sgyu ma bde ba'i mchog ces bya ba'i rgyud bla ma 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ rtog pa thams cad 'dus pa zhes bya ba sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ mkha' 'gro ma sgyu ma bde ba'i mchog gi rgyud phyi ma'i phyi ma rtog pa bco brgyad pa nas nyi shu rtsa gnyis yan gsal ba / rgya gar gyi mkhan po smṛ ti dzñā na kirti nyid kyis bsgyur/ yon bdag bod kyi mkhan po gzhon nu grags pas zhus nas bshad nas gtan la phab cing zhus/kye'i rdo rje zhes bya ba rgyud kyi rgyal po/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ghā ya dha ra'i zhal snga 185—485

nas / bod kyi lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab / slar yang lots+tsha ba gzhon nu dpal gyis 'gyur chad bsabs shing dag par bgyis pa/ 'phags pa mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po'i brtag pa le'u bco lnga pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po gha ya dha ra dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba/ dpal phyag rgya chen po'i thig le zhes bya ba rnal 'byor ma chen mo'i rgyud kyi rgyal po'i mnga' bdag le'u nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa/rgya gar gyi slob dpon rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po/ dpal shes rab gsang ba'i zhal sngar/ kum chos kyi ye shes dang / phyug mtshams dgra bcom gyis dad cing gus pas zhus te bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa bcas bzhugs/kha pa la/ dpal ye shes snying po zhes bya ba rnal 'byor ma chen mo'i rgyud kyi rgyal po'i rgyal po le'u bzhi pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dpal shes rab gsang ba'i zhal snga nas bsgyur ba/ dpal ye shes thig le rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po mchog tu rmad du byung ba zhes bya ba le'u sum cu pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po shrī pradzñā gupa tas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/ slad kyis dpal sa skya'i dben gnas su zhu thig g.yar khral bgyis pa/ dpal de kho na nyid kyi sgron ma zhes bya ba'i rnal 'byor chen mo'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po pradzñā shrī gup+tas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/ dus phyis dpal sa skya'i dben gnas su bsgyur cing zhus te dag par byas pa/ rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal bde mchog nyung ngu zhes bya ba le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa/ mkhas pa pad ma ka ra'i zhal sngar / lo tsā ba rin chen bzang pos kha che'i dpe las bsgyur ba la/ phyis lo tsā ba pradzñā kirti dang / mar pa sgra bsgyur chos kyi dbang phyug gis yul dbus kyi dpe 185—486

dang gtugs te bcos pa/ mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma zhes bya ba le'u drug cu rtsa dgu pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dī pang ka ra shrī dzñā na dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba chen po dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/ phyis paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dzñā na shrī dang / lots+tsha ba khyung po chos kyi brtson 'grus kyis kyang zhus/ phyis paṇ+ḍi ta ā nan ta dang / lo chung gis chad lhag rnams bsabs nas zhus dag byas nas legs par bcos te gtan la phab pa / rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro zhes bya ba le'u lnga bcu pa/rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po gha ya dha ra dang / bod kyi zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba 'gos lhas btsas kyis bsgyur cing zhus te dpe gnyis la gtugs nas gtan la phab pa bcas bzhugs/ga pa la/ dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho chen po rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa/ rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po rdo rje slob dpon rtog ge pa rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu dus deng sang 'gran zla med pa/ dpal rdo rje phag mo'i zhabs kyi chu skyes kyi rdul la reg pa shākya'i sras po rgyal ba'i sde'i zhal snga nas dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba shākya'i dge slo nga dharmā yon tan gyis mnyan cing bsgyur ba/ dpal bde mchog 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po rim par phye ba sum cu rtsa gsum pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po gzhan la phan pa mtha' yas dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba rgyus ban de smon lam grags kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ slar yang yongs su rdzogs pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shrī pa na rat+na'i rgya dpe la gtugs nas lots+tsha ba gzhon nu dpal gyis zhus pa/ dpal khrag 'thung mngon par 'byung ba zhes bya ba le'u bzhi bcu rtsa lnga pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇ+ḍi 185—487

ta chen po ā dwa ya badz+ra dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba chings yon tan 'bar gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ phag mo mngon par brjod pa bshad pa'i rgyud kyi phyi ma las/ phag mo mngon par byang chub zhes bya ba/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzñā na kā ra'i zhal snga nas dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba khu ston dngos grub kyis bsgyur te gtan la phab pa/ rnal 'byor ma'i kun tu spyod pa le'u bcu bdun pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ rnal 'byor ma bzhi'i kha sbyor gyi rgyud ces bya ba brtag pa bdun pa/ bod kyi lo tsā ba chings yon tan 'bar gyis bsgyur te/ slad kyis de nyid kyi tshe paṇ+ḍi ta gnyis la'ang gtugs te gtan la phab pa/ rig pa 'dzin pa rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po mkhas pa chen po dzā ya se na'i zhabs dang / lots+tsha ba btsun pa dharma yon tan gyis bsgyur ba/yang dag par sbyor ba zhes bya ba'i rgyud chen po brtag pa bcu pa brtag pa re re la rab byed bzhi bzhi yod pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta gā ya dha ra dang / bdag nyid chen po 'brog mi shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba las/ slad kyis thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston zhabs kyis rgya dpe rtsa 'grel dang bstun nas hor kong bsabs shing 'gyur bcos legs par mdzad pa las bris pa/ dpal yang dag par sbyor ba'i thig le zhes bya ba/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po kā ya s+tha pa ga ya dha ra'i zhal snga nas dang /bod kyi lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur cing zhus te/ gtan la phab pa bcas bzhugs/nga pa la/ dpal gsang ba rdo rje rgyud kyi rgyal po/ paṇa ḍi ta rad na badz+ra dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur te gtan la phab pa/ dpal gsang ba thams cad gcod pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ paṇa ḍi ta gā ya dha ra dang /185—488

lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ paṇa ḍi ta gā ya dha ra dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba/ dpal nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba/ paṇa ḍi ta gā ya dha ra dang / dge slong shākya ye shes kyis zhus shing bsgyur ba/ dpal nam mkha' chen po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ dpal sku gsung thugs kyi rgyud kyi rgyal po/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po gā ya dha ra dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba/ dpal sku gsung thugs kyi rgyud kyi rgyal po / paṇa ḍi ta gā ya dha ra dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba/dpal rin chen phreng ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po rin chen rdo rje dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/dpal dam tshig chen po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po gā ya dha ra dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba/ dpal stobs po che'i rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba le'u lnga pa/ paṇa ḍi ta gā ya dha ra dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba/ dpal ye shes gsang ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/rnal 'byor ma tsan dra mā le dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba/dpal ye shes phreng ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ rnal 'byor ma tsan dra mā le dang /dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba/ dpal ye shes 'bar ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/sing ga la'i gling gi rnal 'byor ma tsan dra mā le dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba/ dpal zla ba'i phreng ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po gā ya dha ra dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba/dpal rin chen 'bar ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba/ rnal 'byor ma zla ba'i 105—489

phreng ba dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ dpal nyi ma'i 'khor lo'i rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po gā ya dha ra dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/ dpal ye shes rgyal po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po gā ya dha ra dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba/ dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po gā ya dha ra dang /lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba/ dpal gsang ba me 'bar ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ paṇa ḍi ta gā ya dha ra dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba/ dpal gsang ba bdud rtsi'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po gā ya dha ra dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba/ dpal dur khrod rgyan gyi rgyud kyi rgyal po/ paṇa ḍi ta gā ya dha ra dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba/ dpal rdo rje rgyal po chen po'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor ma tsan dra mā le dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba/ dpal ye shes bsam pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ paṇa ḍi ta gā ya dha ra dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba/ dpal chags pa'i rgyal po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/rnal 'byor ma tsan dra mā le dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba/dpal mkha' 'gro ma'i sdom pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po gā ya dha ra dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba/ dpal mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba 'bar ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po gā ya dha ra dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed rnam par 'joms pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ paṇa ḍi ta gā ya dha ra dang /185—490

lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba/ dpal me'i phreng ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po / rgya gar gyi mkhan po gā ya dha ra dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur cing zhus pa/ dpal rdo rje grub pa dra ba'i sdom pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po / rgya gar gyi mkhan po gā ya dha ra dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur cing zhus pa/ dpal stobs chen ye shes rgyal po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po gā ya dha ra dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba/dpal 'khor sdom pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po dur khrod kyi rgyan rmad du byung ba zhes bya ba/paṇa ḍi ta gā ya dha ra dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba/rgyud kyi rgyal po rtog pa med pa zhes bya ba/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇa ḍi ta gā ya dha ra dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba/ dpal bde mchog nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba le'u gsum pa/ kha che'i mkhan po dzñā na badz+ras rang 'gyur du mdzad pa/ mkha' 'gro ma thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes rdo rje phag mo mngon par 'byung ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba dang / de'i rgyud phyi ma bsdoms pa'i le'u bcu gnyis pa/ paṇa ḍi ta gā ya dha ra'i zhal snga nas/ lots+tsha ba gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer gyis bsgyur ba/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po khros pa'i mgon po gsang ba dngos grub 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i rgyud le'u nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta a bha yā ka ra gup+ta'i zhal snga nas dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba mkhas pa chen po khe'u rgang 'khor lo grags kyis bsgyur cing zhus/ yang slad nas mkhas pa chen po sangs rgyas grags pa'i spyan sngar kre bo shes rab dpal gyis kyang zhu tig bgyis pa/ dpal sangs rgyas thod pa zhes bya ba rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi 185—491

rgyal po le'u bcu bzhi pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī gā ya dha ra dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa sgyu 'phrul chen po'i rgyud ces bya ba le'u gsum pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na pa ra dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba chen po 'gos lhas btsas kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ rdo rje ā ra li zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po le'u bcu pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po kā ya stu pa gha ya dha ra'i zhal snga nas dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ ri gi ā ra li'i rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba le'u lnga pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po kā ya stu pa gha ya dha ra'i zhal snga nas dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po dpal gdan bzhi pa zhes bya ba/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po gā ya dha ra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba 'gos khug pa lhas btsas kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ dpal gdan bzhi pa'i bshad pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po sngags kyi cha zhes bya ba le'u bdun pa/rgya gar gyi mkhan po gha ya dha ra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba 'gos khug pa lhas btsas kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ dpal gdan bzhi pa'i rnam par bshad pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba le'u brgya dang gsum/ paṇ+ḍi ta smri ti dzñā na krirtis gsar du bsgyur nas bshad cing gtan la phab/ slad nas bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa'i thugs dam rgyud 'bum dang dpe gsar rnying dag dang yang gtugs te/ sdebs zhus dang bcas pa ches shin tu dag par bgyis pa/dpal gtum po khro bo chen po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba rim par phye ba nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta rat+na shrī'i zhal snga nas/ lots+tsha ba grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis 185—492

bsgyur ba bcas bzhugs jo——————————————————— ———————ca pa la/ 'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i rtog pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po le'u bdun pa/paṇ+ḍi ta a tu la dha sa badz+ra dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba mar pa ban+de chos kyi dbang phyug grags pas bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i gsang rgyud chen po le'u bzhi pa/khro bo'i rgyal po thams cad gsang sngags gsang ba'i rgyud ces bya ba le'u lnga pa/rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rgyud le'u bcu gcig pa/ rigs kyi 'jig rten mgon po lnga bcu pa zhes bya ba/ paṇa ḍi ta chen po bi ma la shrī bha dra'i zhal snga nas/ shud ke grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba/ 'phags ma sgrol ma ku ru ku l+le'i rtog pa rtog pa lnga pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po kriṇ+ḍa paṇ+ḍi ta dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis bstod pa gsungs pa/ rdo rje phur pa rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi dum bu/ slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas dngos kyi rgya dpe dang mthun par/ sa skya paṇa ḍi tas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/nag po chen po zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po le'u lnga bcu pa/ pha rgyal khams pas zhus pa'i don du/ paṇ+ḍi ta chen po sa man+ta shrī dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba rwa dge slong chos rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ ji bzhin brnyes pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud le'u lnga pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po tāk+ṣa ka ga ṇa dang / lots+tsha ba mang 'or dge slong byang chub shes rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi gsang chen gsang ba 'dus pa zhes bya ba brtag pa'i rgyal po chen po le'u bcu bdun pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrad+dha ka ra warma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba dge 105—493

slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/ slad kyis paṇa ḍi ta bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po rje btsun nyi ma'i dbang po'i zhal snga nas/ chag lo tsā ba dge slong chos rje dpal gyis gus pas zhus shing dag par bcos te gtan la phab/ de'i rgyud phyi ma zur du phyung ba le'u bco brgyad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po a tsār+ya shrad+dha ka ra wasgro dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur te gtan la phab pa/ rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba mngon par brjod pa rgyud thams cad kyi snying po gsang ba rnam par phye ba zhes bya ba le'u drug cu rtsa brgyad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su dza na shrī dzñā na dang / sgra bsgyur gyi lots+tsha ba chen po bod kyi lha btsan po bla ma dge slong zhi ba'i 'od kyi zhal snga nas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ dgongs pa lung bstan pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud le'u bcu gnyis pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharma shrī bha dra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzñā na ka ra'i zhal snga nas dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba khu ston dngos grub kyis bsgyur/slad nas bla ma de nyid dang / dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas zhus shing gtan la phab pa/ lha mo bzhis yongs su zhus pa le'u bzhi pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po smri ti dzñā na kirti nyid kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ dpal rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud ces bya ba le'u bcu bdun pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ka ma la gup+ta dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba chen po mnga' bdag lha ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa bzhugs/cha pa la/ 'phags pa gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid rnam par rgyal ba zhes 185—494

bya ba'i rtog pa'i rgyal po chen po le'u nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa/ mkhan chen thar pa lots+tsha ba'i phyag dpe'i gseb nas shog yar lnga byung ba sngar bsgyur ba las/ phyis nying stod smon gro'i gtsug lag khang nas/ rgya dpe lhag ma rnams rnyed nas bsgyur bar rtsom pa na/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi tshul la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs me thob pa'i bla ma yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po / legs par sbyar ba'i skad kyi brda sprod pa'i tshul la blo gros shin tu byang ba'i 'jig rten gyi mig chos grags dpal bzang po'i bkas bskul zhing / sbyin bdag mdzad nas/ bu ston gyis bsgyur ba/ dpal de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba rnal 'byor chen po rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba mnyam pa nyid gnyis su med pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ rdo rje dpal mchog chen po brtag pa dang po le'u bdun cu rtsa bdun pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dpal ye shes snying po dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba mar pa lho brag pa chos kyi blo gros kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa / paṇa ḍi ta mkhas pa chen po smri ti dzñā na khrir tas rang 'gyur byas pa cig kyang yod par gda'/ rgyud 'di u rgyan nas slob dpon chen po khom bi he ru gas gdan drangs gsung ngo / /'phags pa lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can drag po gsum 'dul ba zhes bya ba'i rgyud/ bal po'i paṇa ḍi ta de ba pur t+ta ma ti dang /lots+tsha ba dge slong chos kyi bzang pos bsgyur ba/ gsang ba'i rgyud rnams kyi rnam par 'byed pa drag po gsum 'dul zhes bya ba/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po de ba puts+tsha ma ti dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong chos kyi bzang pos bsgyur ba/ lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi cho ga rdo rje be con gyi rgyud le'u bco lnga pa/ de'i bshad rgyud rdo rje gdengs pa'i rgyud las khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i le'u/ paṇa ḍi ta a ḍa 105wa 495

ya shrī ma ti zhes bya ba dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba ban de chos kyi dbang phyug grags kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ dpal rdo rje gtum po thugs gsang ba'i rgyud le'u nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po a ba yu gha ta'i zhal snga nas zhus nas/ bod kyi lots+tsha ba chos kyi brtson 'grus kyis bsgyur ba/ dpal rdo rje gtum po thugs gsang ba'i rgyud phyi ma le'u bcu bzhi pa/ rgya gar gyi slob dpon a ba yu ga ti la dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba bla ban chos kyi brtson 'grus kyis zhus te bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa/ dpal rdo rje gtum po thugs gsang ba'i rgyud phyi ma'i phyi ma le'u brgyad pa/ rgya gar gyi slob dpon a ba yu ga ti la dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba bla ban chos kyi brtson 'grus kyis zhus te bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa/rmi lam mthong ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ja pa la/ phyag na rdo rje gos sngon can gnod sbyin drag po chen po rdo rje me lce'i rgyud ces bya ba le'u bco lnga pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po rad na khrir ti dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba dge tshul khyung grags kyis bka' drin mnos nas rgya dpe bod du spyan drangs te bsgyur ba/ dpal phyag na rdo rje gsang ba bstan pa'i rgyud le'u bdun pa/ rgya gar gyi paṇa ḍi ta wa la tsan dra dang / lots+tsha ba glan chung dar ma tshul khrims kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje gsang ba mngon par bstan pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po wa la tsan dra gu ru chen po dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba glan chung dar ma tshul khrims kyis byang phyogs sham bha la'i dpe dang bstun te bsgyur/ slad kyis yul dbus kyi dpe dang / kha che nas byung ba dang bstun nas legs par gtan la phab pa/ rdo rje snying po rdo rje lce dbab pa zhes bya ba'i 185—496

gzungs / 'di dang po ska cog gis bsgyur zhing / phyis gnyan lots+tsha ba dharma grags kyis kyang bsgyur ba/ rdo rje bde khros rgyud kyi rgyal po le'u bcu bdun pa/dzñā na kā ras bsgyur ba/ rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po sgyu 'phrul dra ba zhes bya ba le'u bcu pa/ zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs gshin rje gshed nag po zhes bya ba'i rgyud le'u bco brgyad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po mkhas pa dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/ slad kyis lots+tsha ba dge slong dar ma grags kyis bcos la/ de las kyang dge slong rdo rje grags kyis bcos pa/gshin rje gshed nag po'i 'khor lo las thams cad grub par byed pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ paṇ+ḍi ta bā ro phyag rdum gyi zhal snga nas rwa rdo rje grags kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud chen po zhes bya ba rtog pa bdun pa/ rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa bā ro phyag rdum gyi zhal snga nas dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba dge slong rdo rje grags kyis bsgyur ba/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rtog pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po le'u bzhi pa/paṇa ḍi ta chen po a mo gha'i zhabs nus pa can dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba mar pa ban dhe chos kyi dbang phyug grags pas bsgyur cing zhus pa/ dpal gshin rje'i gshed nag po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po rtog pa gsum pa zhes bya ba/ gtam rgyud kyi rtog pa / thar chen rgyal rigs kyis zhus chen bgyis pas dag /dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po zhes bya ba rgyud kyi rgyal po rim par phye ba bcu dgu pa/ shākya'i dge slong tsan dra shrī'i zhal snga nas zhus shing / paṇa ḍi ta chen po tsan dra khrir ti 105—497

————— ——— —————— ——————— ———————————wa wa dang / yar lungs pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bal yul yam bu'i grong khyer du bsgyur ba/ dpal bcom ldan 'das ral pa gcig pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po zhes bya ba/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po shrī dza ga ta mi tra ā nan da'i bka' drin la brten nas rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po badz+ra shrī kha la ru tra dang /bod kyi lots+tsha ba dge slong byams pa'i dpal gyis bsgyur ba/ dpal zla gsang thig le zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po/ zhus chen gyi lots+tsha ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa bcas bzhugs/nya pa la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi de kho na nyid bsdus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgyud 'di la 'gyur byang mi snang na'ang / paṇ+ḍi ta shrad+dhā ka ra wasgro dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba rin chen bzang pos bsgyur bar grags shing rgyud dpe rnying 'gyur mi 'dra ba gsum bstun te zhus dag bsgrubs pa/gsang ba rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud rdo rje rtse mo bam po bcu gnyis pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po rdo rje slob dpon chen po kurma badz+ra'i zhal snga nas dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong gzhon nu tshul khrims kyis bsgyur cing zhus pa/ thams cad gsang ba zhes bya ba rgyud kyi rgyal po/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pad ma kā ra bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa bcas bzhu/ dī/ la/ 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba rtog pa'i rgyal po chen po 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i rtog pa zhes bya ba bam po gsum pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shārnyi gar+bha dang /185—498

bod kyi lots+tsha ba ban+de dza ya rak+ṣi tas bsgyur cing zhus/ ā tsar+ya rin chen mchog gis skad gsar bcad kyis bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i brtag pa phyogs gcig pa zhes bya ba/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bla ma rje btsun chen po re ben+d+ra de ba'i zhabs dang / bla ma paṇa chen skyes bu chen po mā ṇi ka shrī dzñā na'i zhal snga nas/ gus par mnyan te chag lots+tsha ba shākya'i dge slong chos rje dpal gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa rab du gnas pa mdor bsdus pa'i rgyud/ kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dzñā na badz+ra dang /lots+tsha ba 'bro dge slong shes rab grags pas bsgyur ba/ dpal mchog dang po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i rtog pa'i rgyal po/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ā tsar+ya shrad+dha ka ra bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ dpal mchog dang po'i sngags kyi rtog pa'i dum bu zhes bya ba / rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta mkhas pa chen po man+t+ra kā la sha dang / sgra bsgyur gyi lo tsā ba lha btsan po dge slong bla ma zhi ba'i 'od kyi zhal snga nas/ bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul brgya lnga bcu pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba rgyan gyi bkod pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/rgya gar gyi mkhan po brda sprod pa chen po bde bar gshegs pa'i dpal zhes bya ba dang / sgra bsgyur gyi mkhas pa sgra yi gzhung lugs la blo gros dkar ba kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis dpal sa skya'i dben gnas dam par bsgyur ba bcas bzhugs/tha pa la/ dpal rdo rje snying po rgyan ces bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po/105—499

dpal ldan chos rje yis bsgyur ba las cung zad ma rdzogs pa/ dpal ldan blo gros brtan pas rdzogs par bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa sgo nyi shu rtsa lnga pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ skad gsar chad kyis bcos nas gtan la phab ces pa las 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa gsang ba nor bu thig le zhes bya ba'i mdo/ mkhas pa bde bar gshegs pa'i dpal dang / sgra rig smra ba kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba/ rnam par snang mdzad chen po mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa rnam par sprul pa byin gyis rlob pa/ shin tu rgyas pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs / rgya gar gyi mkhan po shi len dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi khro bo'i rgyal po mi g.yo ba de'i stobs dpag tu med pa brtul phod pa 'dul bar gsungs pa zhes bya ba'i rtog pa/ me nyag rgyal po'i bka' lung gis / rgya gar gyi mkhan po u la shra rak+ṣi ta'i zhal snga nas/ lots+tsha ba glan dge slong dharma blo gros kyis bsgyur cing zhus pa/ bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi rgyud ces bya ba le'u bcu gsum pa/ kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta tse lu dang /bod kyi lots+tsha ba 'phags pa shes rab kyis bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can rdo rje sa 'og ces bya ba'i rgyud le'u bdun pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra dang / sgra bsgyur gyi lots+tsha ba dge slong bya'i gdong pa can gyis bsgyur ba bcas bzhugs/da pa la/ 'phags pa lag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud chen po/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī len+d+ra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes 105—500

bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa rdotā ༵ gsum— bye —bye shā —rterte ༵ ———rte rte wa pa'i rgyal po rtog pa lnga pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ku ma ra badz+ra dang / ra byid lots+tsha bas bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi cho ga zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba rgya brtson 'grus seng ges dpal na len dra'i sgo 'gram du bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can zhes bya ba 'jig rten gsum 'dul ba'i rgyud le'u lnga pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba/ dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba'i rgyud/rgya gar gyi mkhan po krit+ta paṇ+ḍi ta dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa zhes bya ba'i theg pa chen po'i mdo/ bam po gnyis pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / shi len+d+ra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla bai drur+ya'i 'od kyi sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa zhes bya ba'i theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / shi len+d+ra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs bskyed pa be+e drur+ya'i 'od ces bya ba'i gzungs / rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / shi len+d+ra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la 105—501
