phab / slad kyis rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang / dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas tho lding gser khang du/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang gtan la phab pa / 'phags pa nor bu chen po rgyas pa'i gzhal med khang shin tu rab tu gnas pa gsang ba dam pa'i gsang ba'i cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po zhes bya ba'i gzungs bam po gnyis dang le'u bdun pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bit+yā garba pra bha dang / lots+tsha ba ban dhe dpal gyi lhun pos bsgyur cing / slad nas rgya gar gyi mkhan po bit+yā ka ra pra bha dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe dpal brtsegs kyis zhus te gtan la phab pa bcas bzhugs/na pa la/ byang chub kyi snying po'i rgyan 'bum gyi gzungs 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa / mchod rten gcig btab na bye ba btab par 'gyur ba'i gzungs 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis rlabs kyi snying po gsang ba'i ring bsrel gyi za ma tog ces bya ba'i gzungs/paṇa ḍi ta bibyā ka ra pra bha dang / lots+tsha ba tsangs de ben+d+ra rak+ṣi tas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa'i mdo chen po/ paṇa ḍi ta su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa shākya thub pa'i snying po'i gzungs / 'phags pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs/'phags pa rgyal ba'i bla ma'i gzungs/ 'phags pa las kyi sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ bde ldan gyi snying po/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs bcas la 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi chos kyi rnam grangs/185—502

rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yan lag dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang /zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas bcu gnyis pa zhes bya ba'i theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas bdun pa zhes bya ba'i theg pa chen po'i mdo/ bcom ldan 'das snang ba mtha' yas kyi gzungs sngags / snang ba mtha' yas rjes su dran pa/ zla ba'i 'od kyi mtshan rjes su dran pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa spyi'i snying po rjes su dran pa/ sangs rgyas rin chen gtsug tor can gyi mtshan rjes su dran pa bcas la 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/'phags pa dri ma med pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa khyad par can zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa dkyil 'khor brgyad pa zhes bya ba'i theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing 185wa 503

zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa yi ge nyung ngu zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi ma la mi tra dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong rin chen sdes bsgyur cing / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba dge slong nam mkha' la sogs pas zhus te gtan la phab pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa/'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi rtsa ba'i rgyud le'u sum cu rtsa drug pa/ dpal lha btsan po lha btsun pa byang chub 'od kyi bkas/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dge bsnyen chen po ku mā ra ka la sha dang / sgra bsgyur gyi lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya blo gros kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa bcas bzhugs/pa pa la/ dpa' bo gcig bu grub pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po le'u bzhi pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang / lots+tsha ba dge ba'i blo gros kyis bsgyur/ dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas gtan la phab pa/bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jam dpal rnon po la bstod pa/ 'jam dpal ngag gi dbang phyug la bu mo brgyad kyis bstod pa/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi zhal nas gsungs pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzñā na gar+bha dang / lots+tsha ba ban de klu'i dbang pos bsgyur/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi shud+dha sing ha dang /zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de de ba tsan+d+ras gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis dmod btsugs pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'jam dpal gyis dam bcas pa'i gzungs/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan/ rje btsun 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi shes rab dang blo 'phel ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa 105—504

'jam dpal gyi sngags yi ge 'bru gcig pa'i tshig /'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa kau shi ka zhes bya ba/ 'phags pa gser 'od dam pa mchog tu rnam par rgyal ba'i mdo sde'i rgyal po theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po bcu dang le'u sum cu rtsa gcig pa/ zhu chen gyi mkhan po dang / lots+tsha ba bcom ldan 'das kyi ring lugs pa ban de chos grub kyis rgya'i dpe las bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/'phags pa gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po zhes bya ba'i theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po bcu dang le'u nyi shu rtsa dgu pa/ paṇa ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang /shī len dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis gtan la phab pa bcas bzhugs/pha pa la/ 'phags pa gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po zhes bya ba'i theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po lnga dang le'u nyi shu rtsa gcig pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ stong chen po rab tu 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shī len+d+ra bo dhi dang / dzñā na sid+dhi dang / shākya pra bha dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/ slar yang lo tsā ba gzhon nu dpal gyis phyag lo'i rgya dpe dang bstun nas dag par bgyis pa/ rig sngags kyi rgyal po rma bya chen mo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shī len+d+ra bo dhi dang / dzñā na sid+dhi dang / shākya pra bha dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa rig sngags kyi rgyal mo so sor 'brang ba chen mo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen 185—505

gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes zhus te skad gsar bcad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ bsil ba'i tshal chen po'i mdo/ gsang sngags chen po rjes su 'dzin pa'i mdo/ paṇ+ḍi ta shī len+d+ra bo dhe dang / dzñā na sirnyi dang / shākya pra bha dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags ma 'od zer can zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ paṇa ḍi ta a mo gha badz+ra dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong ba ri rin chen grags pas bsgyur ba/ sgyu ma'i 'od zer can 'byung ba'i rgyud las phyung ba'i rtog pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba/ 'phags ma 'od zer can gyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'od zer can 'byung ba'i rgyud stong phrag bcu gnyis pa las phyung ba'i rtog pa'i snying po bdun brgya pa zhes bya ba/ 'phags pa par+ṇa sha ba ri'i mdo/ 'phags pa ri khrod lo ma gyon pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'phags ma rdo rje lu gu rgyud ma'i rgyud kyi rtog pa le'u bzhi pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta a tu la dha sa badz+ra la zhus nas bod kyi lots+tsha ba mar pa chos kyi dbang phyug grags pas bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa lha mo bskul byed ma zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa dug sel zhes bya ba'i rig sngags/ 'phags pa dbyig dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa grags ldan ma'i gzungs/ 'phags pa rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo rgyal ba can zhes bya ba/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa rgyal ba can zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya'i yang snying 185—506

zhes bya ba/ 'phags rig sngags kyi rgyal mo sgron ma mchog gi gzungs/ 'phags pa lha mo brgyad kyi gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shī len+d+ra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs rtog pa dang bcas pa/ 'phags pa ngan 'gro thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang /su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i gzungs zhes bya ba'i rtog pa dang bcas pa/ ne'u mkhan po'i gsung bzhin du / mang du thos pa'i lo tsā ba gnas brtan dpal nyi ma rgyal mtshan bzang pos bsgyur ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i gzungs zhes bya ba'i rtog pa dang bcas pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor nas byung ba gdugs dkar mo can zhes bya ba gzhan gyis mi thub ma phyir zlog pa'i rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gzhan gyis mi thub ma phyir zlog pa chen mo mchog tu grub pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ paṇ+ḍi ta pa ri ha ta bha dra dang / lo tsā ba gzu dga' rdor gyis kha che'i bdud rtsi 'byung gnas kyi gtsug lag khang gi dpe rnying la gtugs nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gzhan gyis mi thub ma zhes bya ba'i gzungs/gtsug tor lha yul ma chung ba kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta ma hā dzñā nas rang 'gyur du mdzad pa/105—507

kun nas sgor 'jug pa'i 'od zer gtsug tor dri ma med par snang ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po dang / dam tshig la rnam par lta ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / shī len dra bo dhi dang /zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/'phags pa nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs/ 'phags pa thams cad nad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs/ 'phags pa rims nad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa / rims nad zhi ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa mig nad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i mdo/ 'brum bu'i nad zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs/ 'phags pa gzhang 'brum rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang /shī len dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa mi rgod rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/'phags pa bu mang po rton pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / shī len dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ stong 'gyur zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa ye shes ta la la zhes bya ba'i gzungs 'gro ba thams cad yongs su sbyong ba/'phags pa 'od zer dri ma med pa rnam par dag pa'i 'od ces bya ba'i gzungs/rgya gar gyi mkhan po bir+ya ka ra si ha dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe dpal gyi lhun po'i sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa la/ jo bo a ti sha dang /dge bshes 'brom ston pas sngags rnams dag par bcos pa/ shes pas thams 105—508

cad mthar phyin par grub pa'i mchod rten zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i snying po'i cho ga'i gzungs/ 'phags pa rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 'phags pa rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i snying po zhes bya ba/ rin po che bdar ba'i gzungs/gtsug tor 'bar ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ sman gtong ba'i tshe sman la sngags kyis gdab pa/ bskor ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa dkon mchog gi rten la bskor ba bya ba'i gzungs zhes bya ba/ yon yongs su sbyong ba zhes bya ba/ yon yongs su sbyong ba'i gzungs/ thos pa 'dzin pa'i gzungs/ thos pa 'dzin pa'i gzungs / shes rab bskyed pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzñā na gar+bha dang / lots+tsha ba ban de klu'i dbang pos bsgyur/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bibya ka ra si ha dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de de ba tsan dras zhus te gtan la phab pa / shes rab bskyed pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzñā na gar+bha dang / lots+tsha ba ban de klu'i dbang pos bsgyur/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bir+ya ka ra sau ha dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de de ba tsan dras zhus te gtan la phab pa/shes rab bskyed pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzñā na gar+bha dang /lots+tsha ba ban de klu'i dbang pos bsgyur/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bir+ya ka ra si ha dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de de ba tsan dras zhus te gtan la phab pa/ shu lo ka brgya lobs pa/ shu lo ka brgya lobs pa/ shu lo ka stong lobs pa'i gzungs / shu lo ka stong lobs pa'i gzungs/ shu lo ka stong lobs pa'i gzungs / shu lo ka sum stong lobs pa'i gzungs/ mi brjed pa'i gzungs/phyag bya ba'i gzungs/ gos brgya thob pa'i gzungs/ mi dga' bar byed pa'i 185—509

gzungs / 'phags pa pad ma'i spyan zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ skran zhi ba'i gzungs/ ma zhu ba'i nad 'byang ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa sdang ba thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs/ sdig pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/khro ba zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs/ 'phags pa khro ba zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs/tshig btsan pa'i gzungs/ bdag srung ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa yid du 'ong ba zhes bya ba/ mgrin pa snyan pa'i gzungs/ don thams cad grub pa'i gzungs / las grub pa'i gzungs/ dug zhi bar byed pa zhes bya ba/ bcings pa las grol ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa bdud thams cad skrag par byed pa zhes bya ba/ rma 'byor bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs sngags/ me'i zug rngu rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs/ mkhris pa'i nad sel ba'i sngags/ bad kun gyi nad sel ba'i gzungs sngags/ k+ṣa ya'i nad sel ba'i sngags/ 'phags pa rims dang srog chags kyis mi tshugs pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ stong chen mo nas phyung ba sman la sngags kyis gdab pa/ sman gtong ba'i tshe sman la sngags kyis gdab pa/ mchog thob pa'i rig sngags/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa'i gzungs/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa'i gzungs/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad stong pa'i gzungs/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi snying po'i gzungs/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug gzung bar 'gyur ba'i gzungs/ pha rol tu phyin pa bcu thob par 'gyur ba'i gzungs/ tshad med pa bzhi thob par 'gyur ba'i gzungs/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa gzung bar 'gyur ba'i gzungs/105—510

'phags pa phal po che gzung bar 'gyur ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa sdong po bkod pa'i snying po/ 'phags pa ting nge 'dzin rgyal po'i mdo gzung bar 'gyur ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa rma bya chen mo'i snying po/ 'phags ma so sor 'brang ma chen mo gzung bar 'gyur ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa lang kur gshegs pa mdo thams cad klags par 'gyur ba'i gzungs bcas bzhugs/ba pa la/ mchod pa'i sprin ces bya ba'i gzungs/ phyag /bstod pa/mchod pa/ mchod pa'i sprin/ mchod pa/ nye gnas/ zhabs la spyi bos phyag byas par 'gyur ba/ 'phags pa yon tan bsngags pa dpag tu med pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa chos thams cad kyi yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs/'phags pa phyir zlog pa stobs can zhes bya ba/ mdangs phyir mi 'phrog pa zhes bya ba/ 'phags pa rig sngags kyi rgyal po dbugs chen po zhes bya ba/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ khro bo rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa gsang ba'i rgyud le'u nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa/ 'phags pa gtsug gi nor bu zhes bya ba'i gzungs/rgya gar gyi mkhan po shī len dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa tsan dan gyi yan lag ces bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ phyir zlog pa 'phags pa rnam par rgyal ba can zhes bya ba/ 'phags pa mdangs phyir 'phrog pa zhes bya ba'i mdo/ gzhan gyis mi thub pa rin po che phreng ba zhes bya ba/ paṇa ḍi ta su ren dra bo dhe dang / zhu 185—511

chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/'phags pa gzhan gyis mi thub pa mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa zhes bya ba/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa gdon mi za ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs / gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i rig pa chen mo/ 'phags pa thams cad la mi 'jigs pa rab tu sbyin pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shrī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa dbang bskur ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang /dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa mig rnam par sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i rig sngags/ 'phags pa bar du gcod pa thams cad rnam par sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa bar du gcod pa thams cad sel ba'i gzungs sngags/'phags pa 'gro lding ba'i rig sngags kyi rgyal po/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'i dpung rgyan ces bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa sa'i 185—512

dbang po zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa be con chen po zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shrī la dang /zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa sgo bzang po zhes bya ba'i gzungs/rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa chos kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren dra bo dhi dang / pradzñā bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ tshigs su bcad pa gnyis pa'i gzungs/ 'phags pa sgo drug pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/'phags pa yi ge drug pa'i rig sngags/ 'phags pa gser can zhes bya ba'i gzungs / rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ snying rje'i mchog ces bya ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa me tog brtsegs pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa gzungs chen po/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa / 'phags pa mi g.yo ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs le'u dgu pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharma shrī mi tra dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba dge slong chos kyi bzang pos bsgyur 185—513

cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa rdo rje khro bo'i rgyal po'i rtog pa bsdus pa'i rgyud ces bya ba le'u bcu pa/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa/ 'phags pa byams pa'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa/ 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa/'phags pa lag na rdo rje'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa/'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa/ 'phags pa sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa/ 'phags pa sa'i snying po'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa zhes bya ba/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa zhes bya ba/ 'phags pa byams pas dam bcas pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po badz+ra pā ṇi dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa gnod 'dzin gyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ mdo chen po 'dus pa chen po'i mdo zhes bya ba/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / pradzñā bar ma dang /zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ mdo chen po kun du rgyu ba dang kun tu rgyu ba ma yin pa dang mthun pa'i mdo zhes bya ba/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / pradzñā bar ma dang /zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas/ bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la 185—514

phab pa/ 'phags pa sprin chen po/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / shī len dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar bcad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa sprin chen po rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi le'u klu thams cad kyi snying po zhes bya ba'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su rin dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa klu'i rgyal po gzi can gyis zhus pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ tshogs kyi bdag po chen po'i rgyud ces bya ba le'u bco lnga pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyis bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa tshogs kyi bdag po'i snying po/'phags ma gza' rnams kyi yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgyal blon byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sku ring la bsgyur ba las/ dus phyis dge bsnyen grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis dpal ldan sa skya'i dben gnas su rgya dpe la gtugs nas shin tu dag par byas pa/ gza' rnams kyi yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa nor gyi rgyun ces bya ba'i gzungs/ bcom ldan 'das ma nor rgyun ma'i rtog pa/bcom ldan 'das ma nor rgyun ma'i gzungs kyi rtog pa/ dpal nag po chen po'i rgyud le'u brgyad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po a mo gha badz+ra dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba phur bu 'od kyis bsgyur ba/ dpal mgon po nag po zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ lha mo nag mo chen mo'i gzungs/ 'phags pa nag po chen po'i gzungs rims nad thams cad las thar bar byed pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ dpal lha mo nag mo'i bstod pa rgyal po'i rgyud/ dpal lha mo nag mo'i mtshan brgya rtsa 105—515

brgyad pa/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis bstod pa/ 'phags pa ro langs bdun pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi shud+dha si ha dang / ban de ye shes snying po'i sdes bsgyur/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bibyā ka ra si ha dang /zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes zhus te gtan la phab pa/ su ru pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ ye shes skar mda'i snying po/ bdud rtsi 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs / yi dgas mo kha 'bar ma dbugs dbyung ba'i gtor ma'i cho ga /yi dgas kha nas me 'bar ba la skyabs mdzad pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'jur 'gegs zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur te gtan la phab pa/ lus kyi zag pa sbyin par btang ba'i gzungs/ bla ma rdo rje gdan pas mdo rgyud nas phyung ste/ ba ri lots+tsha bas bsgyur ba/ 'chi med rnga sgra'i gzungs/ tshe dpag med kyi snying po/ 'phags pa tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 'phags pa tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 'phags pa tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po purgya saṃ bha wa dang /lots+tsha ba pa tshab nyi ma grags kyis bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po pad ma dra ba zhes bya ba le'u bcu gnyis pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta so ma shrī bha bya dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba skyu ra tshul khrims 'od zer gyis bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa bcas bzhugs/ma pa la/ 'phags pa don yod pa'i zhags pa'i cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po bam po nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa/ 'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i snying po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po a mo gha badz+ra dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba dge 105—516

wa ————————————————slong rin chen grags pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par byed pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs / paṇ+ḍi ta mañdzu shrī warma dang / lots+tsha ba blo ldan shes rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/ lots+tsha ba chos kyi shes rab kyis kyang bsgyur te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug phyag stong spyan stong du sprul pa rgya chen po yongs su rdzogs pa/ thogs pa med par thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa'i gzungs/ 'phags pa byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug phyag stong spyan stong dang ldan pa thogs pa mi mnga' ba'i thugs rje chen po'i sems rgya cher yongs su rdzogs pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs bam po gsum pa/ zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de chos grub kyis/ rgya'i dpe las bsgyur te gtan la phab pa bcas bzhu/ dī/ la/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gsang ba'i mdzod thogs pa med pa'i yid bzhin gyi 'khor lo'i snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs le'u drug pa/ zhu chen gyi mkhan po dang lots+tsha ba bcom ldan 'das kyi ring lugs pa ban de chos grub kyis rgya'i dpe las bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gzungs zhes bya ba/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi snying po/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug zhal bcu gcig pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shī len+d+ra bo dhi dang /zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/'phags pa zhal bcu gcig pa'i rig sngags kyi snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ zhu chen gyi mkhan po dang lots+tsha ba bcom ldan 'das kyi ring lugs pa ban de chos grub 185—517

kyis rgya'i dpe las bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ pad ma cod pan zhes bya ba'i rgyud le'u bcu gcig pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta dharma shrī mi tra dang /bod kyi lots+tsha ba dge slong chos kyi bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/'jig rten dbang phyug gi rtog pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzam+bha la dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba dge slong ba ris bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa nī la kun ṭha zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug ha ya gri ba'i gzungs / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po'i gzungs phan yon mdor bsdus pa zhes bya ba/ dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba/'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ 'phags pa gnod 'dzin chu dbang snying rje can gyi gzungs bde byed ces bya ba/ klags pas grub pa bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma sor mo can zhes bya ba rig pa'i rgyal mo / 'phags pa lus kyi dbyibs mdzes pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ seng ge sgra'i rgyud ces bya ba/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta pradzñā ka ra dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba 'gos khug pa lhas btsas kyis zhus shing bsgyur te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug seng ge sgra'i gzungs zhes bya ba/ rje btsun ma rdo rje sems ma dang / sgra bsgyur gyi lots+tsha ba mgar shes rab 'byung gnas zhes bya bas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/705—518

seng ge sgra'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ngag gi dbang phyug dang / glog skya shes rab brtsegs kyis bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa snying rjes mi bshol ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs / rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yum sgrol ma las sna tshogs 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i rgyud le'u sum cu rtsa lnga pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharma shrī mi tra dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba dge slong chos kyi bzang pos bsgyur ba/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa zhes bya ba/ lha mo sgrol ma'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa zhes bya ba/'phags ma sgrol ma'i gzungs/ 'phags ma sgrol ma rang gis dam bcas pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'phags ma sgrol ma 'jigs pa brgyad las skyob pa'i mdo/'phags pa 'jigs pa chen po brgyad las sgrol ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ dpal lha mo sgra dbyangs la bstod pa/ 'phags pa lha mo chen mo dpal lung bstan pa/'phags pa dpal chen mo'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ dpal gyi lha mo'i mtshan bcu gnyis pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/'phags pa las kyi sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/'phags pa rig pa mchog gi rgyud chen po/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bit+yā ka ra pra bha dang / lots+tsha ba ban de dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur ba bcas bzhugs/tsha pa la/ 'phags pa rdo rje sa 'og gi rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba le'u nyi shu rtsa 185—519

lnga pa/ rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta brda' sprod pa chen po bde bar gshegs pa'i dpal zhes bya ba dang / sgra bsgyur gyi mkhas pa sgra'i gtsug lag la ma rmongs pa/gsang sngags 'dzin pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ dpal sa skya'i dben gnas dam par bsgyur ba/ 'byung po 'dul ba zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po rim par phye ba gnyis pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bud+dha ka ra bar ma dang /lots+tsha ba dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/'phags pa lag na rdo rje'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gsang sngags dang bcas pa/rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa rdo rje'i ri rab chen po'i rtse mo'i khang pa brtsegs pa'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shī len+d+ra bo dhi dang / dzñā na sirnyi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar bcad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa rdo rje mi pham pa me ltar rab tu rmongs byed ces bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar bcad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ rdo rje phra mo thogs pa med pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa lag na rdo rje bcu'i snying po/rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ rdo rje mchu zhes bya ba klu'i dam tshig /rdo rje gnam lcags mchu zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa lcags mchu zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa lcags kyi mchu zhes bya ba'i 105—520

gzungs / 'phags pa lcags mchu nag po/ 'phags pa stobs po che zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ mchod pa'i sprin ces bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shī len+d+ra bo dhi dang / dzi na mi tra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi gzungs zhes bya ba/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po don yod rdo rje'i zhal snga nas bsgyur nas/ bod kyi ban de skyo 'od 'byung la gnang ba/'phags pa bdud rtsi thabs sbyor gyi snying po bzhi pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ khro bo'i rgyal po sme brtsegs la bstod pa'i sngags/ 'phags pa bgegs sel ba'i gzungasal/ 'phags pa nor bu bzang po'i gzungs zhes bya ba/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bir+ya ka ra sing ha dang / lots+tsha ba ban dhe klu'i dbang pos bsgyur ba/gnod sbyin nor bu bzang po'i rtog pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta mañdzu shrī dang /bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong ba ris bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon gar mkhan mchog gi brtag pa/ 'phags pa gnod 'dzin dpal zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa gnod gnas dbang po ci ltar 'byung ba'i rtog pa zhes bya ba/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po sgeg pa'i rdo rje dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa rdo rje grags kyis bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa me kha la zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa dpung bzang gis zhus pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud le'u bcu gcig pa/ dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi spyi'i cho ga gsang ba'i rgyud/ bsam gtan gyi phyi ma rim par phye ba/legs par grub par byed pa'i rgyud chen po las sgrub pa'i thabs rim par phye ba/105—521

'phags pa dgongs pa'i rgyud kyi phreng ba chen po byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par nges pa chen po bstan pa las/ nor bu chen po rin po che la mkhas pa bstan pa yongs su bsngo ba chen po'i rgyal po zhes bya ba/ kha che'i mkhan po dharmā ka ra dang /lo tsā ba ban+de dpal 'byor gyis bsgyur/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bir+ya ka ra pra bha dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa yongs su bsngo ba'i rgyal po chen po sngags dang bcas pa/paṇa ḍi ta bibyā ka ra pra bha dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes snying po dang /dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ dpal legs par grub par byed pa yi rgyud chen po las 'byung ba'i smon lam/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rtog pa las smon lam 'byung ba/stong chen mo rab tu 'joms pa las gsungs pa'i smon lam/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo las gsungs pa'i smon lam dang bden tshig /sbyin pa'i rabs las 'byung ba'i smon lam/ 'phags pa yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa'i mdo las 'byung ba'i bde legs kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ bde legs kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ bde legs su 'gyur ba'i tshigs su bcad pa/ lhas zhus pa'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ dpal rnal 'byor gyi rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa lha sum bcu rtsa bdun gyi bkra shes kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ sangs rgyas rabs bdun gyi bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ rigs gsum gyi bkra shis/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/rigs gsum gyi bkra shis/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan 105—522

po dzi na mi tra dang / zhu chen gyilots+tshababawadeyishesaṅger+shar+sha(rte(washā rte gtan la phab pa/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa bcas bzhugs/dza pa la/ chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ de'i rgyud phyi ma/ phyi ma'i phyi ma bcas bsdoms pas le'u brgyad cu rtsa bzhi pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dpal gyi seng ge mgon po dang / dge slong bai ro tsā nas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo theg pa chen po mngon par rtogs pa chos kyi rnam grangs rnam par bkod pa zhes bya ba'i mdo/ bam po bcu dang sho lo ka nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gnyis/ le'u bdun cu rtsa lnga pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharma bo dhi dang / ring lugs pa chen po dā na rak+ṣi ta dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba che btsan skyes kyis bru sha'i yi ge las bru sha'i yul gyi khrom du bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba gsang ba'i mdzod chen po mi zad pa gter gyi sgron ma brtul zhugs chen po sgrub pa'i rgyud ye shes rngam pa glog gi 'khor lo theg pa chen po'i mdo le'u bcu bdun pa bcas bzhugs/wa pa la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po khro bo rdo rje'i rigs kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo rnal 'byor grub pa'i rgyud ces bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo le'u sum cu rtsa gsum pa/ dpal gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid rnam par nges pa le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa/ rdo rje sems 105—523

dpa'i sgyu 'phrul dra ba gsang ba thams cad kyi me long zhes bya ba'i rgyud le'u bcu gsum pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi ma la mi tra dang / ban+de dzñā na ku ma ras bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa le'u brgyad cu pa/ 'phags pa thabs kyi zhags pa pad mo'i phreng ba zhes bya ba le'u bzhi bcu pa bcas bzhugs/zha pa la/ lha mo sgyu 'phrul dra ba chen mo zhes bya ba'i rgyud le'u bcu gsum pa/gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa'i bla ma chen po le'u bcu gsum pa/'phags pa 'jam dpal las bzhi 'khor lo gsang ba'i rgyud/ de'i rgyud phyi ma dang bcas par le'u bcu bzhi pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dgongs pa bla na med pa gsang ba rta mchog rol pa'i rgyud chen po zhes bya ba le'u sum cu pa/dpal he ru ka snying rje rol pa'i rgyud gsang ba zab mo'i mchog ces bya ba le'u bcu bdun pa/ rgya gar gyi lots+tsha ba mkhas par lobs pa bal po shrī tī rtis gtan la phab ste skad gsar pas bsgyur ba/ thams cad bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin dngos grub chen po nye ba'i snying po mchog bam po chen po brgyad pa/ spyir bdud rtsi 'bum sde las nyung shas tsam zhig bi ma la mi tras bshad cing / lo tsā ba dzñā na ku ma ras bsgyur ba/ mkha' 'gro ma me lce 'bar ba'i rgyud le'u nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa / drag sngags 'dus pa rdo rje rtsa ba'i rgyud ces bya ba le'u bcu gcig pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba bdag bai ro tsā nas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyi bla'i phyag dpe las zhal bshus pa las brgyud pa/ 'jig rten mchod bstod sgrub pa rtsa ba'i rgyud ces bya ba le'u bcu gcig pa bcas bzhugs/105—524

za pa la/ ral pa gyen brjes kyi rtog pa chen po/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i rnam par 'phrul pa le'u rab 'byams las/ bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i rtsa ba'i rtog pa zhes bya ba/ jo bo chen po a ti sha'i phyag dpe rwa sgreng nas dka' thub chen pos gdan drangs nas/ shākya'i dge slong rin chen grub kyis bsgyur ba bzhugs/'a pa la/ spyan 'dren rgyud gsum pa/ 'phags pa dkon mchog ta la la'i gzungs zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa / 'phags pa ye shes ta la la zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa zhes bya ba'i mdo/ o gcig pa dang gnyis pa dang gsum pa dang gsum yod pa las/ o gsum pa 'di dag pa yin te/ 'di la tshe dpag med kyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa zhes zer ro/ /'di la yi ge brgya rtsa bcu yod pa ni klog pa'i ched du a gnyis dkyus su bcug pa yin no/ /'di rgya dpe dngos las bris so/ /'phags pa tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po purgya saṃ bha wa dang / lots+tsha ba pa tshab nyi ma grags kyis bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa yon tan bsngags pa dpag tu med pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas bdun pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdol/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas bcu gnyis pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi 105—525

chos kyi rnam grangs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang /zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yan lag dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa tsan dan gyi yan lag ces bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa rig sngags kyi rgyal po sgron ma mchog gi gzungs/ 'phags pa dbang bskur ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa shākya thub pa'i snying po'i gzungs/ 'phags pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla'i snying po'i gzungs/ 'phags pa rgyal ba'i bla ma'i gzungs/ bcom ldan 'das snang ba mtha' yas kyi gzungs sngags/ 'phags pa 'od dpag med mthong ba'i gzungs / 'phags pa pad ma'i spyan zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ snang ba mtha' yas rjes su dran pa/ zla ba'i 'od kyi mtshan rjes su dran pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa 185—526

spyi'i snying po rjes su dran pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa bcu'i snying po rjes su dran pa/sangs rgyas rin chen gtsug tor can gyi mtshan rjes su dran pa/ 'phags pa dri ma med pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shrī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa khyad par can zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang /zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa/ 'phags pa byams pa'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa/ 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa/'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa / 'phags pa lag na rdo rje'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa/ 'phags pa sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa/ 'phags pa sa'i snying po'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa/ 'phags pa dkyil 'khor brgyad pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ de bzhin 105—527

gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis rlabs kyi snying po gsang ba'i ring bsrel gyi za ma tog ces bya ba'i gzungs theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bir+ya ka ra pra bha dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe rtsangs de ben dra rak+ṣi tas bsgyur cing zhus pa/ shes pas thams cad mthar phyin par grub pa'i mchod rten zhes bya ba'i gzungs / 'phags pa nor bu chen po rgyas pa'i gzhal med khang shin tu rab tu gnas pa gsang ba dam pa'i gsang ba'i cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po zhes bya ba'i gzungs bam po gnyis dang le'u bdun pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bibyā gar+bha pra bha dang / lots+tsha ba ban dhe dpal gyi lhun pos bsgyur cing / slad nas rgya gar gyi mkhan po bit+yā ka ra pra bha dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe dpal brtsegs kyis zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa me tog brtsegs pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/'phags pa sa'i dbang po zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa gzungs chen po/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang /zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ bde ldan gyi snying po/ 'phags pa byams pas dam bcas pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po badz+ra pā ṇi dang /bod kyi lots+tsha ba dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa / 'phags pa sgrib pa rnam par sel ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi zhal nas gsungs pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzñā na gar+bha dang / lots+tsha ba ban de klu'i dbang pos bsgyur/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po 105—528

bi shud+dha sing ha dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe de ba tsan+d+ras gtan la phab pa/'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis dmod btsugs pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan/ rje btsun 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi shes rab dang blo 'phel ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sngags yi ge 'bru gcig pa'i cho ga /'phags pa byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong dang ldan pa thogs pa mi mnga' ba'i thugs rje chen po'i sems rgya cher yongs su rdzogs pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs bam po gsum pa/ zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de chos grub kyis rgya'i dpe las bsgyur te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gsang ba'i mdzod thogs pa med pa yid bzhin gyi 'khor lo'i snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs le'u drug pa/ zhu chen gyi mkhan po dang / lots+tsha ba bcom ldan 'das kyi ring lugs pa ban dhe chos grub kyis rgya'i dpe las bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs zhal bcu gcig pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ 'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i snying po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po a mo gha badz+ra dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba ba ri rin chen grags pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ sa bcu pa'i gzungs/ 'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i pha rol du phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par byed pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ paṇ+ḍi ta mañdzu shrī warma dang / lots+tsha ba blo ldan shes rab kyis bsgyur te gtan la phab/ lots+tsha ba chos kyi shes rab kyis kyang bsgyur te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po zhes bya ba'i gzungs / rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen 105—529

gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa nī la kun ṭha zhes bya ba'i gzungs/'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug ha ya spyi ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa me kha la zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ snying rjes mi bshol ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ spyan ras gzigs kyi yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs/rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gzungs zhes bya ba / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi snying po/ seng ge sgras dam bcas pa'i gzungs / rgya gar gyi mkhan po ngag gi dbang phyug dang / lots+tsha ba glog skya shes rab brtsegs kyis bsgyur ba/ snying rje'i mchog ces bya ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa sgo mtha' yas pas bsgrub pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes ṭī ka dang sbyar te slad kyis zhus nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa sgo bzang po zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa sgo drug pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa yi ge drug pa'i rig sngags/ tshigs su bcad pa gnyis pa'i gzungs/ 'phags pa lus kyi dbyibs mdzes pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā bar ma dang /zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ byang 105—530

chub kyi snying po'i rgyan 'bum gyi gzungs/ mchod rten gcig btab na bye ba btab par 'gyur ba'i sngags dang cho ga 'phags pa gtsug gi nor bu zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shī len dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'i dpung rgyan zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa gser can zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa thams cad la mi 'jigs pa rab tu sbyin pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa bar du gcod pa thams cad rnam par sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa 'gro lding ba'i rig sngags kyi rgyal po/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang /zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa gzhan gyis mi thub pa mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab 185—531

pa / 'phags pa gzhan gyis mi thub pa rin po che'i phreng ba zhes bya ba/ stong 'gyur zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa 'jigs pa chen po brgyad las sgrol ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa'i gzungs/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa'i gzungs / 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad stong pa'i gzungs/pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi snying po'i gzungs/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug gzung bar 'gyur ba'i gzungs/ pha rol tu phyin pa bcu thob par 'gyur ba'i gzungs/tshad med pa bzhi thob par 'gyur ba'i gzungs/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa gzung bar 'gyur ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa phal po che gzung bar 'gyur ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa sdong po bkod pa'i snying po/ 'phags pa ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po'i mdo gzung bar 'gyur ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa rma bya chen po'i snying po/ 'phags ma so sor 'brang ma chen mo gzung bar 'gyur ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa lang kur gshegs pa'i mdo thams cad bklags par 'gyur ba'i gzungs bcas bzhugs/ya pa la/ 'phags pa rdo rje ri rab chen po'i rdo rje rtse mo'i khang pa brtsegs pa'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shī len dra bo dhi dang / dzñā na sid dhi dang /zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa stobs po che zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 'phags pa lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi cho ga zhes bya ba'i gzungs / rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba rgya brtson 'grus seng ges dpal na len dra'i sgo 'gram du bsgyur ba/ rdo rje rnam 105—532

par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang /dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa lag na rdo rje'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa sngags dang bcas pa/ 'phags pa lag na rdo rje bcu'i snying po/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa rmi lam mthong ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ phyag na rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi bdag po'i gzungs/'phags pa rdo rje mi pham pa me ltar rab tu rmongs byed ces bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ rdo rje phra mo thogs pa med pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi gzungs zhes bya ba/ rnal 'byor gyi rnal 'byor chen po don yod rdo rje'i zhal snga nas bsgyur nas/ bod kyi ban dhe skyo 'od 'byung la gnang ba/'phags pa bdud rtsi thabs sbyor gyi snying po bzhi pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/'phags pa be con chen po zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa bgegs sel ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa phyir bzlog pa stobs can zhes bya ba'i gzungs / 'phags pa mi rgod rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/gtsug tor 'bar ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa khro bo mi g.yo ba'i gzungs / paṇa ḍi ta dharma ta shrī dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong chos kyi bzang pos 185—533

bsgyur ba/ rdo rje mchu zhes bya ba klu'i dam tshig /rdo rje gnam lcags mchu zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa lcags mchu nag po/ 'phags pa mdangs phyir 'phrog pa zhes bya ba'i mdo/ phyir bzlog pa 'phags pa rnam par rgyal ba can zhes bya ba/ 'phags pa rig sngags kyi rgyal po dbugs chen po zhes bya ba/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa nor bu bzang po'i gzungs zhes bya ba/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bir+ya ka ra sing ha dang / lots+tsha ba ban de klu'i dbang pos bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa gnod 'dzin chu dbang snying rje can gyi gzungs bde byed ces bya ba/ 'phags pa gnod 'dzin gyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa zhes bya ba/ 'phags pa gnod 'dzin dpal zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa mtshan mo bzang po zhes bya ba'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang /dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa chos kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren dra bo dhi dang / pradzñā bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa bu mang po ston pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa gdon mi za ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i rig pa chen po/ 'phags pa rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i snying po'i cho ga'i gzungs/ 'phags pa rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rten cing 'brel 105—534

bar 'byung ba'i snying po/ 'phags pa 'od zer dri ma med pa rnam par dag pa'i 'od ces bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bir+ya ka ra si ha dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe dpal gyi lhun po'i sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa la/jo bo a ti sha dang / dge bshes 'brom ston pas sngags rnams dag par bsgyur ba / kun nas sgor 'jug pa'i 'od zer gtsug tor dri ma med par snang ba de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po dang dam tshig la rnam par lta ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / shī len dra bo dhi dang /zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/'phags pa ngan 'gro thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa / 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can zhes bya ba/ gzhan gyis mi thub ma phyir bzlog pa'i rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo/ 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gzhan gyis mi thub ma zhes bya ba'i gzungs/dpal lha mo gtsug tor rol pa'i tan dra/ 'phags ma 'od zer can zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ paṇa ḍi ta a mo gha badz+ra dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong ba ri rin chen grags pas bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa lha mo bskul byed ma zhes bya ba'i gzungs/'phags pa dug sel ces bya ba'i rig sngags/ 'phags pa dbyig dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang /zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis 105wa 535

kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa grags ldan ma'i gzungs/klags pas grub pa bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma sor mo can zhes bya ba rig pa'i rgyal mo/ 'phags pa paṇ+ḍi sha ba ri'i mdo/ 'phags pa ri khrod lo ma gyon pa'i gzungs/ 'phags ma chos thams cad kyi yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs/'phags ma gza' rnams kyi yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgyal blon byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sku ring la bsgyur ba las/ dus phyis dge bsnyen grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis dpal ldan sa skya'i dben gnas su rgya dpe la gtugs nas shin tu dag par byas pa/ gza' rnams kyi yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa lha mo brgyad kyi gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shī len dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ 'phags ma sgrol ma'i gzungs/'phags ma sgrol ma rang gis dam bcas pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'phags ma rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo rgyal ba can zhes bya ba/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa rgyal ba can zhes bya ba'i gzungs/'phags pa dpal chen mo'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ dpal gyi lha mo'i mtshan bcu gnyis pa/ 'phags pa nor gyi rgyun ces bya ba'i gzungs/'phags pa mig rnam par sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i rig sngags/ 'phags pa las kyi sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa bar du gcod pa thams cad sel ba'i gzungs sngags/ yon yongs su sbyong ba zhes bya ba/105—536

yon yongs su sbyong ba'i gzungs/ ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs / 'phags pa nad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs/ 'phags pa rims nad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang —/ dā na shrī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ rims nad zhi ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa mig nad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i mdo/ 'brum bu'i nad zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs/'phags pa gzhang 'brum rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ ma zhu ba'i nad 'byang ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa snang ba thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ sdig pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ sdug bsngal thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ khro ba zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs/'phags pa khros pa zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs/ tshig btsan pa'i gzungs/bdag srung ba'i gzungs/ don thams cad grub pa'i gzungs/ las grub pa'i gzungs / gos brgya thob pa'i gzungs/ mi dga' bar byed pa'i gzungs/'phags pa yid du 'ong ba zhes bya ba/ mgrin pa snyan pa'i gzungs/ bcings pa las grol ba'i gzungs/ mchog thob pa'i rig sngags/ shes rab bskyed pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzñā na gar+bha dang / lots+tsha ba ban de klu'i dbang pos bsgyur/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bir+ya ka ra si ha dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de de ba tsan dras zhus te gtan la phab pa/ shes rab bskyed pa zhes 185—537

bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzñā na gar+bha dang / lots+tsha ba ban de klu'i dbang pos bsgyur/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bir+ya ka ra si ha dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de de ba tsan dras zhus te gtan la phab pa/ shes rab bskyed pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzñā na gar+bha dang / lots+tsha ba ban de klu'i dbang pos bsgyur/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bir+ya ka ra si ha dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de de ba tsan dras zhus te gtan la phab pa/ thos pa 'dzin pa'i gzungs/thos pa 'dzin pa'i gzungs/ sho lo ka brgya lobs pa/ sho lo ka brgya lobs pa/sho lo ka stong lobs pa/ sho lo ka stong lobs pa'i gzungs/ sho lo ka stong lobs pa'i gzungs/ sho lo ka sum stong lobs pa'i gzungs/ mi brjed pa'i gzungs / phyag bya ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa rims dang srog chags kyis mi tshugs pa zhes bya ba/ dug zhi bar byed pa zhes bya ba/ mdangs phyir mi 'phrog pa zhes bya ba/ 'phags pa bdud thams cad skrag par byed pa zhes bya ba/ rma 'byor bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs sngags/ me'i zug rngu rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs/ mkhris pa'i nad sel ba'i sngags/ bad kun gyi nad sel ba'i gzungs sngags/ k+ṣa ya'i nad sel ba'i sngags/ stong chen mo nas phyung ba sman la sngags kyis gdab pa/ sman gtong ba'i tshe sman la sngags kyis gdab pa/skran zhi ba'i gzungs/ mdo chen po kun tu rgyu ba dang kun tu rgyu ba ma yin pa dang mthun pa'i mdo zhes bya ba/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / pradzñā bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ mdo chen po 'dus pa chen po'i mdo zhes bya ba/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / pradzñā bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban 105—538

dhe ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa sprin chen po/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / shī len dra bo dhi dang /zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/'phags pa sprin chen po rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi le'u klu thams cad kyi snying po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa klu'i rgyal po gzi can gyis zhus pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/'phags pa sdong po rgyan gyi mchog ces bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas kyi chos gsal zhing yangs pa snang brgyad ces bya ba'i mdo/ mchod pa'i sprin zhes bya ba'i gzungs / phyag /bstod pa/ mchod pa/ mchod pa'i sprin/ mchod pa/nye gnas/ zhabs la spyi bos phyag byas par 'gyur ba/ rin po che bdar ba'i gzungs / bskor ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa dkon mchog gi rten la bskor ba byas pa'i gzungs/ ye shes skar mda'i snying po/ su rū pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/yi dgas mo kha 'bar ma dbugs dbyung ba'i gtor ma'i cho ga /yi dgas kha nas me 'bar ba la skyabs mdzad pa'i gzungs / yi dgas 'jur 'gegs zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur te gtan la phab pa / lus kyi zag pa sbyin par btang ba'i gzungs/ bla ma rdo rje gdan pas mdo rgyud nas phyung ste/ ba ri lots+tsha bas bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa ro langs bdun pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi shud+dha si ha dang / ban de ye shes snying po'i sdes bsgyur/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bit+yā ka ra si ha dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa tshogs kyi 105wa 539

bdag po'i snying po/ dpal mgon po nag po zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa nag po chen po'i gzungs rims nad thams cad las thar bar byed pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ lha mo nag mo chen mo'i gzungs/ dpal lha mo nag mo'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis bstod pa/nad kyi bdag mo la bstod pa/ lha mo nam gru la bstod pa/ dpal lha mo sgra dbyangs la bstod pa/ 'phags pa yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa'i mdo chen po / rgya gar gyi mkhan po su rin dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rtog pa las smon lam 'byung ba/ 'phags pa bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi rgyal po/ 'phags pa byams pa'i smon lam/mchog gi spyod pa'i smon lam/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/stong chen mo rab tu 'joms pa las gsungs pa'i smon lam/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo las gsungs pa'i smon lam dang bden tshig /lhas zhus pa'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ bde legs kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ bde legs su 'gyur ba'i tshigs su bcad pa/ dkon mchog gsum dang mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa / sangs rgyas rabs bdun gyi bkra shis tshigs su bcad pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i bkra shis tshigs su bcad pa/ rigs gsum gyi bkra shis/105—540

shis par brjod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa bcas bzhugs so// //sher phyin gyi skor la/ ra pa la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa bam po dang po nas bcu dgu pa'i bar bzhugs/la pa la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa bam po nyi shu tham pa nas bzhi bcu rtsa gcig pa'i bar bzhugs/sha pa la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa bam po bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis pa nas drug cu rtsa gsum pa'i bar bzhugs/sa pa la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa bam po drug cu rtsa bzhi pa nas brgyad cu rtsa bzhi pa'i bar bzhugs/ha pa la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa bam po brgyad cu rtsa lnga pa nas brgya dang bdun pa'i bar bzhugs/a pa la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa bam po brgya dang brgyad pa nas brgya dang sum cu pa'i bar bzhugs/k+ṣa pa la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa bam po brgya dang sum cu rtsa gcig pa nas brgya dang lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa'i bar bzhugs/ki pa la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa bam po brgya dang lnga bcu rtsa gnyis pa nas brgya dang drug cu rtsa dgu pa'i bar bzhugs/khi pa la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa bam po brgya dang 105—541

bdun cu pa nas brgya dang dgu bcu rtsa gnyis pa'i bar bzhugs/gi pa la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa bam po brgya dang dgu bcu rtsa gsum pa nas nyis brgya dang bcu bzhi pa'i bar bzhugs/ji pa la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa bam po nyis brgya dang bco lnga pa nas nyis brgya dang sum cu rtsa bdun pa'i bar bzhugs/ci pa la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa bam nyis brgya dang sum cu rtsa brgyad pa nas nyis brgya dang lnga bcu rtsa rtsa dgu pa'i bar bzhugs/chi pa la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa bam po nyis brgya dang lnga bcu rtsa dgu pa nas nyis brgya dang bdun cu rtsa dgu pa'i bar bzhugs/ji pa la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa bam po nyis brgya dang brgyad cu pa nas sum brgya tham pa'i bar bzhugs shing / bsdoms pas le'u bdun cu rtsa gnyis 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa bzhugs/nyi pa la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa bam po dang po nas nyi shu tham pa'i bar bzhugs/ti pa la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa bam po nyi shu rtsa gcig pa nas bzhi bcu pa'i bar bzhugs/thi pa la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa bam po bzhi bcu rtsa gcig pa nas lnga bcu rtsa dgu pa'i bar bzhugs/di pa la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa bam po drug cu pa nas bdun cu rtsa brgyad pa'i bar bzhugs shing / bsdoms pas le'u bdun cu rtsa drug 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa bzhugs/105—542

ni pa la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa khri brgyad stong pa bam po dang po nas nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa'i bar bzhugs/pi pa la/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa khri brgyad stong pa bam po nyi shu rtsa gsum pa nas bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi pa'i bar bzhugs/phi pa la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa khri brgyad stong pa bam po bzhi bcu rtsa lnga pa nas drug cu pa'i bar dang / bsdoms pas le'u brgyad cu rtsa bdun 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa dang / 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa khri pa bam po dang po nas brgyad pa'i bar bcas bzhugs/bi pa la/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa khri pa bam po dgu pa nas sum cu rtsa bzhi pa'i bar bzhugs shing / bsdoms pas le'u sum cu rtsa gsum / rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / pradzñā bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes zhus te gtan la phab pa bzhugs/mi pa la/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad stong pa bam po nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang le'u sum cu rtsa gnyis pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shākya se na dang /dzñā na sirnyi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de dharma tā shī la la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/ slad kyis dbang phyug dam pa'i mnga' bdag bod kyi dpal lha btsan po bkra shis lha lde btsan gyi bkas/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su bhā ṣi ta dang / sgra bsgyur gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos 'grel pa dang mthun par bsgyur/ slad kyis rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇa ḍi ta chen po dī pang ka ra shrī dzñā na dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba chen po dge slong rin chen bzang pos/ yul dbus kyi 'grel pa dang gtugs nas bcos shing zhus te gtan la phab/ yang 185—543

slad kyis skyi smad mnye thang na mo cher paṇa ḍi ta chen po dī pang ka ra shrī dzñā na dang /lots+tsha ba 'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas gnyis kyis brgyad stong pa bshad pa'i dus su che long zhig gtan la phab/ slad kyis ra sgreng gtsug lag khang du lots+tsha ba 'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyis rgya gar gyi mdo gsum dang gtugs nas lan gnyis gtan la phab/ slad kyis yang lots+tsha ba de nyid kyis bshad pa mdzad cing phran tshegs kyang gtan la phab/ dus phyis lots+tsha ba chen po shākya'i dge slong blo ldan shes rab kyis kha che'i dpe dang yul dbus kyi dpe du ma bsags nas gtan la phab pa bzhugs/tsi pa la/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sdud pa tshigs su bcad pa / rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi dha ka ra sing ha dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban de dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa rab kyi rtsal gyis rnam par gnon pas zhus pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bstan pa bam po drug dang le'u bdun pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shī len+d+ra bo dhi dang / dzi na mi tra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bdun brgya pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po gnyis pa/skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa zhes pa las 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa lnga brgya pa/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa zhes pa las 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rdo rje gcod pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi 105—544

pha rol tu phyin pa lnga bcu pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yum shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa yi ge gcig ma zhes bya ba 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyi ma'i snying po'i theg pa chen po'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa zla ba'i snying po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa theg pa chen po'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa kun tu bzang po theg pa chen po'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa lag na rdo rje'i mdo theg pa chen po 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi mdo theg pa chen po 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor ba'i mdo/ skyes pa rabs kyi gleng gzhi/ lcang lo can gyi pho brang gi mdo/ 'dus pa chen po'i mdo/ byams pa'i mdo/byams pa bsgom pa'i mdo/ bslab pa lnga'i phan yon gyi mdo/ ri'i kun dga' bo'i mdo/ klu'i rgyal po dga' bo nyer dga' 'dul ba'i mdo/ 'od srung chen po'i mdo/ nyi ma'i mdo/ zla ba'i mdo/ bkra shis chen po'i mdo ste/ mdo tshan bcu gsum po 'di rnams paṇa ḍi ta ā nan da shri'i zhal snga nas/ mang du thos pa'i lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ dpal thar pa gling du bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa bcas bzhugs so// //dkon brtsegs kyi skor la/ tshi pa la/ 'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa chen po'i chos kyi rnam grangs le'u stong phrag brgya pa las/ sdom pa gsum bstan pa'i le'u zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po gsum pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po 185—545

dzi na mi tra dang / su rin tra bo rnyi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/'phags pa sgo mtha' yas pa rnam par sbyong ba bstan pa'i le'u zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po bzhi pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe dpal brtsegs rak+ṣi tas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa / 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po bcu dang le'u nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / mu ni bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa rmi lam bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po gsum pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa 'od dpag med kyi bkod pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po gsum pa/ ban de klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur cing zhus pa bcas bzhugs/dzi pa la/ 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs pa'i bkod pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po lnga pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang /su ren dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa go cha'i bkod pa bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po drug pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin dbyer med par bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po gnyis pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa chos bcu pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po gnyis pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su 105—546

ren dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa kun nas sgo'i le'u zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po gcig pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa 'od zer kun tu bkye ba bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po lnga pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod ces bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ bam po gsum pa'i bar bcas bzhugs/wi pa la/ 'phags pa byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod ces bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po bzhi pa nas nyi shu tham pa'i bar/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ā tsar+ya su ren dra bo dhi dang / shrī len dra dang / ā tsar+ya dharma tā shī las bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ dga' bo mngal du 'jug pa bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ bam po gcig pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa dga' bo mngal na gnas pa bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po gsum pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan bkod pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po bzhi pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shī len dra bo dhi dang / dzi na mi tra dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa bcas bzhugs/zhi pa la/ 'phags pa yab dang sras mjal ba zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po bco lnga pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la 105wa 547

dang tso/ zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas zhus te gtan la phab nas chos kyi phyag rgyas btab pa/ 'phags pa yul 'khor skyong gis zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po gsum pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / mu ni bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa gang pos zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po drug pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa khyim bdag drag shul can gyis zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po gsum pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa glog thob kyis zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ bam po gnyis pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa bcas bzhugs/zi pa la/ 'phags pa sgyu ma mkhan bzang po lung bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po gcig pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / badz+ra barma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sde la stsogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa cho 'phrul chen po bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po gsum pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren dra bo dhi dang / pradzñā barma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa byams pa'i seng ge'i sgra chen po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po bzhi pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang /su ren dra bo dhi dang / pradzñā barma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la 185—548

sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa 'dul ba rnam par gtan la dbab pa nye bar 'khor gyis zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/bam po gnyis pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren dra bo dhi dang /pradzñā barma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa lhag pa'i bsam pa bskul pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po gnyis pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang /su ren dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa lag bzang gis zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po gnyis pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dha na shi la dang /dzi na mi tra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la stsogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa des pas zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po gcig pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa dpal byin gyis zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po gcig pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa bad sa'i rgyal po 'char byed kyis zhus pa zhes bya ba'i le'u bam po gcig pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su rin dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la stsogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa bu mo blo gros bzang mos zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa 105—549
