chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren dra bo dhi dang /zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas/ bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa gang gā'i mchog gis zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo / rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa mya ngan med kyis byin pa lung bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po gcig pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa dri ma med kyis byin pas zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po gnyis pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ yon tan rin chen me tog kun tu rgyas pas zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / pradzñā bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la stsogs pas bsgyur cing zhus nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi yul bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po gnyis pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar bcad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa lha'i bu blo gros rab gnas kyis zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po bzhi pa/ ban de klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur cing zhus pa bcas bzhugs/105—550

'i pa la/ 'phags pa seng ges zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/rgya gar gyi mkhan po dā na shī la dang / mu ni bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang chen thabs la mkhas pa byang chub sems dpa' ye shes dam pas zhus pa'i le'u zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po bzhi pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa tshong dpon bzang skyong gis zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa bu mo rnam dag dad pas zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po gcig pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa byams pas zhus pa'i le'u zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/'phags pa byams pas zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa 'od srung gi le'u zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / shī len dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar bcad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa blo gros mi zad pas zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa rin po che'i phung po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa / 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bdun brgya pa zhes bya ba theg pa 185—551

chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa gtsug na rin po ches zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de dar mā tā shī las bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa lha mo dpal phreng gi seng ge'i sgra zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa drang srong rgyas pas zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa bcas bzhugs so// //phal chen gyi skor la/ yi pa la/ sangs rgyas phal po che zhes bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo bam po bcu dgu bzhugs/ri pa la/ sangs rgyas phal po che zhes bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo bam po nyi shu tham pa bzhugs/li pa la/ sangs rgyas phal po che zhes bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo bam po nyi shu tham pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren dra bo dhi dang /zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la stsogs pas/ bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa bzhugs/shi pa la/ sangs rgyas phal po che zhes bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo bam po nyi shu tham pa bzhugs/si pa la/ sangs rgyas phal po che zhes bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo bam 705—552

po bco brgyad/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su rin dra bo dhi dang /zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas/ bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa bzhugs/hi pa la/ sangs rgyas phal po che zhes bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo bam po bcu drug bzhugs shing / phal po che bsdoms pas le'u bzhi bcu rtsa lnga bzhugs so// //mdo sna tshogs kyi skor la/ i pa la/ 'phags pa bskal pa bzang po pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po nyi shu rtsa drug pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bibyā ka ra sing ha dang / lots+tsha ba ban de dpal gyi dbyangs kyis bsgyur/ lots+tsha ba ban de dpal brtsegs kyis zhus te gtan la phab pa bzhugs/ku pa la/ 'phags pa rgya cher rol pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po bco brgyad dang le'u nyi shu rtsa bdun pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang /dā na shī la dang / mu ni bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/'phags pa 'jam dpal rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po gnyis pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'jam dpal rnam par 'phrul pa'i le'u zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shī len dra bo dhi dang /dzi na mi tra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa de bzhin 105—553

gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis rlabs sems can la gzigs shing sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi bkod pa kun tu ston pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes zhus te gtan la phab/ ban dhe klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa bcas bzhugs/khu pa la/ 'phags pa bcom ldan 'das kyi ye shes rgyas pa'i mdo sde rin po che mtha' yas pa mthar phyin pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po nyi shu rtsa lnga pa / rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā bar ma dang / lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes snying pos bsgyur / rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi shud+dha sing ha dang / sarba dzñā de ba dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe dpal brtsegs kyis zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yul la 'jug pa'i ye shes snang ba'i rgyan ces bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po gsum pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa bcas bzhugs/gu pa la/ 'phags pa dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su 'dzin pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po bco brgyad dang le'u bco lnga pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā warma dang / lots+tsha ba ban dhe legs kyi sdes bsgyur/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā bar ma dang / dzñā na gar bha dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa dge 'dun zung gi mdo'i chos kyi rnam grangs bam po bzhi pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis 105—554

— ————wa —————— kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa khye'u snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pas bstan pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan brjod pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa dkyil 'khor brgyad pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs theg pa chen po'i mdo/ zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa bcas bzhugs/ngu pa la/ 'phags pa dgongs pa nges par 'grel pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo le'u bcu pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa lang kur gshegs pa'i theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po dgu pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa lang kur gshegs pa rin po che'i mdo las/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi snying po zhes bya ba'i le'u bam po brgyad pa/ dpal lha btsan po'i bka' lung gis rgya'i slob dpon we na tī yis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa dang sbyar nas/ lots+tsha ba dge slong 'gos chos grub kyis bsgyur cing zhus pa/ 'phags pa ga ya mgo'i ri zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren dra bo dhi dang /zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa bcas bzhu/dī/ la/ 'phags pa rgyan stug po bkod pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po bzhi dang le'u dgu pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa snying rje chen po'i pad ma dkar po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po drug dang le'u bcu gsum pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / shī len dra bo dhi dang / zhu 105—555

chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/'phags pa snying rje pad ma dkar po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po bco lnga dang le'u drug pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren dra bo dhi dang / pradzñā barma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa bcas bzhugs/chu pa la/ dam pa'i chos pad ma dkar po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po bcu gsum dang le'u nyi shu rtsa bdun pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba lo tsā ba ban de sna nam ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa chos thams cad kyi yon tan bkod pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā bar ma dang /su ren dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa bde ba can gyi bkod pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa za ma tog bkod pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po bzhi pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/'phags pa dkon mchog gi za ma tog ces bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ bam po bzhi pa/ zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe rat+na rak+ṣi tas zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa rin po che'i mtha' zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas/ bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa bcas bzhugs/ju pa la/ 'phags pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po'i mdo bam po 105—556

dang po nas nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa'i bar bzhugs/nyu pa la/ 'phags pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po'i mdo bam po nyi shu rtsa dgu pa nas lnga bcu rtsa drug pa'i bar dang / bsdoms pas le'u bco lnga bzhugs shing / rgya nag gi mkhan po wang phab zhun dang / dharma'i gzhi 'dzin dge ba'i blo gros dang / lots+tsha ba rgya mtsho'i sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa bzhugs/tu pa la/ 'phags pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po'i mdo bam po bcu gsum dang le'u lnga pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dzñā na gar+bha dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe de ba tsan dras bsgyur te gtan la phab pa/'phags pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ka ma la gub ta dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa 'da' kha ye shes zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzod kyi chos kyi yi ge bam po bzhi dang le'u bcu gcig pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa dkon mchog 'byung gnas zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po bdun pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes skad gsar chad kyis bcos nas slad kyis gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa gser gyi mdo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa gser gyi bye ma lta bu zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su rin dra bo dhi dang / pradzñā bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa bcas bzhugs/105—557

thu pa la/ 'phags pa chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin mnyam pa nyid rnam par spros pa ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ bam po bco lnga dang le'u sum cu rtsa dgu pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shī len dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de dharma tā shī las bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar bcad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa chos nyid rang gi ngo bo stong pa nyid las mi g.yo bar tha dad par thams cad la snang ba'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dā na shī la dang / ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ dā na shī la'i zhal nas sde snod kyi bstan bcos dang dbu ma'i lta ba tha dad rnams 'di las 'phros pa yin gsung skad/ 'phags pa rab tu zhi ba rnam par nges pa'i cho 'phrul gyi ting nge 'dzin ces bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po gsum pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin ces bya ba'i theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po phyed gnyis pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa / 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i ting nge 'dzin ces bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po gnyis pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin ces bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po lnga pa / rgya gar gyi mkhan po shākya pra bha dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de rad na rak+ṣi tas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos pa bcas bzhugs/105—558

du pa la/ 'phags pa da ltar gyi sangs rgyas mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i ting nge 'dzin ces bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po bdun dang le'u nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/rgya gar gyi mkhan po shākya pra bha dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de rad na rak+ṣi tas zhus te gtan la phab pa/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos pa/ 'phags pa bsod nams thams cad bsdus pa'i ting nge 'dzin ces bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po bzhi pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā warma dang / shī len dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin gyi chos kyi yi ge gnyis dang le'u dgu pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa khye'u bzhi'i ting nge 'dzin ces bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po gsum pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang /pradzñā barma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa ting nge 'dzin mchog dam pa bam po gcig pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa 'dus pa chen po rin po che tog gi gzungs zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po brgyad dang le'u bcu gsum pa/rgya gar gyi mkhan po shī len dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa rdo rje snying po'i gzungs zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shī len dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa sgo mtha' yas pa sgrub pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa sgo drug pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa bcas bzhugs/105—559

nu pa la/ 'phags pa rnam par mi rtog par 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ska ba dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur te gtan la phab pa/ tshigs su bcad pa gnyis pa'i gzungs 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa theg pa chen po la dad pa rab tu sgom pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po gnyis dang le'u bzhi pa/rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas zhus shing bris te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa byang chub sems dpa'i spyod yul gyi thabs kyi yul la rnam par 'phrul pa bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo le'u bcu pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying rje chen po nges par bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po bdun pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shī len dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa nam mkha'i mdzod kyis zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po brgyad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi tsa ya shī la dang / shī len dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/'phags pa byams pas zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis zhus pa chos bdun pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang /lots+tsha ba dge slong dge ba'i blo gros kyis bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa spobs pa'i blo 105—560

gros kyis zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā barmā dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa bcas bzhugs/pu pa la/ 'phags pa blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po bcu dang le'u bcu gnyis pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang /dā na shrī la dang / bud dha pra bha dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/'phags pa klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po bdun dang le'u bcu pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / pradzñā bar ma dang ske/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren dra bo dhi dang /zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/'phags pa klu'i rgyal po ma dros pas zhus pa zhes/ bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzī na mi tra dang / dā na shrī la dang / ban de ye shes sde dang /yi ge pa dgon gling rma la sogs pas/ zhu chen bgyis te gtan la phab pa/'phags pa mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong pos zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po lnga pa/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban dhe dpal gyi lhun po dang / dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa bcas bzhugs/phu pa la/ 'phags pa tshangs pas zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/105—561

rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa tshangs pas byin gyis zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren dra bo dhi dang /pradzñā bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa tshangs pa khyad par sems kyis zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po drug pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shākya pra bha dang / dharma pā la dang / dzi na mi tra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe dharma tā shī la dang / par zhus kyi lots+tsha ba ban de de ban tra rak+ṣi ta dang / ku mā ra rak+ṣi ta la sogs pas zhus shing gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa lha'i bu rab rtsal sems kyis zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po gsum pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa dpal dbyig gis zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren dra bo dhi dang / pradzñā bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa rin chen dra ba can gyis zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzñā na gar bha dang / lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes snying pos bsgyur/ zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de dpal brtsegs kyis zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa rin chen zla bas zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi shud dha sing ha dang / lots+tsha ba ban de dge dpal gyis bsgyur/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bid dh+ya ka ra sing ha dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de de ba tsan dras zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa bde byed 185—562

wa wa———— ——————wa ——————— ——— — — —kyis zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā bar ma dang —/ zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan phab pa/ 'phags pa yul 'khor skyong gis zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa rnam par 'phrul pa'i rgyal pos zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po gsum pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ dri ma med pa'i 'od kyis zhus pa bam po bzhi pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa theg pa chen po'i man ngag ces bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po bzhi pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang /zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sde la sogs pas/ bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa bram ze mo dpal ldan mas zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa bgres mos zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang /zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa bcas bzhu/kā/la/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis dris pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa bdag med pa dris pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ka ma la gub ta dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa 'jig rten 'dzin gyis yongs su dris pa zhes bya ba'i mdo bam po bzhi dang le'u bcu gnyis pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa blo gros mi zad pas bstan 105—563

pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po bdun pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/'phags pa dri ma med par grags pas bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo le'u bcu gnyis pa/ lo tsā ba ban dhe chos nyid tshul khrims kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa byang chub kyi phyogs bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dzñā na sid+dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i bden pa bstan pa zhes bya ba chen po'i mdo bam po gnyis pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shākya pra bha dang / dzi na mi tra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de dharma tā shī la la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa chos thams cad 'byung ba med par bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po gsum pa/ lots+tsha ba ban dhe rin chen mtshos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa bcas bzhugs/mu pa la/ 'phags pa pha rol du phyin pa lnga bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po drug dang le'u nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa sbyin pa'i pha rol du phyin pa bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/'phags pa sbyin pa'i phan yon bstan pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren dra bo dhi 185—564

dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa / 'phags pa byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / pradzñā warma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan dang ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yul la 'jug pa bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po gsum pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzñā na gar+bha dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi stobs bskyed pa'i cho 'phrul rnam par 'phrul pa bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi chos bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa bam po gsum pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa mar me mdzad kyis lung bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi shud+dha sing ha dang /lots+tsha ba ban dhe dge dpal gyis bsgyur/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzñā na gar+bha dang /zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis zhu chen bgyis te gtan la phab pa/'phags pa tshangs pa'i dpal lung bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi shud+dha sing ha dang / lots+tsha ba ban dhe dge dpal gyis bsgyur/rgya gar gyi mkhan po bibya ka ra sing ha dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de de ba tsan dras zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa bud med 'gyur ba lung bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po gnyis pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/'phags pa bu mo zla mchog lung bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes zhus te 105wa 565

gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa bde ldan ma lung bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa lha mo chen mo dpal lung bstan pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa rgyal ba'i blo gros zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang /zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gnas pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa bdud rtsi brjod pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/'phags pa byams pa 'jug pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā bar ma dang / dzi na mi tra dang / su ren dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa / 'phags pa 'jig rten gyi rjes su 'thun par 'jug pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa bcas bzhugs/tsu pa la/ 'phags pa dad pa'i stobs bskyed pa la 'jug pa'i phyag rgya zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po lnga pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang /zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/'phags pa nges pa dang ma nges par 'gro ba'i phyag rgya la 'jug pa zhes bya ba theg 185—566

pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā bar ma dang / su ren dra bo dhe dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa chos kyi phyag rgya zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa mar me 'bul ba zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa grong khyer gyis 'tsho ba zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzñā na gar bha dang / lots+tsha ba ban de klu'i dbang pos bsgyur/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bibyā ka ra sing ha dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de de ba tsan dras zhus te gtan la phab pa/ zas kyi 'tsho ba rnam par dag pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ glang po'i rtsal ces bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa sgra chen po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi shud dha sing ha dang / lo tsā ba ban de dge ba dpal gyis bsgyur / rgya gar gyi mkhan po bibyu ka ra sing ha dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de de ba tsan dras zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa seng ge'i sgra bsgrags pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi dh+yā ka ra sing ha dang /lo tsā ba ban dhe sba rje ye shes snying pos bsgyur nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa sā lu'i ljang pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba dang po dang rnam par dbye ba bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa 105—567

sor mo'i phreng ba la phan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po bdun pa/rgya gar gyi mkhan po shākya pra bha dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de dharma tā shrī la dang / rgya'i lots+tsha ba ban de to da a ca la la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ rgyal po la gdams pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ rgyal po la gdams pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo / rgya gar gyi mkhan po dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa ma skyes dgra'i 'gyod pa bsal ba zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po lnga pa/ a tsār+ya mañdzu shrī gar+bha dang / rad na rak+ṣi tas zhus pa/ 'phags pa dpal sbas zhes bya ba'i mdo/rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shrī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa las kyi sgrib pa rnam par dag pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo / rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / pradzñā bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/'phags pa las kyi sgrib pa rgyun gcod pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis bcos shing gtan la phab pa bcas bzhugs/tshu pa la/ sangs rgyas kyi sde snod tshul khrims 'chal pa tshar gcod pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po bdun dang le'u dgu pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po 105—568

dharma shrī pra bha dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong dpal gyi lhun pos pho brang lhan dkar du bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa rgyal po la gdams pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa rnga bo che chen po'i le'u zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po lnga pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bibyā ka ra pra bha dang / lots+tsha ba ban de dpal gyi lhun pos bsgyur/ zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de dpal gyis zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i le'u zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po gsum pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa lhag pa'i bsam pa brtan pa'i le'u zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su rin dra bo dhi dang / pradzñā bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po sarba dzñā de ba dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa srid pa 'pho ba zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shrī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa rnam par 'thag pa thams cad bsdus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / mu ne bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas bgro ba zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po gsum pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/105—569

de bzhin gshegs pa bgro ba zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po gsum pa/rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzñā na gar+bha dang / lots+tsha ba ban de dpal gyi dbyangs kyis bsgyur cing / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de dpal brtsegs kyis zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'dus pa chen po theg pa chen po'i mdo sde las de bzhin gshegs pa'i dpal gyi dam tshig ces bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po gsum dang le'u bzhi pa / rgya gar gyi mkhan po sarba dzñā de ba dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur cing zhus nas gtan la phab pa bcas bzhugs/dzu pa la/ 'phags pa dkon mchog sprin ces bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po bdun pa/ lots+tsha ba bsne rin chen mtsho dang / chos nyid tshul khrims kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa sprin chen po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po bcu dang le'u sum cu rtsa brgyad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su men dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa sprin chen po'i mdo las phyogs bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho 'dus pa'i dga' ston chen po la rtse ba zhes bya ba'i le'u/rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa sprin chen po rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi le'u klu thams cad kyi snying po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa sprin chen po/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / shī len dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/185—570

———wa ——————————wa ————— ————————bcom ldan 'das kyi gtsug tor chen po/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba sgrub pa'i don mngon par thob pa'i rgyu/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyod pa dpa' bar 'gro ba'i mdo le'u stong phrag bcu pa las le'u bcu pa bam po gnyis pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ gtsug tor chen po'i bam po dgu las bdud kyi le'u nyi tshe 'byung ba 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa bcas bzhugs/wu pa la/ 'phags pa chos yang dag par sdud pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po bdun pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po mañdzu shrī gar+bha dang / bi dza ya shrī la dang / shrī len dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'dus pa chen po las sa'i snying po 'khor lo bcu pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po bcu dang le'u brgyad pa/ rgya'i mkhan po ho shang zab mo la sogs pa dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de rnam par mi rtog gis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/'phags pa phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ bam po drug pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / mu ne bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa ting nge 'dzin gyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa yongs su bsngo ba'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ li'i dge slong sde snod gsum dang ldan pa shī la dharmas / rgya gar gyi dhar ma rgya'i yi ge las ban dhe rnam par mi rtog gis bsgyur ba bcazlo dīstags/ dam pa'i chos kyi rgyal po theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po gcig pa 185—571

'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa chos kyi tshul zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo / rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa chos kyi phung po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā barma dang /zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/'phags pa don dam pa'i chos kyi rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo / rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis gtan la phab pa / 'phags pa chos dang don rnam par 'byed pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo / rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i so so'i thar pa chos bzhi sgrub pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī pang ka ra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya blo gros dang / dge slong dge ba'i blo gros kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/'phags pa chos bzhi bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ chos bzhi pa'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/'phags pa chos bzhi pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/'phags pa bzhi bsgrub pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/chos gsum pa zhes bya ba'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de de ba tsan dras bsgyur/ lots+tsha ba dpal brtsegs kyis zhus 185—572

—————— ——————te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi mdo theg pa chen po 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ theg pa chen po'i mdo chos kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ chos kyi rgya mo bam po gnyis pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/'phags pa shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i sde nyi ma'i snying po zhes bya ba'i mdo/ bam po bcu gsum dang le'u bcu gnyis pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po sarba dzñā de ba dang /bit+yā ka ra pra bha dang / dharmā ka ra dang / lots+tsha ba ban de bzang skyong gis bsgyur / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de dpal brtsegs kyis zhus te gtan la phab pa/'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shākya pra bha dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa yi ge med pa'i za ma tog rnam par snang mdzad kyi snying po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa thabs mkhas pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ bam po gnyis pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa bcas bzhu/kā/la/ sangs rgyas kyi mtshan lnga stong bzhi brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum pa bam po brgyad pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa yang dag par spyod pa'i tshul nam mkha'i mdog gis 'dul ba'i bzod pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ bam po bcu gcig dang le'u bcu gnyis pa/ 'phags pa thar pa chen po phyogs su rgyas pa 'gyod tshangs kyis sdig sbyangs te sangs rgyas su grub pa rnam par bkod pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po gnyis dang shu log brgya bcu gnyis pa/ rgya 185—573

nag gi 'gyur/ 'phags pa rtogs pa chen po yongs su rgyas pa'i mdo las phyag 'tshal ba'i cho ga dang / 'gyod tshangs kyi le'u nyi tshe 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/'phags pa me tog gi tshogs zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po gsum pa/rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzñā na sid dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de dharmā tā shī la la sogs pas zhu chen bgyis te gtan la phab pa bcas bzhugs/'u pa la/ dpang skong phyag brgya pa zhes bya ba 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/'phags pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyal po'i mdo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa phyogs bcu'i mun pa rnam par sel ba zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi shud dha sing ha dang /lots+tsha ba ban de rtsangs de ben dra rak+ṣi tas bsgyur/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban de klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis zhu chen bgyis te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas bdun pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas brgyad pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/sangs rgyas bcu pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/'phags pa sangs rgyas bcu gnyis pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi dbu rgyan zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo chos kyi rnam grangs chen po/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shākya sing ha dang / lots+tsha ba ban de de ben dra rak+ṣi tas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi sa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo / rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / shī len dra bo dhi dang / pradzñā 185—574

bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes ṭī ka dang sbyar te gsar du bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas mi spang ba zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / pradzñā bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa dkyil 'khor brgyad pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa bkra shis brgyad pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ chos rjes su dran pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/dge 'dun rjes su dran pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ bslab pa gsum gyi mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa sku gsum zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa phung po gsum pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa zhes pa las 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pa zhes bya ba'i yongs su bsngo ba 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa 'gro ba thams cad yongs su skyob par byed pa zhes bya ba'i yongs su bsngo ba/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bibyā ka ra pra bha dang / lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes snying pos bsgyur/zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de dpal brtsegs kyis zhus te gtan la phab pa/'phags pa dam pa'i chos dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bam po dang po nas nyi shu pa'i bar bcas bzhugs/yupa la/ 'phags pa dam pa'i chos dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bam po nyi shu rtsa gcig pa nas bzhi bcu rtsa lnga pa'i bar bzhugs/105—575

ru pa la/ 'phags pa dam pa'i chos dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bam po bzhi bcu rtsa drug pa nas bzhi bcu rtsa dgu pa'i bar dang / 'thab bral gyi lha rnams kyi sa las rtag tu bde ba'i sa ste brgyad pa'i skabs yan dang 'thab bral gyi bdag po mu su lun dha'i rdzu 'phrul chen po rdzogs pa'i bar bzhugs/lu pa la/ 'phags pa dam pa'i chos dran pa nye bar gzhag pa'i mjug yongs su rdzogs pa/ rig pa'i gnas lnga la thogs pa med pa'i mkhyen pa dang ldan pa'i dpal gyis mdzes pa'i paṇa ḍi ta chen po shān ta a ka ra 'grub ta'i zhal snga nas dang / mkhas pa chen po skyes bu dam pa 'dul ba 'dzin pa'i yang mchog tu gyur pa paṇa ḍi ta chen po ā bh+ya a ka ra 'grub ta dang / thos pa 'dzin pas 'jam dpal dang 'dra bar grags pa spobs pa'i shes rab can rnams kyi mchog paṇa ḍi ta chen po shākya rak+ṣi ta dang / paṇa ḍi ta chen po bir+ya a ka ra shan ti la sogs pa rnams la rgya dpe lnga dang / gzhan yang yul dbus ma ga dha zhes bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa'i rten mang du bzhugs shing sangs rgyas pa'i skye bo dkon mchog gsum la dad pas yul gang ba'i ma ga dha'i yul smad na/ rgyal po byang chub sems dpa' de ba pā las mdzad pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po bstan pa'i mig tu gyur pa bi kra ma shī la na yang mkhas pa'i skye bo mang du zin kyang / shākya rak+ṣi ta de nyid dang / sgra dang / snyan dngags dang / legs par sbyar ba'i skad kyi lugs la mkhas pa'i paṇa ḍi ta chen po su bhu ti tsan dra dang / mngon pa la mkhas pa a ḍi ta tsan dra la sogs pa rnams la rgya dpe gnyis la legs par mnyan cing gus pas thad du bsten nas don dang tshig ma lus par rtogs pa'i bshad pa zhus nas/shin tu dka' ba'i gnas rnams la ni phyir zhing legs par dpyad pas/ don 105—576

dgrol ba'i thabs zhus te/ 'gyur gyi yan lag rgya gar gyi sang sgri ta dang /'phral skad gnyis/ bod kyi chos skad dang / 'phral skad gnyis te bzhi la dbang 'byor ba'i shes rab kyi snang ba thob mod kyis kyang spyir mdo sde la don gyi gnas mang bas tshig don phal cher brling zhing lhag par yang mdo 'di don du ma tshig zur rnams kyis dag gcig tu 'brel bar ston pa ni/ tshig mdzes pa'i rgyan gyis don gsal bar mdzad pa snyan dngags kyi dbang phyug 'gran gyi do zla med pa rnams kyi mdzad pa'i rim pa yin pa'i phyir na sbyangs pa zhan pa rnams la sla ba ma yin la/ khyad par du yang gzhung nyung bas don du ma ston pa'i mdo dum bu rnams ni spyi sor bsgyur bar mngon yang / blo'i nor can rnams kyis ni de nyid la don du ma nges nus la/ bye brag tu gsal btab na ni don cig ston par 'khrul pa'i phyir dang / tshig ji tsam pas brjod pa de tsam du bsgyur bar rigs pa'i yang phyir te/ mdor na rgya bod kyi don thun mong pa brda tha dad pa'i byed pa ma nyams par byas nas sngon gyi bsgyur ba la mkhas pa rnams kyis bkas bcad la sogs pa'i lugs dang yang mi 'gal bar byang phyogs pa tshab kyi rgyud du skyes pa'i dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyis dam pa'i chos la gus pas rgya gar gyi rgyal po phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal gyi rgyal mtshan gyi dbang phyug gzhan pas ches mtho ba dang ldan pa rā ma pā la'i ring la theg pa chen po'i mdo sde dam pa'i chos dran pa nye bar gzhag pa zhes bya ba'i shas shig 'gyur ba'i 'phro yongs su rdzogs par byas nas bsgyur ba/ slad kyis zhus thug la ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen zhang bu gcig pa zhes rab tu grags shing skye dgu rnams sgrogs pa yang 'jig rten pa ni rang la phan pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis brjod pa de dag rnams kyi gshis yin pa'i phyir te/105—577

skyes bu des ni sems can la bu gcig pa bzhin du dgongs pas sras gcig pa'o//des ni thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa mtshon no/ /chos la gnas pa rnams la shes rab 'od ces grags pa yang theg pa'i rim pa dang mthun par mkhyen cing bden pa gnyis la sogs pa'i sgor bsdu bas mos pa dang / nges pa dang / mngon du rtogs shing shes nas rang dang gzhan gyi nyon mongs pa dang / shes bya'i sgrib pa'i mun pa 'joms pa'i 'od mdzad pa'i phyir te/ des ni shes rab chen po dang ldan pa dang / bdag dang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pa bstan to/ /dam pa'i skye bo des grogs mdzad nas dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan nyid kyis dag par byas so/ /de ltar na dang po'i gzhir 'gyur dang / zhu chen dang /tshig don gyi 'brel dpyad pa dang / zhu chung dang / yang 'brel dpyad pa dang lngar zhus shing gtugs te gtan la phab pa/ mdo chen po sgyu ma'i dra ba zhes bya ba/rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / pradzñā bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ mdo chen po gzugs can snying pos bsu ba zhes bya ba/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / pradzñā bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ mdo chen po stong pa nyid ces bya ba/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / pradzñā bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ mdo chen po stong pa nyid chen po zhes bya ba/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / pradzñā bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ mdo chen po rgyal mtshan mchog ces bya ba/ rgya gar 185—578

gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / pradzñābaramadabyewa 9nu chen dū ༵༵ shā shā wa de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ mdo chen po rgyal mtshan dam pa zhes bya ba 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ mdo chen po lnga gsum pa zhes bya ba/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / pradzñā bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/'phags pa rdo 'phangs pa'i mdo bam po gnyis pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/gzhon nu dpe'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ khams mang po pa'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ gaṇa ḍi'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharma shrī bha dra dang /lots+tsha ba dge slong tshul khrims yon tan gyis bsgyur/ zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bcos te gtan la phab pa/ gaṇa ḍi'i dus kyi mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī pang ka ra shrī dzñā na dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong dge ba'i blo gros kyis bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pabacas bzhugs/shu pa la/ mngon par 'byung ba'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ā tsār+ya dharma shrī bha dra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ dge slong la rab tu gces pa'i mdo zhes bya ba 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ tshul khrims yang dag par ldan pa'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ltung ba sde lnga'i dge ba dang mi dge ba'i 'bras bu brtag pa'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ā tsār+ya dzñā na shrī gub ta dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya blo gros kyis bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa/ mchog tu gdags pa'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ rnam par grol ba'i lam las sbyangs pa'i yon tan bstan pa zhes bya 105—579

ba / rgya gar gyi mkhan po bibyā ka ra pra bha dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de dpal brtsegs kyis zhus te gtan la phab pa/ che'i mtha'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi shud dha sing ha dang / lots+tsha ba ban de dge ba'i dpal gyis bsgyur/rgya gar gyi mkhan po bibyā ka ra sing ha dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de dpal brtsegs kyis zhu chen bgyis te gtan la phab pa/ tshe 'pho ba ji ltar 'gyur ba zhus pa'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ mi rtag pa nyid kyi mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de zhang ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus nas skad gsar bcad kyis kyang bsnan nas gtan la phab pa/mi rtag pa nyid kyi mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa 'du shes bcu gcig bstan pa'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa'i mdo chen po 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa mtshan mo bzang po zhes bya ba'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ mun gyi nags tshal gyi sgo zhes bya ba'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ pha ma'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/'phags pa bden pa bzhi'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ don rnam par nges pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa don rgyas pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa rmad du byung ba zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang /su ren dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs brnyan bzhag pa'i phan yon yang dag par brjod pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharmā ka ra dang / lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes snying pos bsgyur/ ban de dpal 105—580

brtsegs kyis zhu chen bgyis te gtan la phab pa/ mchod rten bskor ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ gsal rgyal gyi tshigs su bcad pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ tshigs su bcad pa gcig pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/tshigs su bcad pa bzhi pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ klu'i rgyal po rnga sgra'i tshigs su bcad pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ ched du brjod pa'i tshoms bam po bzhi dang / mi rtag pa'i tshoms nas bram ze'i tshoms kyi bar sum cu rtsa gsum yod pa/dgra bcom pa chos skyob kyis bsdus pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bibyā ka ra pra bha dang / lots+tsha ba ban de rin chen mchog gis bsgyur/ zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de dpal brtsegs kyis zhus nas gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa skyes bu dam pa'i mdo / rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharmā ka ra dang / lots+tsha ba ban de bzang skyong gis bsgyur / ban de dpal brtsegs kyis zhu chen bgyis pa/ dga' bo rab tu byung ba'i mdo/ rtsangs de ban dra rak+ṣi tas zhu chen bgyis pa/ lha'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ lha'i mdo nyung ngu / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ zla ba'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ khang bu brtsegs pa'i mdo/ zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba rad na rak+ṣi tas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa gnas 'jog gi mdo zhes bya ba/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po sarba dzñā de ba dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de dpal brtsegs la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa dga' ba can gyi mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa 'khar bsil gyi mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa / mkhar bsil 'chang ba'i kun tu spyod pa'i cho ga 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/chos kyi 'khor lo'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ las kyi rnam par smin pa'i 185—581

'bras bu'i mdo/ sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa rgya'i lots+tsha ba thang sam tsang zhes bya bas rgya gar dngos las rgya nag tu legs par bsgyur zhing / phyis thams cad gzhi yod par smra ba'i sde ba las rab tu byung ba rgya nag chen po'i lha btsun chos kyi rin chen gyis dpal ldan sa skya'i gtsug lag khang chen por bsgyur zhing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ las rnam par 'byed pa bam po gnyis pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/las kyi rnam par 'gyur ba zhes bya ba'i chos kyi gzhung bam po gcig pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa bcas bzhugs/su pa la/ las brgya tham pa bam po dang po nas nyi shu rtsa drug pa'i bar bzhugs / hu pa la/ las brgya tham pa bam po nyi shu rtsa bdun pa nas sum cu rtsa bdun pa'i bar 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'dzangs blun zhes bya ba'i mdo bam po bcu gnyis dang le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa kun tu rgyu sen rings kyis zhus pa zhes bya ba'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/'phags pa byams pa'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa byams pa lung bstan pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / lots+tsha ba ban dhe dpal brtsegs rak+ṣi tas bsgyur ba bcas bzhugs/u pa la/ gang po la sogs pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa brgya pa bam po nyi shu rtsa gnyis dang sdom gyi tshigs su bcad pa bcu pa/ rgya sar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de de ba tsan dras bsgyur te gtan la phab pa/'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi rtogs pa brjod pa shes ldan gyi mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bit+yā ka ra sing ha dang / sarba dzñā de ba dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban 185—582

de dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ phag mo'i rtogs pa brjod pa zhes bya ba'i mdo/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ ma ga dha bzang mo'i rtogs pa brjod pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharma shrī bha dra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba dge slong tshul khrims yon tan gyis bsgyur/ sgra bsgyur gyi lots+tsha ba chen po dge slong rin chen bzang pos bcos te gtan la phab pa bcas bzhugs/ke pa la/ bsod nams stobs kyi rtogs pa brjod pa bam po gnyis pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de de ba tsan dras bsgyur te gtan la phab pa/ zla 'od kyi rtogs pa brjod pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharma shrī bha dra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba dge slong shes rab legs pas bsgyur cing zhus te/ dge slong rin chen bzang pos bcos te gtan la phab pa/dpal gyi sde'i rtogs pa brjod pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharma shrī bha dra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba dge slong shes rab legs pas bsgyur/ sgra bsgyur gyi lots+tsha ba chen po dge slong rin chen bzang pos bcos te gtan la phab pa/ gser mdog gi sngon gyi sbyor ba zhes bya ba 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa rgyal bu don grub kyi mdo bam po gcig pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ tshangs pa'i dra ba'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ thabs mkhas pa chen po sangs rgyas drin lan bsab pa'i mdo bam po bdun dang le'u dgu pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa legs nyes kyi rgyu dang 'bras bu bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de chos grub kyis rgya gar dang rgya'i dpe las bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ dge ba dang mi dge ba'i las kyi rnam par smin pa bstan 105—583

pa'i mdo bam po gcig pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa zla ba'i snying pos zhus pa'i mdo las/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gnas pa dang 'jig pa'i tshul lung bstan pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa glang ru lung bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bam po gcig pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ stag rna'i rtogs pa brjod pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dge slong a dzi ta shrī bha dra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba seng kur dge slong shākya'i 'od kyis bsgyur ba/ sme bdun zhes bya ba skar ma'i mdo/ mdo 'di rgya gar gyi yul nas rgya gar gyi pan ḍi ta gcig dang / thang zam tshang gis khyer te rgya'i yul du bsgyur ro/ /rgya chen po'i yul du rgyas par gyur cing gnas pa las/ rgyal po chen po'i blon po byang chub sems dpa'i rigs su byung ba dad pa dang shes rab dang / ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pa'i gim rtse gong lu ta'i hu'i g.yu'i shrī tha'i hu u rug po gas bskul te/ yu gur gyi bstan pa'i bdag po pradzñā shrīs hor gyi skad dang yi ger bsgyur nas stong phrag gnyis spar du btab/ a lin ti mur ta'i si dus yu gur gyi skad du bsgyur te/stong phrag gcig spar du btab nas chos kyi sbyin pa byas te/ hor dang yu gur la rgyas par byas shing / ta'i hu nyid kyang sngon chad sog po'i chos lugs 'dzin pa la / chos 'di'i byin brlabs kyis sangs rgyas kyi chos la zhugs shing rab tu byung te / 'di'i yon tan rnams nyams su myong bar gyur pa'o/ /slad kyis me mo glang gi lo la lots+tsha ba ma hā pha la dang / shrī ā nan+da badz+ras gung thang gi gtsug lag khang du/ bod kyi skad dang yi ger bsgyur zhing zhus te gtan la phab pa mig bcu gnyis pa zhes bya ba'i mdo 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa bcas bzhugs so// //105—584

'dul ba'i skor la/ khe pa la/ 'dul ba gzhi bam po dang po nas nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa'i bar bzhugs/ge pa la/ 'dul ba gzhi bam po nyi shu rtsa lnga pa nas lnga bcu rtsa bzhi pa'i bar bzhugs/nge pa la/ 'dul ba gzhi bam po lnga bcu rtsa lnga pa nas brgyad cu rtsa gnyis pa'i bar bzhugs/ ce pa la/ 'dul ba gzhi bam po brgyad cu rtsa gsum pa nas brgya dang dgu pa'i bar 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa bzhugs/che pa la so sor thar pa'i mdo bam po gnyis pa/ slob dpon dzi na mi tra dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban de cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'dul ba rnam par 'byed pa bam po dang po nas nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'i bar bcas bzhugs/je pa la/ 'dul ba rnam par 'byed pa bam po nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa nas bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis pa'i bar bzhugs/nye pa la/ 'dul ba rnam par 'byed pa bam po bzhi bcu rtsa gsum pa nas drug cu rtsa gnyis pa'i bar bzhugs/te pa la/ 'dul ba rnam par 'byed pa bam po drug cu rtsa gsum pa nas brgyad cu rtsa gsum pa'i bar/ kha che'i bye brag tu smra ba'i slob dpon dzi na mi tra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa bzhugs/the pa la/ dge slong ma'i so sor thar pa'i mdo bam po gnyis pa/ kha che'i 105—585

bye brag tu smra ba'i slob dpon dzi na mi tra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ dge slong ma'i 'dul ba rnam par 'byed pa bam po nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa/ kha che'i mkhan po sarba dzñā de ba dang / dharmā ka ra dang / rgya gar gyi mkhan po bibyā ka ra pra bha dang / lots+tsha ba ban de dpal gyi lhun pos bsgyur/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bit+yā ka ra pra bha dang /zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de dpal brtsegs kyis/ zhus te gtan la phab pa bcas bzhugs/de pa la/ 'dul ba phran tshegs kyi gzhi bam po dang po nas nyi shu rtsa bdun pa'i bar bzhugs/ne pa la/ 'dul ba phran tshegs kyi gzhi bam po nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa nas lnga bcu rtsa brgyad pa'i bar/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bibyā ka ra pra bha dang / dharma shrī pra bha dang / lots+tsha ba ban de dpal 'byor gyis bsgyur ba bzhugs/pe pa la/ 'dul ba gzhung bla ma bam po bcu gnyis pa 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa / 'dul ba gzhung dam pa bam po dang po nas nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa'i bar bcas bzhugs/phe pa la/ 'dul ba gzhung dam pa bam po nyi shu rtsa gsum pa nas lnga bcu rtsa gsum pa'i bar 'gyur byang ma 'khod pa/ 'phags pa bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi rgyal po/ 'phags pa byams pa'i smon lam/ mchog gi spyod pa'i smon lam / rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ mar me'i lo rgyus dang smon lam gyi mdo/ 'phags pa gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 105—586

las gsungs pa'i smon lam/ 'phags pa stong chen mo rab tu 'joms pa las gsungs pa'i smon lam/ rigs sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo las gsungs pa'i smon lam dang bden tshig 'dul ba lung gi cha shas yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa'i bde legs kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ bde legs kyi tshigs su bcad pa / bde legs su 'gyur ba'i tshigs su bcad pa/ shis par brjod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin la sogs pa gsum gyis bkra shis tshigs su bcad pa/ lhas zhus pa'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ sangs rgyas rabs bdun gyi bkra shis tshigs su bcad pa/ bkra shis tshigs su bcad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang ske/ zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa bcas bzhugs so//legs tshogs dpal gyi dum bu'i ljon/ /'dab ma stong gi mchu yi sgros/ /'dzum la dkar chag nyi 'od kyi/ /phreng ba'i rtse dga' 'di na dgod/ /gangs ri dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal la/ /bzhad gad 'khrungs pa'i lhag bsam mtshor /dad gus rlabs ris 'gyu ba yis/ /legs byas gral la 'di yang bskrun/ /ces rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog gi dkar chag legs tshogs 'dab stong 'dzum pa'i nyi 'od ces bya ba 'di ni/ bka' 'gyur dpe bsdur ma'i mjug tu bka' 'gyur par ma khag gi dkar chag phyogs gcig tu sgrig skabs/ pe cing bka' 'gyur gyi dkar chag yin zer ba re gnyis lag tu chud kyang / mtshan byang rkyang 105—587

ba tsam las 'gyur byang sogs ci yang mi snang zhing / mtshan byang bsdus drags pa dang / chad lhag gi skyon yang mi nyung ba zhig yod pas blo yid tshim pa ma byung ba dang / pe cing bka' 'gyur gyi lo rgyus yig cha khag tu'ang dkar chag 'di dang 'bri mkhan 'di yin gyi gsal kha mi 'dug pas/ phal cher skabs der dkar chag ma bris par mngon pas/ des na 'dir pe cing bka' 'gyur gyi dkar chag rgyas bsdus 'tsham pa zhig yod na ci ma rung snyam ste/ ma bskul dang blangs kyi sgo nas / ldong nge bstan 'dzin grags pa dang ngo mo'i kun bzang nam mkha' gnyis kyis / las zhor du tshegs la ma 'dzems par pe cing bka' 'gyur gyi pod re rer zhib tu mjal nas/ chos kyi bzhugs byang dang / 'gyur byang / le'u dang bam grangs sogs gzhung las ji ltar 'byung ba de ltar chad lhag ma shor bar bsgrigs pa yin la/ 'on kyang / nga tsho mthong thos nyung ba'i dbang gis sngon gyi pe cing bka' 'gyur gyi dkar chag rnying pa yod nas ma mthong ba yin na/blo dang ldan pa su yin kyang dgongs 'gal med par 'di la kha skong gnang rogs zhes zhu ba lags/ 'di yang sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa bla na med pa 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir yun ring du gnas pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga lo/705—588

deb brgya dang lnga pa/krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi bka' bstan dpe sdur khang gis legs sgrig zhus/spung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang gis bsgrun/zhin hwa dpe tshong khang pe cin 'grem spel khang gis bkram/bka' bstan dpe sdur khang shā glopa rdul rtsis 'khor pe cin ta yun ho paXng 'ardokā ṭī kā /na ༵da /dri/ sis dpar btab/ཿ byi / 0 //sbya dzā/dri sdu/ pa/ /sdo / /rdokāṭā//52sa/lha/gra kā/rngo/shā|53123—9
